nodes.name: Fireball Pierce Chance And Increased Mana Cost
nodes.description: Fireball now pierces enemies (continue through targets it hits), but costs more mana.

nodes.name: Fireball Fire Penetration
nodes.description: Fireball hits have additional fire penetration and lightning penetration.

nodes.name: Fireball Fire Crit Chance
nodes.description: Improves Fireball's base critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Fireball Projectile Speed And Damage
nodes.description: Fireball deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and travels faster, causing it to travel farther.

nodes.name: Fireball Crit Chance Reduced Cast Speed
nodes.description: Fireball has additional critical strike chance, but it has less cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Fireball Added Projectiles Two Allocable
nodes.description: Fireball releases additional projectiles that fire in a cone when cast, but costs more mana.

nodes.name: Fireball Extra Projectile After Sequence Node
nodes.description: Fireball releases additional projectiles. These additional projectiles are NOT reduced by the extra projectiles penalty via the {Embers} node.

nodes.name: Fireball Ignite Chance
nodes.description: Fireball hits have a higher chance to ignite enemies.

nodes.name: Fireball Spreading Flames Chance
nodes.description:
Fireball hits have a chance to apply {Spreading Flames}, an ailment which deals fire damage over time and spreads to nearby enemies.

Additionally all damage over time ailments applied by Fireball deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifier).

nodes.name: Fireball Spreading Flames Damage
nodes.description: {Spreading Flames} applied by fireball has additional fire penetration

nodes.name: Fireball Crit Chance Against Ignited
nodes.description: Fireball hits have more critical strike chance against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Fireball Cast Speed
nodes.description: Fireball has increased cast speed.

nodes.name: Fireball Shred Fire Protection On Hit
nodes.description: Fireball hits have a chance to reduce enemy fire resistance.

nodes.name: Fireball Flame Burst After 1 Fewer Hits
nodes.description: Flame Burst requires fewer hits with Fireball to trigger.

nodes.name: Fireball Mana Cost And Damage
nodes.description: Fireball deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and costs less mana.

nodes.name: Fireball Pierce Vs Mana Drain
nodes.description: Fireballs have a chance to pierce enemies (continue through targets it hits), but {Flamethrower} costs more mana per second to channel.

nodes.name: Fireball Reduced Mana Drain
nodes.description: {Flamethrower} costs less mana per second to channel.

nodes.name: Fireball Protection While Channelling
nodes.description: You have additional Armor and Fire Resistance while channeling Fireball's {Flamethrower}.

nodes.name: Fireball Increased Duration
nodes.description: Fireballs last longer, causing them to travel further.

nodes.name: Fireball Added Projectiles One Allocable
nodes.description: Fireball releases additional projectiles that fire in a cone when cast, but costs more mana.

nodes.name: Fireball Converts Crit Chance
nodes.description: Nodes on this tree that add crit chance instead increase stun chance by 20 times the stated value.

nodes.name: Fireball Projectiles In Sequence
nodes.description: Directly cast Fireballs fire in sequence in the same direction and can now hit the same target, but Fireball releases fewer projectiles and has less cast speed for each extra projectile (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Fireball Homing
nodes.description: Fireballs now seek nearby targets.

nodes.name: Fireball Flame Burst After 5 Hits
nodes.description: Hitting the same enemy with several fireballs triggers a {Flame Burst} around them.

nodes.name: Fireball Zero Cost
nodes.description: Fireball has increased cast speed and deals more damage for each extra projectile (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer fires extra projectiles.

nodes.name: Fireball Flamethrower
nodes.description: Fireball becomes a channeled ability that rapidly spews fireballs from your hand, but rapidly drains your mana.

nodes.name: Fireball Added Lightning Damage
nodes.description:
Half of Fireball's base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this portion of its damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Fireball gains a {Lightning} tag.

Fireball also gains additional critical strike multiplier.

nodes.name: Nova Skill Tree Ice Nova
nodes.description: Enables {Ice Nova}, which has a freeze rate of 40. Elemental Nova hits deal more (multiplicative with other modifiers) damage.

nodes.name: Nova Skill Tree Chill Chance
nodes.description: Elemental Nova has a chance to chill enemies and an increased chance to freeze enemies.

nodes.name: Nova Skill Tree Increased Damage
nodes.description: Elemental Nova deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Elemental Nova costs more mana.

nodes.name: Nova Skill Tree Type Repeat Chance
nodes.description: Direct casts of Elemental Nova have a chance to repeat a short distance away from you. This chance is multiplied by the number of Elemental Nova types you have enabled.

nodes.name: Nova Skill Tree Repeat Targets Nearby
nodes.description: Repeated casts from {Elemental Expulsion} will instead target a random nearby enemy within 12 meters, but Elemental Nova has additional mana cost.

nodes.name: Nova Skill Tree Lightning Nova
nodes.description: Enables {Lightning Nova}, which has +1% critical strike chance compared to other Elemental Nova types. Elemental Nova hits deal more (multiplicative with other modifiers) damage.

nodes.name: Nova Skill Tree Crit Chance
nodes.description: Elemental Nova hits have an increased critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Nova Skill Tree Chance To Gain Ward On Kill
nodes.description: Elemental Nova grants ward when it kills an enemy or hits a boss or rare enemy.

nodes.name: Nova Skill Tree Ward Retention
nodes.description: You have additional ward retention for 4 seconds after killing an enemy with Elemental Nova. You may have only one instance of this buff at once.

nodes.name: Nova Skill Tree Fire Nova
nodes.description: Enables {Fire Nova}, which deals 8% more hit damage than other Elemental Nova types. All Elemental Nova hits deal more (multiplicative with other modifiers) damage.

nodes.name: Nova Elemental Penetration
nodes.description: Elemental Nova hits penetrate enemy elemental resistances.

nodes.name: Nova Skill Tree Cast Speed
nodes.description: Elemental Nova hits deal more damage against enemies that are at high health (multiplicative with other modifiers). Elemental Nova has increased cast speed.

nodes.name: Nova Skill Tree Cooldown Recovery
nodes.description: Elemental Nova has a shorter cooldown.

nodes.name: Nova Skill Tree Spark Charge
nodes.description:
Elemental Nova hits have a chance to attach a {Spark Charge}, which deals lightning damage to nearby enemies after 1 second or when the enemy dies.

Additionally, Elemental Nova deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Nova Skill Tree Ignite Chance
nodes.description: Elemental Nova hits have a chance to Ignite enemies.

nodes.name: Nova Skill Tree Extra Charge
nodes.description: You can store an additional charge of Elemental Nova.

nodes.name: Nova Skill Tree Increased Area
nodes.description: Elemental Nova has a larger area of effect.

nodes.name: Nova Skill Tree Overcharge Damage
nodes.description: {Overcharged} Elemental Novas deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased stun chance.

nodes.name: Nova Freeze Shock Ignite
nodes.description:
{Ice Nova} has a higher chance to Freeze enemies.

{Lightning Nova} has a chance to Shock enemies.

{Fire Nova} has a chance to Ignite enemies.

nodes.name: Nova Subtracts Mana Cold Vulnerability
nodes.description: Elemental Nova costs less mana, but you take increased cold damage if you have cast Elemental Nova recently (past 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Nova Base Elemental Damage
nodes.description: Elemental Nova deals more elemental damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a slightly larger area of effect. These effects are doubled when it is directly cast.

nodes.name: Nova Crit Chance and Armour Shred
nodes.description: Elemental Nova has a chance to shred armour on hit and has increased critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Nova Reduced Mana Drain
nodes.description: Elemental Nova costs less mana per second to channel

nodes.name: Nova No Lightning
nodes.description:
You have additional lightning resistance while channeling, but Lightning Nova is disabled.

If you have not taken the {Fire Nova} or {Ice Nova} nodes, then this node re-enables basic Elemental Nova.

nodes.name: Nova Conditional Damage
nodes.description: Elemental Nova hits deal more damage against chilled enemies, frozen enemies, shocked enemies, and ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Nova Skill Tree Chaining Ice Nova
nodes.description: Elemental Nova casts {Freezing Cascade} on hit, creating a cascade of freezing novas that chain between enemies.

nodes.name: Nova Skill Tree Target
nodes.description: Elemental Nova is now cast at a target location instead of around you.

nodes.name: Nova Skill Tree Increased Area Cooldown
nodes.description: Elemental Nova has a significantly larger area of effect when directly cast, and ignites caused by Elemental Nova have increased duration, but Elemental Nova has a 4 second cooldown. The area of effect increase is smaller if Elemental Nova is channeled.

nodes.name: Nova Skill Tree Overcharge
nodes.description: Elemental Novas have a chance to be {Overcharged}. Overcharged Novas shock enemies and have a larger area of effect.

nodes.name: Nova Channelled
nodes.description: Elemental Nova becomes a channeled ability, unleashing 5 novas per second, and rapidly draining your mana. Elemental Nova has a smaller area of effect (multiplicative with other area modifiers).

nodes.name: Nova Skill Tree Crit Damage
nodes.description: Elemental Nova critical strikes deal more damage.

Summon Wolf Skill Tree Dodge Rating
nodes.description: Your Wolves have additional dodge chance, and have increased dodge rating for each point of strength you have.

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Skill Tree Bleed Chance
nodes.description: Wolves have a chance to cause enemies to bleed with their melee attacks.

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Bleed And DoT Damage
nodes.description: Wolves deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) and bleed they inflict has additional Physical Penetration.

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Skill Tree Added Speed
nodes.description: Wolves have increased attack and move speed.

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Skill Tree Damage
nodes.description: Wolves deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Skill Tree Melee Damage
nodes.description: Your Wolves' melee hits deal more damage, have a greater chance to stun (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and it has improved base critical strike chance, but has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Armour and Leech
nodes.description: Wolves have additional armor, and their attacks leech a portion of the physical damage they deal as health.

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Chill Chance
nodes.description: Wolves have a chance to chill enemies on hit.

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Cold Damage
nodes.description: Wolves deal additional cold damage with attacks, and have an increased chance to stun enemies.

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Skill Tree Added Health Regen
nodes.description: Wolves have additional base health regeneration and increased health regeneration.

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Small Lightning Retaliation Chance
nodes.description: Your Wolves have a chance to retaliate with {Storm Bolt} when hit or when they hit an enemy.

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Skill Tree Added Health
nodes.description: Your Wolves have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Skill Tree Lightning Damage
nodes.description: Your Wolves deal more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Skill Tree Melee Lightning Damage
nodes.description: Your Wolves' melee attacks deal additional lightning damage.

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Attunement Scaling
nodes.description: Your Wolves now deal increase damage and have increased health for each point of Attunement you have.

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Damage If Howled
nodes.description: Wolves have more damage and dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers). This bonus is tripled for Wolves that have used {Howl} recently.

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Stun Immunity
nodes.description: Your Wolves cannot be stunned.

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Howl on Your Kill
nodes.description:
When you kill an enemy one of your Wolves has a chance to {Howl}. This does not expend Howl's mana cost or put it on cooldown.

Howl also grants more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased melee attack speed to all affected allies.

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Howl on Hit
nodes.description: The buffs granted by {Howl} last longer and wolves have a chance to Howl when they hit a rare or boss enemy. This does not expend Howl's mana cost or put it on cooldown.

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Haste On Howl
nodes.description: Your Wolves' {Howl} also grant {Haste} for a short duration.

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Slow Chance
nodes.description: Bleed inflicted by Wolves lasts longer and wolves have a chance to slow on hit and when hit.

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Ice Bite Chance
nodes.description:
Your Wolves gain the {Ice Bite} ability, which deals higher damage in a larger area, with a 6 second cooldown. 20% of the remaining cooldown is recovered every time the Wolf hits with an ability other than Ice Bite, including their basic attack.

Ice Bite deals melee cold damage. Consequently this damage scales with your wolves' increases to melee and cold damage, but not increases to their physical damage.

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Skill Tree Leaps
nodes.description: Your Wolves gain a {Leap Attack} to close the gap on distant enemies. Leap Attack has a 10 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Skill Tree Lightning Retaliation
nodes.description: Your Wolves have a chance to retaliate with {Storm Bolt} when hit, and deal more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Additional Wolf
nodes.description: You have an additional wolf companion at all times. This wolf does not count towards your companion limit.

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Additional Wolf Always Howl
nodes.description: While you have the additional wolf from {Permanent Bond} summoned, Summon Wolf is replaced with {Howl}, but you cannot have more than one wolf summoned at a time.

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Infinite Wolves
nodes.description: You can summon Wolves up to your maximum number of companions.

nodes.name: Summon Wolf Howl on Kill
nodes.description: Wolves have a chance to {Howl} on kill. This does not expend Howl's mana cost or put it on cooldown.

nodes.name: Swipe Skill Tree Crit Damage On Hit
nodes.description: While you have {Aspect of the Panther} you have additional critical strike multiplier per Stack. This bonus is doubled if you are dual wielding.

nodes.name: Swipe Bleed Chance
nodes.description: Swipe hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

nodes.name: Swipe Physical Shred Chance
nodes.description: Swipe has a chance to shred physical resistance on hit.

nodes.name: Swipe Health Or Mana Gain
nodes.description: When you attack with Swipe and hit at least one enemy you gain health if you are transformed, or mana if you are not transformed.

nodes.name: Swipe Skill Tree Cull Percent
nodes.description:
Swipe hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). 

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

nodes.name: Swipe Aspect Of The Panther Duration
nodes.description:
Each stack of {Aspect of the Panther} lasts longer and grants increased health regen.

Aspect of the Panther also applies to your {Sabertooth} if you have one.

nodes.name: Swipe Reduced Lightning Damage Cooldown
nodes.description: The cooldown for the effect of the {Storm Claw} node is reset if you summon a Totem.

nodes.name: Swipe Added Lightning Damage
nodes.description:
Swipe has a chance to shock on hit and a portion of Swipe's base damage is converted to Lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not with increases to physical damage.

If you have 5 points in this node, Swipe loses its {Physical} tag.

nodes.name: Swipe Damage And Leech
nodes.description: Swipe deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and leeches a portion of damage dealt as health.

nodes.name: Swipe Skill Tree Damage On Hit
nodes.description: When you attack with Swipe and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of Aspect of the Panther. Each stack lasts 4 seconds and grants you more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Swipe Skill Tree Melee Damage On Hit
nodes.description: Aspect of the Panther can have more stacks and each stack grants you additional melee damage.

nodes.name: Swipe Skill Tree Always Spirit Wolves
nodes.description: When you attack with Swipe and hit at least one enemy you call forth a {Spirit Wolf} from each of your summoned wolves.

nodes.name: Swipe Skill Tree Attack Speed On Hit Keystone
nodes.description: While you have {Aspect of the Panther} you have increased attack and cast speed. This does not scale with the number of stacks.

nodes.name: Swipe Damage Vs Shocked and Chilled
nodes.description: Swipe deals more Lightning Damage per stack of Shock on the target and more Cold Damage per stack of Chill on the target.

nodes.name: Swipe Increased Area
nodes.description: Swipe deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

nodes.name: Swipe Companion Ability On First Hit
nodes.description: When you use Swipe and hit at least one enemy your nearest companion uses its companion ability and is restored to full health.

nodes.name: Swipe Damage To Slowed
nodes.description: Swipe hits deal more damage against slowed enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers)

nodes.name: Swipe Skill Tree Slows
nodes.description: Swipe deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and slows enemies, but has a cooldown.

nodes.name: Swipe Lightning Damage Cooldown
nodes.description:
Swipe deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Every 3 seconds, your next Swipe deals damage in a larger area and has its base damage converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not with increases to physical damage.

Swipe gains a {Lightning} tag.

nodes.name: Swipe Skill Tree Claw Totem
nodes.description: You have a chance to summon a {Claw Totem} when Swipe kills an enemy or hits a rare or boss enemy.

nodes.name: Swipe Skill Tree Spirit Wolves
nodes.description: When you attack with Swipe and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to call forth a {Spirit Wolf} from each of your summoned wolves.

nodes.name: Swipe Lightning Penetration
nodes.description: Swipe has additional lightning penetration based on your Attunement

nodes.name: Swipe Totem Damage On Hit
nodes.description: When you use Swipe and hit at least one enemy, all your totems gain +1 Melee Damage and +1 Spell Damage. This buff stacks and lasts until the totems expire.

Tornado Skill Tree Increased Duration
nodes.description: Tornado lasts longer.

nodes.name: Tornado Skill Tree Pull Multiplier
nodes.description: Tornado has increased pull strength.

nodes.name: Tornado Skill Tree Double Cast
nodes.description: When you directly use Tornado, you have a chance to create an additional Tornado, but Tornadoes have reduced pull strength.

nodes.name: Tornado Skill Tree Casts Lightning Faster
nodes.description: Tornado casts {Storm Bolt} more frequently.

nodes.name: Tornado Skill Tree Increased Base Damage
nodes.description: Tornado deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but costs more mana.

nodes.name: Tornado Skill Tree Stationary
nodes.description: Tornado is now stationary, but deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Tornado Skill Tree Lightning Range
nodes.description: {Storm Bolts} target enemies from further away.

nodes.name: Tornado Skill Tree Storm Orb Frequency
nodes.description: Tornadoes cast {Storm Orbs} more frequently.

nodes.name: Tornado Skill Tree Ignites
nodes.description: Tornado ignites nearby enemies every second.

nodes.name: Tornado Skill Tree Ignite Frequency
nodes.description: Tornado gains a portion of your chance to ignite with fire spells as ignite chance per second.

nodes.name: Tornado Skill Tree Cast Speed
nodes.description: Tornado has increased cast speed and area of effect.

nodes.name: Tornado Skill Tree Attack And Cast Speed On Cast
nodes.description: {Aspect of the Storm} now also grants increased attack and cast speed.

nodes.name: Tornado Skill Tree Mana Regen On Cast
nodes.description: Tornado costs less mana, and {Aspect of the Storm} grants increased mana regeneration.

nodes.name: Tornado Skill Tree Buff Duration
nodes.description: {Aspect of the Storm} lasts longer.

nodes.name: Tornado Skill Tree Instant Cast
nodes.description: Tornado is now instant cast and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but now has a 4 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Tornado Skill Tree Cooldown Recovery Speed
nodes.description: Tornado has a shorter cooldown and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Tornado Skill Tree Casts Lightning
nodes.description: Tornado casts {Storm Bolt} at an enemy within 5 meters every 2 seconds.

nodes.name: Tornado Skill Fire Tornado
nodes.description:
Tornados' base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Tornado deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Tornado Skill Tree Attaches
nodes.description: Tornado deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and attach to you wherever you move, but you can no longer cast additional Tornadoes at once.

nodes.name: Tornado Skill Tree Storm Orbs
nodes.description: Tornado now create a {Storm Orb} every second, but Tornado has less cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Tornado Skill Tree Movement Speed On Cast
nodes.description: Casting Tornado grants {Aspect of the Storm} for 2 seconds, which grants 10% increased movespeed.

nodes.name: Tornado Skill Tree Channel
nodes.description: Tornado is now a channelled skill, sustaining a single tornado that follows your cursor. This tornado deals much more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased area of effect. Modifiers to duration affect its damage instead.

nodes.name: Tornado Skill Tree Channel Buff
nodes.description: While channelling Tornado you take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and have increased dodge rating.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Skill Tree Root Node
Mana Strike Skill Tree Increased Attack Speed
nodes.description: Mana Strike has increased attack speed.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Skill Tree Armor Shred And Shock Chance
nodes.description: Mana Strike has a chance to shred armor and a chance to shock enemies.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Skill Tree Increased Spell Damage On Hit
nodes.description: Mana Strike hits grant you increased spell damage for 4 seconds. This effect can stack, and is doubled when hitting a boss or rare enemy.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Skill Tree Mana On Kill
nodes.description: Mana Strike instantly restores mana when it kills an enemy, or when it hits a boss or rare enemy.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Skill Tree Mana On Crit
nodes.description: Mana Strike instantly restores mana when it critically strikes an enemy.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Skill Tree No Crit Damage
nodes.description: Mana Strike has significant additional critical strike chance, but Mana Strike's critical strikes no longer deal extra damage.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Skill Tree Increased Mana On Hit
nodes.description: Mana Strike grants more mana gained (multiplicative with other modifiers) from its mana orbs and instant restoration.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Skill Tree Knockback
nodes.description:
Mana Strike has a chance to knock enemies back on hit.

This effect has a 2 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Skill Tree Crit Per Mana
nodes.description: Mana Strike gains additional critical strike chance equal to a percentage of your current mana, but its base critical strike chance is removed.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Skill Tree Lightning Damage Per Mana
nodes.description: Mana Strike has additional melee lightning damage equal to a percentage of your current mana.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Skill Tree Damage While Out Of mana
nodes.description: Mana Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you are not on full mana.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Skill Tree Leech While Not Full Mana
nodes.description: Mana Strike leeches a percentage of damage dealt as health while you are not on full mana.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Skill Tree Attack Speed And Lightning Reduced Mana Cost
nodes.description: Mana Strike has increased attack speed. {Mana Arc}'s mana consumption is reduced.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Skill Tree Damage Lightning Increased Mana Cost
nodes.description: Mana Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but {Mana Arc}'s mana consumption is increased.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Skill Tree Increased Area
nodes.description: Mana Strike has an increased area of effect.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Skill Tree Mana On Hit While Out Of Mana
nodes.description: Mana Strike's mana orbs restore additional mana while you are out of mana.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Skill Tree Damage And Shock Chance
nodes.description: Mana Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a chance to shock enemies.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Skill Tree Additional Mana On Hit
nodes.description: Mana Strike's mana orbs restore additional mana.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Percent Mana To Ward
nodes.description: A portion of the mana gained from Mana Strike's mana orbs is instead gained as twice as much ward.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Increased Ward On Hit
nodes.description: {Transfusion} grants more ward (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Mana Strike Triggers Static Orb
nodes.description:
When you directly use Mana Strike and hit at least one enemy, you have a chance to cast {Static Orb}. This chance is doubled while you are above 80% mana. This effect can occur up to 3 times per 2 seconds, and consumes 120% of Static Orb's mana cost.

If Mana Strike has a cooldown, this effect is guaranteed.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Skill Tree Target
nodes.description: Mana Strike hits enemies near the target location, rather than in front of you, but grants significantly less mana (multiplicative with other modifiers) from mana orbs and instant restoration.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Skill Tree Cooldown Mana On Hit
nodes.description: Mana Strike now has a cooldown. It grants more mana gained from mana orbs and instant restoration, and it has more area of effect (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Mana Strike Skill Tree Spark Charge
nodes.description: Mana Strike hits have a chance to attach a {Spark Charge}.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Skill Tree Lightning On Hit
nodes.description: Mana Strike additionally strikes enemies it hits with {Mana Arc} while you are not out of mana. {Mana Arc} consumes 10 mana.

nodes.name: Mana Strike Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Mana Strike's base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage. It now has a chance to freeze enemies.

Shock chance on hit from all sources is converted to frostbite chance for Mana Strike.

Swaps Mana Strike's {Lightning} tag for a {Cold} tag.

nodes.name: Fury Leap Skill Tree Root Node
Fury Leap Skill Tree Crit Damage
nodes.description: Fury Leap's critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Fury Leap Other Reset Chance
nodes.description:
You have a chance to reset Fury Leap's cooldown whenever you kill an enemy with any other skill.

Fury Leap's cooldown can only be reset once every 5 seconds.

nodes.name: Fury Leap Skill Tree Casts Lightning Faster
nodes.description: {Storm Bolts} occur with increased frequency.

nodes.name: Fury Leap Skill Tree Lightning Resets Cooldown
nodes.description:
You have additional spell damage per 2 Attunement while leaping, and kills with {Storm Bolt} have a chance to reset Fury Leap's cooldown.

Fury Leap's cooldown can only be reset once every 5 seconds.

nodes.name: Fury Leap Damage On Landing
nodes.description: When you land, you and your minions gain additional melee damage and spell damage for 3 seconds. This buff can stack.

nodes.name: Fury Leap Skill Tree Attack And Cast Speed On Landing
nodes.description: When you land, you and your minions gain {Frenzy} for 3 seconds, which increases attack and cast speed. Frenzy cannot stack.

nodes.name: Fury Leap Skill Tree Stun Chance
nodes.description: Fury Leap has an increased chance to stun enemies and stuns it inflicts last longer.

nodes.name: Fury Leap Skill Tree Pull Chance
nodes.description: Fury Leap pulls enemies when you land.

nodes.name: Fury Leap Skill Tree Vines At End
nodes.description: Fury Leap has a chance to cast {Summon Vines} where you land.

nodes.name: Fury Leap Skill Tree Area
nodes.description: Fury Leap deals damage in a larger area and costs less mana.

nodes.name: Fury Leap Skill Tree Damage Against Full Life
nodes.description: Fury Leap hits deal more damage against enemies at full health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Fury Leap Increased Damage
nodes.description: Fury Leap deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you leech a portion of the damage it deals as health.

nodes.name: Fury Leap Always Crit Below Half Health
nodes.description: While you are below half health, Fury Leap always critically strikes.

nodes.name: Fury Leap Reset On Kill
nodes.description:
Fury Leap's cooldown is reset when you kill an enemy with a short leap.

Fury Leap's cooldown can only be reset once every 5 seconds.

nodes.name: Fury Leap Skill Tree Pets Jump
nodes.description: Your Wolf, Sabertooth, and Raptor companions leap with you.

nodes.name: Fury Leap Skill Tree Vines At Start
nodes.description: Fury Leap has a chance to cast {Summon Vines} where you leap from.

nodes.name: Fury Leap Skill Tree Casts Lightning
nodes.description: Fury Leap creates {Storm Bolts} while you are leaping.

nodes.name: Fury Leap Cooldown Recovery Speed
nodes.description: Fury Leap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a shorter cooldown.

nodes.name: Fury Leap Casts Upheaval
nodes.description: When you land with Fury Leap you cast Upheaval. This consumes Upheaval's mana cost and requires positive mana.

nodes.name: Fury Leap Immune While Leaping
nodes.description: You are immune to damage while leaping.

nodes.name: Fury Leap Damage Per Distance
nodes.description: Fury Leap deals more damage based on how far you leap.

nodes.name: Fury Leap Heal on Landing
nodes.description: When you land, you and your minions are healed.

nodes.name: Fury Leap Cleanse on Landing
nodes.description: When you land you cleanse all ailments on you and your minions.

nodes.name: Meteor Skill Tree Increased Damage
nodes.description: Meteor deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Meteor has reduced cast speed.

nodes.name: Meteor Skill Tree Cast Speed
nodes.description: Meteor has increased cast speed, but costs more mana. Meteors fall faster.

nodes.name: Meteor Skill Tree Against Full Health
nodes.description: Meteor deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and even more against enemies at full health.

nodes.name: Meteor Skill Tree Shrapnel Damage
nodes.description: {Shrapnel} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Meteor Skill Tree Shrapnel Speed
nodes.description: {Shrapnel} travels faster, causing it to travel further.

nodes.name: Meteor Skill Tree Shrapnel Pierces
nodes.description: {Shrapnel} projectiles pierce (continue through targets they hit), but travel slower.

nodes.name: Meteor Skill Tree Stun Chance
nodes.description: Meteor has a chance to stun enemies and stuns it inflict last longer.

nodes.name: Meteor Skill Tree Fall Speed
nodes.description: Meteor falls faster.

nodes.name: Meteor Skill Tree Shower Radius
nodes.description: Meteor deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but meteors fall further apart.

nodes.name: Meteor Skill Tree More Meteors
nodes.description: When directly cast, more Meteors fall per cast, but individual Meteors deal damage in a smaller area.

nodes.name: Meteor Skill Tree Frequency
nodes.description: Meteors fall more frequently. This does not affect the total number of Meteors that fall.

nodes.name: Meteor Skill Tree Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Meteor costs less mana.

nodes.name: Meteor Increased Area
nodes.description: Meteors deals damage in a larger area of effect.

nodes.name: Meteor Crit Chance
nodes.description: Improves Meteor's base critical strike chance. Meteor has a chance to deal damage in a significantly increased area.

nodes.name: Meteor Crit Multi
nodes.description: Meteor critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Meteor Additional Meteors
nodes.description: When directly cast, more Meteors fall per cast.

nodes.name: Meteor Mana Recovered
nodes.description:
After you cast Meteor you recover a portion of the mana spent over the next three seconds. 

You can only recover mana from one cast at once, so if you cast meteor again within three seconds you lose the remaining mana you would have recovered from the first cast.

nodes.name: Meteor Fire Damage Buff
nodes.description: Casting Meteor grants the {Craterborn} buff, granting additional fire penetration and increased cast speed for a short duration. Craterborn does not stack.

nodes.name: Meteor Mana From Fireball
nodes.description: Directly casting Fireball while you have {Craterborn} grants ward and restores your mana.

nodes.name: Meteor Non Fire Damage
nodes.description: Meteors deal more damage of all types except fire (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Meteor Skill Tree Shrapnel Chance
nodes.description: Meteor has a chance to break into {Shrapnel} on impact, hitting nearby enemies.

nodes.name: Meteor Skill Tree Twin Meteors
nodes.description: When directly cast, an additional Meteor falls within a 4m radius of the first, but Meteor costs much more mana.

nodes.name: Meteor Skill Tree Line
nodes.description: Meteors fall in a line towards where you aim, but Meteor costs more mana.

nodes.name: Meteor Always Crit
nodes.description: Meteor always crits if you have more than 400 mana before you cast it.

nodes.name: Meteor Frost Claw on Impact
nodes.description: Meteors cast {Frost Claw} towards a nearby enemy on impact, consuming 120% of Frost Claw's mana cost.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Skill Tree Root Node
Lightning Blast Chain Range
nodes.description: Lightning Blast chains have increased range.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Cast Speed
nodes.description: Lightning Blast has increased cast speed.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast More Damage Against Shocked And Chilled
nodes.description: Lightning Blast hits deal more damage to chilled or shocked enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Blind Chance
nodes.description: Lightning Blast hits have a chance to blind enemies.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Shock Nova
nodes.description: Lightning Blast has a chance to create a {Spark Nova} around the first enemy hit. Spark Nova deals spell lightning damage to all enemies in a small area.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Shock Chance
nodes.description: Lightning Blast hits have a chance to shock enemies.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Freeze Rate
nodes.description: Lightning Blast has a higher chance to freeze enemies.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Ward On Hit
nodes.description: Lightning Blast hits grant you ward.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Ward Per Mana Spent
nodes.description: Casting Lightning Blast grants you ward per mana spent. This only counts the upfront mana cost, not the channelling cost if Lightning Blast is channelled.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Base Crit And Damage
nodes.description: Improves Lightning Blast's base critical strike chance, and Lightning Blast deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Added Lightning Damage And Forks
nodes.description: Lightning Blast hits have added lightning damage, and Lightning Blast chains can fork in addition to chain.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Lightning Aegis Chance
nodes.description: When you cast Lightning Blast you have a chance to be granted {Lightning Aegis,} which grants 50% increased lightning damage and 25% less damage taken. Lightning Aegis causes an explosion of lightning damage when you lose 25% of your health or after 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Double Cast And Crit Multi
nodes.description:
Lightning Blast has a chance to double cast, and Lightning Blast critical strikes deal more damage.

Lightning Blast cannot double cast if it is channelled or cast by another skill.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Increased Damage And Reduced Chain Damage
nodes.description: Lightning Blast deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but this damage bonus is lessened each time Lightning Blast chains.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Spark Charge Chance
nodes.description: Lightning Blast hits have a chance to apply a {Spark Charge}.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Spark Charge Damage
nodes.description: {Spark Charges} applied by Lightning Blast deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Detonate Spark Charges
nodes.description: If Lightning Blast hits an enemy already affected by {Spark Charge} the Spark Charge explodes, dealing lightning damage to all nearby enemies.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast No Cost When OOM And Cannot Chain
nodes.description: While out of mana, Lightning Blast has no cost, but cannot chain.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Quadrouple Cast
nodes.description:
When double casting, Lightning Blast instead has a chance to quadruple cast.

Lightning Blast cannot quadruple cast if it is channelled.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Channel Cost Reduction
nodes.description: Reduces Lightning Blast's channel cost if Lightning Blast cannot chain.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Additional Chains Per Recent Cast
nodes.description: Lightning Blast chains an additional time for each Lightning Blast you have directly cast recently up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Chains To Allies
nodes.description: Lightning Blast can now chain to you or your allies, granting increased damage and critical strike chance for 4 seconds. This buff cannot stack.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Lightning Blast now has a chance to freeze and its base lightning damage is converted to cold damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from this tree is converted to chill chance.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Channelled
nodes.description:
Lightning Blast is now a powerful channelled attack, hitting enemies caught within it but costs mana per second to channel and provides less ward when you hit enemies. You do not regenerate mana while channelling.

This is incompatible with the {Focal Blast} node. If you have taken both, this will not work.

Lightning Blast cannot double cast and only chains every 5th cast if it is channelled.

Lightning blast hits grant half as much ward from the {Positive Protection} node and have 50% reduced chance to apply ailments.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Increased Maximum Chains And Mana Cost
nodes.description: Lightning blast can chain additional times, but costs more mana.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Line Damage And No Chain
nodes.description:
Lightning Blast now deals damage to all enemies in a line, but no longer chains or forks. Lightning Blast hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each time it would have chained (up to your maximum).

This node is incompatible with the {Insidious Conduction} node. If you have taken both, {Insidious Conduction} will not work.

nodes.name: Lightning Blast Chains Hit Same Enemy
nodes.description: Lightning Blast chains now hit the same target after a delay, but no longer chains to additional enemies. Lightning Blast chains half as many times rounded up.

nodes.name: Ice Ward Skill Tree Root Node
Ice Ward Skill Tree Additional Block Elemental Protection
Ice Ward Skill Tree Ward Gain on Block
Ice Ward Skill Tree Additional Block Chance
Ice Ward Skill Tree Reduced Mana Regeneration Penalty
Ice Ward Skill Tree Nova Area
Ice Ward Skill Tree Ward Retention
Ice Ward Skill Tree Additional Armour
Ice Ward Skill Tree Ward Regen
Ice Ward Skill Tree Nova Frequency
Ice Ward Skill Tree Nova Damage
Ice Ward Skill Tree Nova Crit Chance
Ice Ward Skill Tree Nova Crit Multi
Ice Ward Skill Tree Block Immunity
Ice Ward Skill Tree Ice Nova
Glacier Skill Tree Chill Chance
nodes.description: Each of Glacier’s explosions has a chance to chill enemies.

nodes.name: Glacier Skill Tree Damage 1
nodes.description: Glacier’s smallest explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Glacier Skill Tree Damage 2
nodes.description: Glacier’s middle-sized explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Glacier Skill Tree Damage 3
nodes.description: Glacier’s largest explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Glacier Skill Tree Chill Chance 1
nodes.description: Glacier’s smallest explosion has a chance to chill enemies.

nodes.name: Glacier Skill Tree Chill Chance 2 And Damage
nodes.description: Glacier’s middle-sized explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a chance to chill enemies.

nodes.name: Glacier Skill Tree Chill Chance 3 And Damage
nodes.description: Glacier’s largest explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a chance to chill enemies.

nodes.name: Glacier Skill Tree Vortex Chance 1
nodes.description: Glacier’s smallest explosion has a chance to create an {Ice Vortex}, which lasts for 4 seconds and deals spell cold damage over time.

nodes.name: Glacier Skill Tree Vortex Chance 2
nodes.description: Glacier’s middle-sized explosion has a greater chance to create an {Ice Vortex}, and the {Rime} buff has increased duration.

nodes.name: Glacier Skill Tree Vortex Chance 3
nodes.description: Glacier’s largest explosion has a greater chance to create an {Ice Vortex}, and the {Rime} buff has increased effect.

nodes.name: Glacier Rime
nodes.description: When you cast Glacier you gain the {Rime} buff which increases your damage over time and freeze rate multiplier.

nodes.name: Glacier Skill Tree Super Middle Explosion
nodes.description: Glacier’s middle-sized explosion deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Glacier costs more mana.

nodes.name: Glacier Skill Stun Chance
nodes.description: Glacier has an increased chance to freeze and stun enemies.

nodes.name: Glacier Skill Tree Mana On Crit
nodes.description: Critical hits with Glacier grant mana equal to a percentage of your maximum mana, up to a limited number of times per second.

nodes.name: Glacier Skill Tree Mana On Kill
nodes.description: Glacier kills grant mana equal to a percentage of your maximum mana.

nodes.name: Glacier Skill Crit Chance
nodes.description: Greatly improves Glacier’s base critical strike chance, but reduces its critical strike multiplier.

nodes.name: Glacier Freeze Chance Vs Damage
nodes.description: Glacier has a higher chance to freeze enemies, but deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Glacier Hit Damage
nodes.description: Glacier costs less mana and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Glacier Ward On Crit
nodes.description: You gain ward on critical strikes with Glacier.

nodes.name: Glacier Skill Tree Vortex Chance
nodes.description: Each of Glacier’s explosions has a chance to create an {Ice Vortex}, which lasts for 4 seconds and deals spell cold damage over time.

nodes.name: Glacier Skill Tree Removes Largest
nodes.description: Glacier costs less mana, but the largest explosion is disabled.

nodes.name: Glacier Skill Tree Reverse
nodes.description: Glacier’s explosions occur in reverse order.

nodes.name: Glacier Skill No Movement
nodes.description: All of Glacier’s explosions occur at a target location, but Glacier's critical hits no longer deal extra damage (compared to non-critical hits).

nodes.name: Glacier Skill Tree Super Vortex Chance
nodes.description: {Ice Vortices} created by Glacier have a chance to instead become a {Greater Ice Vortex} that deals significantly more damage and has a larger radius.

nodes.name: Glacier More Damage To Bosses
nodes.description: Glacier deals more hit damage to rare and boss enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Glacier Double Chill
nodes.description: Chill chance granted by this tree is doubled. Glacier hits deal more damage to chilled enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Glacier Teleport
nodes.description:
When you directly cast Glacier you are teleported to the target location, as long as the location is accessible. This does not count as casting the Teleport skill and is not affected by Teleport's skill tree.

Glacier also gains a cooldown and now counts as a {Traversal} skill.

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Root Node
Summon Bear Skill Tree Damage And Bleed Chance
nodes.description: Your bear deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Thorn Burst Damage
nodes.description: {Thorn Burst} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a chance to inflict bleed on hit.

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Thorn Burst Retaliation
nodes.description: Your bear also releases a {Thorn Burst} when hit, up to a limited number of times per 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Thorn Burst Armor Shred
nodes.description: {Thorn Burst} has a chance to shred armor on hit.

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Swipe Cooldown
nodes.description: Your bear's {Swipe} has a shorter cooldown.

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Swipe Damage And Area
nodes.description: Your bear deals more damage with Swipe (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased area with Swipe.

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Added Health And Tenacity
nodes.description: Your bear has more health and takes less damage at low health (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Crit Chance
nodes.description: Your bear has additional critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Crit Damage
nodes.description: Your bear takes less damage from critical strikes and its own critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Armour
nodes.description: Your bear has additional armor based on your strength.

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Thorn Bear
nodes.description: Your bear's basic attack releases a {Thorn Burst}, a spell that deals physical damage around the bear.

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Health Regen
nodes.description:
Your bear has more health regeneration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

While you have an active bear companion, you have more health regeneration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Swipe
nodes.description:
Your bear can use {Swipe} with a 2 second cooldown. Your Bear's Swipe scales with its own stats, but is affected by your Swipe Tree.

Your bear deals additional melee physical damage per 3 points of your Strength.

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Earthquake
nodes.description: Your bear can use {Earthquake}, with a 6 second cooldown. When cast this way, Earthquake uses your bear's stats but your Earthquake tree. Earthquakes cast by your bear deal less damage.

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Thorn Burst Poison
nodes.description: {Thorn Burst} has a chance to poison enemies on hit. Additionally, your bear deals more poison damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Bear Damage Per Bleed
nodes.description: Your bear has increased movement speed and deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed on the target (up to 30).

nodes.name: Summon Bear Area
nodes.description: Your bear's abilities have increased area of effect.

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Earthquake Reset
nodes.description: Your bear gains an additional charge for Earthquake. When you directly cast {Warcry} or enter {Werebear Form}, your bear restores a charge for Earthquake.

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Lightning Conversion
nodes.description:
The base physical damage of your bear's melee attack is converted to lightning, and it has a {Lightning} tag instead of {Physical}.

Your bear shocks enemies on hit.

Your bear gains the ability to teleport towards enemies, on an 8 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Attack Speed
nodes.description: Your bear has increased attack speed.

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Stun Immunity
nodes.description: Your bear has increased movement speed and cannot be stunned.

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Earthquake Causes Thorn Bursts
nodes.description: Your bear has a chance to cast a {Thorn Burst} from each enemy hit by its {Earthquake}. This chance is tripled against bosses and rare enemies.

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Roar Area And Effect
nodes.description: Your bear's {Roar} has increased area and healing effectiveness.

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Roar Damage Mitigation
nodes.description: Your bear's {Roar} also grants itself and your minions less damage taken for 6 seconds.

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Roar Frailty
nodes.description: Your bear's {Roar} inflicts Frailty on enemies.

nodes.name: Summon Bear Skill Tree Roar Damage Redirect
nodes.description: Your bear's {Roar} also grants you a percentage of damage taken redirected to your highest health minion for 6 seconds.

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Mana Regain
nodes.description: You regain mana when a Thorn Totem dies or is unsummoned.

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Tree Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Summon Thorn Totem costs less mana.

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Tree Poison Chance
nodes.description: Thorn Totem hits have a chance to poison enemies.

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Poison Duration
nodes.description: Poison and Frostbite inflicted by Thorn Totem last longer.

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Freeze Chance From Attunement
nodes.description: Thorn Totem has a higher chance to freeze enemies, and a greater chance to freeze enemies for each point of Attunement you have.

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Added Cold Damage
nodes.description: Thorn Totem deals additional spell cold damage, including its own thorns.

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Tree Spell Damage vs Distance And Speed
nodes.description: Thorn Totems deal more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but their projectiles travel more slowly.

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Tree Extra Projectiles
nodes.description: Thorn Totems have a chance to release twice as many thorns with each burst.

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Pierce
nodes.description: Thorn Totem's thorns can pierce enemies up to a maximum

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Tree Damage vs Cast Speed
nodes.description: Thorn Totem deals more damage, but has less cast speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Tree Double Damage Chance
nodes.description: Thorn Totem's thorns have a chance to deal double damage on hit.

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Tree Armour Shred Chance
nodes.description: Thorn Totem hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Tree Increased Speed
nodes.description: Thorn Totem's thorns travel faster and farther.

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Summoning Speed
nodes.description: You summon Thorn Totem faster and all Thorn Totems have increased cast speed.

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Tree More Health
nodes.description: Thorn Totems have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and additional physical resistance.

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Tree Duration
nodes.description: Thorn Totems last longer and have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers)

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Tree Crit
nodes.description: Thorn Totems have an increased critical strike chance and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Damage Per Poison Stack
nodes.description: Thorn Totem's thorn hits deal more damage per stack of poison on the target (multiplicative with other modifiers) up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Tree More Totems
nodes.description: You can have additional Thorn Totems active, but Summon Thorn Totem costs more mana.

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Ring
nodes.description: You summon your maximum number of Thorn Totems at once in a ring around the target location, but your maximum number of Thorn Totems is reduced and Summon Thorn Totem costs additional mana per additional totem summoned.

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Tree Poison Cloud
nodes.description:
When Thorn Totems die or are unsummoned they release a {Poison Burst}, which deals a small amount of physical spell damage on hit and inflicts poison.

Thorn Totem gains a {Poison} tag, but this does not affect the damage type of Thorn Totems' other abilities.

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Convert To Cold
nodes.description:
Thorn Totem's thorns gain a chance to freeze and 100% of their base physical damage is converted to cold damage. Consequently its damage now scales with your totems' increases to cold damage instead of physical damage.

All poison chance is converted to frostbite chance for Thorn Totems.

Thorn Totems have additional cold resistance.

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Single Projectile
nodes.description: Thorn Totems fire only one thorn with each burst, but they have massively increased cast speed, are more accurate with their thorns, and their thorns' hits deal more damage to rare enemies and bosses (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Thorn Totem Tree Homing
nodes.description: Thorn Totem's thorns now seek nearby targets, but Thorn Totem has less cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Cull
nodes.description: Serpent Strike hits have a chance to instantly kill enemies that are below a threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Freeze Rate
nodes.description: Serpent Strike hits have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Serpent Venom Damage Per Vit
nodes.description: Serpent Venom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your Vitality, and if you have 50 Vitality you regain mana when you inflict an enemy with Serpent Venom or refresh its duration.

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Poison And Damage Per Poison
nodes.description: Serpent Strike hits have a higher chance to poison on hit and they deal more melee damage per stack of poison on the target, up to a limit.

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Scorpion Ability
nodes.description:
When you lunge forwards with Serpent Strike, if you have a {Scorpion} it casts its companion ability, {Venom Nova}, twice, once centred on itself, and once centred on you.

This effect has a 12 second cooldown, but ignores Venom Nova's regular cooldown and does not put it on cooldown.

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Constrictor
nodes.description: You gain a stack of {Constrictor} every 0.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 4. When you use Serpent Strike all stacks are consumed causing the attack to deal more damage per stack (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Constrictor Poison
nodes.description: Each stack of {Constrictor} also grants Serpent Strike additional poison chance and increased poison duration when consumed

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Constrictor Mana
nodes.description: You regain mana when you consume a stack of {Constrictor}.

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Dodge Rating On Use
nodes.description:
You gain {Slither} for 4 seconds when you use Serpent Strike and hit at least one enemy.

Each stack grants you more dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Bleed Chance
nodes.description: Serpent Strike hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Attack Speed
nodes.description: Serpent Strike has increased attack speed.

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Armour Shred
nodes.description: Serpent Strike hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Health On Crit And Kill
nodes.description: You regain health when Serpent Strikes kills or critically strikes an enemy.

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Crit Multi
nodes.description: Serpent Strike's critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Snake Recovery
nodes.description: {Primal Serpents} have increased melee attack speed and are granted health when they hit enemies with a melee attack.

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Snake Health
nodes.description: {Primal Serpents} have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and additional armour

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Snake Poison
nodes.description: {Primal Serpents}'s hits have an additional chance to poison enemies and inflict {frailty}.

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Heal Snake
nodes.description: Instead of summoning a new serpent when the {Primal Serpent} node's effect triggers, you heal your current serpent to full health and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds. This damage buff can stack.

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Snek
nodes.description: When Serpent Strike kills an enemy or hits a rare or boss enemy, you have a chance to summon a {Primal Serpent}.

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Serpent Venom
nodes.description: Serpent Strike hits have a chance to inflict {Serpent Venom}, an ailment that deals poison damage over time and prevents enemies from landing critical strikes. It lasts 3 seconds and cannot stack.

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Lunge If Out Of Range
nodes.description: When you attempt to use Serpent Strike against a target that is slightly out of range you will lunge forwards before attacking.

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Serpent Strike now has a chance to freeze and its base physical damage is converted to cold damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to Frostbite chance.

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Frostbite Duration
nodes.description: Frostbite inflicted by Serpent Strike lasts longer and has additional cold penetration

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Dodge Per Cold Res
nodes.description: You have additional dodge rating per cold resistance, for each stack of the {Slither} buff.

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Bleed Chance Per Maelstrom
nodes.description: Each active stack of {Maelstrom} grants Serpent Strike additional chance to inflict bleed on hit and more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Armour Shred Effect Per Dex
nodes.description: Armour Shred inflicted by Serpent Strike has an increased effect based on your Dexterity.

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Serpent Venom Damage Per Poison
nodes.description: Serpent Venom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on the number of poison and frostbite stacks on them, up to a maximum benefit from each ailment.

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Serpent Venom Damage Per Crit
nodes.description:
Serpent Venom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your melee critical strike chance.

If your melee crit chance is above 50% then Serpent Venom deals its damage twice as quickly. This does not increase the total damage it deals over its full duration, but rather halves its duration and doubles its damage per second.

nodes.name: Serpent Strike Poison Pen
nodes.description: Ailments applied by Serpent Strike and {Primal Serpents} have additional poison penetration.

nodes.name: Static Orb Shock Chance
nodes.description: Static Orb hits has a chance to shock enemies.

nodes.name: Static Orb Mana Cost And Damage From Max Mana
nodes.description: Static Orb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 25 maximum mana, but Static Orb costs additional mana equal to a portion of your maximum mana, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Static Orb Static Ground
nodes.description: The explosion now leaves behind {Charged Ground} dealing lightning damage over time in an area. Creating another Charged Ground halves the remaining duration of all existing ones.

nodes.name: Static Orb Static Ground Damage From Crit Multi
nodes.description: {Charged Ground} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per additonal critical strike multiplier.

nodes.name: Static Orb Allies Shock Chance In Static Ground
nodes.description: You and allies have additonal shock chance and increased shock effectiveness while inside {Charged Ground's} area.

nodes.name: Static Orb No Pull Less Mana Cost
nodes.description: Static Orb costs less mana, but it no longer pulls enemies.

nodes.name: Static Orb Rare Explosion Much Less Mana Cost
nodes.description:
Static Orb costs significantly less mana, but it now has a chance to not explode.

If you {Scatter Blast} then you only have a chance to create small orbs, and if you have {Orbital Fulmination} all static orbs orbit you for a reduced duration.

nodes.name: Static Orb Returns On Not Exploding But Added Mana Cost
nodes.description:
If Static Orb does not explode it returns to you and deals damage on the way back, but it costs more mana.

This node has no effect if you have {Orbital Fulmination}.

nodes.name: Static Orb Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Static Orb's base lightning damage is converted to cold and it gains a base freeze rate, but it no longer pulls enemies. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} and effects related to shock now depend on Frostbite instead.

nodes.name: Static Orb Freeze Rate
nodes.description: The orb and the explosion have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

nodes.name: Static Orb No Tendrils Much More Freeze Rate
nodes.description: The orb and the explosion have a higher chance to freeze enemies, but the explosion no longer creates Tendrils.

nodes.name: Static Orb Orbit
nodes.description:
The orb now orbits you for up to 3 seconds before exploding, but you are limited to a few orbs and casting more will detonate older ones.

Static Orb gains damage and explosion area with time rather than travel distance, but scales up to the same maximum as before.

nodes.name: Static Orb Spell Damage To Shocked Enemies
nodes.description: Static Orb deals more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to shocked enemies.

nodes.name: Static Orb Static Charges On Hit With Orb
nodes.description: Static Orb generates {Static Charges} on hit.

nodes.name: Static Orb Stun Chance And Duration Plus Ward On Stun
nodes.description: The explosion has a higher chance to stun, increased stun duration and you gain ward on stun with the explosion.

nodes.name: Static Orb Crit Multi
nodes.description: Static Orb's critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Static Orb More Tendrils
nodes.description: The explosion creates additional {Tendrils} to hit enemies outside the explosion area.

nodes.name: Static Orb Lightning Aegis Duration
nodes.description: Static Orb grants you {Lightning Aegis} for a short duration on cast, which grants 50% increased lightning damage and 25% less damage taken. Lightning Aegis causes an explosion of lightning damage when you lose 25% of your health or after 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Static Orb More Damage And Area Automatic Early Explosion
nodes.description: Static Orb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area, but automatically explodes after 4 meters.

nodes.name: Static Orb More Damage With Distance But Slower
nodes.description: The explosion's damage ramps up more with distance, but it travels slower.

nodes.name: Static Orb Arching Orb No Pull But Faster
nodes.description: Static Orb deals more damage and now travel faster and in an arcing trajectory rather than a straight line, but it no longer pulls or hits enemies until it explodes.

nodes.name: Static Orb More Chains On Next Lightning Blast
nodes.description: After using Static Orb the next {Lightning Blasts} cast from any source chain 2 additonal times.

nodes.name: Static Orb Next Lightning Blasts Regain Static Orb Mana
nodes.description:
For 4 seconds after using Static Orb directly casting {Lightning Blast} and hitting at least one enemy will return 25% of Static Orb's mana cost. 

This effect can only occur a limited number of times.

nodes.name: Static Orb More Damage And Speed
nodes.description: Static Orb travels faster and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Static Orb Explodes On Contact More Damage Per Mana Cost
nodes.description: Static Orb explodes on hit rather than piercing enemies. The orb deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 1 mana cost.

nodes.name: Static Orb Double Cast Chance On Rare And Bosses
nodes.description: You have a chance to cast an additional Static Orb towards the target when it hits a rare enemy or boss. This effect has a short cooldown.

nodes.name: Static Orb Smaller Arching Orbs
nodes.description: Casting Static Orb sends out smaller orbs in a cone in front of you. These small orbs can hit the same target as the large orb, but cannot explode and do not pull.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Shockwave Poison Chance
nodes.description: Root Wave hits have a chance to poison enemies, and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Entangling Roots DoT Poison Conversion
nodes.description: Entangling Roots' base physical damage over time is converted to poison and it now has the poison tag. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to physical damage.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Blind
nodes.description: Rooted enemies are also blinded.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Creates Seeds
nodes.description:
Entangling Roots now creates seeds in the area. When an enemy draws too close to a seed it bursts, releasing a burst of spores that slow and poison enemies.

If you have taken the {Winternid Thorns} node, the seed bursts inflict {Frostbite} and {Chill} instead of slow and poison.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Seeds Heal
nodes.description:
The spores from {Seeds} now heal you and your allies. 

This effect is tripled for minions.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Haste On Allies
nodes.description: Seeds now burst when an ally draws close to them which grants you and your allies the {Haste} buff, granting you 30% increased movement speed.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Seeds Burst From Upheaval
nodes.description: Seeds now burst when you hit them with {Upheaval} and deal damage in a larger area when detonated this way.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Seeds Grow Vines After Burst
nodes.description: Seeds will now grow {Vines} when they burst.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Rooting Duration
nodes.description: Enemies hit by the Root Wave are rooted for an increased duration. This affects the immobilize duration, the total damage dealt, and any other effects attached to the root.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Cannot Be Dodged
nodes.description: Root Wave cannot be dodged.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Roots Buffs Totems
nodes.description: Entanging Roots now wraps around your totems and vines for twice the duration as enemies, granting them additional armor and increased attack and cast speed.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Roots Buffs And Roots Spriggan
nodes.description: Entangling Roots now also wraps around your Spriggans for twice the duration as enemies, granting them all buffs from {Frenzying Thorns} as well as additional projectiles with their {Thorn Volley}.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Roots Leech
nodes.description: Entangling Roots leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health to you.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Roots More Damage
nodes.description: Entangling Roots deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Root Damage Accelerates
nodes.description: Entangling Roots damage accelerates over time, dealing more damage each second (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Circle Mode
nodes.description: You now cause Entangling Roots to expand in a circle around you rather than a cone in front, but it now has a cooldown.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Cast From Nearest Totem
nodes.description: Entangling Roots is now cast from the nearest totem to your cursor.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Autocast When Stunned
nodes.description:
When you are stunned, you now cast Entangling Roots. 

This effect has a 20 seconds cooldown, which doesn't affect Entangling Root's cooldown.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Shockwave Physical Shred
nodes.description: Root Wave hits shred enemy physical resistance.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Shockwave Damage And Stun Chance
nodes.description: Root Wave's hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have a higher chance to stun enemies.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Entangling Roots' base damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Physical Resistance Shred from all sources is converted to Cold Resistance Shred chance and effects related to Physical Resistance Shred now depend on Cold Resistance Shred instead.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Frostbite Conversion
nodes.description:
Root Wave has a chance to inflict {Frostbite}.

Poison chance from all sources is converted to Frostbite for Root Wave and effects related to poison now depend on Frostbite instead.

Root Wave gains additional freeze rate per character level.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Res Reduction
nodes.description: Root Wave lowers the physical resistance of affected enemies for the duration of its root. This effect stacks.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Shockwave Heals Allies
nodes.description:
Root Wave now heals other allies it hits, and has increased area of effect. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

This effect is tripled for minions.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Physical Damage Buff To Allies
nodes.description: Root Wave causes your minions and other allies it hits to deal additional physical damage with spells and attacks for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Adaptive Spell Damage Buff To Allies
nodes.description: Root Wave causes your minions and other allies it hits to deal additional damage with spells for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Crit Buff To Allies
nodes.description: Root Wave causes your Wolves and Bear it hits to have improved base critical strike chance and deal more damage with critical strikes for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Poison Chance Buff To Allies
nodes.description:
Root Wave causes your minions and other allies it hits to have additional chance to poison on hit. This buff lasts 8 seconds and does not stack.

The effect is tripled for Scorpions and Serpents.

nodes.name: Entangling Roots Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Entangling Roots has increased mana efficiency.

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Tree Chill Chance
nodes.description: {Shrapnel}, {Explosive Orb} and {Fire Glyph} have a chance to chill enemies and a chance to inflict frostbite on hit.

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Tree More Damage Against Chilled
nodes.description: {Shrapnels} hits deal more damage against chilled enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Tree Shrapnel Speed
nodes.description: {Shrapnel} travels faster, causing it to also travel further. Shrapnel is created more frequently.

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Tree Damage VS Duration
nodes.description:
Volcanic Orb core and {Shrapnel} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Volcanic Orb's duration is reduced. 

If you have taken the {Explosive Ground} node, Volcanic Orb leaves Explosive Ground more frequently.

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Tree Increased Speed
nodes.description: You have increased cast Speed with Volcanic Orb, and Volcanic Orb travels faster, causing it to also travel further.

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Tree Shrapnel Stun Chance
nodes.description: {Shrapnel} has an increased chance to stun enemies and a chance to ignite on hit.

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Tree Shrapnel Damage
nodes.description: {Shrapnel} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Tree Shrapnel Pierces
nodes.description: {Shrapnel} pierces enemies (continues through enemies it hits).

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Tree Explosive Ground Frequency
nodes.description: Volcanic Orb leaves {Explosive Ground} more frequently, but costs more mana.

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Tree Duration And Mana
nodes.description: Volcanic Orb costs less mana, but moves slower and has a reduced duration.

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Tree Explosion Damage
nodes.description: Explosions from {Explosive Orb} and {Glyph of Fire} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Tree Explosion Ignite Chance
nodes.description: Explosions from {Explosive Orb} and {Glyph of Fire} have a chance to ignite enemies.

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Tree Orb Damage
nodes.description: Volcanic Orb's core deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Tree Long Cast
nodes.description: Volcanic Orb's core, {Shrapnel} and {Explosive Orb} hits deal more damage, but Volcanic Orb costs more mana and has less cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Tree Less Shrapnel
nodes.description: Volcanic Orb's core and {Shrapnel} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Shrapnel is created less frequently.

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Freeze Chance
nodes.description: Frozen Orb has an increased chance to freeze enemies.

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Speed Fade
nodes.description: Volcanic Orb moves slower for each second it exists.

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Speed Increase Over Time
nodes.description: Volcanic Orb's core deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and it accelerates, moving faster for each second it exists.

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Cooldown Recovery
nodes.description: Volcanic Orb has a shorter cooldown.

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Volcanic Orb costs less mana.

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Increased Final Shrapnel
nodes.description: Volcanic Orb fires additional {Shrapnel} from its final explosion.

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Tree Frozen Orb
nodes.description:
Volcanic Orb is converted into Frozen Orb. Base fire damage is converted to cold for Frozen Orb and the skill effects it creates. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not with increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance for Volcanic Orb.

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Tree Explosive Ground
nodes.description: Volcanic Orb leaves {Explosive Ground} as it travels, which explode after 3 seconds, dealing fire damage to enemies within its area of effect. Volcanic Orb costs significantly more mana.

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Tree Explosion On Death
nodes.description: Volcanic Orb creates a large explosion at the end of its duration, dealing fire damage.

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb Tree Explosion On Cast Chance
nodes.description: Casting Volcanic Orb creates a {Fire Glyph} at your feet which explodes after 1.3 seconds, creating a {Fire Nova}.

nodes.name: Volcanic Orb No Final Shrapnel
nodes.description: Volcanic Orb's core hits deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Volcanic Orb no longer creates {Shrapnel} when it ends.

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Vines Cooldown Recovery
nodes.description: Your Spriggan's Summon Vine ability has a shorter cooldown.

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Vine Damage
nodes.description: Your Spriggan's summoned {Vines} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Vine Health And Poison Resist
nodes.description: Your Spriggan's summoned {Vines} have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and additional poison resistance.

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Spell Damage
nodes.description: Your Spriggan deals more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Hit Damage To CCd
nodes.description: Your Spriggan's {Thorn Volley} hits deal more damage to immobilized, stunned or frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Hit Damage To Poisoned
nodes.description: Your Spriggan's {Thorn Volley} hits deal more damage to poisoned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Aura Increased Healing
nodes.description: Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} and {Rejuvenating Wind} restore more health.

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Aura Spell Damage
nodes.description: Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} now also grants allies additional spell damage.

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Aura Crit Chance And Avoidance
nodes.description: Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} now also grants allies additional base critical chance and critical strike avoidance.

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Health
nodes.description: Your Spriggan has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Armor And Physical Resist
nodes.description: Your Spriggan has additional armor and physical resistance.

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Ensnaring Roots Damage
nodes.description: Your Spriggan's {Ensnaring Roots} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Ensnaring Roots Towards You
nodes.description: Your Spriggan now casts {Ensnaring Roots} towards you whenever there are enemies around you, rather than it casting towards enemies near itself.

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Ensnaring Roots Cooldown Recovery
nodes.description: Your Spriggan's {Ensnaring Roots} has a shorter cooldown.

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Ensnaring Roots Duration
nodes.description: Your Spriggan's {Ensnaring Roots} lasts longer.

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Aura Minion Healing
nodes.description: Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} restores significantly more health to minions.
