nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Summons Vines
nodes.description:
Your Spriggan can now use {Summon Vine}, melee minions that poison enemies they hit, up to a maximum of 6 Vines.

These Vines are not affected by your Vine limit or nodes on the {Spriggan Form} tree.

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Three Vines
nodes.description: Your Spriggan's {Summon Vine} ability now summons three vines at a time, but has a significantly longer cooldown (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Chance For More Volley Thorns
nodes.description: Your Spriggan's {Thorn Volley} has a chance to fire 2 extra Thorns.

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan More Volley Thorns
nodes.description: Your Spriggan's {Thorn Volley} always fires 1 extra Thorn and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Casts Ensnaring Roots
nodes.description: Your Spriggan can now cast {Ensnaring Roots}, a wave of roots deals physical damage and roots enemies it hits for 1.5 seconds. Rooted enemies take physical damage over time until they are freed.

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Thorn Volley's and Ensnaring Roots' base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. They also have a chance to freeze enemies.

Poison chance from all sources, for both skills, is converted to {Frostbite} and effects related to poison now depend on Frostbite instead.

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Freeze Rate And Aura Freeze Rate
nodes.description: Your Spriggan has a higher chance to freeze enemies. Your Spriggans Aura grants its allies a higher chance to freeze enemies.

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Aura Dodge Rating Per Attunement Doubled For Minions
nodes.description:
Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} now also grants allies additional dodge rating per point of your Attunement.

This effect is doubled on minions.

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Ensnaring Roots Heals Allies On Hit
nodes.description: Your Spriggan's {Ensnaring Roots} now heals allies it hits.

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Ensnaring Roots Cannot Be Dodged
nodes.description: Your Spriggan's {Ensnaring Roots} can no longer be dodged.

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Reflect For You And Spriggan Plus Vitality
nodes.description: For each Spriggan you control, you and your Spriggans reflect flat damage to attackers per point of Vitality.

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Aura Wolf Crow Raptor Effects
nodes.description:
Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} grants additional effects based on the amount of active companions you have.
For each {Wolf}, it grants increased attack and cast speed.
For each {Storm Crow}, it grants increased mana regeneration.
For each {Raptor}, it grants additional critical strike multiplier.

nodes.name: Summon Spriggan Bear Cat Scorpion Effects
nodes.description:
Your Spriggan's {Healing Aura} grants additional effects based on your active companions.
With a {Bear}, it grants a percentage of max health gained as endurance threshold.
With a {Sabertooth}, it grants increased dodge rating.
With a {Scorpion}, it grants increased area of effect.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Added Void Damage
nodes.description:
Warpath deals additional melee void damage. 

This effect is doubled while wielding a 2 handed weapon.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Time Rot Conversion
nodes.description:
Warpath's base physical damage is converted to void. Consequently this damage scales with increases to void damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Warpath has a chance to inflict {Time Rot}. Bleed and ignite chance from all sources are converted to Time Rot chance for Warpath.

Swaps Warpath's {Physical} tag for a {Void} tag.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Damage Against Time Rot
nodes.description: Warpath hits deal more damage against enemies per stack of {Time Rot} on them (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Area
nodes.description: Warpath deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Increased Speed
nodes.description: While spinning, you have increased movement speed.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Damage
nodes.description:
Warpath deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled while using a two handed weapon or dual wielding.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Less Channel Cost
nodes.description: Warpath costs less mana per second.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Armor Shred Chance
nodes.description: Warpath hits shred enemy armor.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Less Channel Cost And Reduced Ele Res
nodes.description: Warpath costs significantly less mana per second, but you have reduced elemental resistance while spinning.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Block
nodes.description: While spinning, you have additional block chance and block effectiveness.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Weapon Master
nodes.description: While spinning, you have additional melee leech while wielding an axe, additional base crit chance while wielding a sword, additional physical penetration while wielding a mace and additional fire penetration while wielding a sceptre.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree 2h Area
nodes.description: Warpath deals damage in a larger area while wielding a two handed weapon.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Mana Regen With 2h
nodes.description: While spinning, you gain mana every three seconds while wielding a two handed weapon.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Bleed Chance And Duration
nodes.description:
Warpath hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and bleed stacks inflicted by Warpath have increased duration.

Both effects will instead apply to ignite or time rot if you have {Earthscorcher} or {Apocalypse Whirl}.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Ignite Conversion
nodes.description:
Warpath's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite for Warpath.

Swaps Warpath's {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Burning Trail
nodes.description: While spinning, you leave behind a burning trail that ignites enemies each second. If ignite has been converted to {Time Rot} with {Apocalypse Whirl} this trail inflicts Time Rot instead.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Spell Damage
nodes.description: While spinning, you have additional spell damage.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Heals Allies
nodes.description: While spinning, you and your allies are healed each second within Warpath's area of effect. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Smite Chance
nodes.description:
While spinning, you have a chance to cast {Smite} each second on a nearby enemy.

This consumes Smite's mana cost.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Hit Damage To Ignited
nodes.description: Warpath hits deal more melee fire damage to ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) and ignite it inflicts has additional Fire Penetration

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Damage And Area More Channel Cost
nodes.description: For each second you continuously spin, Warpath deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased area, but costs additional mana per second. These effects will stop scaling after a duration.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Slash After Spinning
nodes.description: After spinning for at least 2 seconds you do a {Warslash} when you stop spinning. This deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area for each second you spent spinning, up to a maximum duration.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Melee Damage To Low Health
nodes.description: Warpath deals more melee damage to enemies on low health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Summon Forged Weapons
nodes.description: While spinning, you summon {Forged Weapons} every 5 seconds as if you had hit an enemy with {Forge Strike}.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Summon Frequency
nodes.description: While spinning, you summon {Forged Weapons} more frequently.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Echoes
nodes.description:
While spinning, you deal increased void damage and you have a chance each second to create an {Echo} at a recent location that uses Warpath on the spot for 2 seconds. This chance is equal to twice your chance for skills to echo.

You can only create a Warpath echo if you have been spinning for at least 2 seconds and have travelled at least 4 metres in the past 2 seconds.

nodes.name: Warpath Tree Abyssal Echoes Every 5 Sec
nodes.description:
While spinning, you cast {Abyssal Echoes} every 5 seconds.

This consumes Abyssal Echoes' mana cost.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Cooldown Recovery
nodes.description: Volatile Reversal has a shorter cooldown.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Short Jump Low Cooldown
nodes.description: Volatile Reversal's forwards jump has a significantly shorter maximum distance, but its cooldown is reduced.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Crit Chance
nodes.description: Volatile Reversal has additional critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Mana Gain On Crit
nodes.description: When you critically strike at least one enemy with Volatile Reversal you regain mana.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Haste On Backwards Jump
nodes.description: You gain the {Haste} buff for a short duration, when you jump backwards in time.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Dodge Rating From Armor
nodes.description: While you are able to jump backwards in time, a percentage of your armor mitigation also applies to damage over time.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Frenzy After Forwards Jump
nodes.description: You gain the {Frenzy} buff, while you are able to jump backwards in time.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Additional Combo Duration
nodes.description: You can use Volatile Reversal's second combo ability for a longer period of time and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Devouring Orbs Get Older
nodes.description:
When you jump forwards in time, your existing {Devouring Orbs} become older.

This causes them to expire sooner.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Devouring Orbs Cooldown Recovery
nodes.description: When you jump backwards in time, {Devouring Orb} recovers some of its cooldown scaling with the amount of {Devouring Orbs} that expired after jumping forwards in time.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Devouring Orbs Pulled To You
nodes.description: When you jump forwards in time, all your {Devouring Orbs} are pulled towards you and trigger a {Void Rift}, but Volatile Reversal costs additional mana.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Devouring Orbs Get Younger
nodes.description:
When you jump backwards in time, your existing {Devouring Orbs} become younger.

This causes them to expire later, and each orb can only benefit from this once.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Second Ability Removed
nodes.description: Volatile Reversal's second combo ability is removed, but the melee attack deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and Volatile Reversal deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal More Damage
nodes.description: Volatile Reversal deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Second Ability Jumps Forwards
nodes.description: Volatile Reversal's second combo ability now jumps you forward in time to your target location, instead of backwards.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Increased Area
nodes.description: Volatile Reversal deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Fire Conversion
nodes.description:
Volatile Reversal's base void damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to void damage.

Time Rot chance from this tree is converted to ignite chance.

Swaps Volatile Reversal's {Void} tag for a {Fire} tag.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Randomized Arrival
nodes.description: When you jump forwards in time, your arrival location is slightly randomized, but the melee attack deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and Volatile Reversal deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Attack Slow Chance
nodes.description: Volatile Reversal's hits have a chance to slow enemies and it deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of slow on the enemy.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Guaranteed Echo After
nodes.description: When you travel at least 4 meters by jumping through time, your next direct melee attack or spell is guaranteed to {Echo}, if it is able to.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal More Damage From Travel
nodes.description: When you jump backwards in time, Volatile Reversal deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per meter travelled, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Attack Void Essence Chance
nodes.description: Volatile Reversal's melee hits have a chance to grant you a {Void Essence}.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Starting Void Bolts
nodes.description: When you directly use Volatile Reversal you now also cast a {Void Bolt} at up to 3 enemies near your starting location, but Volatile Reversal costs additional mana.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Void Bolts Time Rot Chance
nodes.description: Volatile Reversal's {Void Bolts} have a chance to inflict time rot.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Void Bolts Increased DoT Taken
nodes.description: Enemies hit by Volatile Reversal's {Void Bolts} take increased damage over time for several seconds. This effect does not stack.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Void Bolts Can Return Shotgun
nodes.description:
Your {Void Bolts} return to you.

All returning Void Bolts can hit the same targets again. (This means a single cast of the Void Bolt spell can hit a single enemy up to 4 times)

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Arrival Void Bolts
nodes.description: When you directly use Volatile Reversal you now also cast a {Void Bolt} at up to 3 enemies near your arrival location, but Volatile Reversal costs additional mana.

nodes.name: Volatile Reversal Arrival Abyssal Echoes
nodes.description:
The {Void Bolts} from the {Terminal Void Bolt} node are now replaced with a single cast of {Abyssal Echoes}.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of {Abyssal Echoes'} mana cost.

nodes.name: Shield Rush Tree Damage
nodes.description: Shield Rush deals more damage.

nodes.name: Shield Rush Tree Damage Against Full Health While Travelling
nodes.description: Shield Rush hits deal more hit damage to enemies at full health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Shield Rush Tree Backwards Beam
nodes.description: When Shield Rush ends it creates a {Void Beam} that travels back in the direction you came from, but Shield Rush costs more mana.

nodes.name: Shield Rush Tree AoE Void Damage
nodes.description: Shield Rush's final impact deals additional melee void damage.

nodes.name: Shield Rush Tree Attack Speed Reduced Void Damage
nodes.description: Shield Rush hits deal additional void damage, but this damage is reduced by your increased attack speed.

nodes.name: Shield Rush Tree Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Shield Rush costs less mana.

nodes.name: Shield Rush Tree Less Damage Taken
nodes.description: You take less damage while using Shield Rush (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Shield Rush Tree Travel Stun Chance
nodes.description: Shield Rush hits have an increased chance to stun enemies.

nodes.name: Shield Rush Tree Mana Restore
nodes.description: When Shield Rush ends, your mana is restored to the amount you had when it started, but Shield Rush now has a 10 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Shield Rush Tree Adds Charges
nodes.description: Shield Rush gains additional charges, but you take more damage while using Shield Rush (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Shield Rush Tree No Cooldown
nodes.description: Shield Rush no longer has a cooldown, but costs health in addition to mana to use.

nodes.name: Shield Rush Tree Increase AoE
nodes.description: Shield Rush's final impact deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

nodes.name: Shield Rush Tree Area Damage
nodes.description: Shield Rush's final impact deals more damage.

nodes.name: Shield Rush Tree Area Crit Chance
nodes.description: Improves the base critical strike chance of Shield Rush's final impact.

nodes.name: Shield Rush Tree Area Crit Multi
nodes.description: Critical strikes from Shield Rush's final impact deal more damage.

nodes.name: Shield Rush Tree Second Aoe Damage And Delay
nodes.description: Shield Rush's final impact echo deals significantly more hit damage, but the delay between the final impacts is longer.

nodes.name: Shield Rush Tree Second Aoe Crit Chance
nodes.description: Improves the base critical strike chance of Shield Rush's final impact echo.

nodes.name: Shield Rush Tree Second Aoe Crit Multi
nodes.description: Critical strikes from Shield Rush's final impact echo deal more damage.

nodes.name: Shield Rush Tree Forwards Beam
nodes.description: When you cast Shield Rush you create a {Void Beam} that travels with you, which is a spell that deals void damage over time in a small area. Shield Rush costs more mana.

nodes.name: Shield Rush Tree No Shield Requirement
nodes.description: Shield Rush no longer requires a shield and hits deal additional base void damage, but Shield Rush costs more mana.

nodes.name: Shield Rush Tree Return To Start
nodes.description:
When Shield Rush ends, you return to the position you used it from.

This removes Shield Rush's {Traversal} tag.

nodes.name: Shield Rush Tree Second Aoe
nodes.description: Shield Rush's final impact strikes a second time after a 0.5s delay, but Shield Rush hits deal less damage.

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Tree Attack Speed
nodes.description: Hammer Throw has increased attack speed.

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Tree Damage vs Proj Speed
nodes.description: Hammer Throw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but hammers travels slower.

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Tree Conversion
nodes.description:
Hammer Throw can no longer spiral, chain, or orbit.

If your hammers would spiral, they instead deal significantly more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

If your hammers would chain, they instead deal more critical damage for each time they would chain.

If your hammers would orbit you, they instead have additional base critical strike chance.

Hammer Throw hits deal increased damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Tree Free When Out of Mana
nodes.description: When you are out of mana Hammer Throw is free.

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Tree Shreds Armour
nodes.description: Hammer Throw hits have a chance to reduce enemy armor.

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Tree More Aoe Damage
nodes.description: {Disintegrating Aura} deals more damage, and Hammer Throw costs less mana.

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Tree Stun Chance
nodes.description: Hammer Throw deals more damage, and has a higher chance to stun enemies.

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Tree Stun Chance vs Pierce
nodes.description: Hammer Throw deals more damage, but Hammer Throw hits no longer pierce (travel through enemies hit). Its hits have a higher chance to stun enemies, and the stuns they inflict last longer.

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Tree Additional Chain
nodes.description: Hammers chain to additional enemies.

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Tree Damage To Stunned
nodes.description: Hammer Throw deals more hit damage against stunned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) and the stuns they inflict last longer

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Tree Health On Hit
nodes.description: Hammer Throw has a chance to grant you health on hit.

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Tree Mana On Hit
nodes.description: Hammer Throw rips a {Dark Orb} from enemies on hit, which travels back to you and grants 6 health and mana. Hammer Throw has a 5 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Tree Projectile Speed
nodes.description: Hammers travel faster.

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Tree No Return
nodes.description: Hammer Throw hits have a chance to deal double damage, but hammers no longer return to you.

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Tree Mana Cost And Damage
nodes.description: Hammer Throw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and costs less mana.

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Tree Double Damage Chance
nodes.description: Hammer Throw hits have a higher chance to deal double damage.

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Stacking Buff
nodes.description: Using Hammer Throw grants you a stack of {Zeal} for 4 seconds, which increases your damage and critical strike chance by 10% per stack.

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Stacking Ignite Buff
nodes.description: Each stack of {Zeal} also grants you added global ignite chance.

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Tree Void Damage In Aoe
nodes.description: Your hammers gain a {Disintegrating Aura}, causing enemies nearby them to take void damage over time, but Hammer Throw costs additional mana and has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Tree Stun Chain
nodes.description:
Hammers chain to nearby enemies instead of returning to you.

Hammer Throw can no longer throw extra projectiles, but it gains more damage and more attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers) for each extra projectile you would have thrown.

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Tree Extra Projectiles
nodes.description:
Hammer Throw launches additional hammers, but Hammer Throw costs more mana.

Hammers from the same throw cannot hit the same enemy, unless they spiral.

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Tree Nova Projectiles
nodes.description: Hammers are now thrown in a nova, with double the amount of additional hammers unless your hammers spiral. Hammer Throw hits deal additional throwing physical damage.

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Tree Spirals
nodes.description: Hammers now travel in a spiral around you, but halves your amount of additional hammers and Hammer Throw costs more mana.

nodes.name: Hammer Throw Tree Moves With Caster
nodes.description: Your spiralling hammers now orbit you, but Hammer Throw costs more mana.

nodes.name: Vengeance Damage While Prepped
nodes.description: You deal more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while preparing to riposte.

nodes.name: Vengeance Attack Speed
nodes.description: Vengeance has increased attack speed.

nodes.name: Vengeance More Damage If Blocked Or Parried
nodes.description:
Vengeance deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled if you have blocked or parried a hit recently.

nodes.name: Vengeance Iron Blade Double Damage Chance
nodes.description: {Iron Blade} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Vengeance Iron Blade Armour Shred Chance
nodes.description: {Iron Blade} has a chance to reduce enemy armor.

nodes.name: Vengeance Iron Blade Speed
nodes.description:
{Iron Blade} travels faster, causing it to also travel further.

Additionally, Vengeance and Riposte hits have a chance to attack with {Iron Blade} per point of Attunement up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Vengeance Parry Chance Per Forged Weapon
nodes.description: You gain an additional chance to parry per {Forged Weapon} for 4 seconds after using Vengeance.

nodes.name: Vengeance Damage Against Low Health Enemies
nodes.description:
Vengeance hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled against enemies on low health (below 35% health).

nodes.name: Vengeance Damage And Frailty Chance
nodes.description: Vengeance deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and its hits have a chance to apply {Frailty} on enemies.

nodes.name: Vengeance Reduced Damage Taken
nodes.description: You take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased armor if you've hit an enemy with Vengeance in the past 2 seconds.

nodes.name: Vengeance Void Essence On Riposte Hit
nodes.description: Vengeance and {Riposte} hits have a chance to grant a {Void Essence}.

nodes.name: Vengeance Void Cleave Or Erasing Strike Buff
nodes.description: Your next {Void Cleave} or {Erasing Strike} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) after you use and hit with Vengeance.

nodes.name: Vengeance Armour Debuff
nodes.description: Vengeance hits have a chance to shred enemy armor and physical resistance.

nodes.name: Vengeance Armour Shred Effect
nodes.description: Increases the effectiveness of all armor shred applied by Vengeance and {Riposte}.

nodes.name: Vengeance Bleed Effect From Phys Res
nodes.description: Vengeance gains additional physical penetration with bleed per 1% overcapped physical resistance.

nodes.name: Vengeance Riposte Fire Damage And Ignite Chance
nodes.description: Riposte deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its hits have a chance to ignite enemies.

nodes.name: Vengeance Double Retaliation
nodes.description: You can {Riposte} an additional time after Vengeance hits an enemy, but Riposte mitigates less damage.

nodes.name: Vengeance Damage Additional Retaliations
nodes.description: You can {Riposte} an additional time after Vengeance hits an enemy.

nodes.name: Vengeance Iron Blade On Vengeance Hit
nodes.description: Vengeance and Riposte hits have a chance to attack with {Iron Blade}.

nodes.name: Vengeance Iron Blade Forged Weapon Chance
nodes.description: {Iron Blades} now have a chance to be summoned as {Forged Weapons} instead.

nodes.name: Vengeance Cannot Be Crit When Riposting
nodes.description:
Hits that you {Riposte} cannot critically strike you.

Additionally, improves Vengeance's base critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Vengeance Fire Conversion
nodes.description:
Vengeance' base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage or other damage types.

Chance to shred physical resistance from all sources is converted to chance to shred fire resistance.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite.

Swaps Vengeance' {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.

nodes.name: Vengeance Gladiator Arsenal
nodes.description:
{Iron Blades} and {Riposte} gains different benefits depending on your equipped weapons.

Mace: Riposte deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
Axe: Riposte instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).
Sword: Improves {Iron Blades'} base critical strike chance.
Spear: {Iron Blades} have increased bleed duration.

nodes.name: Vengeance Void Conversion
nodes.description:
Vengeance' base physical damage is converted to void. Consequently this damage scales with increases to void damage, but not increases to physical damage or other damage types.

Chance to shred physical resistance from all sources is converted to chance to shred void resistance.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to chance to inflict {Time Rot} for Vengeance.

Swaps Vengeance' {Physical} tag for a {Void} tag.

nodes.name: Vengeance Bleed Chance
nodes.description: Vengeance hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

nodes.name: Vengeance Time Rot And Echo Chance
nodes.description:
Vengeance hits have a chance to inflict {Time Rot}.

Additionally, Vengeance has additional chance to Echo if it can Echo.

nodes.name: Vengeance Undodgeable Echo
nodes.description:
Vengeance deals more void damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and additional melee void damage.

Additionally, Echoed Vengeance cannot be dodged.

nodes.name: Vengeance Crit Multi
nodes.description: Vengeance critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Vengeance Frenzy And More Fire Damage Per Ignite
nodes.description:
Vengeance has a chance to grant you {Frenzy} for 2 seconds when hitting ignited enemies.

Additionally, Vengeance deals more fire hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per ignite on the enemy, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Tree Void Rift AoE
nodes.description: Erasing Strike and {Void Rifts} it creates deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Tree Void Rift Time Rot
nodes.description: Erasing Strike hits have a chance to inflict enemies with {Time Rot}, an ailment that deals void damage over time, increases stun duration by 5%, lasts 3 seconds, and stacks up to 12 times.

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Tree Damage Over Time
nodes.description: Erasing Strike deals more damage over time.

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Tree Always Creates Void Rift
nodes.description: Erasing Strike always creates a {Void Rift} at its impact location.

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Tree Void Rift Increased Damage Taken
nodes.description: Erasing Strike hits shred enemy void resistance.

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Tree Damage Against Damaged
nodes.description: Erasing Strike has increased cooldown recovery speed and deals more melee damage to enemies that are already damaged (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Tree Damage Against Full Health
nodes.description: Erasing Strike deals more melee damage to enemies at full health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Tree Damage And Cull
nodes.description: Erasing Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Tree Damage And Mana Cost
nodes.description:
Erasing Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). 

This bonus is doubled while wielding two handed weapon.

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Tree Crit Chance
nodes.description:
Improves Erasing Strike's base critical strike chance.

Additionally, Erasing Strike's hits cannot be dodged.

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Tree Crit Multiplier
nodes.description: Erasing Strike critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Tree Speed On Kill
nodes.description: You gain the {Haste} buff for 1 second, granting 30% increased movement speed when Erasing Strike kills an enemy or hits a boss or rare enemy.

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Tree Lower Beam Requirement
nodes.description: The kills required to summon {Void Beams} via the {Ravenous Void} node require less kills to trigger, but Erasing Strike costs more mana.

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Void Damage With Sword Axe Mace
nodes.description:
Erasing Strike deals more void damage if you are using a two handed mace (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Erasing Strike has increased cooldown recovery speed if you are using a two handed sword.

Erasing Strike's melee hit and void rifts have a larger area of effect if you are using a two handed axe.

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Tree Stationary Void Beam
nodes.description: When Erasing Strike kills an enemy you have a chance to cast {Void Beam} at their location, a spell that continuously damages surrounding enemies for 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Tree Void Essence On Crit
nodes.description:
Erasing Strike critical strikes have a chance to grant you a {Void Essence}, which grants 3% more void damage, 3% more melee damage, and 15% reduced duration of stuns received.

You can have a maximum of 3 void essences at once.

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Tree Life On Kill
nodes.description: When Erasing Strike kills an enemy or hits a boss or rare enemy you regain health equal to a percentage of the target's maximum health.

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Tree Void Beams
nodes.description: If you kill 5 or more enemies simultaneously with Erasing Strike, you create 4 {Void Beams} which travel at random, damaging surrounding enemies for 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Void Beam vs Boss
nodes.description: When Erasing Strike hits a boss or rare enemy you have a chance to cast {Void Beam} at their location, a spell that continuously damages surrounding enemies for 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Void Beam Damage
nodes.description: All {Void Beams} created by Erasing Strike deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Consumes Mana For Echoes
nodes.description: Erasing Strike consumes mana to cause additional echoes when used. Each echo will appear one second after the last. These additional echos cannot be created while you have negative mana.

nodes.name: Erasing Strike No Cooldown
nodes.description: Erasing Strike no longer has a cooldown, but it deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Slow Chance
nodes.description: Erasing Strike hits have a chance to slow and deals more melee damage to slowed enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Bleed to Time Rot Conversion
nodes.description:
Bleed chance from all sources is converted to {Time Rot} chance for Erasing Strike and effects related to bleed now depend on Time Rot instead. 

Erasing Strike deals more melee damage against targets with 12 stacks of Time Rot (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Additional Charge
nodes.description: You can store an additional charge of Erasing Strike.

nodes.name: Erasing Strike Cooldown Recovery
nodes.description: Erasing Strike has increased cooldown recovery speed, but also has a higher mana cost.

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree Orbit Distance
nodes.description: Devouring Orb deals more damage and orbits you at a greater distance.

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree Autocast While Moving
nodes.description:
While you are moving, you will automatically cast Devouring Orb if it is not on cooldown and you have enough mana.

This effect puts Devouring Orb on cooldown.

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree Increased Damage
nodes.description:
Devouring Orb deals more hit damage to enemies it collides with (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This ONLY affects the damage that devouring orb deals when the orb itself collides with an enemy, not the damage dealt by its void rifts or other sub skills.

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree Damage During Duration
nodes.description:
You deal more global void damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased mana regen while a Devouring Orb is active.

These bonuses are doubled if you have at least 90 vitality.

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree Duration vs growth
nodes.description: Devouring Orb lasts longer, but a Devouring Orb's {Void Rifts} no longer increase in size or damage for each successive rift.

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree Abyssal Orb Frequency
nodes.description: The rate at which Devouring Orbs cast {Abyssal Orb} is increased by a random amount.

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree Reduced Duration
nodes.description: Devouring Orb costs less mana, but has a shorter duration (multiplicative with other duration modifiers).

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree Cast Speed
nodes.description: Devouring Orb has increased cast speed and a shorter cooldown.

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree Cooldown Recovery
nodes.description: Devouring Orb has a shorter cooldown and {Void Eruption} deals more damage

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree Rift Damage
nodes.description: All damage from Devouring Orb penetrates enemy void resistance. This includes {Void Rifts} and other sub skills and sources of damage added by this tree, and any ailments they inflict

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree Rift Damage Growth
nodes.description: The rate at which {Void Rift} hit damage and area increments when a nearby enemy dies is increased.

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree Rift AoE Growth
nodes.description: {Void Rift} hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to {Time Rotting} enemies.

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree AoE
nodes.description: Devouring Orb deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Consume Buffs
nodes.description: When you directly cast non-orbiting Devouring Orb within the area of an existing Devouring Orb, the new Orb consumes all existing Orbs to deal more damage in a larger area (both multiplicative with other modifiers), per Orb consumed. However, the new Orb also deals less ailment damage per Orb consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree Rift Time Rot
nodes.description:
Devouring Orb lasts longer and it has a chance to inflict {Time Rot} on enemies each second inside its area of effect.

This chance also applies to hits from its subskills.

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree Frailty Chance Area
nodes.description: Devouring Orb has a chance to apply frailty to enemies within its area of effect each second.

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree More Radius Per Second
nodes.description: Devouring Orb gains more radius each second, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree More DoT Less Hit
nodes.description: Devouring Orb deals more damage over time, but less hit damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree Autocast Chance For Refund
nodes.description: Whenever {Abyssal Rush} triggers, it has a chance to consume only 50% of Devouring Orb's cooldown and mana cost.

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree Added Charges
nodes.description: Devouring orb gains additional charges, but costs more mana.

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree Protection During Duration
nodes.description: You have a chance to gain a {Void Essence} when Devouring Orb expires.

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree Orbits
nodes.description: Devouring Orb now orbits you, but has a much shorter duration (multiplicative with other duration modifiers).

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree Deals Damage
nodes.description: Devouring Orb now deals void damage to enemies it collides with.

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree Abyssal Orb
nodes.description: Every 3 seconds Devouring Orb releases an {Abyssal Orb}, a spell which seeks enemies and detonates, dealing void damage in an area.

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree Erupts On Death
nodes.description:
Devouring Orb now erupts at the end of its duration, creating a {Void Eruption}.

Devouring Orb has a much shorter duration (multiplicative with other duration modifiers).

nodes.name: Devouring Orb Tree Abyssal Orb Slow And Shred
nodes.description: Devouring Orb hits have a chance to slow and shred enemy void resistance.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes More Damage
nodes.description: Abyssal Echoes deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Armor Shred Stacks
nodes.description: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst shreds enemy armor.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Armor Shred Effect
nodes.description: Armor shred applied by Abyssal Decay has increased effect.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes No Cooldown Added Mana Cost
nodes.description: Abyssal Echoes no longer has a cooldown, but costs more mana.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Abyssal Echoes costs less mana.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Trigger Nearby Devouring Orbs
nodes.description: Directly using Abyssal Echoes has a chance to cast a {Void Rift} from each nearby {Devouring Orb}.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Targeted Cast
nodes.description: Abyssal Echoes can now be cast at the target location.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Increased Duration
nodes.description: Abyssal Decay has increased duration.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Blinds
nodes.description: Abyssal Decay now blinds enemies.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Reduce Physical Res But No Trigger On Hit
nodes.description: Abyssal Decay causes enemies to have reduced physical resistance, but it is no longer consumed when the enemy is hit.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Increased DoT Taken
nodes.description: Abyssal Decay causes enemies to take increased damage over time.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Damage When Hit Rather Than Over Time
nodes.description: Abyssal Decay now deals damage when the enemy is hit, rather than over time. Each hit deals a portion of the full damage Abyssal Decay would have dealt over its full duration. This damage still counts as damage over time.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes DoT And Melee Attack Speed Buff
nodes.description: Directly using Abyssal Echoes grants you {Nether Coating} for 5 seconds, granting you increased attack speed with your melee and throwing attacks and causing you to deal more damage to blinded enemies.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Time Rot On Hit With Buff
nodes.description: {Nether Coating} also grants you a chance to inflict {Time Rot} on hit.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Consume Bleeds For Instant Damage
nodes.description: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst consumes all stacks of bleed on the enemy, causing their damage to be dealt instantly.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Slow Stacks
nodes.description: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst slows enemies.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Slow To Haste Conversion From Enemies
nodes.description: Abyssal Decay causes Enemies that would apply {Slow} to instead grant their target {Haste} for 1 second.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Next Erasing Strike Or Void Cleave More Melee Damage To Slowed
nodes.description: After casting Abyssal Echoes your next {Erasing Strike} and {Void Cleave} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to slowed enemies.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Increased Area
nodes.description: Abyssal Echoes affects a larger area.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Ignite Chance
nodes.description: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst has a chance to ignite enemies.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Void Spell Damage On Hit No Decay
nodes.description: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst now hits and deals spell void damage, but no longer inflicts Abyssal Decay.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Fire Conversion
nodes.description:
Spell void damage from {Potent Corruption}, {Vorpal Reverberation} and attribute scaling is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to void damage.

Abyssal Echoes' initial burst now also heals you and your allies and nodes on this tree that grant more damage also grant more healing.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Attunement Scaling
nodes.description: Abyssal Echoes' damage now scales with attunement rather than vitality, and its healing effectiveness is also increased by attunement.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes More Damage No Chain
nodes.description: Abyssal Echoes deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer chains.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Ailment Spread
nodes.description: Abyssal Decay now spreads to several nearby enemies after 1 second.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Ailment Spread Modification
nodes.description: Abyssal Decay spreads to enemies further away and can spread to more enemies when it spreads.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Abyssal Rift
nodes.description: Abyssal Echoes now creates an {Abyssal Rift} at the target location that casts Abyssal Echoes for you 3 times at its location before expiring.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Abyssal Rift Echoes More
nodes.description: {Abyssal Rifts} cast additional Abyssal Echoes.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes More Chains Tripled For Echoes
nodes.description:
Abyssal Echoes can chain additional times. 

This effect is tripled for echoed casts.

nodes.name: Abyssal Echoes Echoed Casts More Damage
nodes.description: Echoed casts deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Health and Damage
nodes.description: Skeleton Warriors have more maximum health, while Skeleton Rogues and Archers deal more damage (all multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Summon Skeletons costs less mana, and your Skeletons have improved base critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Ward On Skele Death
nodes.description: You gain ward whenever one of your Skeletons dies.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mana On Skele Death
nodes.description: You gain mana whenever one of your Skeletons dies.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Spell Damage On Skele Death
nodes.description: You have increased spell damage if one of your Skeletons has died recently (past 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Increased Speed
nodes.description: Skeletons have increased attack speed, cast speed, and movement speed.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Only One Warrior
nodes.description: Your Skeletons have increased critical strike chance, but you can only have one Skeleton Warrior summoned at once.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Fire Arrow
nodes.description:
Skeleton Archers have their basic attack replaced with {Fire Arrow}, which is a more powerful bow attack that deals fire damage and ignites on hit.

Skeleton Archers have less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

abilityGrantedByNode.name: Summon Skeleton Archer Fire Bow Attack

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Additional Fire Arrows
nodes.description: {Fire Arrow} has a chance to shoot additional projectiles.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Ice Arrow
nodes.description: Converts {Fire Arrow} into {Ice Arrow}, converting its base fire damage to cold damage. Ignite chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance for Ice Arrow.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Bone Armor
nodes.description:
Skeleton Warriors can now cast {Bone Armor} for 4 seconds, which grants less damage taken (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect has a 4 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Bone Armor On Allies
nodes.description: Skeleton Warriors can target allies with {Bone Armor}.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Life Leech
nodes.description: Skeletons leech a portion of the damage they deal as health and they have additional physical resistance.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Extra Summons
nodes.description: When you directly cast Summon Skeleton, you summon multiple Skeletons in a single cast, but Summon Skeleton costs more mana. This does not affect your maximum number of Skeletons.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Melee Range And Damage
nodes.description: Skeletons have an increased area of effect with melee attacks, and your Skeletons deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Chance To Resummon
nodes.description: When a Skeleton dies, there is a chance to summon a random new one at the same location after 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Acid Flask
nodes.description: Skeleton Rogues can now throw a {Vile Flask}, which inflicts poison and armor shred on hit. Vile Flask has a 5 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Rogue Recovery
nodes.description: Skeleton Rogues deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each Skeleton Warrior or Archer you control, up to 5.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Heal Skeleton On Skeleton Death
nodes.description: When one of your Skeletons dies, another Skeleton is healed to full health.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton No Warriors
nodes.description: Skeleton Warriors are removed from the pool of Skeletons that can be summoned.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Max Skeles Alpha
nodes.description: You can summon more Skeletons.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Max Skeles Beta
nodes.description: You can summon more Skeletons.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Max Skeles Delta
nodes.description: You can summon more Skeletons.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton No Archers
nodes.description: Skeleton Archers are removed from the pool of Skeletons that can be summoned.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Half Skeletons
nodes.description: Skeletons deal more damage and have more health (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and are larger, but you can only summon half as many as you could before (rounded up).

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Rogues
nodes.description: Adds Skeleton Rogues to the pool of Skeletons that can be summoned. Rogues dash to distant enemies, throw shurikens, use melee attacks, and they poison enemies on hit.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Fire Or Ice Arrow
nodes.description: Skeleton Archers will randomly use Fire Arrow or Ice Arrow, but have additional chance to ignite or inflict frostbite depending on the arrow used.

nodes.name: Root Node
nodes.description: Rips blood out of a target enemy dealing physical damage to it. A {Blood Orb} is drawn back to you which restores 10 health when it reaches you.

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Area
nodes.description: {Blood Splatter} deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Damage Over Time
nodes.description: Rip Blood deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Buff Minion Damage
nodes.description: {Blood Splatter} grants your minions {Blood Infusion} when it hits them. The {Blood Infusion} buff grants 15% more damage for 4 seconds (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Area Per Minion
nodes.description: Blood Splatter has increased area for each minion you currently control, up to a maximum benefit.

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Buff Minion Attack Speed
nodes.description: {Blood Infusion} grants increased attack and cast speed.

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Buff Minion Leech
nodes.description: {Blood Infusion} causes your minions to leech a portion of the physical damage they deal as health.

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Cast Speed
nodes.description: Rip Blood has increased cast speed.

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Mana Cost And Cast Speed
nodes.description: Rip Blood costs less mana and has increased cast speed.

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Free When Out Of Mana
nodes.description: When you are out of mana Rip Blood is free.

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Added Health Gained
nodes.description: {Blood Orbs} grant additional health and the {Blood Orb} returns faster.

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree More Health Per Intelligence
nodes.description: {Blood Orbs} restore more health based on your Intelligence stat.

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Mana Gained
nodes.description: {Blood Orbs} now also grant you mana when you directly cast Rip Blood. The amount of mana is tripled for orbs from bosses and rare enemies.

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Crit Chance
nodes.description: Rip Blood has additional critical strike chance..

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Marrow Shards
nodes.description: When you directly use Rip Blood and hit a boss or rare enemy or hit at least 3 enemies, you cast Marrow Shards in the same direction.

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Spell Damage On Hit
nodes.description: When you directly cast Rip Blood and hit at least one enemy you gain additional spell damage for 6 seconds. The amount of spell damage gained is doubled for Rip Blood. This effect can stack.

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Upfront Damage
nodes.description: Rip Blood deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Upfront Damage Per Minion
nodes.description: Rip Blood deals more damage for each minion you currently control (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to a maximum benefit.

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Health To Ward
nodes.description:
{Blood Orbs} now grant ward instead of health, equal to half of the health they would have restored.

Being at or close to full health does not affect the amount of the ward the {Blood Orbs} grant.

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Splatter Chance
nodes.description: Rip Blood hits have a chance to create a {Blood Splatter} at the target, dealing damage to other enemies around it that were not hit by Rip Blood. This effect can occur a limited number of times per cast of Rip Blood.

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Blood Tether
nodes.description: When you directly cast Rip Blood and hit a boss or rare enemy it attaches a {Blood Tether}, dealing physical spell damage over time.

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Targets Minions
nodes.description: Rip Blood can be cast on your minions, but no longer can be cast on enemies. {Blood Orbs} restore significantly more health.

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Cast Again On Kill
nodes.description:
When you directly cast Rip Blood and it kills at least one enemy, it will recast from that position towards another enemy, consuming Rip Blood's mana cost. These recasts can also trigger this effect.

Rip Blood no longer creates {Blood Orbs}.

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Necrotic
nodes.description:
Rip Blood and {Blood Splatter's} base physical damage are converted to necrotic damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to necrotic damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to Damned chance.

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Target For Minions
nodes.description: Rip Blood has increased cast speed leaves a stench on the target enemy that causes your minions to prioritise attacking it.

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Coagulated Blood
nodes.description:
When a blood orb grants health, you gain a stack of {Coagulated Blood}. Upon reaching at least 6 stacks, your next cast of Rip Blood consumes 6 stacks to form a {Coagulated Blood Orb} that seeks out a nearby enemy, dealing spell physical damage in a small area.

Additionally, Blood Tethers such as from {Blood Bond} grant 3 stacks each second.

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Coagulated Blood Damage And Area
nodes.description: The {Coagulated Blood Orb} deals more damage in a larger area (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Rip Blood Tree Bleed Chance
nodes.description: Rip Blood hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed..

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree Damage Vs Mana Cost
nodes.description: Sacrifice deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Sacrifice costs more mana.

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree Damage If Minion Has More Health
nodes.description: Sacrifice deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if the sacrificed minion has more current health than you.

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree Damage If Only One Minion
nodes.description: Sacrifice deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if the minion you sacrifice is your only active minion.

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree Added Fire Damage
nodes.description: Sacrifice deals additional fire damage.

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree Mana Efficiency and DoT on Cast
nodes.description: Sacrifice costs less mana and if you cast Sacrifice while you control at least one minion you gain a buff that grants you more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers). This buff does not stack.

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree Ignite Chance
nodes.description: Sacrifice has a chance to ignite enemies and ignites it inflicts have additional fire penetration.

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree Damage Vs Bleeding
nodes.description: Sacrifice deals more hit damage against bleeding enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree Damage Per Minion
nodes.description: Sacrifice deals more damage for each minion you currently control (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree Blood Wraith Bleed
nodes.description: {Blood Spectres} have a chance to cause enemies to bleed. Blood Spectres consume less mana when summoned.

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree Blood Wraith Health And Damage
nodes.description: {Blood Spectres} summoned by Sacrifice have more maximum health and deal more damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree Blood Wraith Size
nodes.description:
Sacrificing a minion always creates a {Blood Spectre}.

Blood Spectres summoned by Sacrifice have significantly more maximum health and damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers), and are larger, but consume more mana when summoned.

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree Blood Wraith Leech
nodes.description: {Blood Spectres} leech a portion of the damage they deal as health. Sacrifice has a greater chance to summon a Blood Spectre.

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree Bone Nova Area
nodes.description: {Bone Nova} has increased area of effect.

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree Bone Nova Damage
nodes.description: {Bone Nova} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree Bone Nova Slows
nodes.description: {Bone Nova} has a chance to slow enemies hit.

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree Bone Nova Bleed Chance
nodes.description: {Bone Nova} hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree DoT Damage On Cast
nodes.description: You deal increased damage over time if you have cast Sacrifice recently (past 4 seconds). You cannot have multiple instances of this buff at once.

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree Area And Stun Chance
nodes.description: Sacrifice deals damage in a larger area and has an increased chance to stun enemies.

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree Area With Three Minions
nodes.description: Sacrifice deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area if you have three or more minions active when you cast Sacrifice.

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree Blood Wraith
nodes.description:
When you sacrifice a minion you have a chance to assemble a {Blood Spectre} from the remains. 15 mana is consumed when you summon a Blood Spectre. 

You cannot summon a Blood Spectre by sacrificing a Blood Spectre or when your mana is negative and below -100.

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree Bone Nova
nodes.description: Sacrificing a minion creates a {Bone Nova} around it, but Sacrifice costs more mana.

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree Chains
nodes.description: Sacrifice is recast onto other minions within its area of effect, which can happen multiple times. Sacrifice costs more mana.

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree Additional Chains
nodes.description: Sacrifice is recast onto other minions within its area of effect up to one additional time. It also has additional Bleed Chance.

nodes.name: Sacrifice Tree Infernal Shade
nodes.description: If you cast Sacrifice while you control at least one minion all your active {Infernal Shades} have their remaining duration reduced to 2 seconds, but deal significantly more damage for their remaining duration.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Physical Leech On Cast
nodes.description: You leech a portion of physical damage as health if you have cast Marrow Shards recently (past 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Splinter Damage
nodes.description: {Bone Splinters} deal more damage.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Splinter Speed
nodes.description: {Bone Splinters} travel faster and further.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Splinter Bleed Chance
nodes.description: {Bone Splinters} have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Splinter Damage Against Bleeding
nodes.description: {Bone Splinters} hits deal more hit damage against bleeding enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Splinter Crit Chance
nodes.description: {Bone Splinters} have additional critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Splinter Crit Multiplier
nodes.description: {Bone Splinters} have additional critical strike multiplier.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Damage Vs Range
nodes.description: Marrow Shards deals more damage, but its range is reduced.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Crit Chance And Multiplier
nodes.description: Marrow Shards has additional critical strike chance and critical strike multiplier.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Crit Multiplier
nodes.description: Marrow Shards has additional critical strike multiplier.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Health Lost On Crit
nodes.description: Marrow Shards has additional critical strike multiplier, but you lose health when you critically strike with Marrow Shards.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Splinter Nova
nodes.description:
Marrow Shards are now instantly destroyed, creating a {Splinter Nova} around you instead of {Bone Splinters}. Splinter Nova hits all enemies in an area around you.
Splinter Nova is affected by all modifiers to Marrow Shards and Bone Splinters. Modifiers to the projectile speed of Bone Splinters grant increased area for Splinter Nova.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Double Cast Chance
nodes.description:
When you directly cast Marrow Shards, you have a chance to immediately cast a second instance of Marrow Shards.

Indirect casts of Marrow Shards, such as from this effect, do not cost health.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Armour Shred Chance
nodes.description: Marrow Shards hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Health On Minion Kill
nodes.description: You gain health when you kill one of your own minions.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Crit Chance On Kill
nodes.description: Grants you increased critical strike chance if you have killed with Marrow Shards recently (past 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Leech On Kill
nodes.description: You leech a portion of physical damage as life if you have killed with Marrow Shards recently (past 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Bleed Chance And Health Cost
nodes.description: Marrow Shards has a chance to cause enemies to bleed, but costs more health.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Chance To Return Health
nodes.description: Marrow Shards has a chance to create a {Marrow Orb} on hit that returns 15 health to you. This effect can occur a limited number of times per second.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Health Returned
nodes.description: {Marrow Orbs} return more health.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Additional Chance For Health Return
nodes.description: Marrow Shards hits have a higher chance to create a {Marrow Orb}.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Mana Returned
nodes.description: {Marrow Orbs} also replenish mana.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Damage Against Bleeding
nodes.description: Marrow Shards deals more hit damage against bleeding enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree No Pierce
nodes.description: Marrow Shards deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer pierces.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Splinters
nodes.description: Marrow Shards creates {Bone Splinters} in a cone behind the enemy when destroyed, damaging other enemies, but Marrow Shards no longer pierces and costs more health.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Splinters At End
nodes.description: Marrow Shards creates {Bone Splinters} in a cone when destroyed, which damage enemies, but Marrow Shards travels less far and costs more health.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Damages Minions
nodes.description:
Marrow Shards deals more damage, but Marrow Shards can hit and damage your own minions. 

On hit effects, such as health gained on hit, do not proc when you hit your minions.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Consumes Minion
nodes.description: Marrow Shards deals significantly more damage, but consumes one of your minions when you cast it.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Marrow Shards's base physical damage is converted to cold damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not to physical damage. It also gains a base freeze rate.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance.

Swaps Marrow Shards's physical tag for a cold tag.

nodes.name: Marrow Shards Tree Second Cast Targets Nearby
nodes.description: The second cast of Marrow Shards from {Ossumancy} will target a random enemy within 15 meters.

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Can Target
nodes.description: {Wraiths} appear at the target location, but Summon Wraith costs more mana.

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Stationary
nodes.description: {Wraiths} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased melee attack speed, but are unable to move.

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Melee Attack Speed
nodes.description: {Wraiths} have more melee attack speed (multiplicative with other modifers).

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Reduced Cooldown
nodes.description: Summon Wraith has a shorter cooldown, and there is a shorter delay between each {Wraith} being summoned.

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Additional Wraith
nodes.description: Summon Wraith summons additional {Wraiths} per cast, but costs more mana.

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Increased Health
nodes.description: {Wraiths} have more maximum health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Bleed Effect
nodes.description: Bleed inflicted by {Wraiths} has increased effect and duration.

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Size and AoE
nodes.description: {Wraiths} are larger, deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and hit a larger area with their melee attacks.

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Added Necrotic Damage
nodes.description: {Wraiths} deal additional necrotic damage with attacks and spells.

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Cast Speed and Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Summon Wraith has increased cast speed and costs less mana.

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Move Speed
nodes.description: {Wraiths} move faster.

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Mana Crit
nodes.description: {Wraiths} have improved base critical strike chance, and when you cast Summon Wraith you gain increased critical strike chance equal to its mana cost for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Wraith Crit Chance
nodes.description: {Wraiths} have additional critical strike chance and leech a portion of the damage they deal with crits as health

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Wraith Crit Multiplier
nodes.description: {Wraiths'} critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Necrotic Leech
nodes.description: {Wraiths} deal more necrotic damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and leech a portion of the necrotic damage they deal as health.

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Tanky
nodes.description: {Wraiths} have more maximum health (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Summon Wraith costs more mana and has reduced cast speed.

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Melee Poison Chance
nodes.description: {Wraiths}' have additional posion penetration and their melee attacks have a chance to poison enemies on hit.

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Reduced Drain
nodes.description: {Wraiths}' health decays more slowly.

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Health On Crit
nodes.description: Your critical strikes restore health to your {Wraiths}.

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Bleed Chance
nodes.description: {Wraiths} have a chance to cause enemies to bleed on hit.

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Damned Chance On Death
nodes.description: {Wraiths} have a chance to apply {Damned} to nearby enemies on death.

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Increased Drain and Ward Gen
nodes.description: Gain ward for each {Wraith} summoned, but their health decays more quickly.

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Multiple Wraiths
nodes.description: Summon Wraith summons additional {Wraiths} with each cast, but Summon Wraith also costs more mana and now has a cooldown.

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Instant Wraiths
nodes.description: Removes the delay between each {Wraith} being summoned, but fewer Wraiths are summoned per cast (rounded up).

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Persistent Wraiths
nodes.description: {Wraiths'} health no longer decays, but you are limited to only 2 wraiths.

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Flame Wraith Chance
nodes.description: You have a chance to instead summon a {Flame Wraith}, which casts fireballs. Additionally all {Wraiths} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Tree Putrid Wraith Chance
nodes.description: You have a chance to instead summon a {Putrid Wraith}, which Poisons enemies from a distance. Additionally all {Wraiths} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Wraith Max Wraiths
nodes.description: You can control more {Wraiths} at once.

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits Summon More
nodes.description: Wandering Spirits reveals Spirits more frequently.

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits Slower Spirits
nodes.description: Spirits deal more damage when they pass through enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers), but move slower.

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits Increased Radius
nodes.description: Spirits are revealed in a larger radius around you.

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits Reduced Radius
nodes.description: Spirits are revealed in a smaller radius around the player and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits Long Lasting
nodes.description: Spirits last longer when they are revealed.

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits Shreds Necrotic Res
nodes.description: Wandering Spirits shred the necrotic resistance of enemies near them.

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits Increased Fear Range
nodes.description: Spirits can Fear enemies in a larger radius. If spirits inflict {Necrotic Resistance Shred} or {Damned} those ailments are also inflicted in a larger radius.

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits Shorter Fear
nodes.description: Spirits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but the fear they apply to enemies via the {Terrifying Presence} node has a shorter duration.

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits Longer Fear
nodes.description: Fear applied to enemies via the {Terrifying Presence} node lasts longer, but affects a smaller area.

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits More Damage While Feared
nodes.description: Spirits deal more damage to feared or possessed enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits Reduced Mana Cost
nodes.description: Wandering Spirits has increased cast speed and costs less mana.

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits More Spawning Duration
nodes.description: Wandering Spirits continues to reveal Spirits for a longer duration, but has a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits Increased Size
nodes.description:
Each Spirit is larger and deals damage in a larger area.

If you have {Terrifying Presence}, the area for inflicting fear is also increased.

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits Ward on Death
nodes.description: You gain Ward whenever a Spirit expires.

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits Mana on Death
nodes.description: You have a chance to gain mana whenever a Spirit expires.

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits Faster Spirits
nodes.description: Spirits move faster and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits More Damage to Poisoned
nodes.description: Spirits deal more damage to poisoned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits Increased Spit Range
nodes.description: Spirits cast {Spectral Putrescence} at enemies from further away.

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits Increased Spit Rate
nodes.description: Spirits can cast {Spectral Putrescence} more frequently.

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits Poison Conversion
nodes.description: The base necrotic damage dealt by Wandering Spirits is converted to poison damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits Fear
nodes.description: Enemies near Spirits are {Feared} for 0.5 to 0.9 seconds, causing them to flee from the spirit that feared them.

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits Poison Spit
nodes.description: Spirits have a chance to cast {Spectral Putrescence} at nearby enemies each second. Spectral Putrescence is a projectile with 100% chance to poison on hit.

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits At Target
nodes.description: Spirits are now revealed around a target location, rather than around you. Spirits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits More Damage to Cursed
nodes.description: Spirits deal more damage to cursed enemies and damned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Wandering Channelled
nodes.description: Wandering Spirits is now a channelled skill, has a much shorter cooldown, and creates Spirits much more frequently. You can regenerate mana while channelling this skill.

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits Reduced Cooldown
nodes.description: Wandering Spirits has a shorter cooldown

nodes.name: Wandering Spirits Applies Damned
nodes.description: Wandering Spirits inflict enemies around them with {Damned}.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls Reduced Projectiles
nodes.description: Souls deal additional spell damage based on your maximum mana, but fewer Souls are created with each cast.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls Increased Crit Chance
nodes.description: Improves Hungering Souls' base critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls Crit Multi
nodes.description: Souls' critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls Even Bigger
nodes.description: Souls are larger and deal more hit damage, but Hungering Souls costs more mana.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls More Mana On Kill
nodes.description: Souls grant you more mana when they kill an enemy.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls Reduced Spread
nodes.description: Hungering Souls fires projectiles in a narrower cone.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls Poison Chance
nodes.description: Souls have a chance to poison enemies.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls Subtracts From Mana Cost
nodes.description: Souls have an increased chance to poison enemies, and they cost less mana.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls DoT Damage on Cast
nodes.description: Directly casting Hungering Souls causes you to deal more damage over time against Possessed Enemies for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls Extra Projectiles Chance
nodes.description: Hungering Souls has a chance to fire additional projectiles.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls Increased Spread
nodes.description: Hungering Souls costs less mana, and fires projectiles in a wider cone.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls Added Speed
nodes.description: Hungering Souls has increased cast speed and its souls travel faster, causing them to go further before they expire.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls Cull Chance
nodes.description:
Souls hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). 

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls Added Necrotic Damage
nodes.description: Souls deal additional necrotic damage on Hit.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls More Retaliation
nodes.description:
You have a higher chance to cast Hungering Souls when hit.

When you directly cast Hungering Souls you gain Ward.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls Reduced Damage and More Cast When Hit
nodes.description:
You have a higher chance to cast Hungering Souls when hit.

When you directly cast Hungering Souls you have a chance to cast it twice in quick succession.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls Damage With A Minion
nodes.description: Souls deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have at least one minion.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls Damage Per Minion
nodes.description: Souls deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each minion you have.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls Damage Exactly 3 Minions
nodes.description: Souls deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have exactly three minions.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls Ward On Kill
nodes.description: Hungering Souls cost less mana and has a chance to grant ward on kill.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls Ignite Power
nodes.description: Ignites inflicted by Hungering Souls last longer and have additional Fire Penetration

nodes.name: Hungering Souls More Damage Over Time
nodes.description: Souls deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Hungering Souls Solo Soul
nodes.description: Souls are significantly larger and deal more hit damage, but only one is created with each cast.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls Mana On Kill Chance
nodes.description: Souls have a chance to grant you mana when they kill an enemy.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls Extra Projectiles
nodes.description: Hungering Souls fires additional projectiles, but costs more mana.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls Cast When Hit
nodes.description: You have a chance to cast Hungering Souls when hit, but Souls cast this way have a 70% chance to only have one projectile.

nodes.name: Hungering Souls Fire Conversion
nodes.description:
Hungering Souls' base damage is increased and converted to fire and its hits ignite instead of possessing. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Souls deal more hit damage.

nodes.name: Lunge More Damage Along Path
nodes.description: Lunge deals more damage to enemies along its path and with its final hit.

nodes.name: Lunge Added Crit Chance With Polearm
nodes.description: Improves Lunge's base critical strike chance when using a spear.

nodes.name: Lunge Physical Penetration Buff Per Enemy Hit
nodes.description: After using Lunge you gain additional physical penetration per enemy hit along the path. This buff lasts 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Lunge Added Charges
nodes.description: Lunge gains an additional charge, but it has a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Lunge Damage Along Path
nodes.description: Lunge now hits all enemies along its path to your target.

nodes.name: Lunge Invincible While Lunging
nodes.description: You are invulnerable while Lunging.

nodes.name: Lunge Recover Missing Health
nodes.description: You regain a percentage of your missing health when you use Lunge.

nodes.name: Lunge Increased Path Area
nodes.description: Lunge deals damage in a wider area along its path.

nodes.name: Lunge Allies In Path Gain Haste
nodes.description: Other allies caught in the path gain {Haste} for a short duration.

nodes.name: Lunge To Allies
nodes.description: You can now Lunge to other allies.

nodes.name: Lunge Heal Allies
nodes.description: You now heal allies and cleanse negative ailments on allies you Lunge to. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

nodes.name: Lunge Chance To Inflict Bleed Along Path
nodes.description: Lunge hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed along its path but not its final hit.

nodes.name: Lunge Fire Conversion
nodes.description:
Lunge's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage or other damage types.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance.

Swaps Lunge's {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.

This has no effect if you have taken the {Voidbringer} node.

nodes.name: Lunge Block Chance While Lunging
nodes.description: You have a high chance to block while Lunging.

nodes.name: Lunge Frailty Chance
nodes.description: Lunge's final hit has a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies based on distance traveled up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Lunge Immobilize On Final Hit
nodes.description: Lunge's final hit now {Immobilizes} enemies for a short duration.

nodes.name: Lunge More Damage And Area Base On Distance
nodes.description: Lunge's final hit deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area based on distance traveled up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Lunge Culling
nodes.description:
Lunge hits instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). The threshold is based on distance traveled up to a maximum.

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

nodes.name: Lunge Smite Chance
nodes.description: Lunge's final hit has a chance to cast {Smite} at up to 3 nearby targets based on distance traveled up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Lunge Frenzy On Kill
nodes.description: Killing an enemy with Lunge grants you {Frenzy} for a short duration.

nodes.name: Lunge Void Conversion
nodes.description:
Lunge's base physical damage is converted to void. Consequently this damage scales with increases to void damage, but not increases to physical damage or other damage types.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to chance to inflict {Time Rot}.

Swaps Lunge's {Physical} tag for a {Void} tag.

nodes.name: Lunge Kills Resets Big Melee Skill Cooldowns
