nodes.description: Killing an enemy with Lunge resets the cooldowns of {Void Cleave}, {Erasing Strike}, {Forge Strike} and {Judgement}

nodes.name: Lunge Polearm Thrust
nodes.description: Lunge's final hit now deals damage in an extended rectangle instead of a circle when using a spear.

nodes.name: Lunge Use Javelin When Reaching Target With Polearm
nodes.description:
Lunge's final hit now causes you to use {Javelin} when using a spear.

This consumes Javelin's mana cost.

nodes.name: Lunge Reduce Cooldown With Other Attacks
nodes.description:
You reduce a portion of Lunge's remaining cooldown when you use a different melee attack and hit at least one enemy. 

This effect can only occur a limited number of times per use of Lunge.

nodes.name: Lunge Melee Damage To High Health Enemies
nodes.description: Lunge deals more melee damage to enemies at high health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Lunge Haste To Nearby Allies Based On Distance
nodes.description: You grant other nearby allies {Haste} at the end of the charge for a short duration based on distance traveled, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Lunge More Cooldown Reduction And Heals
nodes.description: {Warrior's Renewal} recovers an additional amount of Lunge's cooldown and also grants you health when it triggers.

nodes.name: Flame Reave Mana Efficiency Vs Speed
nodes.description: Flame Reave has increased attack speed and costs less mana, but travels more slowly, reducing its range.

nodes.name: Flame Reave Every 4 Attacks Large
nodes.description: Using Flame Reave grants 4 stacks of {Rhythm of Fire}. If you already have 12 stacks, Flame Reave instead consumes all the stacks to gain significantly more width, range, and damage (all multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Flame Reave Surge And Mana Strike Count
nodes.description:
Directly using Surge, Fireball, Mana Strike, or Firebrand also grants stacks of {Rhythm of Fire}.

These skills cannot consume stacks of {Rhythm of Fire} and you cannot exceed the number of stacks required for Flame Reave to consume stacks, which is 12 by default.

nodes.name: Flame Reave Spreading Flames
nodes.description:
Flame Reave hits have a chance to apply {Spreading Flames}.

Flame Reave deals more fire damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Flame Reave Flat Fire Damage
nodes.description:
Flame Reave hits have a chance to grant you {Frenzy} for 3 seconds.

In addition to Frenzy's base effect it now grants Flame Reave additional melee fire damage.

nodes.name: Flame Reave Flat Fire With Swords
nodes.description: Flame Reave hits deal additional melee fire damage per equipped sword.

nodes.name: Flame Reave More Fire Damage
nodes.description: Flame Reave deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers)

nodes.name: Flame Reave Casts Lightning Blast
nodes.description: When you directly use Flame Reave and kill an enemy or hit a boss or rare enemy, you cast {Lightning Blast} at a random enemy within 6 meters. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds, and consumes a percentage of Lightning Blast's mana cost.

nodes.name: Flame Reave More Melee Damage
nodes.description: Flame Reave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and it deals added melee damage based on your added spell damage.

nodes.name: Flame Reave Melee Damage
nodes.description: Flame Reave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Flame Reave Cooldown Expands Again
nodes.description: Flame Reave now has a cooldown, but it expands and returns a second time. This can hit the same enemy two additional times.

nodes.name: Flame Reave Cooldown Recovery
nodes.description: Flame Reave can store an additional charge and has increased cooldown recovery rate, but it also has additional mana cost.

nodes.name: Flame Reave Pull on Return
nodes.description: Each time Flame Reave returns, it pulls enemies to you and grants you {Haste} for a duration.

nodes.name: Flame Reave Crit Narrow
nodes.description: Flame Reave has additional critical strike chance, but deals damage in a narrower area.

nodes.name: Flame Reave Ward on Crit
nodes.description: When you attack with Flame Reave and critically strike at least one enemy you gain ward.

nodes.name: Flame Reave Ignite Chance
nodes.description: Flame Reave hits have a chance to ignite enemies.

nodes.name: Flame Reave Damage vs Ignited
nodes.description: Flame Reave hits deal more melee damage against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Flame Reave Crit vs Ignited
nodes.description: Flame Reave melee hits have more critical strike chance against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Flame Reave Speed and Range
nodes.description: Flame Reave travels faster, increasing its range.

nodes.name: Flame Reave Crit Multi
nodes.description: Flame Reave's critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Flame Reave Increased Width
nodes.description: Flame Reave deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Flame Reave Casts Elemental Nova
nodes.description: When you directly cast Flame Reave and consume {Rhythm of Fire}, you cast {Elemental Nova} with more area and damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This effect consumes a percentage of Elemental Nova's mana cost.

nodes.name: Flame Reave Lightning Conversion
nodes.description:
Half of Flame Reave's base damage is converted to lightning, meaning that this half of the damage scales with increases to lightning damage but not with increases to fire damage.

Fire damage bonuses from this tree now also apply to Lightning.

Ignite chance from this tree now also grants an equal amount of shock chance.

Flame Reave gains a {Lightning} tag.

nodes.name: Flame Reave Casts Fireball
nodes.description: When you directly use Flame Reave and kill an enemy or hit a boss or rare enemy, you cast {Fireball} at a random enemy within 6 meters. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds, and consumes a percentage of Fireball's mana cost.

nodes.name: Flame Reave Returns
nodes.description: Flame Reave returns to you. This can hit the same enemy again, but it costs more mana.

nodes.name: Flame Reave Circle
nodes.description: Flame Reave hits enemies in an expanding circle centered on you, but has less range and costs significantly more mana.

nodes.name: Flame Reave Fire Aura
nodes.description:
You have a chance to cast {Fire Aura} when you directly use Flame Reave. Flame Reave has additional chance to Ignite on hit per active Fire Aura.

These effects are tripled if Flame Reave has a cooldown.

nodes.name: Flame Reave Rhythm of Fire Crit
nodes.description:
Flame Reave requires fewer stacks of {Rhythm of Fire} to consume all stacks. This does not affect the bonuses from consuming stacks.

Additionally when Flame Reave consumes {Rhythm of Fire} stacks it gains additional critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Black Hole Damage and Less Pull
nodes.description: Black Hole deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Black Hole pulls enemies towards it slower.

nodes.name: Black Hole Chill Chance Per Second
nodes.description: Black Hole has a chance to chill enemies within its area of effect each second.

nodes.name: Black Hole Added Fire Damage
nodes.description: Black Hole’s damage over time penetrates enemy fire resistance.

nodes.name: Black Hole Ignite Chance Per Second
nodes.description: Black Hole has a chance to ignite enemies within its area of effect each second based on your uncapped fire resistance.

nodes.name: Black Hole Increased Fire Damage
nodes.description: Black Hole deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Black Hole Ward Generate
nodes.description: Black Hole grants you ward each second.

nodes.name: Black Hole Increased Damage
nodes.description: Black Hole deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Black Hole Slower Cast and Increased Damage
nodes.description: Black Hole deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has reduced cast speed.

nodes.name: Black Hole Chance To Freeze On Hit
nodes.description: The explosions created by the {Collapse} and {Pulsar} nodes have an increased chance to freeze enemies.

nodes.name: Black Hole Blind Enemies
nodes.description: Black Hole has increased duration and a chance to blind enemies within its area of effect each second.

nodes.name: Black Hole Recast Chance On End
nodes.description: Black Hole has a chance to create another Black Hole once it expires.

nodes.name: Black Hole All Smaller
nodes.description: Black Hole's cooldown is reduced and it costs less mana, but pulls enemies towards it slower and pulls enemies within a lesser area (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Black Hole Increased Pull Strength
nodes.description: Black Hole pulls enemies toward it faster and from within an increased area.

nodes.name: Black Hole Faster Homing
nodes.description: Black Hole moves faster toward the nearest enemy.

nodes.name: Black Hole Hit Damage
nodes.description: Black Hole’s center hits enemies, dealing spell physical damage.

nodes.name: Black Hole Prioritises Rares And Bosses
nodes.description: Black Hole deals more damage to rare enemies and bosses (multiplicative with other modifiers), and it prioritises moving towards rare enemies and bosses.

nodes.name: Black Hole Added Duration
nodes.description: Black Hole lasts longer.

nodes.name: Black Hole Added Duration and Cooldown
nodes.description: Black Hole has increased duration, but has additional cooldown duration.

nodes.name: Black Hole Extra Black Hole
nodes.description: A second Black Hole is created 10 meters away in a random direction from the first Black Hole.

nodes.name: Black Hole Increased Damage At Center
nodes.description: Black Hole deals more damage to enemies within 1 meter of its center.

nodes.name: Black Hole One Hole Only
nodes.description: Black Hole deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but only 1 Black Hole can be created at a time.

nodes.name: Black Hole Convert To Fire
nodes.description:
Black Hole’s base cold damage is converted to fire damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Black Hole lasts much longer, but no longer pulls enemies.

nodes.name: Black Hole Binary Star
nodes.description:
Black Hole becomes two stars which orbit each other. One deals fire damage and the other deals cold damage. 

Black Hole deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Black Hole Shockwave On End
nodes.description: Black Hole will {Collapse} at the end of its duration, an explosion which deals cold hit damage and knocks enemies back.

nodes.name: Black Hole Shockwave Per Second
nodes.description: Black Hole will {Collapse} each second while it exists, but it deals less damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Black Hole Homing
nodes.description: Black Hole moves toward the nearest enemy that is not within its damaging area.

nodes.name: Black Hole Armageddon
nodes.description: Black Hole casts {Meteor} every second, but consumes Meteor's mana cost every second.

nodes.name: Black Hole Additional Charge
nodes.description: You can store an additional charge of Black Hole.

nodes.name: Bone Golem Added Attack Speed
nodes.description: Your Golem has increased attack speed, cast speed, and movement speed.

nodes.name: Bone Golem Added Fire Protection
nodes.description: Your Golem has a chance to ignite enemies, additional fire resistance, and deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Bone Golem Added Fire Damage
nodes.description: Your Golem deals additional fire damage with spells and melee attacks.

nodes.name: Bone Golem Fire Area
nodes.description: Your Golem deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers), and {Pyre Golems}’ {Infernal Aura} deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Bone Golem Increased Move Speed
nodes.description: Your Golem causes all nearby minions to move faster, including themselves. This bonus is doubled for the Golems themselves.

nodes.name: Bone Golem Poison Buff to Player
nodes.description: Your Golem has a chance to grant you a stack of {Putrid Coating} when it is hit. Each stack lasts for 8 seconds and grants you a chance to poison enemies.

nodes.name: Bone Golem Melee Cold Damage And Chill To Attackers
nodes.description: Your Golem deals additional melee cold damage and it has a chance to chill attackers when hit.

nodes.name: Bone Golem Health and Armor
nodes.description: Your Golem deals more damage and has more health and armor (each multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Bone Golem Melee Attack Damage
nodes.description: Your Golem deals more damage with melee attacks (multiplicative with other modifers), and has an increased chance to stun with melee attacks.

nodes.name: Bone Golem Big and Armor
nodes.description: Your Golem is larger (multiplicative with other modifiers), has increased area of effect, and generates more threat, which increases the likelihood of enemies targeting it.

nodes.name: Bone Golem Protection From Corpse
nodes.description:
Your Golems have increased size and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have no other living golems when you summon them.

Your Golems have significantly higher armor for the first 15 seconds of their life when summoned near the corpse of another Golem.

nodes.name: Bone Golem Undead Armor Aura
nodes.description: Your Golem grants additional armor to nearby minions, including itself.

nodes.name: Bone Golem Health On Hits
nodes.description: Your Golem's hits restore health to you and itself. This effect restores additional health per 2 Vitality.

nodes.name: Bone Golem Increased Stun Chance
nodes.description: Your Golem deals more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and has an increased chance to stun.

nodes.name: Bone Golem Increased Bone Nova Damage
nodes.description: Your Golem has a higher chance to retaliate with {Bone Shatter} when hit and its Bone Shatter deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Bone Golem Health Regen
nodes.description: Your Golem has additional health regeneration based on your total amount of health regeneration.

nodes.name: Bone Golem Armor On Skeleton Death
nodes.description: Your {Skeletons} which die within 18 meters of your Bone Golem grant it more armor and melee damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Bone Golem Betrayal
nodes.description: If you only control one Golem, it has a much higher chance to retaliate with {Bone Shatter} when damaged by hits from allies.

nodes.name: Bone Golem Twins
nodes.description: When you directly cast Summon Bone Golem you summon an additional Golem, but each Golem has reduced maximum health, is smaller, and deals less damage (all multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Bone Golem Bone Golem
nodes.description: Your Golems deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). If Bone Golems have been replaced by another type of Golem, you now have an equal chance to summon a Bone Golem.

nodes.name: Bone Golem Pyre Golem
nodes.description:
You now summon a {Pyre Golem} instead of a Bone Golem.

The base physical damage of Pyre Golems' melee attacks is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to minion fire damage, but not increases to minion physical damage.

Pyre Golems also cast {Infernal Aura}, a spell that deals a burst of fire damage on cast and fire damage over time afterwards. Infernal Aura also ignites nearby enemies every second.

nodes.name: Bone Golem Deathchill Golem
nodes.description:
You now summon a {Deathchill Golem} instead of a Bone Golem. 

The base physical damage of Deathchill Golems' melee attacks is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to minion cold damage, but not increases to minion physical damage. Death Chill Golems' melee attacks gain a Freeze Rate equal to twice their base damage.

Deathchill Golem also casts Freezing Grasp, a spell that deals cold damage and has high freeze rate. Bosses cannot be frozen by this.

nodes.name: Bone Golem Blood Golem
nodes.description:
You now summon a {Blood Golem} instead of a Bone Golem. 

Blood Golems can also cast {Sanguine Orb}, a spell that deals physical damage to nearby enemies over 2 seconds.

nodes.name: Bone Golem Bone Nova Repeat
nodes.description: Your Golem's {Bone Shatter} has a chance to repeat from enemies hit by it. This effect can occur a limited number of times per second.

nodes.name: Bone Golem Freeze Rate Per Vitality
nodes.description: Your Golem's {Freezing Grasp} spell now has additional spell damage and base freeze rate per point of Vitality.

nodes.name: Bone Golem Fire Aura Consumes Skeletons
nodes.description: Your {Skeletons} and {Skeletal Mages} which die within 18 meters of your Bone Golem grant it more fire damage over time to ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Snap Freeze Cast Speed
nodes.description: Snap Freeze has increased cast speed.

nodes.name: Snap Freeze Reduced Duration and Cooldown
nodes.description: Snap Freeze has a shorter cooldown, but Freeze inflicted by Snap Freeze has reduced duration.

nodes.name: Snap Freeze Chill Chance
nodes.description: Snap Freeze has a chance to chill enemies.

nodes.name: Snap Freeze Chill Duration
nodes.description: Chill caused by Snap Freeze has increased duration. If you have taken the {Snap Shock} node, this increases Shock duration instead.

nodes.name: Snap Freeze More Cold Damage
nodes.description: Snap Freeze hits deal additional spell cold damage.

nodes.name: Snap Freeze Crit Chance
nodes.description: Improves Snap Freeze’s base critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Snap Freeze Crit Multi
nodes.description: Snap Freeze critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Snap Freeze Shock Effectiveness
nodes.description: Snap Freeze hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of {Shock} on the target.

nodes.name: Snap Freeze Reduced Cooldown
nodes.description: Snap Freeze costs less mana and has a shorter cooldown.

nodes.name: Snap Freeze Frostbite
nodes.description: Snap Freeze inflicts {Frostbite} on all enemies within its area of effect.

nodes.name: Snap Freeze Frostbite Effect
nodes.description: {Frostbite} inflicted by Snap Freeze has additional Cold Penetration.

nodes.name: Snap Freeze Reduced Mana and Cone Width
nodes.description: Snap Freeze costs less mana, but has a narrower area of effect.

nodes.name: Snap Freeze Increased Range
nodes.description: Snap Freeze’s area of effect extends further away from you.

nodes.name: Snap Freeze More Freeze Duration
nodes.description: Freeze inflicted by Snap Freeze has a longer duration, but has a narrower area of effect.

nodes.name: Snap Freeze Armor
nodes.description: You have additional armor and cold resistance while Snap Freeze is on cooldown.

nodes.name: Snap Freeze Increased Freeze Duration
nodes.description: Freeze inflicted by Snap Freeze last longer.

nodes.name: Snap Freeze Steal Protection
nodes.description: You steal cold resistance from enemies hit by Snap Freeze, causing you to gain cold resistance for 4 seconds and the enemies hit to lose it.

nodes.name: Snap Freeze Second Charge
nodes.description: You can store an additional charge of Snap Freeze, but Snap Freeze has a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Snap Freeze Knockback
nodes.description: Snap Freeze knocks enemies back.

nodes.name: Snap Freeze Cold Damage
nodes.description: Snap Freeze hits and deals spell cold damage and can apply on-hit effects, but costs more mana.

nodes.name: Snap Freeze Lightning Conversion
nodes.description:
Snap Freeze no longer freezes and its base cold damage is converted to lightning damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Adds 4 lighting damage for each second of freeze duration. 

All chill chance is converted to shock chance, and all nodes which rely on targets being frozen or chilled now work on shocked enemies instead.

nodes.name: Snap Freeze Frozen Ground
nodes.description: Snap Freeze leaves a patch of {Frozen Ground} for 5 seconds, which chills all enemies who walk on it. Frostbite inflicted by Snap Freeze last longer.

nodes.name: Snap Freeze Self Freeze
nodes.description: When directly cast, Snap Freeze also freezes yourself for 2 seconds. You cannot take damage while frozen this way.

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth More Health
nodes.description: Your sabertooth has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and recovers a percentage of its maximum health when it leaps.

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Added Cold Protection
nodes.description: Your sabertooth has additional cold resistance and it has a chance to chill attackers that hit it. It also has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Attack Speed And Flurry Swipes Damage
nodes.description: Your sabertooth has increased attack speed. Additionally, it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with {Flurry Swipes}.

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Dodge Rating
nodes.description: Your sabertooth has more dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers), and it gains additional dodge rating for each point of Dexterity you have.

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Increased Melee Damage
nodes.description: Your sabertooth deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its melee attacks have increased area.

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Crit Chance
nodes.description: Your sabertooth has additional critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Crit Multi
nodes.description: Your sabertooth has additional critical strike multiplier.

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Attack Speed
nodes.description: Your sabertooth has increased attack speed.

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Low Health
nodes.description: While your sabertooth is on low health it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and leeches a portion of the melee damage it deals as health.

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth DoT Damage
nodes.description: Your sabertooth deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Melee Cold Damage
nodes.description: Your sabertooth deals additional cold damage with spells and melee attacks.

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Increased Cold Damage And Freeze Chance
nodes.description: Your sabertooth has additional Freeze Rate Multiplier and it has more Freeze Rate per stack of Chill on the target (multiplicative with other modifiers)

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Cold Damage Per Dex
nodes.description: Your sabertooth deals additional cold melee damage based on your dexterity.

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Physical Taken As Cold
nodes.description: All physical damage dealt to your sabertooth is converted to cold damage. Consequently it is reduced by cold resistance, but not by physical resistance.

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Swipes On Attack
nodes.description: When your sabertooth directly uses a melee attack and hits at least one target it has a chance to use {Flurry Swipes}.

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Attack Speed and Bleed
nodes.description: Your sabertooth gains Frenzy for 2 seconds after using {Flurry Swipes}.

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Ice Tiger
nodes.description:
Your sabertooth becomes an {Ice Tiger}, converting 100% of its base melee physical damage to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not with increases to physical damage. The ice tiger's melee attacks have a freeze rate equal to twice their base damage.

All bleed chance is converted to frostbite chance for your ice tiger.

The ice tiger's melee attacks' {Physical} tags are swapped for {Cold} tags.

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Damage To Chilled
nodes.description: Your sabertooth deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of chill on the target.

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Frostbite And Chill Chance
nodes.description: Your sabertooth has a chance to inflict frostbite and chill on hit.

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth No Leap
nodes.description: Your sabertooth deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies, but your Sabertooth can no longer leap.

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Upheaval
nodes.description:
Your sabertooth's attacks which hit at least one enemy have a chance to trigger {Upheaval}. Upheaval cast in this way uses your sabertooth's stats, but your Upheaval tree.

This chance is halved if Upheaval creates multiple fault lines.

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Casts Upheaval On Leap
nodes.description: When your sabertooth leaps, it uses {Upheaval} when it lands

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Haste On Leap
nodes.description: When your sabertooth leaps you gain {Haste} for a duration.

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Ancestral Sabertooth Chance
nodes.description: Your sabertooth's hits now have a chance to summon an {Ancestral Sabertooth} that attacks nearby enemies for a short duration. This effect can trigger a limited number of times per 5 seconds.

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Ancestral Sabertooth Damage
nodes.description: Your sabertooth's hits have a higher chance to summon {Ancestral Sabertooths} and they deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Flurry Swipes Bleed And Crit
nodes.description: Your sabertooth's {Flurry Swipes} inflict Bleed on hit and if you or your Sabertoth are below half health it always crits.

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Ancestral Sabertooth Duration
nodes.description: Your ancestral sabertooths have increased duration per point of your attunement. Additionally, your sabertooth gains attunement scaling equivalent to its strength scaling.

nodes.name: Summon Sabertooth Bleed Chance
nodes.description: Your sabertooth's hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and a chance to shred armor.

nodes.name: Focus Health Regen
nodes.description: Focus grants increased health regeneration while channeled.

nodes.name: Focus Increased Regen per Missing
nodes.description: Focus grants increased mana regeneration while channeled proportional to the amount of mana you are missing when you start channeling.

nodes.name: Focus Negative Mana Boost
nodes.description: Casting Focus while at negative mana instantly grants mana equal to a percentage of your maximum mana, but Focus has a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Focus Instant Mana Gained As Ward
nodes.description: The mana gained from the Null Profusion and Null Infusion nodes is also gained as ward, but Focus has a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Focus Increased Mana Regen
nodes.description: Focus grants increased mana regeneration while channeled.

nodes.name: Focus Shock Chance
nodes.description: Focus grants a chance to shock nearby enemies each second while channeled and causes you to take less damage from shocked enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Focus Increased Ailment Duration
nodes.description: Shocks, chills and ignites inflicted by Focus have a longer duration.

nodes.name: Focus Ignite Chance
nodes.description: Focus grants a chance to ignite nearby enemies each second while channeled and causes you to take less damage from ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Focus Armor
nodes.description: Focus heightens your armor while channeling (multiplicative with other modifiers) and grants you additional armor based on your intelligence.

nodes.name: Focus Elemental Protection
nodes.description: Focus grants less elemental damage taken while channeled (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Focus Heath Recovery
nodes.description: Focus heals the target each second while channeled.

nodes.name: Focus Overcharged Mana
nodes.description: Focus can increase your current mana to a percentage above your maximum mana. The excess decays at a rate of 10 mana per second after you stop channeling.

nodes.name: Focus All Protections
nodes.description: Focus grants additional resistance while channeled.

nodes.name: Focus Ward Retention
nodes.description: Focus grants additional ward retention while channeled.

nodes.name: Focus Ward Per Second
nodes.description: Focus grants additional ward per second while channeled.

nodes.name: Focus End Channel Ward
nodes.description: You gain ward equal to a percentage of the mana you gained once you finish channeling.

nodes.name: Focus Increased Channelling Lightning Damage Frequency
nodes.description: {Energy Overflow} is cast more frequently.

nodes.name: Focus Channelling Lightning Damage Max Mana Damage
nodes.description: The waves of lightning released by the Energy Overflow and Energy Battery nodes deal more damage while you are at full mana (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Focus End Channel Lightning Damage
nodes.description: When you finish channeling, you unleash a wave of lightning with base damage equal to a percentage of the mana you gained while channeling.

nodes.name: Focus Burst Mana and Ward
nodes.description: The burst of ward and mana after channelling for exactly one second grants additional ward and mana.

nodes.name: Focus No Cooldown
nodes.description:
Focus no longer has a cooldown, but the burst no longer grants mana.

This node has no effect if you have either the {Null Profusion} node or the {Conveyance} node.

nodes.name: Focus Negative Mana Key Node
nodes.description: Casting Focus while at negative mana instantly grants mana equal to a percentage of your maximum mana, but Focus has a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Focus Chill Chance
nodes.description: Focus grants a chance to chill nearby enemies each second while channeled and causes you to take less damage from chilled enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Focus Health Recovery Per Int
nodes.description: Focus has increased healing effectiveness per point of intelligence.

nodes.name: Focus Cast on Allies
nodes.description: Focus can be cast on allies.

nodes.name: Focus End Channel Move Speed
nodes.description: You gain Haste for 1 second per 20 mana you gained while channeling once you finish channeling. Maximum of 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Focus Channelling Lightning Damage AoE
nodes.description: You unleash waves of lightning with base damage equal to a percentage of your maximum mana to nearby enemies each second while channeling.

nodes.name: Focus Teleport
nodes.description:
You teleport to the target location when you start channelling Focus, as long as the location is accessible. This does not count as casting the Teleport skill and is not affected by Teleport's skill tree.

Focus now counts as a {Traversal} skill.

nodes.name: Harvest Shred Necrotic Protection
nodes.description: Harvest hits have a chance to reduce enemy necrotic resistance, and Harvest deals more damage over time.

nodes.name: Harvest Heal On Hit Cursed
nodes.description:
Harvest grants you health each time it hits a cursed enemy.

Health gained scales with your intelligence stat.

nodes.name: Harvest Increased Radius
nodes.description: Harvest has increased area of effect, and is increased further if using a two handed weapon.

nodes.name: Harvest Added Crit Chance
nodes.description: Improves Harvest's base critical strike chance, and increases Harvest's attack speed.

nodes.name: Harvest Increased Crit Chance On Hit
nodes.description: You have increased critical strike chance and critical strike multiplier if you have hit a {Cursed} enemy with Harvest recently (past 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Harvest Move Speed On Crit
nodes.description: Critical hits with Harvest have a chance to grant Haste for 2 seconds.

nodes.name: Harvest Ward On Hit Cursed
nodes.description:
Harvest grants you ward when it hits a {Cursed} enemy. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 5 seconds.
Harvest also deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Harvest Mana On Kill Or Hit
nodes.description: When you directly use Harvest, you restore mana for each enemy killed or each boss or rare enemy hit.

nodes.name: Harvest Wandering Spirit Stacks
nodes.description:
When Harvest kills an enemy or hits at least one boss or rare enemy, you have a chance to gain a stack of {Stolen Spirit}, up to 5.

At 5 stacks, your next Harvest hit against a boss or rare enemy consumes all stacks to release a Wandering Spirit per stack.

nodes.name: Harvest Chance to Poison
nodes.description: Harvest hits have a chance to poison enemies.

nodes.name: Harvest Hit Damage Per Ailment
nodes.description: Harvest hits deal more hit damage per unique ailment on the target (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to a maximum benefit.

nodes.name: Harvest Chance To Inflict Bleed
nodes.description: Harvest has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

nodes.name: Harvest Self Bleed
nodes.description:
When you hit an enemy with Harvest both you and the enemy are inflicted with bleed. Bleed stacks on enemies inflicted by Harvest have additional Physical Penetration.

The self-inflicted bleed does not scale with your stats.

nodes.name: Harvest Added Crit and Health Cost
nodes.description: Harvest has additional critical strike chance and critical multiplier, but a percentage of your current health is also consumed on use.

nodes.name: Harvest Minion Crit Chance On Crit
nodes.description: Minions have increased critical strike chance if you have landed a critical strike with Harvest recently (past 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Harvest Cull On Hit
nodes.description: Harvest hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health), and Harvest deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Harvest Zombie Chance
nodes.description: When Harvest kills an enemy or hits a boss or rare enemy, you have a chance to summon a {Volatile Zombie}, consuming a percentage of its mana cost. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Harvest Minions Target Enemies Hit
nodes.description: Harvest hits leave a trace on enemies, causing enemies to take increased damage and be prioritized by your minions. Traces last for 5 seconds.

nodes.name: Harvest Blood Wraith Crit Chance
nodes.description: {Blood Specters} summoned by Harvest have a significantly increased critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Harvest Blood Wraith Leech
nodes.description: {Blood Specters} summoned by Harvest leech a signficant portion of the damage they deal as health.

nodes.name: Harvest Blood Wraith Necrotic Damage
nodes.description: {Blood Specters} summoned by Harvest deal additional melee necrotic damage.

nodes.name: Harvest Spread Spirit Plague
nodes.description: When Harvest hits a target afflicted by Spirit Plague, it applies Withering and has a chance to spread Spirit Plague to an additional target.

nodes.name: Harvest Extra Damage vs Marked
nodes.description: Harvest hits deal more damage against {Cursed} enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Harvest Missing Health As Ward
nodes.description: When you directly use Harvest and hit at least one enemy, gain a percentage of your missing health as ward.

nodes.name: Harvest Chance to Summon Blood Wraith
nodes.description: Harvest has a chance to summon a {Blood Specter} when it kills an enemy. You cannot summon more than one Blood Specter every 2 seconds.

nodes.name: Harvest Physical Damage Conversion
nodes.description:
Harvest's base necrotic damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Harvest now gains bleed chance per point of intelligence. Harvest's added damage per dexterity scaling is now added physical melee damage.

Swaps Harvest's {Necrotic} tag for a {Physical} tag.

nodes.name: Harvest Cold Damage Conversion
nodes.description:
Harvest's base necrotic damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Harvest now gains frostbite chance per point of intelligence. Harvest gains added cold melee damage per dexterity instead of added necrotic melee damage. Bleed chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance.

Swaps Harvest's {Necrotic} tag for a {Cold} tag.

nodes.name: Harvest Attack Speed Dual Wielding
nodes.description: Harvest has increased attack speed, and is increased further if dual wielding.

Teleport Reduced Cooldown
nodes.description: Teleport has a shorter cooldown.

nodes.name: Teleport Cold Protection and Armor
nodes.description: You have higher cold resistance and armor if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Teleport Increased Buff Duration
nodes.description: Stat buffs granted by having cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds) last longer.

nodes.name: Teleport Extra Images at End
nodes.description: Teleport creates additional {Mirror Images} on arrival. Mirror images have a shorter duration.

nodes.name: Teleport Increased Mirror Duration
nodes.description: {Mirror Images} last longer.

nodes.name: Teleport Gain Flat Ward
nodes.description: Teleport grants ward on cast.

nodes.name: Teleport Gain Ward Per Int
nodes.description: When you use Teleport, you are granted ward equal to your intelligence stat.

nodes.name: Teleport Increased Ward Retention
nodes.description: You have increased ward retention if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Teleport Lightning and Fire Protection
nodes.description: You have higher lightning resistance, fire resistance, and stun avoidance if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Teleport Increased Knockback Distance
nodes.description: Teleport knocks enemies further back.

nodes.name: Teleport Increased Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Teleport costs less mana.

nodes.name: Teleport Increased Cooldown Recovery Stat
nodes.description: Your other skills recover more quickly if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Teleport Increased Elemental Damage
nodes.description: You deal increased elemental damage if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Teleport Cast Elemental Nova At Start
nodes.description:
Teleport casts Elemental Nova where you depart.

This node does not work if Elemental Nova has a cooldown.

nodes.name: Teleport Cast Elemental Nova In Middle
nodes.description:
Teleport casts Elemental Nova halfway between your arrival and departure points.

This node does not work if Elemental Nova has a cooldown.

nodes.name: Teleport Cast Health To Ward
nodes.description: Casting Teleport converts a percentage of your current health into twice as much ward.

nodes.name: Teleport Stun Immunity
nodes.description: You cannot be stunned if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Teleport Knockback At End
nodes.description: Teleport knocks enemies back from your destination once you arrive.

nodes.name: Teleport Cold Snap At Start
nodes.description: You have a higher chance to freeze enemies if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Teleport Next Spell Free
nodes.description: After casting Teleport your next direct spell cast refunds its mana cost, but Teleport has a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Teleport Mirror Image at Start
nodes.description: Teleport creates a {Mirror Image} where you depart. Mirror Images count as minions and will taunt nearby enemies for 10 seconds, then disappear. Teleport costs more mana.

nodes.name: Teleport Mirror Image at End
nodes.description: Teleport creates a {Mirror Image} where you arrive. Mirror Images count as minions and will taunt nearby enemies for 10 seconds, then disappear. Teleport costs more mana.

nodes.name: Teleport Cast Elemental Nova At End
nodes.description:
Teleport casts Elemental Nova where you arrive.

This node does not work if Elemental Nova has a cooldown.

nodes.name: Teleport Cooldown Recovery
nodes.description: Teleport has a shorter cooldown and if you have {Haste} when you cast Teleport its duration is reset.

nodes.name: Rebuke Health Regen
nodes.description: You have increased health regeneration while channelling Rebuke.

nodes.name: Rebuke Cooldown Reduction
nodes.description: Rebuke has a shorter cooldown, but costs more mana.

nodes.name: Rebuke Elemental Protection
nodes.description: You take less elemental damage while channelling Rebuke (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Rebuke Armor
nodes.description: You have more armor (multiplicative with other modifiers) while channelling Rebuke.

nodes.name: Rebuke Extended Duration
nodes.description: Rebuke's maximum duration is increased, allowing you to absorb more damage.

nodes.name: Rebuke Increased End Buff Duration
nodes.description: Buffs via the {Burst of Speed} and {Protective Legacy} nodes last longer after you finish channelling Rebuke.

nodes.name: Rebuke Increased Mana Regen
nodes.description: You have increased mana regeneration while channelling Rebuke.

nodes.name: Rebuke Increased Area
nodes.description: Rebuke hits deal more damage, and Rebuke hits in a larger area.

nodes.name: Rebuke Ignite Chance
nodes.description: You have a chance to ignite nearby enemies each second while channelling Rebuke.

nodes.name: Rebuke Debuff Enemy Armor
nodes.description: You have a chance to reduce nearby enemy armor each second while channelling Rebuke.

nodes.name: Rebuke Increased Ailment Duration
nodes.description: Ignite, armor shred, and spreading flames applied to enemies while channelling Rebuke last longer.

nodes.name: Rebuke Added Void Damage To Final Hit
nodes.description: Rebuke hits deal additional base void damage.

nodes.name: Rebuke Increased Duration And Cooldown
nodes.description: Rebuke has an increased maximum duration, allowing you to absorb more damage, but has a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Rebuke Heal Acceleration
nodes.description: While channeling Rebuke the healing from the {Redemption} node increases each second.

nodes.name: Rebuke Heal AttunementScaling
nodes.description: Healing via the {Redemption} node now also scales with your attunement.

nodes.name: Rebuke Buffs After Channelling
nodes.description: The buffs you are granted via the {Augmented Plating} and {Brave the Elements} nodes now persist after you finish channelling Rebuke. Their duration is equal to half the duration you channelled Rebuke for.

nodes.name: Rebuke Mana When Hit
nodes.description: Regenerate mana when you are hit while channelling Rebuke.

nodes.name: Rebuke End Channel Move Speed
nodes.description: After you finish channelling Rebuke you gain the {Haste} buff, attack speed, and cast speed for a duration equal to half the duration you channelled Rebuke for.

nodes.name: Rebuke Heal Over Time
nodes.description: You heal yourself and nearby allies each second while channelling Rebuke.

nodes.name: Rebuke Spreading Flames On Hit
nodes.description: While channelling Rebuke, you have a chance to apply {Spreading Flames} to nearby enemies each second.

nodes.name: Rebuke Chance To Gain Void Essence On Hit
nodes.description: Rebuke hits have a chance to grant you a {Void Essence}.

nodes.name: Rebuke Cooldown Recovery On Melee Hit
nodes.description:
You reduce a portion of Rebuke's remaining cooldown when you use a different melee attack and hit at least one enemy.

This effect can only occur a limited number of times per use of Rebuke, and the effect is doubled while wielding a two handed weapon.

nodes.name: Rebuke Additional Charge
nodes.description: Rebuke now has an additonal charge.

nodes.name: Storm Totem Added Shock Chance
nodes.description: Storm Totem attacks have a chance to shock enemies.

nodes.name: Storm Totem More Damage To Shocked
nodes.description: Storm Totem hits deal more damage to shocked enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Storm Totem Added Crit Chance To Shocked
nodes.description: Storm Totem has more critical strike chance against shocked enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Storm Totem Lightning Damage Per Shock Chance
nodes.description: Storm Totem has additional Spell Lightning Damage based on your Shock Chance and your Chance to Shock Attackers.

nodes.name: Storm Totem Move Speed On Shock
nodes.description: You have increased movement speed if Storm Totem has hit a shocked enemy recently (last 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Storm Totem Increased Lightning Damage On Shock
nodes.description: You deal increased lightning damage if a Storm Totem has hit a shocked an enemy recently.

nodes.name: Storm Totem Lightning Protection Aura
nodes.description: Allies near your Storm Totem have additional lightning resistance.

nodes.name: Storm Totem Increased Health
nodes.description: Storm Totem has increased health.

nodes.name: Storm Totem Increased Stun Chance
nodes.description: Storm Totem hits have an increased chance to stun enemies and the stuns they inflict last longer.

nodes.name: Storm Totem Increased Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Storm Totem costs less mana to summon.

nodes.name: Storm Totem Increased Totem Cast Speed
nodes.description: Storm Totem has more cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Storm Totem Added Crit Chance
nodes.description: Improves Storm Totem's base critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Storm Totem Added Crit Multi
nodes.description: Storm Totem critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Storm Totem Added Cold Damage
nodes.description: Storm Totem deals additional cold spell damage.

nodes.name: Storm Totem Increased Chill Chance
nodes.description: Storm Totem hits have a chance to chill enemies.

nodes.name: Storm Totem Added Frostbite Chance
nodes.description: {Blizzard} has a chance to inflict enemies with {Frostbite} each second.

nodes.name: Storm Totem Increased Frostbite Effectiveness
nodes.description: {Frostbite} inflicted by {Blizzard} has additional Cold Penetration.

nodes.name: Storm Totem Increased AoE
nodes.description: Storm Totem's individual lightning strikes damage enemies in a larger area

nodes.name: Storm Totem Lightning Damage Aura
nodes.description: Allies near your Storm Totem are granted additional melee lightning damage.

nodes.name: Storm Totem Increased Damage and Mana Cost
nodes.description: Storm Totem deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but cost more mana.

nodes.name: Storm Totem Reduced Move Speed To Shocked
nodes.description: Enemies hit by Storm Totem recently have reduced movement speed.

nodes.name: Storm Totem Blizzard
nodes.description:
Storm Totem now creates a {Blizzard} around itself; enemies caught in the blizzard take cold damage over time and have a 25% chance to be chilled each second.

All shock chance is converted to chill chance. All effects which are conditional on shock are conditional on chill instead.

nodes.name: Storm Totem Nova On Death
nodes.description: Storm Totem casts {Lightning Nova} when it dies.

nodes.name: Storm Totem Thunder Totem
nodes.description:
If you have at least 3 other totems when you summon Storm Totem, up to 5 are consumed to instead summon a {Thunder Totem} which has more damage, duration, health and size per totem consumed this way (all multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect does not consume other Storm Totems or Thunder Totems.

nodes.name: Storm Totem Storm Bolt
nodes.description: Your Storm Totem now casts {Storm Bolts} from your {Gathering Storm} instead of its own lightning strikes, but Storm Totem has significantly less cast speed and deals less damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Holy Aura Increased Flame Burst Final Hit
nodes.description: If you are the one to get the final hit to unleash {Flame Burst} on an enemy, it deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Holy Aura Increased Attack and Cast Speed
nodes.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased attack and cast speed.

nodes.name: Holy Aura Added Crit Chance
nodes.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Holy Aura Increased Crit Multi
nodes.description: Holy Aura causes you and your allies' critical strikes to deal more damage.

nodes.name: Holy Aura Fire Damage
nodes.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased fire and lightning damage.

nodes.name: Holy Aura Added Ignite On Hit Chance
nodes.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies a chance to ignite and electrify enemies.

nodes.name: Holy Aura Added Elemental Penetration
nodes.description: Holy Aura causes you and your allies to penetrate enemy fire and lightning resistance.

nodes.name: Holy Aura Physical Damage
nodes.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased physical damage.

nodes.name: Holy Aura Throwing Damage And Stun Chance
nodes.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased throwing attack damage and increased stun chance with throwing attacks.

nodes.name: Holy Aura Added Ele Prot
nodes.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies additional elemental resistance and endurance threshold.

nodes.name: Holy Aura Increased Dodge Chance
nodes.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies additional dodge chance.

nodes.name: Holy Aura Increased Healing Effectiveness
nodes.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased healing effectiveness.

nodes.name: Holy Aura Throwing Attack Speed And Haste Chance
nodes.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increasing throwing attack speed and a chance to gain {Haste} for 1 second on hit.

nodes.name: Holy Aura Increased Health Regeneration
nodes.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased health regeneration.

nodes.name: Holy Aura Ward Generation
nodes.description: Holy Aura regenerates ward for you and nearby allies.

nodes.name: Holy Aura Ward Retention
nodes.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased ward retention.

nodes.name: Holy Aura Block Prot And Health On Block
nodes.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies additional block effectiveness and health when blocking attacks.

nodes.name: Holy Aura Ward On Block
nodes.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies ward when blocking attacks.

nodes.name: Holy Aura Health Globe Chance On Kill
nodes.description: When an enemy dies in Holy Aura's area of effect, there is a chance it spawns a {Health Globe}, healing for 70 health.

nodes.name: Holy Aura Fire Damage After Melee Hits
nodes.description:
Your melee hits apply 10 stacks of {Fiery Inquisition} and the melee hits of other allies affected by the aura apply 1 stack. If an enemy reaches 60 stacks, the stacks are consumed to release a {Flame Burst}, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies.

While Holy Aura is active twice as many stacks are applied.

The {Flame Burst} scales with the stats of the player or minion that triggers it.

nodes.name: Holy Aura Boost Duration
nodes.description: Holy Aura's active duration lasts longer, but Holy Aura's cooldown lasts longer and its passive is disabled during its cooldown.

nodes.name: Holy Aura Slow Aura
nodes.description: Activating Holy Aura grants you a chance to slow surrounding enemies each second.

nodes.name: Holy Aura Ward Boost
nodes.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies a burst of ward when activated, but Holy Aura has a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Holy Aura Poison Resist And Cleanse
nodes.description:
Holy Aura grants you and your allies additional poison resistance.
Activating Holy Aura cleanses ailments for you and your allies.

nodes.name: Holy Aura Flame Burst Area
nodes.description: Your melee hits apply an additional stack of {Fiery Inquisition} and if you are the one to get the final hit to unleash {Flame Burst} on an enemy, it deals damage in an increased area.

nodes.name: Smite Increased Fissure Area
nodes.description: {Fissure} deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Smite Increased Fissure Damage
nodes.description: {Fissure} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Smite Fissure Culls
nodes.description: {Fissure} instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (percentage of their maximum health).

nodes.name: Smite Fissure Increased Duration
nodes.description: {Fissures} can be triggered more frequently.

nodes.name: Smite Knockback
nodes.description: Directly cast Smite hits knock enemies back.

nodes.name: Smite Increased Healing Area
nodes.description: Smite heals in a larger area.

nodes.name: Smite Increased Melee Damage On Hit
nodes.description: You deal additional melee fire damage if you have hit an enemy with Smite recently (last 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Smite Increased Attack Speed On Hit
nodes.description: You have increased attack and cast speed if you have hit an enemy with Smite recently (last 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Smite Cleansing
nodes.description: Being healed by a direct cast of Smite has a chance to cleanse all negative ailments, such as ignite and chill, from you and allies.

nodes.name: Smite Heals Over Time
nodes.description: Being healed by Smite grants you or your allies increased health and mana regeneration for 4 seconds (does not stack).

nodes.name: Smite Double Cast
nodes.description: When you directly cast smite, you have a chance to double cast. The additional cast does not incur a mana cost and cannot teleport you if you have the Descend node.

nodes.name: Smite Added Ignite Chance
nodes.description: Smite hits have a chance to ignite enemies.

nodes.name: Smite More Damage To Ignited
nodes.description: Smite hits deal more damage to ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Smite Chance To Apply Spreading Flames
nodes.description:
Smite hits have a chance to apply {Spreading Flames}.

Additionally, Smite deals more fire damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Smite Chance To Explode On Kill
nodes.description: Enemies killed by Smite have a chance to explode, dealing fire damage to nearby enemies.

nodes.name: Smite Chance To Blind
nodes.description: Smite hits have a chance to blind enemies and deal more damage to blinded enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Smite Electrify Effect
nodes.description: Electrify applied by Smite has increased duration and additional Lightning Penetration

nodes.name: Smite Extra Lightning Targets
nodes.description: {Lightning Bolts} created by Smite hit additional enemies.

nodes.name: Smite Added Crit Chance and Increased Cast Duration
nodes.description: Improves Smite's base critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Smite Increased Crit Multi
nodes.description: Smite critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Smite Increased Healing
nodes.description: Smite heals allies for more health.

nodes.name: Smite Reduced Damage Taken From Tree
nodes.description: The {Sacrifice} node costs less health.

nodes.name: Smite Fissure
nodes.description:
Directly casting Smite consumes 10 mana to cause a {Fissure} underneath the target, dealing fire damage to enemies who stand on it.

{Fissure} lasts 3 seconds, and can be triggered once per second.

nodes.name: Smite Descend
nodes.description: When you directly cast Smite, you appear at Smite's targeted location, dealing physical damage to surrounding enemies. Smite costs more mana, has a cooldown, and counts as a {Traversal} skill.

nodes.name: Smite Free When Out Of Mana
nodes.description: When you are out of mana Smite is free, but cannot heal, cleanse, or create {Fissures}.

nodes.name: Smite Lightning Conversion
nodes.description:
Smite's base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to electrify chance for Smite and effects related to ignite now depend on electrify instead.

nodes.name: Smite Chance To Cast Lightning Blast
nodes.description: Smite hits also cast a {Lightning Bolt} at 3 nearby enemies, dealing lightning damage. Smite costs more mana.

nodes.name: Smite Increased Damage And Health Cost
nodes.description: Smite deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Smite consumes a percent of your current health on cast.

nodes.name: Smite Electrify Chance
nodes.description: Smite has a chance to {Electrify} on hit.

nodes.name: Smite Void Conversion
nodes.description:
Smite's base fire damage is converted to void. Consequently this damage scales with increases to void damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to {Time Rot} chance for Smite and effects related to ignite now depend on {Time Rot} instead.

Smite no longer heals.

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Increased Ailment Rate
nodes.description: Aura of Decay applies poison and other ailments to enemies more frequently.

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Freezing Concoction
nodes.description: While Aura of Decay is active, you have a chance when hit to cast {Freezing Blast}. This effect has a 4 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Increased Application Rate And Mana Drain
nodes.description: Aura of Decay applies Poison and other ailments to enemies more frequently, but drains mana each second.

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Ailment Duration
nodes.description: Poison and other ailments inflicted by Aura of Decay last longer. This does not include ailments that slow.

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Reduced Enemy Armor
nodes.description: Aura of Decay has a chance to shred the armor of nearby enemies every second. A percentage of your chance to shred armor on hit also contributes to this chance per second.

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Chance To Slow
nodes.description: Aura of Decay has a chance to slow nearby enemies every second.

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Retaliation
nodes.description: Enemies are inflicted with multiple stacks of poison when they hit you, but you also gain poison stacks when hit.

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Heal Allies
nodes.description: Allies within range are healed by Aura of Decay each second. Aura of Decay heals more health the less health you currently have.

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Increased Minion Poison
nodes.description: Minions within Aura of Decay’s area of effect deal more poison damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Fester Poison Bolt
nodes.description: When you lose a stack of {Fester} or gain a stack while already at maximum stacks, you fire a {Poison Bolt} at a nearby enemy.

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Less Poison Damage Taken
nodes.description: You take less poison damage while Aura of Decay is active (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Poison Protection Debuff
nodes.description: Enemies within Aura of Decay’s area of effect have less Poison Resistance.

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Int Poison Prot Debuff
nodes.description: You and Enemies within Aura of Decay’s area of effect have less poison resistance for each point of intelligence you have.

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Explosion Cooldown
nodes.description: {Poison Nova} can occur an additional number of times per 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Chance To Plague
nodes.description: Aura of Decay has a chance to inflict nearby enemies with {Plague} each second, and Aura of Decay deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Increased Area Of Effect Beta
nodes.description: Aura of Decay affects a larger area.

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Chance To Chill
nodes.description: Aura of Decay has a chance to chill nearby enemies every second.

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Increased Health Regen On End
nodes.description: You have additional poison resistance while in Aura of Decay and you have increased health regeneration if you have deactivated Aura of Decay recently (past 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Aura of Decay is converted to cold, inflicting frostbite instead of poison. Your chance to inflict frostbite applies to Aura of Decay at 100% effectiveness. 

All of its effects related to poison and poison resistance are converted to frostbite and cold resistance. Effects from Aura of Decay which granted less poison damage taken instead grant less cold damage over time taken.

Swaps Aura of Decay's {Poison} tag for a {Cold} tag.

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Increased All Ailment Chance
nodes.description: Aura of Decay applies poison and other ailments to enemies more frequently, but also applies poison to yourself more frequently.

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Physical Conversion
nodes.description:
Aura of Decay is converted to physical, inflicting bleed instead of poison. Your chance to inflict bleed applies to Aura of Decay at 75% effectiveness. 

All of its effects related to poison and poison resistance are converted to bleed and physical resistance. Effects from Aura of Decay which granted less poison damage taken instead grant less physical damage over time taken.

Swaps Aura of Decay's {Poison} tag for a {Physical} tag.

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Putrid Bombs
nodes.description: While Aura of Decay is active, when using a traversal skill or {Evade} you leave behind a {Putrid Bomb}. Putrid Bombs explode after a 1 second delay and Poison all enemies they hit.

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Poison Minions
nodes.description: Minions within Aura of Decay’s area of effect have a chance to poison on hit, but are poisoned every second.

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Fester
nodes.description:
While Aura of Decay is active and you are stationary, you gain two stacks of {Fester} per second, up to a maximum. You lose two stacks per second while moving.

{Fester} grants your active Aura of Decay more damage per stack (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Chance To Explode On Death
nodes.description: Enemies that die within Aura of Decay’s area of effect have a chance to emit a {Poison Nova}, which poisons all enemies it hits. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Poison Nova On Activation
nodes.description:
Aura of Decay consumes mana every 15 seconds to emit a powerful {Defiling Nova}, as long as there is a boss or rare enemy nearby.

This effect occurs with increased frequency based on your uncapped poison resistance.

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Fester Gain While Moving
nodes.description: You gain {Fester} stacks faster while channeling.

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Fester Max Stacks
nodes.description: {Fester}'s maximum stacks is increased, and the rate at which you lose stacks while moving is reduced.

nodes.name: Aura Of Decay Fester Stack Gain Chance
nodes.description: You have a chance when you would lose a stack of {Fester} to instead gain a stack. Additionally, you lose Fester stacks at an increased rate while moving.

nodes.name: Transplant Reduced Damage on Teleport
nodes.description:
When you use Transplant you are granted {Bone Armor} for 4 seconds, which causes you to take less damage.

This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Transplant Increased Bone Armor Duration
nodes.description: {Bone Armor} lasts longer.

nodes.name: Transplant Increased Minion Damage on Teleport
nodes.description: Your minions deal additional melee damage for 4 seconds after you cast Transplant.

nodes.name: Transplant Similacrum Bone Minion Duration
nodes.description: {Bone Minions} last until killed, but you may have only 1 active at a time.

nodes.name: Transplant Max Bone Minions
nodes.description: You can summon more {Bone Minions}.

nodes.name: Transplant Area of Effect
nodes.description: Transplant’s detonations deal damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Transplant Damage Vs Cursed
nodes.description: Transplant deals more hit damage to cursed enemies. Transplant hits against enemies afflicted with Bone Curse restore health. Transplant hits against enemies afflicted with Spirit Plague grant ward.

nodes.name: Transplant Increased Cast Speed and Cost
nodes.description: Casting Transplant grants you {Haste} and {Frenzy} for a short duration.

nodes.name: Transplant Inflict Bleed
nodes.description: Explosions cause enemies to bleed, but using Transplant also causes you to bleed.

nodes.name: Transplant Reduced Health Cost
nodes.description: Transplant costs less health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Transplant Blood Pool Percent Heal
nodes.description: {Pools of Blood} heal you for a percentage of your total health when you walk on them.

nodes.name: Transplant Rip Blood on Targets
nodes.description: You automatically cast {Rip Blood} at enemies nearby where you depart, but Transplant costs more health (multiplicative with other modifiers). An enemy cannot be hit by multiple instances of Rip Blood created this way.

nodes.name: Transplant Current Health Lost on Hit
nodes.description: When you hit an enemy with Transplant you regain mana, but lose a portion of your current health and ward.

nodes.name: Transplant Mana Restore and Increased Health Cost
nodes.description: Transplant restores mana, but has a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Transplant Damage vs Bleeding
nodes.description: Transplant detonation hits deal more damage, especially to bleeding enemies.

nodes.name: Transplant Increased Damage at Negative Mana
nodes.description: When you are out of mana, Transplant detonations deal more damage.

nodes.name: Transplant Execute Enemy at Low Health
nodes.description:
Transplant explosions instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). 

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node, then the highest threshold is used.

nodes.name: Transplant Increased Health Cost and Regenerate Health Lost
nodes.description: Transplant's health cost is regenerated over 4 seconds, but costs significantly more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Transplant Create Bone Minion
nodes.description: You leave behind a {Bone Minion}, which is a temporary melee minion, when you use Transplant, but your previous body no longer detonates. Other detonations still behave normally.

nodes.name: Transplant Attach to Minion and Sacrifice
nodes.description: You may Transplant to minions, which sacrifices the minion. Sacrifice cast this way uses your Sacrifice Tree and deals more damage than usual (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Transplant Convert to Necrotic
nodes.description: Transplant's base physical damage is converted to necrotic damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to necrotic damage, but not increases to physical damage.

nodes.name: Transplant Fear on Depart
nodes.description: Transplant inflicts surrounding enemies with {Fear} on departure.

nodes.name: Transplant Fear on Arrival
nodes.description: Transplant inflicts surrounding enemies with {Fear} on arrival.

nodes.name: Transplant Explode on Arrival
nodes.description: Transplant creates an additional body that detonates on arrival.

nodes.name: Transplant Explosions Leave Blood Pool
nodes.description: Transplant detonations leave a {Pool of Blood} for 3 seconds that slows enemies.

nodes.name: Transplant Bone Curse on Arrival
nodes.description: You cast Bone Curse around the target location after you arrive.

nodes.name: Transplant Cast Speed and Cooldown
nodes.description: Transplant has increased cast speed and cooldown recovery speed.

nodes.name: Transplant Convert to Cold
nodes.description: Transplant's base physical damage is converted to cold damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

nodes.name: Rive Increased Damage and Stun Chance
nodes.description: Rive deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies.

nodes.name: Rive Summon Weapon
nodes.description: When Rive kills an enemy or hits a boss or rare enemy, you have a chance to summon a {Forged Weapon}.

nodes.name: Rive Void Conversion Double Echo Chance
nodes.description:
Rive's base physical damage is converted to void. Consequently this damage scales with increases to void damage, but not increases to physical damage or other damage types.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to chance to inflict {Time Rot}.

Swaps Rive's {Physical} tag for a {Void} tag. 

Additionally, your chance to {Echo} with Rive is doubled.

nodes.name: Rive Mana Restore on Hit
nodes.description: Rive's third strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and restores mana if it hits at least one target.

nodes.name: Rive Hit Damage Especially For Echoes
nodes.description: Rive deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This effect is tripled for {Echoes}.

nodes.name: Rive First Hit Ignite Chance
nodes.description: Rive's first strike has a chance to ignite enemies.

nodes.name: Rive Second Hit Ignite Chance
nodes.description: Rive's second strike has a chance to ignite enemies.

nodes.name: Rive Third Hit Grants Life Leech
nodes.description: When you trigger {Flame Drinker's Blade's} effect you also gain an additional buff that causes you to leech a percentage of the damage you deal as health. Unlike the buff from Flame Drinker's Blade, this buff cannot stack.

nodes.name: Rive Increased Damage to Ignited Targets
nodes.description: Rive hits deal more damage to ignited targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Rive First and Second Hit Increased Attack Speed
nodes.description: Rive's first and second strike have increased attack speed.

nodes.name: Rive Crit Chance and Double Crit Hit Three
nodes.description: Improves Rive's base critical strike chance. This bonus is doubled for Rive's third strike.

nodes.name: Rive First Hit Crit Chance
nodes.description: Rive's first strike grants you increased critical strike chance on hit for 4 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times.

nodes.name: Rive Third Hit Always Crit
nodes.description: Rive's third strike has double crit chance and its critical strikes deal more damage, but strikes one and two can no longer critically strike.

nodes.name: Rive Chance to Armor Shred on First and Second Hit
nodes.description: Rive's first and second strike have a chance to reduce enemy armor.

nodes.name: Rive Change Order of Hits
nodes.description: Changes Rive's sequence of strikes to {1, 2, 1, 2, 3.}

nodes.name: Rive Third Hit Increased Damage and Stun and Area
nodes.description: Rive's third strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and hits in a larger area, and has increased chance to stun enemies.

nodes.name: Rive Second Hit Increased Damage and Area
nodes.description: Rive's second strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

nodes.name: Rive Third Hit Increased Area
nodes.description: Rive's third strike deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Rive Leech on Third Hit
nodes.description: Rive's third strike leeches damage dealt as health.

nodes.name: Rive Third Hit Increased Damage
nodes.description: Rive's third strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Rive Bleed Chance And Duration
nodes.description:
Rive's hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed. 

Additionally, bleeds inflicted by Rive's third strike last longer.

nodes.name: Rive Lacerate
nodes.description:
Rive's third strike {lacerates} enemies on it.

Lacerated enemies take melee damage over time for 3 seconds, with base damage equal to 300% of your added melee damage. Laceration does not stack.

nodes.name: Rive Melee Damage per Attribute
nodes.description:
Rive deals additional melee physical damage per point of Dexterity if you are using a Sword.

Rive deals additional melee void damage per point of Vitality if you are using an Axe.

Rive deals additional melee fire damage per point of Attunement if you are using a Mace.

nodes.name: Rive Consume Ignite Stacks for Damage
nodes.description: Rive's third strike consumes all stacks of ignite you applied to enemies it hits, granting you a buff that grants physical penetration per stack consumed, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Rive Wave Projectile at High Health and Mana
nodes.description: Rive's first strike consumes mana to release a wave of energy that passes through enemies.

nodes.name: Rive Remove Third Hit
nodes.description: Rive skips its third strike.

nodes.name: Rive Pull on Second Hit
nodes.description:
If you have positive mana, Rive's second strike pulls enemies.

Additionally, Rive's hits slow enemies.

nodes.name: Rive Cull on Hit Three
nodes.description: Rive's third strike instantly kills enemies below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

nodes.name: Rive 2h Weapon Stats Multiplier
nodes.description: If you are using a two handed weapon, stats on that weapon that directly add damage, increase damage or add a chance to apply an ailment on hit, have double effect for Rive.

nodes.name: Rive Scrap Metal
nodes.description: Whenever you would summon a {Forged Weapon} from any source, you instead gain a stack of Scrap Metal. Each stack grants more armour and more damage with Rive (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Avalanche Increased Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Avalanche costs less mana.

nodes.name: Avalanche Channel Persists
nodes.description: Avalance now persists after you stop channeling for a duration equal to twice as long as you spent channeling, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Avalanche More Damage
nodes.description: Avalanche deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Avalanche Upheaval And Stun Chance
nodes.description:
Avalanche hits have an increased chance to stun enemies.

Additionally, the impact from the large boulders have a chance to create your {Upheaval} towards a nearby enemy.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of {Upheaval's} mana cost.

nodes.name: Avalanche Subtracted Mana Cost
nodes.description:
Avalanche costs less mana.

If it's channeled, it will reduce the channel cost instead.

nodes.name: Avalanche Increased Damage With A Totem
nodes.description: Avalanche hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you have at least one active totem.

nodes.name: Avalanche Chance For Big Boulder
nodes.description: Small boulders have a chance to be replaced by large boulders.

nodes.name: Avalanche Increased Boulder Cast Rate
nodes.description:
Avalanche drops additional small boulders.

If Avalanche is channeled, small boulders drop more frequently instead.

nodes.name: Avalanche Repeat Boulder Chance
nodes.description:
Improves Avalanche's base critical strike chance.

When a large boulder critically strikes, it has a chance to drop a small boulder at the same location.

nodes.name: Avalanche Increased Freeze Chance
nodes.description: Avalanche hits have an increased chance to freeze enemies.

nodes.name: Avalanche Chance To Chill Ground
nodes.description: Avalanche's large boulders have a chance to leave behind {Frozen Ground,} which chills all enemies who stand on it.

nodes.name: Avalanche Increased Chilling Ground Area
nodes.description:
{Frozen Ground} affects a larger area.

You and your allies standing on your {Frozen Ground} gain a chance to inflict frostbite on hit.

nodes.name: Avalanche Increased Damage To Frozen
nodes.description:
Avalanche hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled against frozen enemies.

nodes.name: Avalanche Increased Fall and Damage Area
nodes.description: Avalanche boulders fall in a larger area, and each boulder has a larger area of impact.

nodes.name: Avalanche Increased Damage Area
nodes.description: Avalanche boulders have a larger area of impact.

nodes.name: Avalanche Increased Fall Area
nodes.description: Boulders fall in a larger area. This reduces your chance to hit single targets.

nodes.name: Avalanche Channeled
nodes.description: Avalanche is now channeled, creating 1 large boulder and 5 small boulders every second, but has a channeling cost every second.

nodes.name: Avalanche Fall Area Reduces
nodes.description: Small boulders now fall in a smaller area up to a maximum, causing them to hit more precisely at the target location.

nodes.name: Avalanche Follows You
nodes.description:
The persisting Avalanche is now cast around you and follows your movement.

The large boulders will automatically target enemies within 6 meters.

nodes.name: Avalanche Physical Conversion
nodes.description: Avalanche's base cold damage is converted to physical damage, and freeze rate multiplier bonuses from this tree are converted to increased stun chance.

nodes.name: Avalanche Storm Totem Synergy
nodes.description: While in range of a {Storm Totem}, Avalanche hits deal additional lightning damage.

nodes.name: Avalanche Fissure
nodes.description:
Large boulders will cause a {Fissure} to open underneath them, dealing physical damage over 4 seconds to enemies who stand on it.

You can have a maximum of 1 {Fissure} at a time.

nodes.name: Avalanche Cold Conversion
nodes.description: Avalanche's base physical damage is converted to cold damage, and increased stun chance provided by this tree is converted to freeze rate multiplier.

nodes.name: Avalanche Earthquake On Third Large Boulder
nodes.description:
Avalanche's every third large boulder creates an {Earthquake} on impact.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of {Earthquake's} mana cost.

nodes.name: Avalanche Chance For Storm Stack
nodes.description: Boulder hits have a chance to grant you a {Storm Stack}.

nodes.name: Avalanche Chance to Summon Elemental
nodes.description:
Large boulders have a chance to form into a {Coldstone Elemental}, which is a melee minion that deals cold and physical damage and decays over time.

You can summon up to 9 {Coldstone Elementals}, and summoning past this maximum will refresh the decay and health of the most decayed one.

nodes.name: Avalanche Buffs Elementals
nodes.description: When a {Coldstone Elemental} is hit by a boulder, they regain health and gain {Frenzy} and {Haste} for a short duration.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Target Allies Grant Armor
nodes.description: Shield Throw can target and ricochet to allies other than yourself, and when it hits allies they are granted {Steel Defense} for a duration, granting them additional armor.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Lava Burst Increased Area
nodes.description: {Lava Burst} deals damage in a larger area and has an increased chance to stun enemies.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Lava Burst Increased Damage
nodes.description: {Lava Burst} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Shield Throw Fire Damage And Fire Pen
nodes.description: Shield Throw deals additional throwing fire damage and penetrate enemy fire resistance.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Increased Fire Damage
nodes.description: Shield Throw deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Shield Throw Ignite Chance
nodes.description: Shield Throw and {Lava Burst} hits have a chance to ignite enemies and ignites it inflicts last longer.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Less Mana Cost
nodes.description: Shield Throw costs less mana.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Colossus Buff On Hit
nodes.description:
Shield Throw's hits grant you a stack of {Colossus} for 4 seconds. This can stack up to 20 times.
