Each stack grants you increased armor and additional physical penetration.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Leech And Steal Armor
nodes.description:
Shield Throw leeches a portion of its damage to you.

Additionally you steal armor from enemies you hit for 4 seconds, meaning you reduce their armor and gain additional armor yourself.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Armor Shred
nodes.description: Shield Throw's hits shred enemy armor.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Added Physical Damage
nodes.description: Shield Throw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its hits deal additional throwing damage.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Added Critical Strike Chance
nodes.description: Improves Shield Throw's base critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Stun and Slow Chance
nodes.description: Shield Throw has a chance to slow and increased chance to stun enemies.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Bleed And Phys Shred Chance
nodes.description: Shield Throw's hits have a chance to inflict bleed and shred enemy physical resistance.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Haste on Cast
nodes.description: When you use Shield Throw, you are granted {Haste} for a duration.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Grant Allies Stun Avoidance
nodes.description: {Steel Defense} also grants allies stun avoidance when Shield Throw hits them.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Whirlwind Attack on Manifest Armor
nodes.description:
If your {Manifest Armor} is hit by the shield, it performs a sweeping melee attack.

This attack cannot be triggered when the shield has no ricochets remaining.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Grant Increased Armor and Elemental and Poison Protection
nodes.description: The benefits granted by {Steel Defense} scale with your Attunement.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Cast Lava Burst on Impact
nodes.description: Whenever Shield Throw ricochets on an enemy or ally, it casts {Lava Burst}, a spell dealing fire damage to all enemies near the impact.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Convert to Fire and Convert Stun to Ignite
nodes.description:
Shield Throw's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance for Shield Throw. 
Physical resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to fire resistance shred chance for Shield Throw.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Increased Chain
nodes.description: Shield Throw ricochets to additional targets and you regain health whenever Shield Throw Ricochets, scaling with your Dexterity.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Damage Increase from Block
nodes.description: Shield Throw deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) equal to a portion of your uncapped block chance.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Cannot Block and Damage Increase from Block
nodes.description: Shield Throw deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) equal to 100% of your uncapped block chance, but you have reduced all resistances while Shield Throw is released.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Critical Strike Multiplier from Block
nodes.description: Shield Throw has additional critical strike multiplier scaling with your block effectiveness.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Projectile And Attack Speed
nodes.description: Shield Throw has increased attack speed and projectile speed.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Increased Mana Cost and Chain
nodes.description: Shield Throw ricochets to additional targets, but it costs additional mana.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Added Cooldown More Damage
nodes.description: Shield Throw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Shield Throw has a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Frenzy
nodes.description: Shield Throw's hits grants you the {Frenzy} buff for a short duration.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Ricochet Bounce To You
nodes.description: Shield Throw can ricochet between additional targets, including you if there are no other targets.

nodes.name: Shield Throw Frailty Chance
nodes.description: Shield Throw's hits have a chance to apply {Frailty}.

nodes.name: Shield Throw No Cooldown
nodes.description:
Shield Throw can be thrown while you have a shield out, but shields deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This node has no effect if {Siege Breaker} is allocated.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Increased Damage and Reduced Healing
nodes.description: While in Reaper Form, you deal increased damage but have reduced healing effectiveness.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Movespeed at Low Health
nodes.description: You move faster for 4 seconds after using {Reap} while below half health.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Leech on Reap
nodes.description: {Reap} deals damage in a larger area and you leech a portion of the damage its hits deal as health.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Reap Gain Health on Kill
nodes.description: While in Reaper Form you gain health from kills. This bonus is doubled for kills using {Reap}.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Lose Health on Kill and Increased Critical Strike Chance
nodes.description: While in Reaper Form, you deal increased damage and have increased critical strike chance, but lose health when you kill an enemy.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Health Lost Increases Damage
nodes.description: {Reap} deal more damage for each percent of health you are missing (multiplicative with other modifiers). You deal increased damage at low health while in Reaper Form.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Reap Culls Enemies
nodes.description: {Reap} hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

nodes.name: Reaper Form Added Necrotic Damage
nodes.description: While in Reaper Form, you deal additional necrotic damage. This bonus is doubled for {Reap}.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Increased Critical Multiplier
nodes.description: While in Reaper Form, your critical strikes deal more damage. This bonus is doubled for {Reap}.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Reap Increased Travel Distance
nodes.description: {Reap} moves you further.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Reap Increased Poison Chance
nodes.description: {Reap} has a chance to poison enemies, and poisons you inflict while in Reaper Form last longer.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Poison On Transform
nodes.description: Entering Reaper Form poisons all nearby enemies. While in Reaper Form, you have a chance to poison enemies that you hit.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Mark For Death
nodes.description: While in Reaper Form, you have a chance apply {Mark For Death} to enemies on hit. This chance is doubled for {Reap}.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Increased Attack Speed and Cast Speed
nodes.description: You have increased attack, cast speed and movement speed while in Reaper Form.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Increased Spell Damage
nodes.description: Gain a stack of {Reaper’s Ascendance} every 5 seconds you spend in Reaper Form, which grants you increased spell damage. You can have up to 25 stacks of Reaper’s Ascendance at a time.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Faster Spell Damage Buildup
nodes.description: You gain stacks of Reaper’s Ascendence more frequently.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Reduced Health Decay
nodes.description: While in Reaper Form, your health decays more slowly and you deal increased damage over time.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Armour from Intelligence
nodes.description: While in Reaper Form, you gain additional armor proportional to your intelligence.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Ward On Hit
nodes.description: While in Reaper Form, you have more ward retention. {Reap} grants ward on hit.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Grant Ward on Transform to Human
nodes.description: {Reaper’s Blessing} also grants ward when you transform back to your human form.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Resummon Skeletons
nodes.description: Entering Reaper Form summons {Skeletons}, unless you are already at your maximum number of Skeletons.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Increased Reap Healing
nodes.description: While in Reaper Form you have increased healing effectiveness and leech more of the damage you deal. You gain additional health on hit with {Reap}.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Protections from Intelligence
nodes.description: While in Reaper Form, you gain additional necrotic and poison resistance per point of intelligence.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Reap Cooldown
nodes.description: {Reap} has increased cooldown recovery speed.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Blood Tether
nodes.description: While in Reaper Form, you have a chance to retaliate with {Blood Tether} when you are hit.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Convert Reap to Cold Damage
nodes.description:
All of {Reap}'s base damage and its added melee damage from intelligence are converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Poison chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} for Reap, and Reap gains a freeze rate equal to four times your intelligence.

Reap loses its {Necrotic} and {Poison} tags and gains a {Cold} tag instead.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Reap Cast Hungering Souls on Kill
nodes.description: You have a chance to cast {Hungering Souls} whenever you kill an enemy with {Reap}.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Convert Reap Poison But No Crit
nodes.description: Reap poisons enemies. It also gains the {Poison} tag.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Potion Efficacy
nodes.description: While in Reaper Form, potions grant twice as much health as normal.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Grant Ward on Transform to Reaper
nodes.description: You gain ward when entering Reaper Form.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Reap Heals Minions
nodes.description: Hitting minions with {Reap} heals them for the same amount that Reap would heal you if an enemy was hit.

nodes.name: Reaper Form No Shared Transplant Cooldown
nodes.description: {Reap} has a much longer cooldown, but no longer shares a cooldown with other traversal skills.

nodes.name: Reaper Form Physical Conversion
nodes.description:
All of {Reap}'s base damage and its added melee damage from intelligence are converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage. You have additional physical penetration while in Reaper Form.

All poison related effects from this tree now affect bleed for Reap.

Reap loses its {Necrotic} tag and gains a {Physical} tag instead.

nodes.name: Bear Form Endurance
nodes.description: You have additional endurance and endurance threshold while in Werebear Form.

nodes.name: Bear Form Swipe Rage Generator
nodes.description: You regain additional {Rage} if you hit at least one enemy with {Swipe}.

nodes.name: Bear Form Swipe Lightning Damage For 6 Seconds
nodes.description: For 6 seconds after you enter Werebear Form, you deal more Lightning Damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and 100% of Swipe's Base Damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with lightning damage instead of physical damage.

nodes.name: Bear Form Spell Damage
nodes.description: You gain additional spell damage per point of Strength while in Werebear Form.

nodes.name: Bear Form Damage With Maul And Rampage
nodes.description: Maul and Rampage deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Bear Form Movespeed And Stun With Rampage
nodes.description: Rampage has increased movement speed, a higher chance to stun enemies and stuns inflicted by Rampage last longer.

nodes.name: Bear Form Damage With Rampage And Damage While Rampaging
nodes.description: Rampage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you have global increased damage while Rampaging.

nodes.name: Bear Form Haste And Ailment Cleanse On Exit
nodes.description: When you leave Werebear Form you cleanse all negative ailments and gain {Haste} for 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Bear Form Armor Shred With Rampage And Maul
nodes.description: Rampage and Maul hits shred enemy armor.

nodes.name: Bear Form Crit Chance With Rampage And Maul Crit Chance In Form
nodes.description: Maul and Rampage have improve base critical strike chance and you have global increased critical strike chance while in Werebear Form.

nodes.name: Bear Form Cast Storm Lightning While Rampaging
nodes.description: You cast {Storm Bolts} from the sky a number of times each second while Rampaging.

nodes.name: Bear Form Health And Rage On Kill Or Hit Rare Or Boss
nodes.description: You regain health and {Rage} on kill or when you hit a rare or boss enemy.

nodes.name: Bear Form Bleed Chance
nodes.description:
Your hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed while in Werebear Form.

This chance is doubled for Maul.

nodes.name: Bear Form Area With Maul And Warcry
nodes.description: Maul and Roar affects a larger area.

nodes.name: Bear Form Cooldown Recovery Speed With Maul
nodes.description: Maul has a shorter cooldown.

nodes.name: Bear Form Minion Damage Buff On Maul
nodes.description: When you use Maul and hit at least one enemy, your minions deal increased damage for 8 seconds. This effect can stack.

nodes.name: Bear Form Roar Grants Rage
nodes.description: You regain {Rage} and health with Roar per enemy hit, up to a maximum number of enemies.

nodes.name: Bear Form Damage To Stunned Enemies With Maul And Gain Rage When Hitting Stunned
nodes.description: Maul deals more melee damage to stunned enemies and you regain {Rage} when you hit a stunned enemy with Maul.

nodes.name: Bear Form Slower Rage Decay
nodes.description: Your {Rage} decays slower while in Werebear Form.

nodes.name: Bear Form Chance To Cast Maelstrom
nodes.description:
You have a chance to cast {Maelstrom} when you use Swipe or Maul and hit at least one enemy.

This consumes Maelstrom's mana cost as Rage.

nodes.name: Bear Form To Spriggan Form
nodes.description:
After using Rampage, Human Form is now replaced with {Arboreal Protection}, which casts {Thorn Shield} on you and up to 5 nearby allies and transforms you to {Spriggan Form}.

This requires you to have Spriggan Form unlocked.

nodes.name: Bear Form Auto Roar After Rampage
nodes.description:
After using Rampage, you now {Roar}.

This consumes Warcry's mana cost as Rage and puts it on cooldown.

nodes.name: Bear Form Lightning Conversion
nodes.description:
Maul and Rampage's base physical damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Armor Shred and bleed chance from all sources is converted to shock and effects related to armor shred or bleed now depend on shock instead for Maul and Rampage.

nodes.name: Bear Form Maul Fury Leap Tree
nodes.description:
Your {Fury Leap} tree now applies to Maul. 

This consumes Fury Leap's mana cost as Rage.

nodes.name: Bear Form Use Upheaval On Maul
nodes.description:
After using Maul, you now use {Upheaval} towards your target.

This consumes Upheaval's mana cost.

nodes.name: Bear Form To Swarmblade Form
nodes.description:
After directly using Roar, Human Form is now replaced with {Swarm Call}, which summons a {Locust} for each nearby stunned enemy up to 6 and transforms you to {Swarmblade Form}.

This requires you to have Swarmblade Form unlocked.

nodes.name: Bear Form Cast Entangling Roots On Maul
nodes.description:
After using Maul, you now cast {Entangling Roots}.

This consumes Entangling Roots' mana cost as Rage.

nodes.name: Bear Form No Rampage Cooldown
nodes.description:
Rampage has no cooldown.

While using Rampage you move more slowly, but deal more lightning damage. Both of these effects are multiplicative with other modifiers.

This removes Rampage's {Traversal} tag.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Increased Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Shatter Strike costs less mana and grants ward on hit.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Chance to Apply Frostbite On Hit
nodes.description: Shatter Strike has a chance to inflict enemies with {Frostbite}.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Frostbite Increased Effectiveness Per Intelligence
nodes.description: {Frostbite} inflicted by Shatter Strike has additional Cold Penetration.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Reduced Attack Speed and Increased Damage
nodes.description: Shatter Strike deals more damage, but has less attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Shatter Strike More Damage to High Health Enemies
nodes.description:
Shatter Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled against enemies at high health.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Increased Area and Cold Penetration
nodes.description: Shatter Strike deals damage in a larger area and penetrates enemy cold resistance.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Equipped Swords Increase Crit Multi
nodes.description: Shatter Strike’s critical strikes deal more damage per equipped sword.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Increased Cull Threshold
nodes.description: Shatter Strike's instant kill on frozen enemies occurs at a higher health threshold, and Shatter Strike has additional critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Mana Gain On Kill
nodes.description: Shatter Strike grants mana when it kills an enemy, doubled if that enemy was frozen.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Increased Damage and Area
nodes.description: Shatter Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased area of effect.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike 1H Or 2H Buff
nodes.description: Shatter Strike has increased attack speed with a one handed weapon equipped, and it has a chance to recast two additional times with a two handed weapon equipped.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Recently Used Increases Cold Damage and Freeze Chance
nodes.description: You deal more cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and are more likely to freeze enemies if you have used Shatter Strike recently (past 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Stacking Armor Buff
nodes.description: Shatter Strike hits grant a stack of {Ice Barrier} for 4 seconds, granting additional armor. This effect can trigger a limited number of times per 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Elemental Protection Gained On Hit Against Frozen Enemies
nodes.description:
You take less cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 4 seconds after hitting an enemy with Shatter Strike. 

This effect is doubled when hitting a frozen enemy.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Ward Gained On Hit Against Frozen Enemies
nodes.description:
Shatter Strike hits grant ward.

This effect is doubled for hits against frozen enemies.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Ice Spikes Increased Damage and Projectile Speed
nodes.description: {Ice Spikes} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). Ice Spikes from direct casts of Shatter Strike move faster, causing them to travel farther.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Increased Freeze Rate
nodes.description: Shatter Strike has a higher chance to freeze enemies and costs less mana.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike More Damage Against Frozen Enemies
nodes.description:
Shatter Strike's hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled against frozen enemies.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Convert Ignite to Frostbite
nodes.description: Shatter Strike hits convert all stacks of ignite on enemies into {Frostbite}.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Knock Back on Arc Collision
nodes.description: Shatter Strike pulls enemies towards a point in front of you.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Chill On Hit
nodes.description: Shatter Strike chills enemies, and has additional freeze rate based on its chill chance.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Haste on Cull
nodes.description: Shatter Strike grants {Haste} for two seconds when it kills a frozen enemy.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Additional Cast and Increased Mana Cost
nodes.description: Shatter Strike recasts after it finishes, but costs more mana and has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers). You can use other skills during the recasts.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Ice Spikes on Attack
nodes.description:
Shatter Strike fires 8 {Ice Spikes}. Indirect casts create half as many Ice Spikes.

An enemy can be hit by both Shatter Strike and up to 1 Ice Spike from each cast.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Ice Spike Glacier Chance
nodes.description: {Ice Spikes} have a chance on hit to create a random size {Glacier}, consuming a percentage of Glacier's mana cost.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Lightning Conversion
nodes.description:
Shatter Strike's base cold damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage.
Frostbite chance from all sources is converted to shock chance.
Swaps Shatter Strike's {Cold} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

Shatter Strike can no longer freeze enemies. Effects within Shatter Strike's tree which require a frozen target instead require that the target has 10 stacks of shock.

nodes.name: Shatter Strike Damage Per Shock
nodes.description: Shatter Strike deals more lightning damage per stack of shock on the target.

nodes.name: Shurikens Added Poison Chance
nodes.description: Shurikens have a chance to poison enemies.

nodes.name: Shurikens More Physical Penetration
nodes.description: Shurikens penetrates enemy physical resistance.

nodes.name: Shurikens Added Bleed Chance
nodes.description: Shurikens have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

nodes.name: Shurikens Damage And Cost
nodes.description: Shurikens deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and costs less mana.

nodes.name: Shurikens Blind
nodes.description: Shurikens have a chance to {Blind} enemies.

nodes.name: Shurikens Grant Haste
nodes.description: Shurikens have a shorter cooldown and you gain {Haste} for a short duration if it hits at least one enemy.

nodes.name: Shurikens Increased Attack Speed
nodes.description: Shurikens have increased attack speed.

nodes.name: Shurikens Added Lightning Damage
nodes.description:
Shurikens deals additional lightning damage and a percentage of its base physical damage is converted to Lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Shurikens gains a {Lightning} tag. If all its base damage is converted it loses its {Physical} tag.

nodes.name: Shurikens Physical And Poison Shred
nodes.description: Shurikens have a chance to shred enemy physical and poison resistance.

nodes.name: Shurikens Rotating Shurikens Armor
nodes.description: When you directly cast Shurikens you gain a stack of {Bladed Armor}, which grants increased armor per stack. Maximum of 3 stacks.

nodes.name: Shurikens Rotating Shurikens added Seconds
nodes.description: {Blade Shield} lasts longer.

nodes.name: Shurikens Pierce Chance
nodes.description: Shurikens have a chance to pierce enemies (continue through targets they hit).

nodes.name: Shurikens Critical Strike Chance And Hit Damage
nodes.description: Improves Shurikens' base critical strike chance and Shurikens deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Shurikens Critical Multiplier
nodes.description: Shurikens' critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Shurikens Hit Damage Per Ailment
nodes.description: Shurikens hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed or poison on the target up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Shurikens Chakram Damage Per Extra Shuriken
nodes.description: {Chakram} hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each projectile you would release with Shurikens.

nodes.name: Shurikens Travel Speed
nodes.description:
Shurikens travel faster and farther.

This does not affect {Chakram.}

nodes.name: Shurikens More Shurikens 1
nodes.description: You have a chance to throw many additional Shurikens with each throw.

nodes.name: Shurikens Any Angle
nodes.description: Shurikens are now thrown at enemies all around you rather than in a cone in front of you.

nodes.name: Shurikens Backflip
nodes.description: You backflip away from target direction when you use Shurikens, but it now has a cooldown.

nodes.name: Shurikens Shock Chance
nodes.description: Shurikens shock enemies on hit.

nodes.name: Shurikens Ricochet
nodes.description:
Shurikens ricochets to different targets up to a maximum number of times, but costs more mana.

Pierce chance is converted to additional critical strike multiplier.

nodes.name: Shurikens More Shurikens 2
nodes.description: You throw additional Shurikens with each throw.

nodes.name: Shurikens Spin Around You
nodes.description: You now summon your Shurikens in a shield around you for 3 seconds. All Shurikens cast this way can hit the same target.

nodes.name: Shurikens Chakram
nodes.description:
You now throw a single returning {Chakram} instead of multiple Shurikens. 

The Chakram has increased size and deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This damage modifier is doubled if Chakram is directly used.

nodes.name: Shurikens Straight Line
nodes.description:
Shurikens are now thrown in a straight line and they can hit the same target, but you throw half as many (rounded up).

This has no effect if you have the {Blade Shield} node.

nodes.name: Manifest Weapon More Mana Less Cooldown
Manifest Weapon More Damage To Bleeding Or Stunned
Manifest Weapon Melee Physical Damage Buff On Hit
Manifest Weapon Armor Buff On Hit
Manifest Weapon Increased Stun Chance On Hit
Manifest Weapon Increased Damage and Cooldown
Frenzy Totem Added Duration and Health
nodes.description: Frenzy Totem has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and lasts longer.

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Increased Area
nodes.description: Frenzy Totem affects allies or enemies in a larger area.

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Chance to Cast Eterra
nodes.description: While in range of your Frenzy Totem, you have a chance to cast {Eterra's Blessing} on a random ally each second.

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Stores Damage Taken and Releases as Damage
nodes.description: Frenzy Totem stores a portion of the damage it receives, releasing it as damage dealt to enemies after taking a percent of its maximum health in damage.

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Stores Player Damage Taken
nodes.description: Frenzy Totem also stores a percentage of the damage taken by you.

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Chance to Cast Ice Thorns
nodes.description: Frenzy Totem has a chance to cast {Ice Thorns} when hit by enemies.

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Cast Totem in Direction and Grants Buff
nodes.description:
Frenzy Totem is no longer summoned at your cursor; instead it is always placed 1 meter in the direction you're facing.

Frenzy Totem costs less mana and grants additional melee damage.

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Tether Increased Range
nodes.description: Frenzy Totem's tether has a higher range.

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Tether Crit Multi
nodes.description: You have additional critical strike multiplier while tethered.

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Allies Increased Health Regen
nodes.description: Allies affected by Frenzy Totem are granted increased health regeneration.

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Allies Granted Haste On Hit
nodes.description: When you summon Frenzy Totem, you and your companions are granted {Haste} for a duration (doubled for companions).

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Companions in Range Increased Armor and Protections
nodes.description: Companions affected by Frenzy Totem have higher physical and elemental resistance.

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Reduced Revive Time while In Range
nodes.description: While affected by Frenzy Totem, you revive downed companions faster.

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Grant Allies Chance to Poison
nodes.description: Allies affected by Frenzy Totem are granted a chance to poison enemies.

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Increased Frenzy Effect
nodes.description: Frenzy Totem's Frenzy buff is more effective.

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Increased Damage and Crit and Reduced Protections on Summon
nodes.description: When you summon Frenzy Totem you gain a temporary buff that grants you more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased melee attack speed, but also increases the damage you take.

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Companions Added Physical Damage on Totem Summon
nodes.description: When you summon Frenzy Totem, your companions are granted additional melee physical damage for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Wolf Howl Grants Increased Crit Chance
nodes.description: While Frenzy Totem is active, your Wolves' howls also grant increased critical strike chance to you and your allies.

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Scorpion Poison Nova Increased Area
nodes.description: While Frenzy Totem is active, your Scorpion's {Venom Nova} hits in a larger area.

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Slows and Shreds Armor
nodes.description:
Frenzy Totem is now {Sloth Totem,} which will now slow and reduce the armor of enemies instead of granting Frenzy.

Increased effect of frenzy is converted to increased effect of armor shred.

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Tether
nodes.description: You are tethered to the totem while you remain within 5 meters of it, and while tethered you deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Only Companions Affected and Increased Effectiveness
nodes.description: Frenzy Totem's buffs are more effective, but Frenzy Totem now affects only companions.

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Heal Allies on Companion Revival
nodes.description: Whenever you revive a downed companion, Frenzy Totem casts {Healing Nova.}

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Refresh Companion Cooldowns on Summon Totem
nodes.description: Summoning Frenzy Totem refreshes companion ability cooldowns.

nodes.name: Frenzy Totem Sabertooth Double Frenzy
nodes.description: While Frenzy Totem is active, your Sabertooth's {Flurry Swipes} casts an additional time when used.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage Base Spell Damage
nodes.description: Skeletal Mages deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage Sacrifice Wraiths
nodes.description: Skeletal Mages can cast {Profane Oblation} on your melee Wraiths and Blood Spectres, sacrificing them to deal necrotic damage to surrounding enemies.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage Sacrifice Skeletons
nodes.description: Skeletal Mages can cast {Profane Oblation} on your Skeleton Warriors, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Vanguards, sacrificing them to deal necrotic damage to surrounding enemies.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage No Mage or Pyro
nodes.description: Removes regular Skeletal Mages and Pyromancers from the pool of Skeletal Mages that can be summoned, and your Skeletal Mages deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage Stun and Freeze
nodes.description: Skeletal Mages have an increased chance to stun enemies and an increased freeze rate.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage Poison Chance
nodes.description: Skeletal Mage hits have a chance to poison enemies.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage Frenzy On Hit
nodes.description: Skeletal Mages have a chance to gain {Frenzy} for 3 seconds when they hit an enemy.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage No Mages
nodes.description: Your Skeletal Mages have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased attack and cast speed, but regular Skeletal Mages are removed from the summon pool of Skeletal Mages.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage Ignite and Poison
nodes.description: Ignites and poisons inflicted by Skeletal Mages last longer and have additional Penetration.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage Crit Chance
nodes.description: Improves Skeletal Mages' base critical strike chance and they move faster.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage Health On Crit
nodes.description: Skeletal Mages' critical strikes deal more damage, and when they critically strike they are healed for a percentage of their maximum health.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage Health and Leech
nodes.description: Skeletal Mages leech a portion of the damage they deal as health and have more maximum health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage Melee Fire Damage
nodes.description: Death Knight melee hits deal additional fire damage.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage DK Projectile Spell
nodes.description: Death Knights cast {Hungering Souls}, using your Hungering Souls tree. Hungering Souls has a 6 second cooldown when cast by Death Knights.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage Cooldown Recovery Speed
nodes.description: Skeletal Mages are able to use their abilities more frequently.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage Chance For Extra Projectiles
nodes.description:
Skeletal Mages have a chance to fire 2 additional projectiles. 

Skeletal Mages have an increased area of effect with melee attacks.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage Attack and Cast Speed
nodes.description: Skeletal Mages attack and cast faster (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage Ward Regen
nodes.description: Skeletal Mages' gain ward over time and have a chance to avoid critical strikes.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage Cryomancer
nodes.description:
Adds {Cryomancers} to the pool of Skeletal Mages that can be summoned. Cryomancers deal cold damage and cast {Ice Shard}.

Poison chance from all sources is converted to chill chance for Cryomancers.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage Pyromancer
nodes.description:
Adds Pyromancers to the summon pool of Skeletal Mages that can be summoned. Pyromancers deal fire damage and cast {Fireball}.
 
Poison chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance for Pyromancers.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage More Mages Alpha
nodes.description: You can summon more Skeletal Mages.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage Death Knights
nodes.description: Adds Death Knights to the summon pool of Skeletal Mages, which uses melee necrotic attacks, and removes all other types of Skeletal Mages from the pool.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage Mortar
nodes.description: Skeletal Mages cast {Necrotic Mortar}, a ranged necrotic spell with a large area of effect. Necrotic Mortar has a 6 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage One Mage
nodes.description: You can only summon one Skeletal Mage, an Archmage, that has significantly more maximum health and damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers), fires twice the number of extra projectiles, and is larger.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage Damage Per Mana
nodes.description: Skeletal Mages deal more damage based on your maximum mana.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage Teleportation
nodes.description: When you directly cast Summon Skeletal Mage you are teleported to the target location. Summon Skeletal Mage now has a cooldown and counts as {Traversal} skill.

nodes.name: Summon Skeleton Mage Minion Teleportation
nodes.description: When you teleport using Summon Skeletal Mage some of your other minions are teleported with you.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Gladiator Of Lagon
nodes.description:
The melee hits grant you a stack of {Gladiator of Lagon} for 8 seconds which grants you and your minions additional spell damage.

This effect can trigger a maximum of 3 times per second.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Gladiator Of Lagon Chance On Tempest
nodes.description: You now have a chance to gain a stack of {Gladiator of Lagon} when you cast a {Tempest}.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Freeze Rate Shock Chance And Damage
nodes.description:
{Frigid Tempest} has a higher chance to freeze enemies.
{Thunder Tempest} has a chance to shock enemies.
{Wind Tempest} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Frigid Tempest Chance On Other Strikes
nodes.description: You have a chance to also cast {Frigid Tempest} when you attack with lightning or physical Tempest Strike.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Thunder Tempest Chance On Other Strikes
nodes.description: You have a chance to also cast {Thunder Tempest} when you attack with cold or physical Tempest Strike.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Wind Tempest Chance On Other Strikes
nodes.description: You have a chance to also cast {Wind Tempest} when you attack with lightning or cold Tempest Strike.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Tempest On Non Hits
nodes.description: If Tempest Strike's melee attack does not hit an enemy you consume a stack of {Gladiator of Lagon} to cast a {Tempest} of the respective type.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Double Gladiator Of Lagon Effect
nodes.description: {Gladiator of Lagon} has double the effect on your totems and {Storm Crows} if you have at least 50 Intelligence.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Elemental Penetration Per Minion
nodes.description: Tempest Strike penetrates enemy physical resistance per active physical minion, penetrates cold resistance per cold minion and penetrates lightning resistance per lightning minion.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Regain Health From Endurance Threshold
nodes.description: Whenever you cast a {Tempest} you also regain a portion of your Endurance Threshold as health.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Transformed Tempest Strike
nodes.description:
While transformed and you use any melee attack and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to cast each {Tempest} of a matching damage type.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of Tempest Strike's mana cost.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike More Damage Per Mana Cost
nodes.description: Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 1 mana cost, but it also costs additional mana.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Tempest Totem
nodes.description: You now create a {Tempest Totem} that casts a {Tempest} of the corresponding strike that created the totem. You are limited to 1 of each type of totem.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike More Totem Cast Speed
nodes.description: Your {Tempest Totems} gain a random amount of more cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers) when summoned.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Storm Bolts
nodes.description:
You now expend {Storm Stacks} when you use Tempest Strike and hit at least one enemy with the melee attack.

{Storm Bolts} cast this way deal more damage.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike More Damage And Area
nodes.description: Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Melee Damage Per Axe Or Mace Spell Damage With 2h
nodes.description: Tempest Strike deals additional melee damage per equipped axe or mace and additional spell damage while wielding a 2 handed weapon.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike More Melee Damage And Area
nodes.description:
Tempest Strike deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

These effects are doubled while wielding a 2 handed weapon.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Removes Wind Tempest
nodes.description:
Tempest Strike can no longer cast {Wind Tempest}, but it does not remove the physical strike from the combo.

Additionally, Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Melee Cold Damage And Freeze Rate
nodes.description:
Tempest Strike deals additional melee damage per 2 Attunement.

All the melee strikes have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Removes Thunder Tempest
nodes.description:
Tempest Strike can no longer cast {Thunder Tempest}, but it does not remove the lightning strike from the combo.

Additionally, Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Mana Recovery On No Tempest
nodes.description: You recover mana if whenever you use Tempest Strike and it hits an enemy and it doesn't cast a {Tempest}.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Removes Frigid Tempest
nodes.description:
Tempest Strike can no longer cast {Frigid Tempest}, but it does not remove the cold strike from the combo.

Additionally, Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Attack Speed And Less Mana Cost
nodes.description: Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Elemental Penetration Per Resistance
nodes.description: Tempest Strike penetrates enemy resistances per your uncapped resistances corresponding to a specific type.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Wind Tempest Shared Haste
nodes.description:
Whenever you cast {Wind Tempest} you and your other allies it touches gain {Haste} for a short duration.

Additionally, Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you have Haste.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Tornado Chance
nodes.description:
Whenever you cast {Wind Tempest} you have a chance to also cast {Tornado}.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of Tornado's mana cost.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Tornado Buffs
nodes.description: {Tornados} cast from {Wind Tempest} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Frigid Tempest Chill And Freeze
nodes.description:
{Frigid Tempest} chills on enemies it hits.

Additionally, Tempest Strike has a higher chance to freeze enemies.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Frigid Tempest During Avalanche
nodes.description: While channeling {Avalanche} you now also cast {Frigid Tempest} every second.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Thunder Tempest Shock Chance
nodes.description:
{Thunder Tempest} shocks enemies it hits.

Additionally, Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to shocked enemies.

nodes.name: Tempest Strike Thunder Tempest Around Storm Totem
nodes.description: Whenever you cast {Thunder Tempest} you also cast it around your nearest {Storm Totem}.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Vine Damage And Health
nodes.description: {Vines} deal more damage and have more health (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Summon Vine On Nearby Vine Death
nodes.description: You now have a chance to summon a new Vine next to a nearby enemy when a {Vine} dies. Vines have increased attack and cast speed.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form To Swarmblade
nodes.description:
After using Summon Vine, Human Form is now replaced with {Infestation}, which converts your 2 nearest {Vines} into {Hives} and transforms you to {Swarmblade Form}.

This requires you to have Swarmblade Form unlocked.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Rage On Vine Hit
nodes.description:
Your {Vines} have a chance to grant you {Rage} on hit. Melee hits have a higher chance to grant Rage than spell hits.

If you have the {Great Vine} node the rage gained is 200% higher.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Summon Single Big Vine
nodes.description:
You can now only summon 1 {Vine} at a time up to a maximum of 6, but they have significantly more health, size, threat generation and their melee attacks deal significantly more damage in a larger area (all multiplicative with other modifiers).

Indirect casts only create a vine on every third cast.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Thorn Shield On Near Vine Chance
nodes.description: You now have a chance to also cast Thorn Shield on the nearest {Vine} when you cast Thorn Shield. Other allies with Thorn Shield deal global increased physical damage and have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Thorn Burst Damage And Area
nodes.description: {Thorn Burst} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Thorn Burst And Spirit Thorns Bleed Chance
nodes.description: {Thorn Burst} and Spirit Thorn hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Chance To Cast Maelstrom With Thorn Shield
nodes.description: You now also have a chance to cast {Maelstrom} when you directly cast Thorn Shield.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Armor
nodes.description: You have additional armor and increased armor while in Spriggan Form.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Thorn Shield Duration
nodes.description: Thorn Shield lasts longer.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Thorn Shield Armor
nodes.description: Thorn Shield grants additional armor and increased armor.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Thorn Shield Recast Chance
nodes.description: Thorn Shield has a chance to recast itself on the same target when it expires.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Thorn Shield Reflect Damage
nodes.description: Thorn Shield reflects additional flat damage to attackers.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form To Werebear
nodes.description:
After directly casting Thorn Shield, Human Form is now replaced with {Bark Skin}, which adds 4 seconds to the duration of every Thorn Shield on you and transforms you to {Werebear Form}.

This requires you to have Werebear Form unlocked.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Ward Burst From Armor
nodes.description: You gain ward equal to your armor when you enter Spriggan Form.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Summon Aditional Spriggan
nodes.description:
You summon an additional {Spriggan} when you enter Spriggan Form which doesn't count towards your Spriggan limit, but does count towards your companion limit.

You will not summon an additional Spriggan if you are already at your maximum companion limit.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Healing Totem Health And Duration
nodes.description: Your {Healing Totems} have more health and duration (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and you have increased summoning speed while in Spriggan Form.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Healing Totem Use Thorn Totem Tree
nodes.description: Healing Totems directly cast from this tree now also shoot thorns. {Thorn Totem's} skill tree, mana cost, cooldown and totem limit also apply to Healing Totems.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Summon More Totems
nodes.description: You now always summon 3 Healing Totems and you can have additional maximum Healing Totems.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Healing Totem Healing Effect
nodes.description: Healing Totems have increased healing effectiveness.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Healing Totems Rage Generation Conversion
nodes.description: Healing Totems are converted to Fury Totems and now restore {Rage} instead of healing, but can only affect you.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Chance For More Thorns From Totems On Spirit Thorns Use
nodes.description: You now have a chance to cast Spirit Thorns from each of your Healing Totems when you directly cast Spirit Thorns.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Spirit Thorns And Thorn Shield Damage
nodes.description: Spirit Thorns and Thorn Shield deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Rage And Ward On Spirit Thorns Use
nodes.description: You gain {Rage} and ward when you directly cast Spirit Thorns and hit at least 1 enemy.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Spirit Thorns Pierce Chance And Penetration
nodes.description: Spirit Thorns has a chance to pierce enemies (continue through targets they hit) and they penetrate enemy physical and cold resistance.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Vale Spirit Every 5 Cast With Spirit Thorns
nodes.description: You now summon a {Vale Spirit} every 5 direct casts with Spirit Thorns, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Healing Totems Chance To Summon Vale Spirit On Death
nodes.description: Your Healing Totems have a chance to summon a {Vale Spirit} when they die.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form More Max Vale Spirits And Entangling Roots At Max Vale Spirits
nodes.description:
When you directly cast Spirit Thorns while at maximum Vale Spirits, you consume them to cast {Entangling Roots} at the target area and you regain {Rage}, which deals more damage when cast this way (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This consumes Entangling Roots' mana cost.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Maelstrom Chance With Spirit Thorns
nodes.description: You have a chance to cast {Maelstrom} on you when you directly cast Spirit Thorns.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Poison Chance For You And Vines
nodes.description: Your hits have a chance to poison enemies while in Spriggan Form and your Vines have a chance to poison enemies.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Spirit Thorns, Summon Vines and Thorn Shield's base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. They also have a chance to freeze enemies.

Poison chance from all sources, for all three skills, is converted to {Frostbite} and effects related to poison now depend on Frostbite instead.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Vines Use Spirit Thorns Instead Of Melee
nodes.description: Your {Vines} now cast thorns from range, instead of using a melee attack. This is affected by nodes on this tree that affects Spirit Thorns, but they only fire 1 projectile and {Great Vine} fires 3 projectiles.

nodes.name: Spriggan Form Thorn Shield Only Cast On You
nodes.description: Thorn Shield can now only target you and can no longer attach to other allies.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Additional Shields
nodes.description: You summon additional shields.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Heal Nearby Allies
nodes.description: Every 4 seconds each Shield heals nearby allies.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Grant Allies Armor and Protections on Heal
nodes.description: When Shields heal allies, they also increase their armor for 4 seconds. This effect does not stack.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Grant Allies Added Block Protection on Heal
nodes.description: When Shields heal allies, they also grant them a non stacking increased block effectiveness buff for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Warpath Makes Shields Spin Faster and Shields Take Less Damage
nodes.description: While using {Warpath}, your Shields spin faster and take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Increased Healing
nodes.description: Shields have increased healing effectiveness.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Reduced Mana Cost and Reduced Shield Health
nodes.description: Ring of Shields costs less mana, but Shields have reduced health.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Heal on Shield Death
nodes.description: You are healed any time one of your Shields dies.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Cast Shrapnel on Death
nodes.description: Shields shatter into {Shrapnel} when they die, dealing physical damage to surrounding enemies.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Shrapnel Melee
nodes.description: When your shields are hit by one of your melee attacks, they have a chance to release Shrapnel towards an enemy within 12 meters. This chance is tripled for melee attacks that cost at least 10 mana.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Added Block Chance on Cast
nodes.description: Each shield grants you additional block chance and block effectiveness.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Player Cannot Take Damage or Move on Cast
nodes.description: You are invulnerable for 1 second after directly casting Ring of Shields.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Slow Enemies When Hit
nodes.description: Shields have a chance to slow enemies that hit them. Additionally, each shield grants you a chance to inflict Frailty on hit.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Increased Shield Health and Armor and Protections
nodes.description: Shields have increased health and additional physical resistance.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Added Duration
nodes.description: Ring of Shields lasts longer.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Convert to Fire Damage and Shield Reduced Fire Damage Taken and Ignite Enemies
nodes.description:
Shields take less fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and have a chance to ignite enemies that hit them. 

If you have the {Collateral Damage} node the base physical damage of the {Shrapnel} it creates is converted to fire damage.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Added Damage and Rotate Faster
nodes.description: Shields deal more damage based on your block chance (multiplicative with other modifiers), and their area abilities have increased area of effect based on your block effectiveness.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Added Physical Damage
nodes.description: Each shield grants you additional physical damage for attacks and spells.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Increased Area
nodes.description: Shields rotate around you at a greater distance.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields More Additional Shields
nodes.description: Ring of Shields summons additional Shields, but costs more mana.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Increased Melee Physical Damage
nodes.description: Each shield grants you increased physical damage.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Position Shields in Front of Player and Increase Area
nodes.description: While using {Shield Rush}, your Shields form a wall in front of you, increasing the area you hit. Each shield in the wall grants Shield Rush more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but the shields are destroyed when Shield Rush ends.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Buff Persistence
nodes.description: If your shields are destroyed before their duration ends, any buffs they granted to you will persist for a percentage of their remaining duration.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Potions also Heal Shields
nodes.description: Consuming a potion also heals your Shields.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Reflect Damage
nodes.description: Shields reflect a percentage of damage taken to attackers.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Fire Damage Over Time
nodes.description: Shields now emanate {Forge Flames}, dealing fire damage over time to surrounding enemies.

nodes.name: Ring of Shields Consumes For Shield Throw
nodes.description:
Each of your shields has a chance every second to be destroyed to cause you to cast Shield Throw at an enemy within 12 meters. This consumes mana equal to a percentage of Shield Throw's mana cost.

This chance is lower if Shield Throw has a cooldown.

nodes.name: Forge Strike Increased Critical Chance and Multiplier
nodes.description: Improves Forge Strike's base critical chance, and critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Forge Strike Cooldown Recovery Speed
nodes.description: Forge Strike has increased cooldown recovery speed and attack speed. The attack speed bonus also applies to your Forged Weapons.

nodes.name: Forge Strike Generate Ward When Weapon is Forged
nodes.description: You are granted ward when Forge Strike summons a {Forged Weapon}.

nodes.name: Forge Strike Increased Damage and Stun Chance
nodes.description: Forge Strike and {Forged Weapons} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have an increased chance to stun enemies.

nodes.name: Forge Strike Armor Shred
nodes.description: Forge Strike hits reduce enemy armor, and armor shred applied by it last longer with increased effect.

nodes.name: Forge Strike Added Melee Physical Damage On Use
nodes.description: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have used Forge Strike recently (last 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Forge Strike Grants Armor
nodes.description: You have increased armor if you have used Forge Strike recently (last 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Forge Strike Increased Area
nodes.description: Forge Strike and {Forged Weapons'} hits deal damage in a larger area

nodes.name: Forge Strike Added Fire Damage
nodes.description: Forge Strike deals additional melee fire damage and more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Forge Strike Eruption Increased Damage
nodes.description: {Detonating Ground} hits deal more damage.

nodes.name: Forge Strike Eruption Ignite Chance
nodes.description: {Detonating Ground} has a chance to ignite enemies on hit.

nodes.name: Forge Strike Forged Weapons Added Fire Damage
nodes.description:
{Forged Weapons} deal additional melee fire damage.

{Forged Weapons} gain the {fire} tag.

nodes.name: Forge Strike Forged Weapons Increased Duration
nodes.description: {Forged Weapons} last longer and you can control more forged weapons at once.

nodes.name: Forge Strike Increased Chance to Forge Weapons
nodes.description:
Forge Strike has a higher chance to summon {Forged Weapons}. This added chance is much higher against bosses and rare enemies.

If your chance to summon Forged Weapons exceeds 100%, you can summon an additional Forged Weapon.

nodes.name: Forge Strike Forged Weapons Chance to Explode on Death
nodes.description: {Forged Weapons} have a much shorter duration, but deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and explode when they expire, dealing fire and physical damage to nearby enemies.

nodes.name: Forge Strike Bleed Effect
nodes.description: Bleed inflicted by Forge Strike has additional Physical Penetration and lasts longer.

nodes.name: Forge Strike More Fire Damage Buff
nodes.description: You have additional global Fire Penetration if you have used Forge Strike recently (last 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Forge Strike Forged Weapons Generate Ward and Do Not Move
nodes.description: {Forged Weapons} no longer move or attack, but generate ward when you are near them.

nodes.name: Forge Strike Cannot Forge Weapons and Increased Crit Chance
nodes.description: Improves Forge Strike's base critical chance and its hits inflict bleeding on hit, but your maximum number of {Forged Weapons} is halved.

nodes.name: Forge Strike Summon Sword
nodes.description:
Converts Forge Strike into a sword that falls from the sky instead. Forge Strike has more attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers), cannot crit, and critical strike multiplier from the tree is converted to additional Physical Penetration for Bleed.

Converts to a polearm if you also have the {Spear Forge} node.

nodes.name: Forge Summon Spear
nodes.description:
Converts Forge Strike into a spear that falls from the sky instead. Forge Strike critical strikes deal significantly more damage, but it hits in a smaller area.

Converts to a polearm if you also have the {Put To The Sword} node.

nodes.name: Forge Strike Cast at Target
nodes.description: Forge Strike can now be cast at your target instead of in front of you.

nodes.name: Forge Strike Increased Stun Chance Vs Rares And Bosses
nodes.description: Forge Strike hits deal more damage against rare and boss enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Forge Strike Summon Anvil
nodes.description:
Converts Forge Strike into an anvil that falls from the sky instead. Forge Strike has an increased chance to stun enemies, and stuns it inflicts lasts longer, but it has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Additionally, when you directly use Forge Strike it deals more physical damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Forge Strike Eruption
nodes.description: Forge Strike causes {Detonating Ground}, sending out cracks which erupt after 1.5 seconds, dealing melee fire damage and igniting enemies.

nodes.name: Forge Strike Summon Axe
nodes.description: {Forged Weapons} now have a chance to become a {Great Axe} on summon, which deal more damage in a larger area, but attack slower.

nodes.name: Forge Strike No Cooldown
nodes.description: Forge Strike has no cooldown, but costs additional mana.

nodes.name: Forge Strike Stun Chance To Damage Over Time
nodes.description: Ailments inflicted by Forge Strike deal increased damage over time equal to your increased stun chance.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Increased Cast Speed and Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Soul Feast has increased cast speed and costs less mana.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Increased Area
nodes.description: Soul Feast deals damage in a larger area and has a chance to apply {Frailty} on hit.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Reduced Ward Gained and Increased Damage
nodes.description: Soul Feast deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but {Soul Fragments} grant less ward.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Soul Feast costs less mana and can hit more targets.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Chance to Poison
nodes.description: Soul Feast's hits have a chance to poison enemies on hit.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Poisons Player and Gain Poison Chance On Hit
nodes.description: Casting Soul Feast grant you a chance to poison enemies with all hits for 4 seconds, but also inflicts you with poison. This buff cannot stack.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Added Ward Gain
nodes.description: {Soul Fragments} grant additional ward based on your intelligence.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Chance To Inflict Bleed On Hit
nodes.description:
Soul Feast has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

Physical ailments inflicted by Soul Feast deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your missing health.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Damned Grants Chance to Frenzy Minions On Kill
nodes.description: When you kill a damned enemy with Soul Feast, you have a chance to grant your minions {Frenzy} for 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Large Enemies Return More Ward
nodes.description: {Soul Fragments} from bosses or rare enemies grant significantly more ward.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Large Enemies Return Mana
nodes.description: {Soul Fragments} from rare or boss enemies also grant you mana. Modifiers to the amount of ward granted by Soul Fragments also apply to the amount of mana gained from this node.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Increased Soul Return Speed and Chance to Gain Haste
nodes.description: {Soul Fragments} return to you faster and Soul Feast has a chance to grant you {Haste} for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Damned Effect
nodes.description: Damned inflicted by Soul Feast has additional necrotic penetration.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Additional Targets
nodes.description: Soul Feast can hit more targets.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Armour Shred
nodes.description:
Poison Chance from all sources is converted to armor shred for Soul Feast and armor shred applied by Soul Feast has increased effect.

The {Diseased Soul} node now inflicts you with armor shred on cast instead of poison.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Attack in Cone and No Marked for Death
nodes.description: Soul Feast no longer requires targets to be {Cursed} and no longer has a target limit, but now hits all enemies a small cone in front of you.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Convert to Physical and Restores Health
nodes.description:
Soul Feast's base necrotic damage is converted to physical damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

{Soul Fragments} now restore health instead of granting ward. The health restored is equal to the ward you would have been granted.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Blood Tether
nodes.description: Soul Feast has a chance to cast {Blood Tether} on enemies it hits.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Blood Splatter On Kill
nodes.description: When you kill an enemy with Soul Feast it has a chance to create a {Blood Splatter} around the target.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Inflict Damned
nodes.description: Soul Feast has additional chance to inflict damned on hit based on your Intelligence.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Consume Poison to Shred Armor and Protections
nodes.description:
Soul Feast consumes poison stacks you applied on the target, granting you more armor (multiplicative with other modifiers) and additional poison resistance per stack.

This buff lasts 6 seconds and can stack a maximum number of times.

Poison stacks applied by minions or other party members are not cleansed and are not counted for the buff.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Chance to Return Large Soul Fragments
nodes.description: Soul Feast costs less mana and has a chance based on your current mana to draw back {Greater Soul Fragments}, which grant more ward (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Soul Feast Mark for Death
nodes.description: If the number of cursed enemies within 15 meters is at or below a threshold shortly after you cast Soul Feast, then a number of enemies within that range are {Marked for Death} to reach that threshold of cursed enemies.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Ward and Hit Damage per Curse
nodes.description: For each {Curse} on the target, Soul Feast hits grant more ward and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Soul Feast Spread Poison
nodes.description:
When you hit a poisoned enemy with Soul Feast it spreads all stacks of your stacks of poison from that enemy to a number of other enemies within 5 metres.

Has no effect if you have the {Toxic Craving} node.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Withering
nodes.description: Soul Feast inflicts {Withering} on hit, an ailment which increases the curse damage taken.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Spreads Curses
nodes.description: When Soul Feast hits an enemy {Cursed} with {Spirit Plague}, {Decrepify}, {Marked for Death}, or {Penance} it spreads those {Cursed} from that enemy to a number of other enemies within 5 metres.

nodes.name: Soul Feast Infernal Hunger
nodes.description: If you go 2 seconds without directly casting Soul Feast you gain a stack of {Infernal Hunger}. When you next cast Soul Feast directly, all stacks of {Infernal Hunger} are consumed to cast Soul Feast an additional time per stack.

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Dual Armor and Poison Prot
nodes.description: Your scorpion has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers), additional physical and poison resistance, and increased size.

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Poison Chance and Health
nodes.description: Your scorpion's attacks grant health on hit, and have a higher chance to poison on hit.

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Damage Per Poison
nodes.description: Your Scorpion deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of Poison on the target (up to 30).

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Increased Melee Area
nodes.description: Your Scorpion's melee attacks have increased area of effect, and your Scorpion has increased attack speed.

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Bleed Chance
nodes.description: Your Scorpion has a chance to cause enemies to bleed, and it deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers)

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Baby Damage and Poison
nodes.description: {Baby Scorpions} deal more damage (damage is multiplicative with other modifiers) and their attacks have a chance to poison enemies.

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Baby Spawn On Activation
nodes.description: Activating your Scorpion's ability summons additional {Baby Scorpions.}

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Baby Dodge Rating
nodes.description: {Baby Scorpions} have more dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Increased Baby Move and Attack Speed
nodes.description: {Baby Scorpions} have increased attack and movement speed.

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Ele Res And Inc Area
nodes.description: Your Scorpion has additional elemental resistance, and its abilities have increased area of effect.

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Freeze Rate
nodes.description: Your Scorpion deals more cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a higher chance to freeze enemies.

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Maelstrom Chance
nodes.description: Your scorpion has a chance to cast {Maelstrom} whenever you do. Maelstroms cast by your scorpion in this way use your Scorpion's stats, but your Maelstrom tree.

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Shock
nodes.description: Your Scorpion has a chance to {Shock} on hit and deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of shock on the target.

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Increased Poison Damage
nodes.description: Your Scorpion deals more poison damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Increased Venom Nova Effect
nodes.description: Your scorpion's {Venom Nova} deals damage in a larger area, and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Venom Nova Pool
nodes.description: {Venom Nova} leaves behind a {Poison Pool} for 4 seconds, which applies a stack of poison each second to enemies standing in the pool.

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Retaliates With Poison Pool
nodes.description: Your Scorpion has a chance when it is hit to create a {Poison Pool}. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Pool Gives Poison Chance
nodes.description: {Poison Pools} grant you and your minions increased attack speed and cast speed and a chance to poison enemies.

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Added Melee Damage
nodes.description: Your Scorpion deals additional melee damage, and its Poison Chance from all sources is converted to Armour Shred Chance.

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Baby Scorpions
nodes.description: Your Scorpion spawns a number of {Baby Scorpions} every 5 seconds. Baby Scorpions have an unlimited duration but can be killed.

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Your scorpion takes less cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

The base physical damage of your scorpion's melee attacks is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to minion cold damage, but not with increases to minion physical damage. These melee attacks now have a {Cold} tag instead of a {Physical} tag.

Your scorpion's melee attacks also gain a chance to freeze, with a freeze rate equal to twice their base damage.

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Frostbite
nodes.description: Your scorpion has a chance to inflict {Frostbite} on hit and its Bleed Chance from all sources is converted to Frostbite Chance.

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Lightning Conversion
nodes.description:
Your Scorpion's activated ability is now {Shock Nova}, a spell that deals lightning damage and applies 3 stacks of {Shock} on hit.

The base physical damage of your scorpion's melee attacks is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage. These melee attacks now have a {Lightning} tag instead of a {Physical} tag.

All sources of poison chance are converted to shock chance for your scorpion, and effects related to poison in this tree instead depend on shock.

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Tail Avalanche
nodes.description:
Your scorpion has a chance on melee hit to cause a large {Avalanche} boulder to land on the target. The Avalanche boulder uses your scorpion's stats, but your Avalanche tree.

This effect can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Soaks Up Storm Bolts
nodes.description:
Your {Storm Bolts} will strike your scorpion to grant it a stack of {Charged}, up to 20.

Your scorpion's {Shock Nova} consumes all stacks of Charged to deal more damage per stack.

nodes.name: Summon Scorpion Crit Chance And Health On Kill
nodes.description: Your scorpion has additional critical strike chance, and whenever it kills an enemy it restores a percentage of its maximum health.

nodes.name: Static Increased Moving Charge Rate
nodes.description: You gain charges faster while moving.

nodes.name: Static Shock When Hit While Over Threshold
nodes.description: Enemies that hit you are shocked while you have more than 80 charges.

nodes.name: Static Added Maximum Charges
nodes.description: You have a higher maximum amount of charges.

nodes.name: Static Haste on Discharge
nodes.description: You gain {Haste} for 1 second per 50 charges when you discharge.

nodes.name: Static Charges Increase Range
nodes.description: Discharge has a higher range the more charges you have.

nodes.name: Static Crit Multi on High Charge Discharge
nodes.description: Discharge’s critical strikes deal more damage if you have over 100 charges when you discharge.

nodes.name: Static Added Lightning Damage and Doubled on High Charge
nodes.description: Discharge deals additional spell lightning damage (doubled if you have at least 80 charges).

nodes.name: Static Crit Chance
nodes.description: Improves Discharge’s base critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Static Hits Additional Enemies Per Charges
nodes.description: Discharge hits an additional enemy for every 50 charges you have when you discharge.

nodes.name: Static Added Mana Cost and Lightning Damage Per Charge
nodes.description: When you directly cast Static, Discharge deals additional lightning damage per charge, but Discharge costs more mana per charge.

nodes.name: Static Increased Charges Gained When Hit
nodes.description: You gain more charges when you are hit.

nodes.name: Static Ward on Discharge
nodes.description: Discharge grants ward proportional to your charges, but has a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Static Additional Enemies Hit
nodes.description: Discharge hits more enemies.

nodes.name: Static Zap Additional Enemies
nodes.description: {Lightning Blast} critical hits have a chance to grant a charge.

nodes.name: Static Reduced Zap Cost and Increased Zap Critical Chance
nodes.description: Lightning Blasts from {Overload} have additional critical strike chance and a chance to chain additional times.

nodes.name: Static Shock on Hit
nodes.description: Discharge shocks enemies on hit. Each enemy is inflicted with 1 stack of shock for each 50 charges expended, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Static Discharges Adds Lightning Damage to Next Attack
nodes.description: After discharging, your next spell and melee attack deal additional lightning damage.

nodes.name: Static Discharge Stun Chance
nodes.description: Discharge now has a chance to stun enemies, with a higher chance based the number of charges you have.

nodes.name: Static Knockback
nodes.description: Nearby enemies are knocked back when you discharge.

nodes.name: Static Charges on Melee Attack
nodes.description: Your next melee attack grants charges on hit. This effect has a 1 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Static Double Movespeed Charge and Decay While Immobile
nodes.description: You gain charges while moving much faster, but charges decay at your movement charge rate if you stop moving for more than 1 second.

nodes.name: Static Arc Attack
nodes.description: Discharge has a significantly higher range, but can only hit enemies within a 90 degree arc.

nodes.name: Static Gain Charges on Crit
nodes.description: You gain charges for each enemy you critically strike if you have discharged in the last 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Static Max Charges Resets Cooldown
nodes.description: Static's cooldown resets when you reach your maximum number of charges.

nodes.name: Static Casts Zap on Enemies
nodes.description: While over 80 charges, you expend 10 charges to cast {Lightning Blast} at an enemy within 8 meters every second. This effect consumes Lightning Blast's mana cost.

nodes.name: Static Zap uses Lightning Bolt
nodes.description: {Lightning Blasts} from {Overload} consume less of Lightning Blast's mana cost, but expends additional charges.

nodes.name: Judgement ConGround Increased Healing
nodes.description: {Consecrated Ground} has increased healing effectiveness.

nodes.name: Judgement ConGround Increased Duration
nodes.description: {Consecrated Ground} lasts longer.

nodes.name: Judgement ConGround Increased Area
nodes.description: {Consecrated Ground} heals allies and deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Judgement Eruption Increased Damage and Healing
nodes.description: {Holy Eruption} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and restore more health.

nodes.name: Judgement Eruption Cleanses
nodes.description: {Holy Eruption} cleanses negative ailments, such as ignite and chill, on you and allies. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Judgement Reduce Duration and Increase Healing
nodes.description: {Consecrated Ground} restores more health, but has a shorter duration.

nodes.name: Judgement ConGround Increased Damage
nodes.description: {Consecrated Ground} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Judgement ConGround Shreds Armour
nodes.description: {Consecrated Ground} has a chance to shred enemy armor each second.

nodes.name: Judgement BaseHit More Damage Against High Health Enemies
nodes.description: Judgement hits and {Consecrated Ground} deal more damage against enemies at high health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Judgement BaseHit Added Damage Against Rare and Boss
nodes.description: Judgement hits deal more hit damage to rare and boss enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Judgement Increased Damage and Stun Chance
nodes.description: Judgement deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies.

nodes.name: Judgement BaseHit Added Ignite Chance
nodes.description: Judgement hits have a chance to ignite enemies and ignites applied by Judgement have additional Fire Penetration.

nodes.name: Judgement Heal On Melee Hit
nodes.description: Judgement's melee attack heals you and nearby allied players for each enemy it hits. This healing is affected by your increased healing effectiveness.

nodes.name: Judgement BaseHit Increased Damage Against Ignited
nodes.description: Judgement hits and {Consecrated Ground} deal more damage against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Judgement BaseHit More Crit Chance Against Ignited
nodes.description: Judgement hits have more critical strike chance against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Judgement BaseHit Added Critical Strike Multiplier
nodes.description: Judgement critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Judgement Undodgeable
nodes.description: Judgement's melee attack cannot be dodged and deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your increased healing effectiveness.

nodes.name: Judgement ConGround Is Aura
nodes.description: {Consecrated Ground} becomes a {Consecrating Aura} which surrounds you and has a longer duration, but Judgement costs more mana. Judgement deals significantly more damage over time.

nodes.name: Judgement Eruption
nodes.description: When {Consecrated Ground} finishes, it casts {Holy Eruption}, dealing fire damage to all nearby enemies and heals you and all your nearby allies for 80 health.

nodes.name: Judgement ConGround Pulls
nodes.description: Judgement now pulls in enemies and slows them, but its initial hit no longer deals damage.

nodes.name: Judgement Consume All Sigils
nodes.description: Judgement consumes all of your {Symbols of Hope} to deal additional fire damage for each Symbol consumed.

nodes.name: Judgement No ConGround
nodes.description: Judgement gains significant physical and fire penetration, but no longer leaves behind {Consecrated Ground}.

nodes.name: Judgement Casts Smite
nodes.description: Judgement also casts {Smite} at nearby enemies. Smite consumes mana equal to its mana cost for each cast.

nodes.name: Judgement Cooldown Recovery
nodes.description: Judgement has a shorter cooldown and a lower mana cost.

nodes.name: Judgement Frenzy
nodes.description: You gain Frenzy for a duration after using Judgement if it hits at least one enemy.

nodes.name: Judgement Mana Consumed
nodes.description: Judgement now also consumes a percentage of your current mana and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per mana consumed.

nodes.name: Judgement Regen After Use
nodes.description: If you hit at least one enemy with Judgement you gain the {Deliverance} buff, which drastically increases mana regen and health regen.

nodes.name: Judgement Mana Gain After Use
nodes.description: While you have the {Deliverance} buff whenever you directly use Vengeance, Rive, or Multistrike and hit at least one enemy you regain additional mana.

nodes.name: Judgement No Cooldown
nodes.description:
Judgement no longer has a cooldown, but costs substantially more mana. The Consecrated Ground it creates deals less damage and its healing restores less health (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

Its mana cost now counts as mana consumed for the effect of the {Pious Offering} node.

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Increased Attack Speed
nodes.description: {Active:} You have increased melee attack speed.

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Melee Shock Chance
nodes.description:
{Passive:} You have a chance to shock enemies with melee attacks.

{Active:} This effect is doubled.
