nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Melee Lightning Damage
nodes.description: {Active:} You deal additional lightning damage with melee attacks, and deal increased lightning damage with melee attacks.

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Zap Replaced With Lightning Blast
nodes.description: {Zap} from {Conduit} has a chance to be replaced with {Lightning Blast}.

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Fire and Lightning Damage Leech
nodes.description: {Active:} You leech a portion of the fire and lightning damage you deal with melee attacks as health.

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Melee Fire Damage
nodes.description: {Active:} You deal additional fire damage with melee attacks, and deal increased fire damage with melee attacks.

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Melee Ignite Chance
nodes.description:
{Passive:} You have a chance to ignite enemies with melee attacks.

{Active:} This effect is doubled.

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Ignite Duration
nodes.description: {Passive:} Ignites you inflict last longer (doubled while active).

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon More Conflagrate Damage
nodes.description: Ignites consumed by {Conflagrate} deal significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Burst of Fire Damage And Area
nodes.description:
{Passive:} {Fire Burst} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

{Active:} Fire Burst also has increased area of effect.

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Increased Duration
nodes.description: Enchant Weapon is active for longer.

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Reduced Activation Cost and Increased Melee Elemental Damage
nodes.description:
{Passive:} Activating Enchant Weapon costs less mana.

{Active:} You deal increased elemental damage with melee attacks.

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Add Ice and Cold Damage per Physical Damage on Weapon
nodes.description: {Active:} You deal additional cold and lightning damage with melee attacks based on your weapon's melee damage.

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Melee Chill Chance
nodes.description:
{Passive:} You have a chance to chill enemies with melee attacks, and you gain a chance to inflict frostbite on enemies based on your chill chance.

{Active:} Both of these effects are doubled.

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Chance To Cast Icicle
nodes.description:
{Passive:} Your melee attacks have a chance to cast piercing {Ice Shards} towards enemies they hit, up to a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

{Active:} The chance to cast Ice Shards is tripled.

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Melee Cold Damage
nodes.description: {Active:} You deal additional cold damage with melee attacks, and deal increased cold damage with melee attacks.

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Cleanses
nodes.description: Activating Enchant Weapon cleanses negative ailments.

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Zap On Melee
nodes.description:
{Passive:} You have a chance to cast {Zap} when you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy. This effect has a 1 second cooldown.

{Active:} Zap's cooldown is reduced.

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Consume Ignite Stacks
nodes.description: Activating Enchant Weapon consumes all ignite stacks on nearby enemies, causing their damage to be dealt instantly.

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Cast Burst of Fire Against Ignited Targets
nodes.description:
{Passive:} Cast {Fire Burst} when hitting an ignited enemy, up to a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

{Active:} Fire Burst's limit is doubled.

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Missing Mana Increases Melee Elemental Damage
nodes.description: {Active:} You deal increased elemental damage with melee attacks proportional to how much mana you are missing when Enchant Weapon is activated.

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Automatic Recast
nodes.description: When you directly use a melee attack, Enchant Weapon will automatically activate if it is not on cooldown.

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Icicles Additional Projectiles
nodes.description: {Active:} {Ice Shards} fires 2 additional projectiles.

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Free Cast on Activate
nodes.description: Activating Enchant Weapon causes your next melee elemental attack to be free.

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Nova
nodes.description:
Enchant Weapon has a reduced cooldown and duration.

{Active:} You cast {Elemental Nova} when you activate Enchant Weapon and when its active duration ends, consuming mana equal to Elemental Nova's mana cost.

nodes.name: Enchant Weapon Fire Aura
nodes.description: {Active:} You gain stacks of {Fire Aura} every second.

nodes.name: Disintegrate Chance to Slow
nodes.description: Disintegrate has a chance to slow enemies caught within the beam.

nodes.name: Disintegrate Faster Flame Energy Buildup
nodes.description: Flame Energy builds up more quickly.

nodes.name: Disintegrate More Damage
nodes.description: Disintegrate deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Disintegrate Ward Regen
nodes.description: You gain ward each second based on your Intelligence while channeling Disintegrate.

nodes.name: Disintegrate Shock Chance
nodes.description: Disintegrate has a chance to shock enemies caught within the beam.

nodes.name: Disintegrate More Lightning Damage Per Mana
nodes.description: Disintegrate deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your maximum mana.

nodes.name: Disintegrate Increased Shock Efficacy and Duration
nodes.description: Shock inflicted by Disintegrate lasts longer and Disintegrate deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of Shock on the target.

nodes.name: Disintegrate Cast Lightning Blast
nodes.description:
You have a chance each second to cast {Lightning Blast} at a nearby enemy.

This consumes mana equal to {Lightning Blast's} mana cost.

nodes.name: Disintegrate Tier Three
nodes.description: Disintegrate is upgraded to tier 3 after 4 seconds of channeling. Tier 3 grants double the bonuses of tier 2.

nodes.name: Disintegrate Tier Three Ailment Chance
nodes.description:
While your Disintegrate is at tier 3 you have a chance to inflict {Spreading Flames} and {Spark Charges} on enemies in the beam each second while channeling.

If Disintegrate is converted to {fire}, the {Spark Charges} are converted to {Spreading Flames}.

If Disintegrate is converted to {lightning}, the {Spreading Flames} is converted to {Spark Charges}.

nodes.name: Disintegrate Faster Tier Charge
nodes.description: Disintegrate upgrades to the next Tier faster. This also affects the rate at which you gain stacks of {Lucomancer}.

nodes.name: Disintegrate Channel More Damage and Damage Taken
nodes.description: Disintegrate deals more damage while at Tier 2, but also causes you to take more damage while at tier 2 (both multiplicative with other modifiers and each other), and these effects are are doubled at Tier 3.

nodes.name: Disintegrate Chance to Ignite
nodes.description: Disintegrate gains a portion of your chance to ignite with fire spells on hit as ignite chance per second.

nodes.name: Disintegrate Burning Aura
nodes.description: You have a chance each second to cast {Fire Aura} while channeling Disintegrate.

nodes.name: Disintegrate Range
nodes.description: Disintegrate has a longer range.

nodes.name: Disintegrate Damage And Mana
nodes.description:
For every 2 seconds you spend channeling Disintegrate, you gain a stack of {Lucomancer}, up to 2 stacks and each stack lasts 4 seconds. Stacks are refreshed when you gain a new one.

Lucomancer grants global more damage to ignited or shocked enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) and global reduced mana cost.

nodes.name: Disintegrate Reduced Damage Taken
nodes.description: You take less damage while channeling Disintegrate (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Disintegrate Flame Energy
nodes.description: Flame energy builds up on enemies within the beam, causing an explosion that deals fire damage around them after 3 seconds of taking damage.

nodes.name: Disintegrate Cooldown Recovery
nodes.description: Your skills recover their cooldowns faster while you are channeling Disintegrate.

nodes.name: Disintegrate Two Beams
nodes.description:
Disintegrate now has two beams, and each beam deals damage independently, so enemies caught in both take double damage.

Disintegrate costs more mana per second to channel, and each beam deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Disintegrate Kamehameha
nodes.description: Disintegrate deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has a delay before casting. This delay is reduced by increased cast speed.

nodes.name: Disintegrate Lightning Conversion
nodes.description:
Disintegrate’s base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Disintegrate loses the {fire} tag.

nodes.name: Disintegrate Restore Mana While Hitting Enemies and Reduce Damage
nodes.description: Disintegrate no longer costs mana while channeling, but it also deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Disintegrate Tier Two
nodes.description: Disintegrate is upgraded to tier 2 after 2 seconds of channeling. Tier 2 Disintegrate deals more damage, but costs more mana to channel.

nodes.name: Disintegrate Fire Conversion
nodes.description:
Disintegrate’s base lightning damage is converted to fire damage, unless you have the {Electrify} node.

Disintegrate loses the {lightning} tag.

nodes.name: Disintegrate More Fire Damage Per Intelligence
nodes.description: Disintegrate deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your Intelligence.

nodes.name: Disintegrate Orb Every Three Seconds
nodes.description:
Every 3 seconds of channelling Disintegrate, you cast {Static Orb} or {Volcanic Orb}, chosen randomly.

If Disintegrate is converted to {fire}, you always cast {Volcanic Orb}.

If Disintegrate is converted to {lightning}, you always cast {Static Orb}.

This consumes mana equal to the mana cost of those respective abilities.

nodes.name: Disintegrate Static Charges
nodes.description: You gain {Static Charges} each second while channeling Disintegrate.

nodes.name: Disintegrate Start At Higher Tier
nodes.description:
If you start channeling Disintegrate while having at least 1 stack of {Lucomancer} it starts at Tier 2.

If you also have the {Amplification} node and at least 2 stacks of {Lucomancer}, Disintegrate starts at Tier 3 instead.

nodes.name: Disintegrate Fireballs On End
nodes.description:
When you stop channeling Disintegrate, you cast {Fireball} at nearby enemies twice per second spent channeling, up to a maximum.

This consumes mana equal to {Fireball's} mana cost.

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Increased Body Armour Effect
nodes.description: Manifested Armor gains increased effect of stats from your body armor.

nodes.name: Manifest Armour More Health
nodes.description: Manifested Armor has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Health Regen
nodes.description: Manifested Armor gains additional health regeneration.

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Reflects Damage
nodes.description: Manifested Armor reflects a percentage of damage to attackers.

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Increased Helmet Effect
nodes.description: Manifested Armor gains increased effect of stats from your helmet.

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Added Fire Damage
nodes.description: Manifested Armor deals additional melee and spell fire damage as well as more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Flamethrower Increased Range and Damage
nodes.description: {Forgebreath} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Flamethrower Increased Cooldown and Ignites
nodes.description: {Forgebreath} has additional ignite chance and a shorter cooldown.

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Ignite Chance
nodes.description: Manifested Armor's melee attacks have a chance to ignite enemies.

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Increased Boots Effect
nodes.description: Manifested Armor gains increased effect of stats from your boots.

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Chance to Taunt Enemies
nodes.description: Manifested Armor has a chance to taunt nearby enemies each second.

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Cannot be Stunned
nodes.description: Manifested Armor cannot be stunned.

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Chance To Slow When Hit
nodes.description: Manifested Armor has a chance to slow attacking enemies when hit.

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Increased Gloves Effect
nodes.description: Manifested Armor gains increased effect of stats from your gloves.

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Chance To Inflict Bleed
nodes.description: Manifested Armor's melee physical attacks have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Physical Damage Over Time
nodes.description: Manifested Armor deals more physical damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Chance to Shred Armour
nodes.description: Manifested Armor's melee attacks have a chance to reduce enemy armor.

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Reduces Health and Armour and Increases Damage
nodes.description: Manifested Armor deals more damage, but has less armor (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Melee Damage Per Chest Armour
nodes.description: Your Manifest Armor gains melee physical damage equal to a proportion of the armour on your body armour.

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Shield
nodes.description: Manifested Armor gains a shield which scales with the stats of your equipped shield.

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Increased Health Regen From All Items
nodes.description: Manifested Armor gains increased effect for health regeneration from all items that affect Manifest Armor.

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Reflects Damage Per Point of Attunement
nodes.description: Manifested Armor reflects damage back to attackers for an amount equal to your attunement.

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Flamethrower
nodes.description: Manifested Armor now also attacks with {Forgebreath}, a fire spell that deals 60 fire damage to all enemies in a cone in front of it. 3 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Whirlwind Attack
nodes.description:
Manifested Armor gains the ability to use {Whirlwind Strike}, a spinning attack which hits all nearby enemies multiple times and travels a short distance. 

This effect has a 4 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Charge
nodes.description: Manifested Armor gains a charge ability, which deals physical damage and knocks back any enemy it passes through. 6 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Manifest Armour Mace
nodes.description: Manifested Armor gains a sword which scales with your equipped weapon's stats.

nodes.name: Maelstrom Increased Area
nodes.description: Maelstrom deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Maelstrom More Damage When Cast on Totem
nodes.description: Maelstrom deals more damage when cast on a totem (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Maelstrom Added Chill Chance
nodes.description: Maelstrom has a chance to chill enemies each second.

nodes.name: Maelstrom Reduced Duration and Increased Damage and Increased Tsunami Damage
nodes.description: {Tsunami} deals more damage and has increased area for each stack of Maelstrom on you.

nodes.name: Maelstrom Heal Per Second
nodes.description: Maelstrom also heals allies in its area of effect each second.

nodes.name: Maelstrom Reduced Area and Increased Damage
nodes.description: Maelstrom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area.

nodes.name: Maelstrom Freeze Rate
nodes.description: Maelstrom has an increased chance to freeze enemies each second.

nodes.name: Maelstrom Increased Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Maelstrom costs less mana.

nodes.name: Maelstrom Dodge Rating
nodes.description: Each stack of Maelstrom grants you increased dodge chance.

nodes.name: Maelstrom Increased Duration
nodes.description: Maelstrom stacks have a longer duration.

nodes.name: Maelstrom Reduced Lightning Attack Stack Requirement
nodes.description: {Power of The Storm's} stack requirement is reduced.

nodes.name: Maelstrom Lightning Attacks More Targets
nodes.description: {Storm Bolt} from the {Power of the Storm} node is cast at additional targets.

nodes.name: Maelstrom Increased Damage
nodes.description: Maelstrom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This bonus is doubled if you have at least 60 Attunement.

nodes.name: Maelstrom Stacks on Kill
nodes.description:
You have a chance on killing an enemy or hitting a boss or rare enemy to cast Maelstrom. 

This effect has a 2 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Maelstrom Haste At High Stacks
nodes.description: If you have 6 stacks of Maelstrom or more, you gain {Haste.}

nodes.name: Maelstrom Frenzy At High Stacks
nodes.description: If you have 6 stacks of Maelstrom or more, you gain {Frenzy.}

nodes.name: Maelstrom Stun Buff
nodes.description: Each stack of Maelstrom grants you an increased chance to stun enemies.

nodes.name: Maelstrom Cast on Minions
nodes.description: You can choose to cast Maelstrom on your minions instead of yourself.

nodes.name: Maelstrom Summon Twisters
nodes.description: When you directly cast Maelstrom, you have a chance to also cast Tornado. This consumes a percentage of Tornado's mana cost.

nodes.name: Maelstrom Summon Tsunami
nodes.description: After every fifth Maelstrom stack gained, you release a {Tsunami}, a cold spell that deals damage in an area around you.

nodes.name: Maelstrom Single Stack
nodes.description: Maelstrom deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), has significantly increased healing effectiveness and lasts significantly longer, but you can have only one maximum stack of Maelstrom.

nodes.name: Maelstrom Unleash
nodes.description: If you go one second without directly casting Maelstrom you gain a stack of {Lagon's Slumber}. When you next cast Maelstrom directly, all stacks of {Lagon's Slumber} are consumed to cast Maelstrom an additional time per stack.

nodes.name: Maelstrom Physical Conversion
nodes.description:
Maelstrom's base cold damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Chill chance from this tree is converted to slow chance.

Maelstrom can no longer freeze, but each stack of Maelstrom grants global more physical damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Maelstrom Lightning Attack At High Stacks
nodes.description: While you have 6 or more stacks, you cast {Storm Bolt} at a nearby enemy each second.

nodes.name: Maelstrom Damage To Frozen
nodes.description: Maelstrom deals more damage to chilled or frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Added Elemental Protection and Dodge Rating
nodes.description: Your raptor has additional elemental resistance and have additional dodge chance.

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Improved Screech
nodes.description: {Screech}'s cooldown is reduced, and it causes enemies it hits to {Bleed}.

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Reduce Cooldown of Other Companions
nodes.description: Your raptor automatically reduces the cooldown of your other companions' activatable abilities by 3 seconds. This effect has an 8 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Damage And Area
nodes.description: Your raptor deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased area of effect for its abilities.

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Fire Breath Damage And Cooldown
nodes.description: {Fire Breath}'s cooldown is reduced, and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Raptor More Damage to Bleeding Enemies
nodes.description: Your raptor deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Haste Chance On Bleeding Death
nodes.description: When a bleeding enemy dies within 12 meters, your raptor has a chance per stack of bleed on that enemy to gain Haste for 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Summon Raptor More Melee Damage Per Bleed
nodes.description: Your raptor deals more melee damage per bleed on the enemy (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Bleed Chance on Hit
nodes.description: Your raptor's melee attacks have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Increased Damage Over Time
nodes.description: Your raptor deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Blinds and Poison Chance
nodes.description: Your raptor's attacks have a chance to inflict blind, poison, and slow on hit.

nodes.name: Summon Raptor More Damage Per Missing Max Health
nodes.description: Your raptor deals more damage for each percent of its missing health (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to 50% missing health.

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Increased Rampage Effect
nodes.description: Your raptor gains increased effect from {Rampage}.

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Increased Critical Strike Chance
nodes.description: Your raptor has additional critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Increased Rampage Duration
nodes.description: {Rampage}'s duration is increased.

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Rampage Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: {Rampage} costs less mana.

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Rampage Cull
nodes.description: While your raptor is {Rampaging}, its hits instantly kill enemies below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Screech
nodes.description: Your raptor gains the ability to {Screech} at enemies, dealing damage and shredding their physical resistance. Screech has an 8 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Fire Conversion
nodes.description:
Your raptor becomes a {Dragon Raptor}. The base physical damage of your raptor's melee attacks are converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not with increases to physical damage.

Your raptor gains the {Fire Breath} ability, dealing spell fire damage over time with an 8 second cooldown.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance for your raptor, and all effects in the tree related to bleed now depend on ignite.

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Attack Speed Doubled On Kill
nodes.description: Your raptor has increased attack and cast speed. This effect is doubled if it has killed an enemy in the past 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Chance to Double Bleed Speed On Hit
nodes.description: When your raptor hits an enemy, bleeds on that enemy have a 25% chance to double in speed.

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Increased Melee Attack Speed and Chance to Lose Health On Attack
nodes.description: Your raptor has increased melee attack speed, but loses 5% of its current health with each attack while above 50% of maximum health.

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Rampage Near Rare or Boss
nodes.description: Your raptor uses {Rampage} if it encounters a boss or rare enemy, if it is able to. This sets Rampage to 50% of its normal cooldown.

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Rampge Damage Reduction
nodes.description: {Rampage} also grants your raptor less damage taken for the duration.

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Cooldown Recovery Speed
nodes.description: Your raptor has increased cooldown recovery speed for its abilities.

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Fire Breath Reset On Rampage
nodes.description: {Rampage} also resets the cooldown of {Fire Breath}.

nodes.name: Summon Raptor Crit Multi And Armor Shred
nodes.description: Your raptor has additional critical strike multiplier, and its attacks have a chance to shred armor on hit.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Increased Damage
nodes.description: Symbols increase the damage of you and your allies.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Ignite Chance
nodes.description: Symbols grant you and your allies a chance to ignite enemies.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Increased Healing
nodes.description: Symbols grant you and your allies increased healing effectiveness.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Duration And Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Symbols of Hope costs less mana and the active effect lasts longer.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Max Sigils Alpha
nodes.description: You can summon an additional Symbol.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Resummon Consumed Sigil
nodes.description: You have a chance to regain a Symbol after activation.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Healing Effectiveness On Consumption
nodes.description: Symbol of Hope's active effect also grants increased healing effectiveness for its duration.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Haste On Use
nodes.description: Symbol of Hope's active effect also grants Haste for its duration.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Max Health Percent Healed
nodes.description: Activating Symbols of Hope now heals you for a portion of your maximum health.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Endurance Threshold
nodes.description: Symbols grant you and your allies additional endurance threshold

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Flare Recast
nodes.description: Directly cast Divine Flares which hit a rare enemy or boss have a chance per symbol consumed to recast Divine Flare.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Damage And Area Per Sigil
nodes.description: {Divine Flare} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area per Symbol consumed.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope AOE Cleanse Chance
nodes.description: Divine Flare now has a chance per Symbol consumed to cleanse negative ailments on allies, and a chance per Symbol consumed to blind nearby enemies.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Chance For Sigil On Kill Or Hit
nodes.description: {Divine Flare} now has a chance to gain a Symbol on kill or when hitting a boss or rare enemy.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Cooldown Recovery
nodes.description: Symbols of Hope has a shorter cooldown.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Cast On Allies
nodes.description: You can now cast Symbols of Hope's active effect on your allies. Any effects from this tree will now be granted to the recipient.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Block Chance And Effectiveness
nodes.description: Symbols grant additional block chance and block effectiveness.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Max Sigils Beta
nodes.description: You can summon an additional Symbol.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Added Fire Damage
nodes.description: Symbols grant you and your allies additional fire damage.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Max Health Percent As Ward
nodes.description: When you activate Symbols of Hope, gain ward equal to a portion of your maximum health per symbol consumed.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope AOE On Cast
nodes.description:
Symbol of Hope's active effect creates a {Divine Flare} that deals fire damage to enemies in an area around you and heals allies for 50 health per Symbol consumed, but it no longer grants damage reduction.

Symbol of Hope's cooldown is significantly reduced, and it is no longer instant cast.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Self Only
nodes.description: Symbols now only affect you, but provide twice as much health regeneration.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Convert To Lightning
nodes.description: Fire damage provided by Symbols is converted to lightning damage. Each Symbol now grants additional chance to {Electrify} on hit, but no longer increases health regeneration.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Mana Regeneration
nodes.description: Symbols of Hope grants you and your allies increased mana regeneration.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Electrify Chance
nodes.description: Symbols of Hope grants you and your allies additional chance to electrify on hit.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Increased Crit Chance
nodes.description: You and your allies gain increased critical strike chance per Symbol.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Increased Gain Rate
nodes.description: You gain Symbols of Hope faster.

nodes.name: Sigils Of Hope Buff Effect For Other Allies
nodes.description: Your Symbols of Hope have increased effect on your other allies.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Increased Retaliation Damage
nodes.description: Flame Ward's retaliation hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Flame Ward Increased Retaliation Area
nodes.description: Flame Ward's retaliation hits in a larger area.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Added Armor
nodes.description: Flame Ward grants armor while active.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Block Protections And Ward On Block
nodes.description: Flame Ward grants additional block chance, block effectiveness, and ward on block while active.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Ice Shield Retaliate Freeze Rate
nodes.description: Flame Ward's retaliation hits have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Increased Duration And Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Flame Ward costs less mana. Flame Ward and Fire Aura last longer.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Fire Aura Increased Damage
nodes.description: {Fire Aura} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This also effects Fire Aura from sources other than Flame Ward.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Ward Regeneration
nodes.description: Flame Ward grants ward over time while active.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Ward Retention
nodes.description: Flame Ward grants increased ward retention while active.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Added Fire Damage
nodes.description:
Flame Ward grants additional fire damage to attacks and spells while active.

If Flame Ward is converted to cold or lightning, then this added damage is also converted.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Additional Ward
nodes.description: Flame Ward grants additional ward.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Additional Damage Reduction
nodes.description: You take less damage from hits while Flame Ward is active (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Flame Ward Elemental Protections
nodes.description: Flame Ward reduces elemental damage taken while active (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Flame Ward Reduced Mana Cost
nodes.description: Flame Ward costs less mana.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Increased Mana Regeneration
nodes.description: Flame Ward grants increased mana regeneration while active.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Reduced Duration And Additional Ward
nodes.description: Flame Ward grants additional ward, but has a shorter duration.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Additional Ward And No Retaliate
nodes.description: Flame Ward grants significantly more ward, but no longer retaliates.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Additional Ward Per Missing Health
nodes.description: Flame Ward grants additional ward equal to a percentage of your missing health.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Increased Cooldown And Ward
nodes.description: Flame Ward grants more ward, but has a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Increased Fire Damage
nodes.description:
Flame Ward grants increased fire damage while active

If Flame Ward is converted to cold or lightning, then this damage increase is also converted.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Haste
nodes.description: You have {Haste} while Flame Ward is active.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Centered on Enemy
nodes.description: Flame Ward's retaliation is centered on the enemy that hits you, but it hits in a smaller area.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Ice Retaliation
nodes.description:
Flame Ward is converted to Cold. This converts the base damage of the retaliation, granting it a freeze rate, and converts any fire damage modifiers from nodes on this tree.

This also globally converts {Fire Aura} to cold and grants it a Freeze Rate.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Lightning Retaliation
nodes.description:
Flame Ward is converted to Lightning, unless it has been converted to cold. This converts the base damage of the retaliation, and any fire damage modifiers from nodes on this tree.

This also globally converts {Fire Aura} to lightning, unless it has been converted to cold.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Fire Aura
nodes.description: While active, Flame Ward grants you {Fire Aura}, a spell that deals fire damage over time to surrounding enemies.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Cast On Allies
nodes.description:
Flame Ward can be cast on allies.

This has no effect if you have taken the {Mental Aegis} node.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Cast When Stunned
nodes.description: Flame Ward is cast when you are stunned, if it is off cooldown and you have positive mana.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Energy Shield
nodes.description: Mana now absorbs damage while Flame Ward is active. Each point of mana shields 5 health and ward.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Extra Charge
nodes.description: Flame Ward can store an additional charge, allowing you to use it twice before it goes on cooldown.

nodes.name: Flame Ward Knock Back
nodes.description: Enemies around you are knocked back when you use Flame Ward

nodes.name: Earthquake Slow Chance
nodes.description: Earthquake and its {Aftershocks} have a chance to slow enemies in their area of effect.

nodes.name: Earthquake Increased Area
nodes.description: Earthquake and its Aftershocks have a larger area of effect.

nodes.name: Earthquake Maximum Aftershocks
nodes.description: Earthquake can cast more maximum possible Aftershocks.

nodes.name: Earthquake Aftershock Chains
nodes.description: Aftershocks have a chance when they hit to cast another Aftershock. Maximum of one additional Aftershock.

nodes.name: Earthquake Aftershocks Cast Snowball
nodes.description:
Aftershock hits have a chance to have an {Avalanche Boulder} cast on their location, and when this effect triggers it consumes mana.

The {Boulder} is affected by your {Avalanche} Skill Tree.

nodes.name: Earthquake Slow Duration
nodes.description: Slows caused by Earthquake and its Aftershocks last longer.

nodes.name: Earthquake Mana Efficiency And Stun Chance
nodes.description: Earthquake and its Aftershocks have an increased chance to stun enemies, and Earthquake costs less mana.

nodes.name: Earthquake Grants Haste And Frenzy
nodes.description: Casting Earthquake grants you {Haste} and {Frenzy} for a duration.

nodes.name: Earthquake Aftershock Damage And Duration
nodes.description: Aftershocks deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) and last longer.

nodes.name: Earthquake Aftershock Blinds Enemies
nodes.description: Aftershocks blind enemies within their area of effect.

nodes.name: Earthquake Aftershock Increased Damage And Stun Chance
nodes.description: Aftershocks deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have an increased chance to stun enemies.

nodes.name: Earthquake Minimum Aftershocks
nodes.description: Earthquake can cast more minimum possible Aftershocks. Each enemy can only be targeted by one Aftershock.

nodes.name: Earthquake Aftershock Increased Area
nodes.description: Aftershocks have a larger area of effect.

nodes.name: Earthquake Increased Hit Damage
nodes.description: Earthquake's initial slam deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Earthquake Reduced Area And Increased Damage
nodes.description: Earthquake's initial slam deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area.

nodes.name: Earthquake Removes Aftershocks And Applies Damage To Base Hit
nodes.description: Modifiers to Aftershock damage on this tree apply to the initial slam, but Earthquake can no longer create Aftershocks.

nodes.name: Earthquake Armor Shred
nodes.description: Earthquake's initial slam reduces enemy armor.

nodes.name: Earthquake Damage Against Rares And Bosses
nodes.description: Earthquake's initial slam deals more hit damage against rare and boss enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Earthquake Increased Hit Damage And Stun Chance
nodes.description: Earthquake's initial slam deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies.

nodes.name: Earthquake Lightning Damage
nodes.description: Earthquake's initial slam deals additional lightning damage, and Earthquake deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Earthquake Lightning Storm
nodes.description:
Casting Earthquake expends Storm Stacks over 0.5 seconds.

{Storm Bolts} triggered this way deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Earthquake Stun Duration
nodes.description: Stuns caused by Earthquake and its Aftershocks last longer, but Earthquake has a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Earthquake Undodgeable
nodes.description: Earthquake's initial slam can't be dodged.

nodes.name: Earthquake Aftershocks Cast At Totems
nodes.description: Aftershocks appear around your totems instead if they are nearby.

nodes.name: Earthquake Aftershock DOT
nodes.description: Aftershocks are now damage over time, dealing their normal hit damage each second. Aftershocks last 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Earthquake Cone Attack
nodes.description: Using Earthquake directly it now deals damage in a cone which has increased range. Aftershocks also favour targets in the direction Earthquake is cast.

nodes.name: Earthquake Triple Hit
nodes.description:
Earthquake's initial slam occurs three times. First with 30% reduced radius and damage, then with 5% reduced radius and damage, then with 30% increased radius and damage.

Earthquake now has a cooldown, and each initial hit consumes mana.

nodes.name: Earthquake Fire Mode
nodes.description:
Earthquake's base damage is converted to fire damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Additionally, armor shred chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance.

nodes.name: Earthquake Spell And Lightning Conversion
nodes.description:
Earthquake is converted into a spell, and no longer scales with melee damage. Earthquake now deals substantial additional base damage on the initial slam and its base damage is converted to Lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increased lightning damage, but not with increased physical damage.

Aftershocks also deal substantial additional spell damage.

nodes.name: Earthquake Stun
nodes.description: Earthquake's initial slam deals more damage and has increased stun chance and stun duration, but Earthquake has a 6 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Earthquake Cold Mode
nodes.description:
Earthquake's base damage is converted to cold damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Additionally, armor shred chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance.

nodes.name: Arcane Ascendance Increased Spell Damage
nodes.description: Arcane Ascendance grants you increased spell damage while active.

nodes.name: Arcane Ascendance Scaling Spell Damage and Cast Speed
nodes.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, each hit you take increases your spell damage and cast speed, but drains your mana.

nodes.name: Arcane Ascendance Increasing Spell Damage
nodes.description: You are granted increased spell damage each second while Arcane Ascendance is active.

nodes.name: Arcane Ascendance Increasing Cast Speed
nodes.description: You are granted increased cast speed each second while Arcane Ascendance is active.

nodes.name: Arcane Ascendance Chance to Slow Distant Enemies
nodes.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, spells and attacks have a chance to slow enemies over 5 meters away and you deal more damage to enemies per stack of slow on them.

nodes.name: Arcane Ascendance Mana Per Kill
nodes.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, you are granted mana whenever you kill an enemy that is over 5 meters away.

nodes.name: Arcane Ascendance Haste on End
nodes.description: You are granted {Haste} for a duration after leaving Arcane Ascendance. The duration is capped at 200% of the time you spent in Arcane Ascendance.

nodes.name: Arcane Ascendance Cooldown
nodes.description: Arcane Ascendance has a shorter cooldown.

nodes.name: Arcane Ascendance Ward on Start
nodes.description: You gain ward when you activate Arcane Ascendance.

nodes.name: Arcane Ascendance Freeze Rate
nodes.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, your spells and attacks that can freeze enemies have a higher chance to do so.

nodes.name: Arcane Ascendance Knockback
nodes.description: You knock back all nearby enemies when you enter Arcane Ascendance.

nodes.name: Arcane Ascendance Lightning Blast Frequency
nodes.description: Lightning Blast cast by {Superconductor} triggers more frequently.

nodes.name: Arcane Ascendance Reduced Mana Drain
nodes.description: Arcane Ascendance drains less mana per second.

nodes.name: Arcane Ascendance Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: All of your spells cost less mana while Arcane Ascendance is active, but you cannot regenerate mana while Arcane Ascendance is active.

nodes.name: Arcane Ascendance Bigger Cast Limit
nodes.description: You can cast more spells via {Acuity}, but Arcane Ascendance has a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Arcane Ascendance Freeze Nearby Enemy On Frozen Kill
nodes.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, whenever you kill a frozen enemy a nearby enemy is frozen for a duration.

nodes.name: Arcane Ascendance Chill Distant Enemies
nodes.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, spells and attacks have a chance to chill enemies over 5 meters away.

nodes.name: Arcane Ascendance Shock Distant Enemies
nodes.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, spells and attacks have a chance to shock enemies over 5 meters away.

nodes.name: Arcane Ascendance Lightning Mark Damage
nodes.description: {Mark Of Thunder} deals more damage when it is consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Arcane Ascendance Lightning Blast
nodes.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, you automatically cast {Lightning Blast} when you hit an enemy. Lightning Blast uses its skill tree and you lose mana equal to Lightning Blast's cost. This effect has a 2 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Arcane Ascendance Cast Limit
nodes.description: Arcane Ascendance now has a 2 second cooldown and no longer drains your mana. You can cast 4 spells before Arcane Ascendance ends automatically. Lasts 12 seconds.

nodes.name: Arcane Ascendance Lightning Mark On Distant Enemies
nodes.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, you {Mark} enemies you hit that are over 5 meters away. When you exit Arcane Ascendance, you consume all marks, dealing lightning damage to affected enemies.

nodes.name: Arcane Ascendance Temporary Mana
nodes.description: You regain mana while you enter Arcane Ascendance, but the mana is lost when you exit Arcane Ascendance.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Armor And Protections
nodes.description: Eterra's Blessing grants elemental and poison resistance.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Next Spell Increased Damage
nodes.description: Your next spell after casting Eterra's Blessing deals increased damage.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Spell Leech
nodes.description: After casting Eterra's Blessing, your spells leech a portion of the damage they deal as health for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Minion Stun Immunity
nodes.description: When cast on a minion, Eterra's Blessing grants stun immunity for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Scorpion Shared Poison Chance
nodes.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your {Scorpion} companion, you are both granted a chance to poison enemies with attacks and spells for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Minion Attack And Movement And Cast Speed
nodes.description: When cast on a minion, Eterra's Blessing also grants increased movement, attack, and cast speed for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Chance To Refresh Companion Ability
nodes.description: When Eterra's Blessing heals one of your companions it has a chance to refresh its activated ability cooldown, but Eterra's Blessing costs more mana.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Target Downed Companion
nodes.description: When Eterra's Blessing targets a downed companion, it heals them for a portion of their maximum downed duration.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Heal Self On Minion Target
nodes.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on one of your companions, you also heal yourself for a portion of its base heal amount.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Chance To Heal Nearby Allies
nodes.description: Eterra's Blessing has a chance to heal all allies nearby its target for 50 health.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Reduced Mana Cost
nodes.description: Eterra's Blessing costs less mana.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Knocks Back
nodes.description: Eterra's Blessing knocks back enemies a given distance from its target.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Increased Healing
nodes.description: Eterra's Blessing has increased healing effectiveness.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Cleanses
nodes.description: Eterra's Blessing cleanses all ailments on its target.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Heal At End Of HoT
nodes.description: When {Efflorescence's} heal over time expires, heal again for half of Eterra's Blessing's value.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Free While OOM
nodes.description: When you are out of mana Eterra's Blessing is free, but Eterra's Blessing can no longer provide additional buffs.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Chance To Summon Healing Totem On High Health Heal
nodes.description: When you heal a target that is already at high health, you have a chance to summon a {Healing Totem} at its location which heals nearby allies.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Increased Healing If Recently Transformed
nodes.description: Eterra's Blessing heals for more if you have transformed recently (last 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Bear Wolf Shared Physical Damage
nodes.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your {Wolf} or {Bear} companions, you are both granted increased physical damage for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Raptor Sabertooth Shared Bleed Chance
nodes.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your {Sabertooth} or {Raptor} companions, you are both granted a chance to cause enemies to bleed with attacks and spells for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Targeted Minion Taunts
nodes.description: When you directly cast Eterra's Blessing on a companion it taunts nearby enemies for 4 seconds. However Eterra's Blessing now has a long cooldown.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Auto Targets Lowest HP Minion
nodes.description: Eterra's Blessing automatically targets the lowest health ally in range, but Eterra's Blessing costs more mana.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Spriggan Shared Spell Damage
nodes.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your {Spriggan} companion, you are both granted increased spell damage for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Heal Over Time
nodes.description: Eterra's Blessing heals half of its value immediately, and half of its value over 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Autocast On Thorn Shield Cast
nodes.description:
Whenever you directly cast Thorn Shield, you also cast Eterra's Blessing on the same target.

Consumes Eterra's Blessing's mana cost as rage.

nodes.name: Eterra's Blessing Storm Crow Haste and Frenzy
nodes.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your Storm Crow companions, they are granted {Haste} and Frenzy for 5 seconds.

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath Increased Charging Speed
nodes.description: Smelter's Wrath charges up faster to reach its maximum area sooner.

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath Ignite Chance From Charging
nodes.description: Smelter's Wrath hits have a chance to ignite enemies for each second channelled.

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath Crit Chance From Charging
nodes.description:
Smelter's Wrath has additional critical strike chance for each second channeled.

Additionally, it has additional critical strike multiplier for each second channeled.

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath Increased Damage From Charging
nodes.description: Smelter's Wrath deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second channelled.

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath Armor And Protections While Charging
nodes.description: While charging Smelter's Wrath you have more armor and endurance threshold (multiplicative with other modifiers)

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath More Damage From Charging
nodes.description: Smelter's Wrath deals more melee damage and fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). These bonuses are increased by charging for longer.

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath Slower Charge And Increased Damage From Charging
nodes.description: Smelter's Wrath hits deal more damage (multiplciative with other modifiers) for each second channelled, but Smelter's Wrath charges more slowly.

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath More Damage To Ignited Enemies
nodes.description: Smelter's Wrath hits deal more damage to ignited enemies per stack of ignite, up to a maximum of 150%.  This effect is multiplicative with other modifiers.

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath Furnace Increased Damage
nodes.description: {Furnace} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath Furnace Ignite Chance
nodes.description: {Furnace} has a chance to ignite enemies each second.

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath Furnace Slow Chance
nodes.description: {Furnace} has a chance to slow enemies each second.

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath Furnace Armor Shred
nodes.description: {Furnace} has a chance to reduce enemy armor each second.

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath Increased Stun Chance From Charging
nodes.description: Smelter's Wrath hits have an increased chance to stun enemies per second channelled.

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath Knockback
nodes.description:
Smelter's Wrath charges up slower to reach its maximum area later (multiplicative with other channel speed modifiers).

Additionally, Smeler's Wrath gains additional physical and fire penetration per second channeled.

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath Hammers Instead Of Javelins
nodes.description: The Javelin throw from {Spear Volley} is replaced with Hammer Throw, and throws additional hammers.

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath More Damage To Rares And Bosses
nodes.description: Smelter's Wrath hits deal more damage to rare enemies and bosses (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath Kill Threshold
nodes.description: Smelter's Wrath hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). This kill threshold is doubled at maximum charge.

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath Nova
nodes.description: Smelter's Wrath now releases in a nova around you instead of a cone, but costs additional mana.

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath Armor Shred Chance From Charging
nodes.description: Smelter's Wrath hits have a chance to shred enemies' armor for each second channelled.

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath Guaranteed Crit
nodes.description: Smelter's Wrath has doubled crit chance and deals more damage when fully charged (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath Duplicate Attack
nodes.description: When Smelter's Wrath is released, a duplicate attack is released in the opposite direction.

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath Furnace
nodes.description: Smelter's Wrath spews {Furnace} while charging, a fire spell that deals damage over time in a cone to enemies.

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath Throwing Javelins On Full Charge
nodes.description:
When releasing a fully charged Smelter's Wrath you also throw a Javelin at an enemy within 12 meters three times.

If Javelin has a cooldown, this effect also has its own cooldown.

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath Attack Speed To Crit Conversion
nodes.description: Smelter's Wrath converts your increased attack speed to increased critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath Burning Patch
nodes.description:
When fully charged, Smelter's Wrath leaves behind a {Burning Patch} for 6 seconds which ignites all enemies who stand in it twice per second.

Smelter's Wrath costs additional mana.

nodes.name: Smelter's Wrath Area To Fire DoT
nodes.description: Increased Area for Area Skills stats no longer increases Smelter's Wrath's charge speed and instead grants its more fire damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Anomaly Increased Area
nodes.description: Anomaly hits enemies in a larger area.

nodes.name: Anomaly Increased Max Duration
nodes.description: Anomaly lasts longer.

nodes.name: Anomaly Instant Cast
nodes.description: Anomaly is cast instantly, but Anomaly has a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Anomaly Time Wave Area
nodes.description: {Time Wave} deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area, and increases to Anomaly's area also affect Time Wave.

nodes.name: Anomaly Double Time Wave
nodes.description: An additional {Time Wave} is released when you cast Anomaly.

nodes.name: Anomaly Cooldown Recovery Speed
nodes.description: Anomaly has a shorter cooldown.

nodes.name: Anomaly Future Strike Effect
nodes.description: {Future Strikes} applied by Anomaly have additional Void Penetration

nodes.name: Anomaly Increased Ailment Speed
nodes.description: When enemies return to the present, all damaging ailments currently applied to them apply faster.

nodes.name: Anomaly Reset Ailment Duration
nodes.description: When enemies return to the present, the duration of damaging ailments applied to them is reset.

nodes.name: Anomaly Time Rot On Return
nodes.description: Enemies hit by Anomaly are afflicted with {Time Rot} when they return.

nodes.name: Anomaly Time Rot Duration
nodes.description: {Time Rot} inflicted by Anomaly lasts longer and has additional Void Penetration

nodes.name: Anomaly Increased Enemy Void Damage Taken On Return
nodes.description: When enemies return to the present, they take increased void damage for a duration.

nodes.name: Anomaly Ignite Conversion
nodes.description: Anomaly now applies Ignite instead of Time Rot. Modifiers to Time Rot apply to Ignite instead.

nodes.name: Anomaly Additional Ignite Stacks
nodes.description: Anomaly applies additional stacks of ignite.

nodes.name: Anomaly Time Bubble Crit Chance To Allies
nodes.description: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies increased critical strike chance while in its area.

nodes.name: Anomaly Time Bubble Duration
nodes.description: {Time Bubble} lasts longer.

nodes.name: Anomaly Time Bubble Cast On Self
nodes.description: {Time Bubble} is now cast on yourself and moves with you, but Anomaly costs more mana.

nodes.name: Anomaly Time Bubble Attack And Cast Speed To Allies
nodes.description: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies increased attack and cast speed while in its area.

nodes.name: Anomaly Time Bubble Cooldown Recovery To Allies
nodes.description: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies increased cooldown recovery speed while in its area.

nodes.name: Anomaly Time Bubble Added Leech To Allies
nodes.description: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies global health leech. This is doubled for void damage.

nodes.name: Anomaly Time Bubble Increased Leech To Allies
nodes.description: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies increased health leech while in its area.

nodes.name: Anomaly Enemy Stasis On Return
nodes.description:
When enemies return to the present they are afflicted by {Time Lock,} rendering them unable to move, attack, or cast spells for 2 seconds.

Anomaly costs more mana.

10% of remaining cooldown recovered whenever you {Time Lock} an enemy with Anomaly. This effect can occur a maximum of two times each second.

nodes.name: Anomaly Stasis Duration
nodes.description: {Time Lock} lasts longer.

nodes.name: Anomaly Stasis In AOE On Return
nodes.description: When enemies return to the present, enemies within the area of Anomaly's original cast are also time locked for 2 seconds.

nodes.name: Anomaly Time Bubble Effects Persist After Duration
nodes.description: When allies or enemies exit {Time Bubble's} area of effect, effects caused or granted by Time Bubble persist for 2 seconds.

nodes.name: Anomaly Time Wave AOE
nodes.description: When enemies return to the present a {Time Wave} is released, a spell dealing void damage to nearby enemies.

nodes.name: Anomaly Future Strike On Hit
nodes.description: {Future Strike} is applied to all enemies hit by Anomaly.

nodes.name: Anomaly Time Bubble
nodes.description: Anomaly leaves behind a {Time Bubble} for 5 seconds, which slows enemies and shreds their void resistance.

nodes.name: Anomaly No Time Travel And Instant Effects
nodes.description: Anomaly no longer sends enemies foward in time. Effects that would be triggered when enemies return to the present are instead triggered immediately.

nodes.name: Drain Life More Damage
nodes.description: Drain Life deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Drain Life Necrotic AOE Increased Area And Damage
nodes.description: {Soul Blast} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

nodes.name: Drain Life Only Targets Minions And Increased Health Leech
nodes.description: Drain Life can now only target minions. Drain Life leeches a higher percentage of damage as health.

nodes.name: Drain Life Does Not Leech And More Damage
nodes.description: Drain Life deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but the health leech from its base effect and nodes on this tree is removed.

nodes.name: Drain Life Soul Wisp On Kill Chance
nodes.description: Drain Life has a chance to summon a {Soul Wisp} when it kills an enemy, a minion that deals necrotic damage to enemies.

nodes.name: Drain Life Ward On Kill
nodes.description: You are granted ward when Drain Life kills an enemy.

nodes.name: Drain Life Fear And Slow Chance
nodes.description: Drain Life has a chance to slow and fear its targets each second.

nodes.name: Drain Life Contempt Stacks
nodes.description:
You gain a stack of {Contempt} when you have channelled on the same enemy for 2 seconds.

Contempt grants more armor (multiplicative with other modifiers) and adds to all resistances. All stacks of Contempt are lost when you stop channelling.

nodes.name: Drain Life Contempt Stacks Persist
nodes.description: {Contempt} stacks last for a duration after you stop channelling Drain Life.

nodes.name: Drain Life Stun Duration
nodes.description: The stun inflicted by {Stagger} lasts longer and Drain Life deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) against bosses and rare enemies.

nodes.name: Drain Life Reduced Mana Drain
nodes.description: Drain Life costs less mana per second.

nodes.name: Drain Life Damned Stacks
nodes.description: Drain Life applies stacks of {Damned} each second. {Damned} is an ailment that deals necrotic damage over time.

nodes.name: Drain Life Damned Duration
nodes.description: {Damned} inflicted by Drain Life lasts longer.

nodes.name: Drain Life Damage Per Damned Stack
nodes.description: Drain Life deals 3% more damage per stack of {Damned} on enemies affected by {Damned}, up to a cap (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Drain Life Increased Health Leech
nodes.description: Drain Life leeches a higher percentage of damage as health and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to targets that are on low health.

nodes.name: Drain Life Increased Leech And Mana Drain
nodes.description: Drain Life leeches a higher percentage of damage as health, but costs more mana per second.

nodes.name: Drain Life Duration Of Casted
nodes.description: {Dark Shackles} lasts longer, but Drain Life costs more mana.

nodes.name: Drain Life Chill Nearby Enemies
nodes.description: When a target is killed by Drain Life, you chill enemies in an area around them for a duration.

nodes.name: Drain Life Necrotic AOE On Kill
nodes.description: When a target is killed by Drain Life you cast Soul Blast at their location, dealing spell necrotic damage to enemies in an area around them.

nodes.name: Drain Life Targets Minions And Grants Mana
nodes.description: Drain Life can now target your minions. You gain 10 mana per second for each minion you are draining.

nodes.name: Drain Life Poison Conversion
nodes.description:
Drain Life's base necrotic damage is converted to poison damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Swaps Drain Life's {Necrotic} tag for a {Poison} tag.

nodes.name: Drain Life Mana To Health Cost Conversion
nodes.description: Drain Life no longer costs mana. Instead, it drains a portion of your current health per second while channelling. Nodes that modify mana drain now modify this health drain instead.

nodes.name: Drain Life Additional Target
nodes.description: Drain Life can drain an additional target.

nodes.name: Drain Life Stuns After Duration Channelled
nodes.description: When Drain Life has channelled on the same target for 2 seconds, it stuns them for 2 seconds. Drain Life has a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Drain Life Casted And Can Move
nodes.description: Drain Life is now cast instead of channelled. Lasts for 3 seconds. Adds an up-front mana cost, and this cost is affected by modifiers to mana drain, except for the {Blood Pact} node.

nodes.name: Drain Life Additional Targets And Slows
nodes.description: {Dark Shackles} can hit up to 10 additional targets, and slows enemies hit each second, but Drain Life costs significantly more mana.

nodes.name: Drain Life Increased Area
nodes.description:
You gain ward over time while channelling based on your maximum mana.

Drain Life can affect enemies in a wider area. This does not affect the maximum number of enemies you can drain from at a time.

nodes.name: Drain Life Area To Ward Retention
nodes.description: Increased Area stats from this tree and other sources has no effect on Drain Life's area of effect, but instead grants you additional Ward Retention while channelling Drain Life.

nodes.name: Drain Life Wandering Spirits Do Not Die While Channelling
nodes.description: If {Wandering Spirits} is active when you start channeling Drain Life it does not expire until you stop channeling.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Root Node
nodes.description: Curses a target with a powerful necrotic damage over time effect. Spreads to a single nearby target on target death.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Slow Affected Enemies
nodes.description: Enemies afflicted by Spirit Plague are now also slowed.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Chance To Spread On Afflicted Hit
nodes.description: You have a chance to spread Spirit Plague when you hit an afflicted enemy.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Ward Gain On Afflicted Hit
nodes.description: You gain ward when hitting an enemy afflicted by Spirit Plague, up to a limited number of times per second.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Spread On Afflicted Crit
nodes.description: Spirit Plague spreads when you critically strike an afflicted target.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Frailty
nodes.description: Enemies you inflict with Spirit Plague are also inflicted with Frailty.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Increased AOE Area
nodes.description: Spirit Plague is cast in a larger area.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague More Damage But No Spread
nodes.description: Spirit Plague deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer spreads.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Poisons
nodes.description: Enemies you inflict with Spirit Plague are also inflicted with poison for the same duration.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Plague Wisp
nodes.description: Spirit Plague has a chance to summon a {Poison Wisp} when it kills an enemy, a minion which lasts for 15 seconds and poisons nearby enemies.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Mana Efficiency And Duration
nodes.description: Spirit Plague costs less mana and lasts longer.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Increased Cast Speed And Duration
nodes.description: Spirit Plague has increased cast speed and lasts longer.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Fears
nodes.description: Enemies afflicted by Spirit Plague are also feared.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Increased Global DOT
nodes.description: You gain increased global damage over time when you afflict an enemy with Spirit Plague. This effect lasts 4 seconds and can stack up to 13 times.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Increased Plague Effect
nodes.description: {Plague} inflicted by Spirit Plague has additional Poison Penetration.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Increased Plague Duration
nodes.description: You gain increased poison damage when you afflict an enemy with Spirit Plague. This effect lasts 4 seconds and can stack up to 13 times.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague More Damage
nodes.description: Spirit Plague deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Spirit Plague More Damage Reduced Spread
nodes.description: Spirit Plague deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but spreads in a smaller area.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Additional Spread
nodes.description: Spirit Plague spreads to additional targets, but costs more mana.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Bleeds
nodes.description: Enemies you inflict with Spirit Plague are also inflicted with bleeding for the same duration.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Self Bleed And Increased Bleed Effect
nodes.description: Bleed inflicted by Spirit Plague has additional Bleed Penetration, but you are now also inflicted with bleeding.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Mana On Kill
nodes.description: You gain mana when Spirit Plague kills an enemy.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Chance To Inflict Bleed On Afflicted Hit
nodes.description: You have a chance to apply bleed when you hit an enemy afflicted by Spirit Plague.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Cast In AOE
nodes.description: Spirit Plague is now cast in an area around the target, but costs more mana.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Spread After Duration
nodes.description: Spirit Plague spreads after a duration. (This does not affect the maximum number of spreads.)

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Combo Skill
nodes.description: Spirit Plague is now a combo skill. Directly recasting Spirit Plague within 2 seconds will cause up to 3 inflicted enemies to spread Spirit Plague to other enemies around them.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Plagues
nodes.description: Enemies you inflict with Spirit Plague are also inflicted by {Plague} for the same duration. {Plague} is an ailment that deals poison damage over time, spreads between enemies, and does not stack.

nodes.name: Spirit Plague Spell Damage Per Intelligence
nodes.description: Spirit Plague has additional spell necrotic damage for each point of Intelligence

nodes.name: Acid Flask Damage
nodes.description: Acid Flask deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Acid Flask Haste
nodes.description: Acid Flask has a chance to grant {Haste} on use for a short duration.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Armor Shred Chance
nodes.description: Acid Flask has a chance to shred enemy armor.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Added Poison Chance In Pool
nodes.description: You have a chance to poison enemies while standing in your {Poison Pools}.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Added Pool Duration
nodes.description: {Poison Pools} last longer.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Poison Shred Chance
nodes.description: Acid Flask has a chance to shred enemy poison resistance on hit.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Added Poison Chance
nodes.description: Acid Flask has additional chance to poison enemies on hit.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Frailty Chance
nodes.description: Acid Flask has a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies hit, causing them to deal less damage.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Increased Poison Duration
nodes.description: Acid Flask has increased poison duration.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Increased Throwing Speed
nodes.description: Acid Flask has increased throwing speed.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Chance To Drop When Hit
nodes.description:
You have a chance to drop an Acid Flask at your feet when an enemy hits you. 

This effect has a 5 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Acid Flask costs less mana and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Acid Flask Slow Chance
nodes.description: Acid Flask has a chance to slow enemies on hit. Slow caused by Acid Flask lasts longer.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Fire Damage
nodes.description: Acid Flask deals additional throwing fire damage.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Ignite Chance
nodes.description: Acid Flask has a chance to ignite enemies.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Critical Strike Chance
nodes.description: Acid Flask has increased critical strike chance and critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Increased Area
nodes.description: Acid Flask deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Travel Speed
nodes.description: Acid Flask travels faster.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Effacacious Toxins
nodes.description: {Poison Pools} have a chance to inflict enemies with {Efficacious Toxin} each second, causing them to take increased damage over time.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Triple Flask Line
nodes.description:
When you directly use Acid Flask, you now throw 3 Acid Flasks in a line, but Acid Flask costs more mana.

Enemies can only be hit by one flask per throw.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Triple Flask Fan Mode
nodes.description: When you directly use Acid Flask, you now throw Acid Flasks in a fan in front of you instead of a line. Flasks travel faster.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Poison Pool
nodes.description:
Acid Flask leaves behind a {Poison Pool} for 4 seconds that poison enemies that stand in it and adds a 2 second cooldown per flask thrown.

You can have a maximum of 4 {Poison Pools} active at once.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Poison Penetration
nodes.description: Acid Flask penetrates poison resistance based on your own uncapped Poison Resistance

nodes.name: Acid Flask Fire Conversion
nodes.description:
Acid Flask's base damage is converted to fire damage and its hits deal significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Acid Flask can no longer apply poison or create poison pools.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Fire Shred Conversion
nodes.description: Converts Armor Shred from all sources that Acid Flask would apply to Fire Resistance Shred.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Secondary Explosions
nodes.description: When Acid Flask is thrown directly it causes 3 smaller explosions around the impact location dealing fire damage on hit, but it costs more mana.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Blind Chance
nodes.description: Acid Flask has a chance to blind enemies hit for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Acid Flask Trap
nodes.description:
Acid Flask is now thrown as a trap that starts arming and explodes when enemies walk over it.

You can have a maximum of 6 Acid Flask Traps active at once.

nodes.name: Multishot Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Multishot costs less mana.

nodes.name: Multishot Chance To Shred Armor
nodes.description: Multishot hits have a chance to apply armor shred on hit.

nodes.name: Multishot Attack Speed And Haste Chance
nodes.description: Multishot has increased attack speed and chance to gain {Haste} when you use or trigger Multishot from another skill.

nodes.name: Multishot More Damage To Close Enemies
nodes.description: Multishot deals more hit damage, but deals less hit damage as it travels (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Multishot Fewer Attacks To Double Attack
nodes.description:
Reduce the amount of attacks to double shoot with Multishot.

Additionally, Multishot deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Multishot Increased Attack Speed
nodes.description: Multishot has increased attack speed.

nodes.name: Multishot Pierce
nodes.description: Multishot arrows pierce enemies (continue through enemies hit) up to a limit.

nodes.name: Multishot Crit Multi
nodes.description: Multishot's critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Multishot More Damage If Stationary
nodes.description: Multishot deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you haven't moved in the past second.

nodes.name: Multishot Haste After Stationary
nodes.description: You have a chance to gain {Haste} for 2 seconds when you use Multishot while {Stand My Ground} is activate.

nodes.name: Multishot Increased Crit Chance
nodes.description: Multishot has increased critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Multishot More Arrows And Mana Cost
nodes.description: Multishot has additional arrows, but costs more mana.

nodes.name: Multishot More Damage Less Area And Fewer Arrows
nodes.description:
Multishot deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but hits in a smaller cone and can only shoot a maximum of 3 arrows.

Additionally, Multishot hits have a chance to shred enemy armor per arrow before the limit.

nodes.name: Multishot Chance To Poison
nodes.description: Multishot hits have a chance to inflict poison.

nodes.name: Multishot Increased Cone Width
nodes.description: Multishot hits in a wider cone.

nodes.name: Multishot Chance To Slow
nodes.description: Multishot hits have a chance to slow and inflict bleed on enemies.

nodes.name: Multishot More Damage To Slowed Target
nodes.description: Multishot deals more hit damage to slowed targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Multishot Slow Duration Based On Dexterity
nodes.description: Multishot has increased slow and bleed duration per point of Dexterity.

nodes.name: Multishot Phys Pen
nodes.description: Multishot penetrates enemy physical resistance.

nodes.name: Multishot Knockback Chance
nodes.description:
Multishot hits have a chance to knock enemies on hit.

This effect only works on direct uses and has a 2 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Multishot No Cost When Out Of Mana
nodes.description: When you are out of mana Multishot is free to use, but it can't shoot more than a few arrows. Other bonuses still apply.

nodes.name: Multishot Damage And Travel Speed
nodes.description: Multishot deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and arrows travel faster.

nodes.name: Multishot Shotgun
nodes.description: Multishot arrows from the same attack can hit the same target and have an increased chance to stun enemies, but {Multishot} deals significantly less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Multishot Slower Attack And Damage
nodes.description: Multishot deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) when used directly, but has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Multishot Autofire On Other Bow Attack
nodes.description: Multishot has a chance to be shot when you use another bow attack with increased chance to stun, but it costs significantly more mana.

nodes.name: Multishot Double Attacks
nodes.description: When directly using Multishot, every 6th attack is a double shot.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Root Node
nodes.description: Repeatedly casts Ice Shards in a target direction.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Freeze Rate Multiplier
nodes.description: Ice Barrage hits have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Stackable Cast Speed On Freeze
nodes.description:
When a target is frozen by Ice Barrage, you are granted increased cast speed for 4 seconds.

This effect can stack a limited number of times.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Freeze Rate Multiplier Per Frostbolt
nodes.description:
Each ice shard released by Ice Barrage has a higher chance of freezing enemies than the previous shard.

This effect resets when Ice Barrage is recast.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Ice Nova On Hit Chance
nodes.description: When Ice Barrage hits an enemy it has a chance to cast {Frost Nova}, a cold spell that damages nearby enemies.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage More Fire Rate
nodes.description: Ice Barrage has a faster rate of fire.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Ward On Hit Chance
nodes.description: You have a chance to gain ward on hit with Ice Barrage.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage More Damage Less Duration
nodes.description: Ice Barrage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has a shorter duration.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Fire Rate Reduced Movement Speed
nodes.description: Ice Barrage has a faster rate of fire, but you move more slowly while it is active.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Shield Duration And Ice Barrage Cooldown
nodes.description: {Ice Shield} lasts longer, but Ice Barrage has a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Cold Damage And Less Cold Damage Taken With Shield
nodes.description: While {Ice Shield} is active, you deal more global cold damage and take less cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Stacking Damage
nodes.description:
Each ice shard released by Ice Barrage deals more damage than the previous shard (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This bonus stacks, but is reset on recasting Ice Barrage.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Duration
nodes.description: Ice Barrage lasts longer.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Increased Fire Rate On Rare And Boss
nodes.description: Ice Barrage hits against bosses and rare enemies grant increased fire rate to the remaining hits. This effect stacks up to a cap.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage More Cold Damage And Crit Chance
nodes.description: Ice Barrage deals more cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has more critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Piercing Chance
nodes.description: Each ice shard cast by Ice Barrage has a chance to pierce all enemies (continue through enemies hit).

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Frostbite On Pierce
nodes.description: Ice Shards that pierce enemies have a chance to inflict them with {Frostbite}.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Larger Slower Meaner Frostbolts
nodes.description:
Ice Barrage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and its ice shards become larger.

Ice Barrage has a slower fire rate, and there is a longer delay between each shard being created and released.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Frostbolt Cone
nodes.description: Ice Barrage now fires 5 ice shards in a cone in front of you, but has a slower fire rate and costs more mana.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Wider Cone
nodes.description: Ice Barrage releases ice shards in a wider cone.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Shatter On Hit
nodes.description: Ice Shards cast by Ice Barrage shatter and deal cold damage in a cone behind the target. This does not work on piercing projectiles.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Crit Chance Against Frozen Targets
nodes.description: Ice Barrage has more critical strike chance against frozen targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Ice Barrage More Damage To Frozen Targets
nodes.description: Ice Barrage hits deal more damage to frozen targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Ice Barrage More Ice Burst Damage And Freeze Rate
nodes.description: Ice shards released via {Ice Burst} have a higher chance to freeze enemies, and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Ice Barrage 5 Instant Projectiles
nodes.description: Ice Barrage instantly fires 5 ice shards in a cone.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Ice Shield
nodes.description:
When you cast Ice Barrage you now also summon an {Ice Shield} in the target direction, a shield that blocks projectiles. Ice Shield lasts 2 seconds.

Ice Barrage has a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Ice Explosion On Shield Death
nodes.description: When {Ice Shield} expires it explodes, freezing nearby enemies.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Increased Fire Rate And Silenced
nodes.description: Ice Barrage has significantly increased fire rate, but while it is active all skills have increased mana cost.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Chilling Aura
