nodes.description: Ice Barrage creates a {Chilling Aura} around you. The aura repeatedly applies chill to nearby enemies for a duration. This effect can apply multiple stacks of chill to the same enemy.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage More Damage But No Homing
nodes.description: Ice Barrage hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer seek nearby enemies.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage Only 3 Projectiles More Damage
nodes.description: Ice Barrage deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a shorter cooldown, but now only lasts 1 second and fires 3 projectiles.

nodes.name: Death Seal Root Node
nodes.description:
Combo skill. Seals your health at your current amount of health, draining your ward to 0 and preventing you from gaining health or ward for up to 5 seconds. For that duration you gain more damage equal to your percent missing health.

Reactivate to release a wave of death dealing damage based on how long the seal has been active, and percent missing health.

nodes.name: Death Seal Clear On Kill
nodes.description: When you kill an enemy while sealed, a percentage of all of your delayed damage is cleared.

nodes.name: Death Seal Wave Shred
nodes.description: The Wave of Death has a chance to shred necrotic resistance.

nodes.name: Death Seal Wandering Spirits Duration With Death Seal
nodes.description: If {Wandering Spirits} is active when you activate Death Seal it is granted additional duration.

nodes.name: Death Seal Clear On End
nodes.description: When Death Seal ends, a percentage of all of your delayed damage is cleared.

nodes.name: Death Seal Wave Of Death On Reap Or Evade
nodes.description:
You release a Wave of Death when you cast {Reap} or {Evade}.

Death Seal must be on your action bar for this effect to work.

nodes.name: Death Seal Armor And Protections Per 10 Missing Health
nodes.description: For the duration of Death Seal, you gain armor and stun avoidance for each 10 health you were missing when Death Seal was activated.

nodes.name: Death Seal Automatic End On 10 Percent Health
nodes.description: If you drop below 10% health while you are sealed, Death Seal is released automatically.

nodes.name: Death Seal Less Poison Damage Taken
nodes.description: While sealed, you take less poison damage per 10% missing health, up to 50% missing health.

nodes.name: Death Seal Wave More Damage To Poisoned Targets
nodes.description: Wave of Death hits deal more damage against poisoned targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Death Seal Wave More Damage Per Poison Stack On Target
nodes.description: Wave of Death hits deal more damage per stack of poison up to a maximum (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Death Seal Wave Increased Area
nodes.description: The Wave of Death has increased area of effect and additional critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Death Seal Wave Increased Damage
nodes.description: Wave of Death deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Death Seal Wave Leech Based On Active Duration
nodes.description: Wave of Death hits now leech a portion of the damage they deal as health.

nodes.name: Death Seal Bone Armor On Seal End
nodes.description: When you release Death Seal, you are granted {Bone Armor}, which grants less damage taken for the duration that Death Seal was active.

nodes.name: Death Seal Culling
nodes.description: Death Seal's waves of death instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold.

nodes.name: Death Seal Minion Hit By Wave More Deal Damage
nodes.description: Minions hit by a Wave of Death deal more damage for 4 seconds (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Death Seal Haste On End
nodes.description: When you release Death Seal, you are granted {Haste} for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Death Seal No Wave Heal Based On Duration
nodes.description: When you release Death Seal, you recover a percentage of your missing health.

nodes.name: Death Seal Damned On Self Increased Wave Damage
nodes.description:
You gain a stack of {Damned} for each second you remain sealed. Waves of Death hits now deal more damage per stack of Damned on you (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to a maximum benefit. 

You are cleansed of all Damned stacks when you release Death Seal.

nodes.name: Death Seal Duration
nodes.description: Death Seal's maximum duration is increased.

nodes.name: Death Seal Minion Increased Damage And Crit Chance
nodes.description: When used on a minion, Death Seal also grants it more damage and critical strike chance (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Death Seal Hungering Souls Frequency
nodes.description:
You release {Hungering Souls} more frequently.

Additionally, whenever you cast Reap or Evade, you gain this effect for a percentage of Death Seal's maximum duration. Death Seal must be on your action bar for this effect to occur.

nodes.name: Death Seal No Health Drain
nodes.description: Death Seal prevents health loss from effects that continously drain a percentage of your current health.

nodes.name: Death Seal Wave Of Death Every Second
nodes.description: You release a Wave of Death each second while sealed and upon activation, in addition to when you release Death Seal, but your waves of death deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Death Seal Above To Below 33 Percent Health
nodes.description: If your health is above 33% of your maximum when you activate Death Seal, it is reduced to 33% of your maximum health.

nodes.name: Death Seal Wave Physical Conversion
nodes.description:
Wave of Death's base damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

All of its effects related to necrotic resistance and necrotic resistance shred are converted to physical resistance and physical resistance shred.

nodes.name: Death Seal Targets Minions
nodes.description: Death Seal now targets only minions.

nodes.name: Death Seal Minion Root And Wave On Death
nodes.description: Minions targeted by Death Seal are rooted in place for its duration. When Death Seal is released, the minion explodes in addition to releasing the wave of death at its location.

nodes.name: Death Seal Hungering Souls But Only One Soul
nodes.description: You now repeatedly cast {Hungering Souls} while you are sealed. Hungering Souls cast this way has a 70% chance to have only 1 projectile.

nodes.name: Death Seal Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
The Wave of Death's base damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

All of its effects related to necrotic resistance and necrotic resistance shred are converted to cold resistance and cold resistance shred.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Root Node
nodes.description: Apply a curse to enemies in an area that causes spell physical damage when hit.

nodes.name: Bone Curse More Damage
nodes.description: Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Bone Curse Culling
nodes.description:
Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Enemies Explode On Death
nodes.description: Enemies afflicted with Bone Curse have a chance to explode on death, dealing damage to nearby enemies, but Bone Curse costs more mana.

nodes.name: Bone Curse More Damage But Falls Off After Hits
nodes.description: Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but falls off after a few hits.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Armor Shred
nodes.description: Bone Curse has a chance to reduce enemy armor.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Bone Armor On Kill
nodes.description: If you kill an enemy affected by Bone Curse you have a chance to gain {Bone Armor} for 4 seconds, which grants less damage taken (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Bone Curse Heal On Bone Armor
nodes.description:
When {Marrow Thief} triggers you are also healed. 

The healing scales with healing effectiveness.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Bleed Chance
nodes.description: Bone Curse has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Cursed Ground
nodes.description: When you cast Bone Curse, it now also leaves behind {Cursed Ground} for a short duration. Enemies that walk into the Cursed Ground are afflicted with Bone Curse.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Increased Area
nodes.description: Bone Curse affects a larger area.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Reduced Duration Prison Gaps
nodes.description: Bone Curse has a significantly shorter cooldown, but {Bone Prison} now has gaps.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Prison Health
nodes.description: Your {Bone Prison} takes less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Bone Curse Mark Duration
nodes.description: {Mark for Death} lasts longer.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Single Target Endless
nodes.description:
Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but now only affects a single target. Bone Curse and Mark for Death have unlimited duration.

This is not compatible with the {Signet of Agony} node.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Slow On Cast
nodes.description: Bone Curse slows enemies within its area of effect

nodes.name: Bone Curse Mana Efficiency Cast Speed
nodes.description: Bone Curse costs less mana and has increased cast speed.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Chill Chance
nodes.description: Bone Curse has a chance to apply chill when the enemy is hit.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Freeze Rate
nodes.description: Adds a freeze rate to Bone Curse, granting it a chance to freeze enemies.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Cast On Minion
nodes.description:
You may cast Bone Curse on your minions, which grants them more physical damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but also applies Bone Curse's negative effects. 

This effect lasts 4 seconds and does not stack.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Reflect On Minions
nodes.description:
Casting Bone Curse on minions causes them to reflect a flat amount damage to attackers. 

This effect lasts 4 seconds and does not stack.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Buffs On Bone Golem Increased Effect
nodes.description: All minion buffs from Bone Curse have 200% increased effect on Bone Golems.

nodes.name: Bone Curse More Damage Less Duration
nodes.description: Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but lingers for a shorter duration on enemies if not reapplied. The duration reduction only applies to Bone Curse applied by the aura.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Vanguard On Kill
nodes.description: Killing an enemy with Bone Curse has a chance to summon a Skeleton Vanguard, a minion that deals melee physical damage using a spear. You are limited to 3 Skeleton Vanguards by default.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Bone Erruption
nodes.description: Shortly after casting Bone Curse, it causes a {Bone Eruption} beneath the target area, causing enemies to take spell physical damage, but Bone Curse Costs more mana.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Aura But Reduced Area
nodes.description:
Bone Curse becomes a toggled aura which surrounds you, but it has reduced area and drains your mana over time. You are also inflicted with Bone Curse.

This is not compatible with the {Oppressive Gaze} and {Illusion of Pain} nodes.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Even More Damage But 1 Hit Fall Off
nodes.description:
Bone Curse falls off after only 1 hit, but it always crits and deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). Bone Curse now has a cooldown.

This is not compatible with the {Signet of Agony} node.
The duration of {Cursed Limbs} and {Cursed Ground} are significantly reduced.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Rip Blood On End
nodes.description: When Bone Curse times out, you cast {Rip Blood} on that enemy, a spell dealing physical damage. This effect can occur a limited number of times per second.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Bone Prison
nodes.description:
When you directly cast Bone Curse you summon a {Bone Prison} around the target area, trapping enemies inside. Bone Prison lasts a long time, but can be attacked and destroyed.

Bone Curse has a significantly longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Mark For Death
nodes.description:
Bone Curse applies {Mark for Death} for 2 seconds, but costs more mana.

This effect overwrites {Mark for Death's} normal duration.

nodes.name: Bone Curse Necrotic Conversion
nodes.description: Bone Curse's base physical damage is converted to necrotic. Consequently this damage scales with increases to necrotic damage, but not increases to physical damage.

nodes.name: Bone Curse On Hit After Cast
nodes.description:
After directly casting Bone Curse, you also cast Bone Curse on hit for the next few seconds, but Bone Curse costs more mana.
This cast on hit effect can't occur more than once per second.

nodes.name: Shift Root Node
nodes.description: Teleport a short fixed distance in the target direction.

nodes.name: Shift Heals
nodes.description: Shifting heals you. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

nodes.name: Shift Increased Distance And Cooldown
nodes.description: You travel farther with Shift, but it has a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Shift Dodge Per Dexterity
nodes.description: You have additional dodge chance per point of Dexterity for 1 second after Shifting.

nodes.name: Shift Heal From Dexterity
nodes.description: Shifting heals you for a portion equal to your Dexterity. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

nodes.name: Shift Reset Cooldown
nodes.description: If a single hit deals at least 50% of your health, Shift's cooldown is reset. This can only occur once every 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Shift Damage On Next Attack
nodes.description: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with your next damaging non-channelled skill after Shifting.

nodes.name: Shift Movement Speed
nodes.description: You gain 50% increased movement speed for a brief moment after Shifting.

nodes.name: Shift Bleed Chance On Next Attack
nodes.description: You have a chance to cause bleeding with your next damaging non-channelled skill after Shifting.

nodes.name: Shift Bleed Effect And Duration On Next Attack
nodes.description: After Shifting your next damaging non-channelled skill has increased bleed duration and bleed it inflicts has additional Physical Penetration.

nodes.name: Shift Mana On Use
nodes.description: Shift restores mana on use. This amount is tripled when below half health.

nodes.name: Shift Health Potion On Use
nodes.description: Shift consumes a health potion on use if you are below 50% health.

nodes.name: Shift Always Crit On Next Attack
nodes.description: The next damaging non-channelled skill you use after Shifting is always a critical strike.

nodes.name: Shift Damage Along Dash With Melee
nodes.description: If using a melee weapon, when Shifting you perform an {Unseen Strike}, hitting enemies along your path.

nodes.name: Shift Shuriken Throw
nodes.description: You throw {Shurikens} at nearby enemies after Shifting.

nodes.name: Shift Wider Damaging Dash
nodes.description: {Unseen Strike} hits in a wider area.

nodes.name: Shift Return To Shadow Location
nodes.description: When the {Shadow} created by Shift is consumed, you return to its location.

nodes.name: Shift Acid Flask On Arrival
nodes.description: You have a chance to drop an {Acid Flask} on arrival.

nodes.name: Shift Acid Flask On Departure
nodes.description: You have a chance to drop an {Acid Flask} on departure.

nodes.name: Shift Cooldown Recovery And Mana
nodes.description: Shift has a shorter cooldown and costs less mana.

nodes.name: Shift Shadow Dagger
nodes.description: {Unseen Strike} has a chance to inflict {Shadow Dagger} to enemies hit.

nodes.name: Shift Slows
nodes.description: {Unseen Strike} slows enemies it hits.

nodes.name: Shift Culls
nodes.description:
{Unseen Strike} instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

nodes.name: Shift Less Distance
nodes.description: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with your next damaging non-channelled skill after Shifting, but travel a shorter distance with Shift.

nodes.name: Shift Jade Arrow Keynode
nodes.description:
Using Shift grants you {Jade Arrows.} 

Using a bow attack consumes a {Jade Arrow} to have increased critical strike chance and a chance to poison enemies.

nodes.name: Shift Jade Arrow Crit Multi
nodes.description: Consuming a {Jade Arrow} also causes your next bow attack's critical strikes to deal more damage.

nodes.name: Shift Jade Arrow DoT
nodes.description: Consuming a {Jade Arrow} also grants your next bow attack increased damage over time.

nodes.name: Shift Ailment Cleansing
nodes.description: Shifting cleanses all negative ailments on you.

nodes.name: Shift Invulnerability While Shifting
nodes.description: You are invulnerable while Shifting.

nodes.name: Shift Leave Behind Shadow
nodes.description: You leave behind a {Shadow} at the place you Shifted from.

nodes.name: Shift Shadow Cascade After Shifting
nodes.description: After using Shift you use {Shadow Cascade}.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Root Node
nodes.description: Hold ability key to channel to increase the area. When you release, combine all of your minions in the area into a single hulking abomination with states based on which minions are consumed.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Stats From Skeletons
nodes.description:
For each {Skeleton Warrior} absorbed, your abomination deals more melee damage and has more health (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

For each {Skeleton Rogue} absorbed, your abomination has increased attack speed.

For each {Skeleton Archer} absorbed, your abomination has increased area of effect.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Crit Chance And Movement Speed
nodes.description:
Your abomination has additional critical strike chance.

For each {Skeleton Rogue} absorbed, your abomination has increased movement speed.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Crit Chance
nodes.description: Your abomination has increased critical strike chance, but can no longer regenerate health or absorb {Bone Golems}.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination More Melee Damage
nodes.description: Your abomination's melee hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but can no longer absorb {Skeletal Mages}.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination More Health And Threat
nodes.description: Your abomination has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and generates more threat, which increases the likelihood of enemies targeting it.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Reflect And Vanguards
nodes.description: Your abomination reflects a percentage of damage to attackers, and disassembles into a number of {Skeletal Vanguards} on death.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination More Damage
nodes.description: Your abomination deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination More Damage Reduced Speed
nodes.description: Your abomination deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has reduced attack speed.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Health Leech
nodes.description: Your abomination's hits leech a portion of the damage they deal as health.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Increased Melee AoE
nodes.description: Your abomination's melee attacks deal damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Stacking Speed On Kill
nodes.description: Your abomination gains increased attack speed when it kills an enemy. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 5 seconds.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Health And Devour
nodes.description: Your abomination has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and restores a larger percentage of its maximum health when devouring other minions.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Max Health On Devour
nodes.description: Your abomination gains more max health (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 8 seconds each time it devours a minion, up to a limited number of times per 8 seconds.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Nova Frequency And Damage
nodes.description:
{Eternal Arrow} has a reduced cooldown.

For each {Skeleton Archer} absorbed, Eternal Arrow has additional Recurve chance.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination More Damage Per Type Consumed
nodes.description: Your abomination has more health and deals more damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers) for each type of minion absorbed to create it among {Summoned Skeleton}, {Skeletal Mage}, {Wraith}, and {Bone Golem}.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Voltron Attack Cast Speed
nodes.description: If the abomination was made by absorbing at least 1 of every type of minion mentioned by {Engorgement}, it gains more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), increased attack speed, and increased and movement speed.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination More Devouring Souls Per Mage Consumed
nodes.description:
{Devouring Souls} has a reduced cooldown.

Devouring Souls deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each {Skeletal Mage} absorbed.

Devouring Souls releases an additional soul for each Skeletal Mage absorbed.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Cooldown Recovery And Ability Damage
nodes.description: Your abomination has increased cooldown recovery speed for its abilities, and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with abilities that have cooldowns.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Stomp Upgrade
nodes.description:
{Stomp} has a reduced cooldown.

For each {Bone Golem} absorbed, Stomp deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased area of effect.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Warrior Attack
nodes.description:
If a {Skeleton Warrior} or {Skeleton Rogue} is absorbed, your abomination is granted the ability to {Double Strike} with a 6 second cooldown, dealing significant melee damage.

Double Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per Skeleton Warrior or Rogue consumed.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Consume Mage Devouring Souls
nodes.description: If a {Skeletal Mage} is absorbed, your abomination can cast {Devouring Souls}, a spell that releases multiple necrotic projectiles.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Cooldown Recovery With Health Sacrifice
nodes.description: Your abomination has increased cooldown recovery speed for its abilities, but takes damage equal to a percentage of its maximum health each time it uses an ability with a cooldown.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Consume Wraith Soul Reave
nodes.description:
If a {Wraith} is absorbed, its melee attack is replaced with {Soul Reave}, which deals melee necrotic damage.

Soul Reave has 200% damage effectiveness compared to the basic melee attack's 150%, and Soul Reave has 15% more radius compared to the basic melee attack.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Consume Golem Stomp
nodes.description: If a {Bone Golem} is absorbed, your abomination uses {Stomp}, a melee attack that deals physical damage and has a high chance to stun enemies in a large area.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Consume Archer Nova
nodes.description:
If a {Skeletal Archer} is absorbed, your abomination casts {Eternal Arrow} every 4 seconds, a bow ability that deals physical damage and has 100% chance to Recurve.

Your abomination gains additional bow damage per point of your Intelligence.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Consume Zombie Explosive Attack
nodes.description: If a {Volatile Zombie} is absorbed, your abomination gains an explosive {Tail Slam} ability.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination No Skeletons Buff Nearby Minions
nodes.description:
Your abomination can no longer absorb {Summoned Skeletons}.

Minions within 12 meters of your abomination gain increased attack speed.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Poison Aura
nodes.description:
Your abomination casts {Aura of Rot}, poisoning itself and nearby enemies every second.

For each {Skeleton Rogue} absorbed, your abomination gains additional chance to inflict poison on hit.

Effects such as this which apply per skeleton absorbed can only consider up to 20 skeletons in total.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Dont Devour Zombies
nodes.description: Your abomination will not devour {Volatile Zombies}, even if they were absorbed to create it.

nodes.name: Assemble Abomination Sacrifice Instead Of Devour
nodes.description: When your abomination would devour a minion, it will instead be {Sacrificed}, consuming a percentage of Sacrifice's mana cost. This Sacrifice is cast by you and uses your Sacrifice tree.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Root Node
nodes.description: Target minion takes 3% max health per second for each second the shade has been active, but it and minions around it deal 25% more damage. Each minion only benefits from one Dread Shade aura. Expires after 20 seconds. Max 4 active shades.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Dread Shade costs less mana and has increased cast speed.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Armor Protections Faster Decay
nodes.description: Dread Shade now grants minions armor based on your vitality, but Dread Shade decays your minions faster.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Additional Shades
nodes.description: You can control one additional Dread Shade or Infernal Shade at once.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Minion Frenzy
nodes.description: Dread Shade now grants frenzy to affected minions for a fixed duration after being cast.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Minion Haste But Ignites
nodes.description: Dread Shade now grants the targeted minion {Haste} while it persists, but it also applies a stack of ignite to the targeted minion each second.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Slower Decay
nodes.description: Dread Shade drains your minions' health more slowly and all affected minions deal additional necrotic damage with spells and attacks.

nodes.name: Dread Shade No Decay But Poisons
nodes.description: Dread Shade no longer decays your minions' health, but instead inflicts a stack of {Everlasting Poison} each second.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Minion Chance To Crit And Be Crit
nodes.description: The minion targeted by Dread Shade has additional critical strike chance and critical strike multiplier, but also has additional chance to be critically hit.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Attack And Cast Speed
nodes.description: Dread Shade grants affected minions increased attack and cast speed.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Damned Chance
nodes.description: Minions affected by Dread Shade have a chance to inflict {Damned} to enemies they hit.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Area
nodes.description: Dread Shade affects minions in a larger area.

nodes.name: Dread Shade More Damage Faster Decay Increased Area
nodes.description: Dread Shade affects minions in a larger area and grants more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but the targeted minion's health decays more quickly.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Mark For Death On All On Expiration
nodes.description:
Dread Shade applies {Mark for Death} to nearby enemies and minions when it expires.

Mark for Death is a curse that reduces all resistances by 25%. It cannot stack.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Sacrifice On Death No Chain
nodes.description: When any of your minions targeted by Dread Shade dies, it casts {Sacrifice} on additional minions, with each cast consuming mana equal to Sacrifice's mana cost.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Cast On Enemy No Drain Limited Duration
nodes.description:
Dread Shade now attaches to enemies instead, still buffing your minions, but Dread Shade now has a duration, and this duration cannot be increased.

This does not buff or drain the health of enemies.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Affect You And Allies
nodes.description: You are affected by the beneficial buffs of Dread Shade's aura.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Doom Brand
nodes.description: Dread Shade now drains the health of other minions, and marks them with {Doom Brand}. When they die, the brand explodes dealing necrotic spell damage to surrounding enemies.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Doom Brand Effect
nodes.description: {Doom Brand} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Dread Shade Buff Effect Per Missing Minion Health
nodes.description: Dread Shade grants increased effect of all its buffs for each 3% of missing health on the targeted minion.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Spirit Plague On Expiration
nodes.description: Dread Shade applies {Spirit Plague} to a nearby enemy whenever it expires.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Infernal Shade Duration Refresh
nodes.description: Casting Dread Shade refreshes the duration of your {Infernal Shades.} Each Infernal Shade can only be refreshed a maximum number of times.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Increased Area Per Minion
nodes.description: Dread Shade has increased area of effect per active minion when cast, up to a maximum benefit.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Taunts But Rooted
nodes.description: Dread Shade now roots the targeted minion and causes it to taunt enemies around it.

nodes.name: Dread Shade No Aura Buff More Damage
nodes.description: Dread Shade grants the targeted minion significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Dread Shade no longer buffs other minions.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Damned In Area To All
nodes.description: Dread Shade now inflicts {Damned} each second to all enemies and friendly minions in its area.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Attack And Cast Speed But Blinds
nodes.description: Dread Shade now increases the attack and cast speed of the targeted minion, but they have less critical strike chance (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Dread Shade Volatile Zombie On Death
nodes.description: When a minion targeted by a Dread Shade dies, you have a chance to summon a single {Volatile Zombie} from its corpse.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Single Shade
nodes.description: Dread Shade no longer drains the health of the minion it is attached to, but you are limited to one active Dread Shade. Increases to health drain from this tree instead increase damage taken by the minion.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Poison Conversion
nodes.description: Dread Shade now increases poison damage instead of necrotic damage, and converts added necrotic damage from the base skill and this tree to chance to poison on hit.

nodes.name: Dread Shade Damage Over Time
nodes.description: Dread Shade grants affected minions more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Root Node
nodes.description: Target enemy and all nearby enemies take fire damage per second . Each enemy can only have one Infernal Shade attached at a time. Expires after 5 seconds. Max 4 active shades.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Increased Mana Efficiency and Cast Speed
nodes.description: Infernal Shade costs less mana and has increased cast speed.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Giant Shade Increased Damage
nodes.description: {Blaze Shade} deals more damage, but has a shorter duration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Increased AoE Damage and Mana Cost
nodes.description: Infernal Shade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Increased Damage While Waiting
nodes.description: Infernal Shade gains 15% fire penetration each second that it is unattached to a target.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade More Damage and Reduced Duration
nodes.description: Infernal Shade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has reduced duration.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Explosion Increased Damage
nodes.description: The explosion which occurs when the Infernal Shade expires deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and affects a larger area.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Explosion Crit Chance
nodes.description: Infernal Shade has reduced duration and the explosion which occurs when the Infernal Shade expires has added critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade More Damage and Reduced Area
nodes.description: Infernal Shade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Increased Duration
nodes.description: Infernal Shade has increased duration.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Slow Chance
nodes.description: Infernal Shade has a chance to slow nearby enemies each second.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed
nodes.description: Infernal Shade has a shorter cooldown.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Additional Shades
nodes.description: You can cast an additional Infernal Shade or Dread Shade.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Increased AoE
nodes.description: Infernal Shade deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Minion Haste
nodes.description: Your minions gain {Haste} while they have an Infernal Shade attached to them.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Increased Damage Per Second
nodes.description: Infernal Shade deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second it has been active, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Unlimited Duration On Minions
nodes.description: Infernal Shades which attach to minions have unlimited increased duration.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Scaling Minion Stats
nodes.description: Minions which have an Infernal Shade attached to them gain increased movement, attack and cast speed each second up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Ignite Chance
nodes.description: Infernal Shade has a chance to ignite nearby enemies each second.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Ignite Effect
nodes.description: Ignited inflicted by Infernal Shade has additional Fire Penetration

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Armor Shred Chance
nodes.description: Infernal Shade has a chance to shred the armor of nearby enemies each second.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Giant Shade Chance
nodes.description: You have a chance to create a {Blaze Shade} which deals more damage in a significantly larger area (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Ground Targetable With Reattach
nodes.description: If no target is within range of your target location the shade will wait up to 10 seconds for a target to come within range and then attach to it.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Added Shades
nodes.description:
When directly casting Infernal Shade you will create extra shades if there are nearby enemies.

Infernal Shade costs more mana to cast.

Has no effect if you have taken the Hellfire node.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Explode At End
nodes.description: When Infernal Shade expires there is a large explosion which deals fire damage to nearby enemies.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Ground Targetable Without Reattach
nodes.description:
Infernal Shade is now ground targeted and cannot attach to any targets.

Infernal Shade applies a stack of Fire Resistance Shred each second but now has a cooldown.

Prevents additional Shades from the Legion node being created.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Chance to Reattach
nodes.description: When Infernal Shade's target dies it has a chance to move to a new target.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Minion Targetable
nodes.description: Infernal Shade can now only attach to your minions, but your minions are also damaged by Infernal Shade.

nodes.name: Infernal Shade Physical Conversion
nodes.description:
Infernal Shade's base fire damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to fire damage.

All ignite chance from this tree is converted to bleed chance and effects related to ignite now depend on bleed instead.

nodes.name: Flurry Root Node
nodes.description: A bow or melee skill that performs 3 rapid attacks.

nodes.name: Flurry Increased Attack Speed
nodes.description: Flurry has increased attack speed.

nodes.name: Flurry Attack Speed Per Hit
nodes.description: You have increased attack speed for each hit you dealt with your previous flurry, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Flurry More Damage
nodes.description: Flurry deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifers).

nodes.name: Flurry Leech
nodes.description: Flurry leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health.

nodes.name: Flurry Adrenaline Rush Bleed Chance
nodes.description: Each stack of {Adrenaline Rush} grants a chance to inflict bleed on hit.

nodes.name: Flurry Adrenaline Rush Damage vs Bosses
nodes.description: Each stack of {Adrenaline Rush} grants Flurry more hit damage against bosses and rare enemies.

nodes.name: Flurry Adrenaline Rush Increased Duration
nodes.description: {Adrenaline Rush} lasts longer.

nodes.name: Flurry Adrenaline Rush Max Stacks
nodes.description: {Adrenaline Rush} can have multiple stacks.

nodes.name: Flurry More Damage From Longer Channel
nodes.description: Flurry deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second channelled up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Flurry Channel Resistances
nodes.description: You have additional physical and elemental resistances while channelling Flurry.

nodes.name: Flurry Channel Inaccuracy
nodes.description: If you are using a bow you fire arrows faster, but they are less accurate.

nodes.name: Flurry Poison Bleed And Shred
nodes.description:
Flurry's first strike has a chance to inflict poison.
Flurry's second strike has a chance to cause bleed.
Flurry's third strike has a chance to shred physical and poison resistance.

nodes.name: Flurry Bleed Effectiveness
nodes.description: Bleed inflicted by Flurry has additional Physical Penetration.

nodes.name: Flurry More Poison Damage
nodes.description: Poison inflicted by Flurry has additional Poison Penetration.

nodes.name: Flurry Waves Range
nodes.description: The {Force Waves} travel further.

nodes.name: Flurry Added Crit Chance
nodes.description: Improves Flurry's base critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Flurry Increased Crit Multiplier
nodes.description: Flurry critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Flurry Heal On Crit
nodes.description: Critical strikes restore health. The amount of health gained is increased by Dexterity.

nodes.name: Flurry Health Gain On Hit
nodes.description: Flurry grants health when hitting at least one enemy.

nodes.name: Flurry Mana Gain On Hit
nodes.description: Flurry grants mana when hitting at least one enemy.

nodes.name: Flurry Slow On 3 Hits
nodes.description: Flurry's third strike Slows enemies hit.

nodes.name: Flurry More Damage Third Hit
nodes.description: Flurry's first and second strike deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but the third strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Flurry More Damage Over Time
nodes.description: Damaging ailments inflicted by Flurry deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Flurry Channelled
nodes.description: Flurry is now a channelled ability that costs mana per second to maintain.

nodes.name: Flurry Multishot
nodes.description: If you are using a bow, every 6th arrow is replaced with {Multishot}.

nodes.name: Flurry Chance To Gain Adrenaline Rush
nodes.description: Flurry strikes have a chance to grant you {Adrenaline Rush}, granting Flurry 5% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and 5% increased attack speed. This lasts for 4 seconds, can stack up to 4 times.

nodes.name: Flurry Force Wave
nodes.description: If you are using a melee weapon Flurry now causes {Force Waves} to blast forward with each strike, dealing melee physical damage.

nodes.name: Flurry Kinetic Burst On Death
nodes.description: Enemies killed by Flurry have a chance to release a {Kinetic Burst} around the target, dealing physical damage.

nodes.name: Firebrand Root Node
nodes.description: A melee attack which grants you a stack of firebrand buff if it hits an enemy. Firebrand buff increases the size of subsequent firebrand attacks and adds melee fire damage.

nodes.name: Firebrand More Damage
nodes.description: Firebrand deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Firebrand More Melee Damage Per Stack
nodes.description: Firebrand deals more melee damage per stack of Firebrand (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Firebrand Shatter Strike Frostbite Chance
nodes.description: Using {Shatter Strike} consumes stacks of Firebrand to gain frostbite chance per stack consumed.

nodes.name: Firebrand Increased Crit Chance Per Stack
nodes.description: Firebrand has increased melee critical strike chance per stack of Firebrand.

nodes.name: Firebrand Added Melee Crit Multi Per Stack
nodes.description: Firebrand has additional melee critical strike multiplier per stack of Firebrand.

nodes.name: Firebrand Crit Consume
nodes.description: Consuming stacks of Firebrand with {Incineration} grants bonus critical strike chance and critical strike multiplier per stack.

nodes.name: Firebrand Added Max Stacks
nodes.description: Firebrand can have more maximum stacks.

nodes.name: Firebrand Added Elemental Prot Per Stack
nodes.description: Firebrand grants additional armor and fire resistance per stack of Firebrand.

nodes.name: Firebrand Lightning Blast Chains
nodes.description: While you have at least 1 stack of Firebrand, your next cast of {Lightning Blast} will consume all stacks to chain additional times per stack consumed.

nodes.name: Firebrand Static Stacks On Hit
nodes.description: Gain stacks of {Static} if Firebrand hits at least one enemy.

nodes.name: Firebrand Ward If Hit
nodes.description: You gain ward when Firebrand hits at least one enemy.

nodes.name: Firebrand Ward Gain Per Stack
nodes.description: You gain ward per second per stack of Firebrand.

nodes.name: Firebrand Increased Duration
nodes.description: Stacks of Firebrand last longer.

nodes.name: Firebrand Stacks All Refresh
nodes.description: You refresh the duration of all stacks of Firebrand when gaining a new stack.

nodes.name: Firebrand Increased Attack Speed Per Stack
nodes.description: Firebrand attacks faster per stack of Firebrand, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Firebrand Added Spell Crit Multi Per Stack
nodes.description: Firebrand grants global spell critical strike multiplier per stack of Firebrand.

nodes.name: Firebrand Flame Wave If Hit
nodes.description: If Firebrand hits at least one enemy, it consumes mana to cast {Flame Wave}, a spell that deals fire damage in a line.

nodes.name: Firebrand Added Ignite Chance
nodes.description: Firebrand has a chance to ignite enemies.

nodes.name: Firebrand Spreading Flames
nodes.description:
Firebrand has a chance to inflict {Spreading Flames} when hitting an ignited enemy.

Stacks of Firebrand also grant more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) against enemies afflicted by Spreading Flames.

nodes.name: Firebrand Added Ignite Chance Per Stack
nodes.description: Each stack of Firebrand grants you global Ignite Chance.

nodes.name: Firebrand Flame Reave Ignite Chance
nodes.description: Using {Flame Reave} consumes stacks of Firebrand to gain ignite chance per stack consumed.

nodes.name: Firebrand Added Stacks Per Attack
nodes.description: You gain an additional stack of Firebrand when attacking, but Firebrand costs more mana.

nodes.name: Firebrand Ward Gain Per Stack Expired
nodes.description: You gain ward when a stack of Firebrand expires or is consumed.

nodes.name: Firebrand Triple Strike
nodes.description: Firebrand now shoots three lines instead of one in a cone in front of you, but costs more mana.

nodes.name: Firebrand Melee Consume
nodes.description: Your next melee attack, that is not Firebrand, consumes all stacks of Firebrand and deals more damage per stack consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Firebrand Lightning Conversion
nodes.description:
Firebrands's base fire damage and added melee fire damage from stacks is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

All ignite chance from this tree is converted to shock chance and effects related to ignite now depend on shock instead.

Swaps Firebrand's {Fire} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

nodes.name: Firebrand No Attack Speed Scaling
nodes.description: Firebrand can have more maximum stacks and deals more damage per stack, but it has less attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Firebrand Adaptive Spell Damage Per Stack
nodes.description: Stacks of Firebrand now also grant added spell fire damage.

nodes.name: Firebrand Fire Aura Chance
nodes.description: Directly using Firebrand has a chance to grant a stack of {Fire Aura} based on your current Firebrand stacks. This effect can trigger a limited number of times per second.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Root Node
nodes.description:
A melee directional attack that stuns enemies for 1 second. 100% increased stun chance against non-boss enemies.

1% more damage per 1% block chance (up to 100%, multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Shield Bash Increased Stun Duration
nodes.description: Stuns caused by Shield Bash last longer.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Health Gained On Stun
nodes.description: You are granted health when you stun an enemy with Shield Bash.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Shield Fragments
nodes.description:
If Shield Bash is used while you have a shield equipped, it fires shield fragments in a cone in front of you.

While Shield Bash is on cooldown you cannot block.

Only works if Shield Bash has a cooldown.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Health Gained On Stun Per Strength
nodes.description: You are granted health per point of Strength, when you stun an enemy with Shield Bash.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Increased Width
nodes.description: Shield Bash deals damage in a wider area.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Frailty
nodes.description: Shield Bash now applies {Frailty} to enemies hit.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Fire Damage
nodes.description:
Shield Bash deals additional melee fire damage.

If Shield Bash has a cooldown, it also deals more fire damage per block chance (multiplicative with other modifiers) up to 100%.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Fire Buff
nodes.description:
Shield Bash causes your next melee or throwing attack to have additional ignite chance and critical strike chance. Excludes channelled skills.

This effect is significantly reduced if Shield Bash does not have a cooldown.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Block Node
nodes.description: Shield Bash grant you additional block chance and block effectiveness for a short duration after use.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Lunge and Rush
nodes.description:
After you use Shield Rush or Lunge, you Shield Bash in the direction you traveled.

Shield Bash must have a cooldown, be charged and on your action bar for this effect to work.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Guaranteed Block
nodes.description:
For 4 seconds after using Shield Bash, you are guaranteed to block a limited number of hits.

Only works if Shield Bash has a cooldown.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Blind
nodes.description: Shield Bash now also blinds enemies hit.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Slow Chance
nodes.description: Shield Bash now also slows enemies.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Increased Length
nodes.description: Shield Bash deals damage in a longer area.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Potion Chance
nodes.description: Shield Bash will cause one enemy that was hit to drop a potion if Shield Bash has a cooldown.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Slow Duration
nodes.description: Slows caused by Shield Bash last longer.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Knockback
nodes.description: Shield Bash now also knocks enemies back, if Shield Bash has a cooldown.

nodes.name: Shield Bash All Charges
nodes.description: Using Shield Bash consumes all charges and deals significantly more damage per extra charge consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Shield Bash Added Physical
nodes.description: Shield Bash deals additional melee physical damage.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Armor Shred
nodes.description: Shield Bash reduces enemy armor and costs less mana.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Bleed
nodes.description: Shield Bash causes enemies to bleed, but costs more mana.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Increased Physical Per Strength
nodes.description: Shield Bash deals more physical damage per point of Strength (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Shield Bash More Damage
nodes.description: Shield Bash deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Shield Bash Stun Chance
nodes.description: Shield Bash has an increased chance to stun and stuns it inflicts last longer.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Ring of Shield Wall
nodes.description: If Shield Bash is used while Ring of Shields is active, the shields form a wall which increases the width of Shield Bash, based on the number of active shields.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Fire Conversion
nodes.description:
Shield Bash no longer has a guaranteed stun, but instead applies additional stacks of ignite. All stun duration modifiers from this tree are converted to affect ignite duration instead.

Shield Bash's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage. 

Swaps Shield Bash's {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Shield Throw Ricochet
nodes.description: Your next {Shield Throw} can ricochet 5 additional times, after using Shield Bash.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Charges and Cooldown
nodes.description: You gain an additional charge of Shield Bash, but it has a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Shield Bash No Shield
nodes.description: Shield Bash no longer requires a shield to use, but costs more mana.

nodes.name: Shield Bash No Cooldown
nodes.description: Shield Bash no longer has a cooldown, but costs significantly more mana and no longer has a guaranteed stun or ignite.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Damage Per Block Effectiveness
nodes.description: Shield Bash has added melee damage based on your block effectiveness.

nodes.name: Shield Bash Attack Speed
nodes.description: Shield Bash has increased attack speed scaling with your uncapped block chance.

nodes.name: Puncture Root Node
nodes.description: An extended melee stab or piercing bow attack that causes enemies to bleed.

nodes.name: Puncture Bleed Chance
nodes.description: Puncture has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

nodes.name: Puncture More Damage Less Speed
nodes.description: Puncture deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Puncture Phys Shred
nodes.description: Puncture has a chance to shred enemy physical resistance.

nodes.name: Puncture More Damage Per Second
nodes.description: Puncture deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second charged.

nodes.name: Puncture Frenzy On Hit
nodes.description: Attacking with Puncture and hitting at least one enemy grants {Frenzy} for a short duration.

nodes.name: Puncture Efficacious Toxin
nodes.description: Puncture has a chance to apply {Efficacious Toxin} on hit, causing them to take increased damage over time.

nodes.name: Puncture Poison Chance
nodes.description: Puncture has a chance to poison on hit.

nodes.name: Puncture Side Shadows
nodes.description:
Directly using Puncture causes several {Mirages} to briefly appear at either side of you, attacking in the same direction as you. These can potentially hit the same enemy.

Puncture deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has additional mana cost.

nodes.name: Puncture Bleeding Fury Bleed Chance
nodes.description: Directly using Puncture and hitting at least one enemy grants you {Bleeding Fury}, a buff that grants bleed chance and stacks up to 3 times. Each stack falls off after 3 seconds of not attacking.

nodes.name: Puncture Bleeding Fury Max Stacks
nodes.description: {Bleeding Fury} can have more maximum stacks.

nodes.name: Puncture Armor Shred And Effectiveness
nodes.description:
Puncture has a chance to shred enemy armor. 

Armor Shred applied by Puncture has increased effect.

nodes.name: Puncture Shadow Daggers
nodes.description:
Puncture has a chance to apply a {Shadow Dagger} on hit.

This chance is doubled when you directly use Puncture.

nodes.name: Puncture More Damage Per Slow
nodes.description: Puncture deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of slow on the target.

nodes.name: Puncture More Damage Against Slowed
nodes.description: Puncture deals more damage against slowed and {Immobilized} targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Puncture Melee Range
nodes.description: When used with a melee weapon Puncture has increased range.

nodes.name: Puncture Bow Damage
nodes.description: When used with a bow, Puncture deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per enemy pierced.

nodes.name: Puncture More Hit Damage Per Ailment
nodes.description: Puncture deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per unique negative ailment on the target.

nodes.name: Puncture Black Arrow Charge
nodes.description: If you use Puncture with a bow while you have a {Black Arrow}, Puncture charges 100% faster and blinds on hit.

nodes.name: Puncture Big Hit Consumes Bleed
nodes.description: Instead of applying bleed, the greater Puncture consumes all stacks of bleed on the target, causing them to deal damage immediately and restoring health per stack consumed.

nodes.name: Puncture Poison Converted To Bleed
nodes.description:
Converts poison chance from all sources to bleed chance.

This has no effect if you have {Scalebane}.

nodes.name: Puncture Every Third Bigger
nodes.description: Every third Puncture deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and if it is a melee attack it has increased area.

nodes.name: Puncture Charge Up
nodes.description:
Puncture can be charged up, causing Puncture with a melee weapon to deal damage in a larger area and causes Puncture with a bow to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second charged.

After 1 second it releases automatically.

nodes.name: Puncture Bleed Converted To Poison
nodes.description:
Converts bleed chance from all sources to poison chance.
Converts physical resistance shred from all sources to poison resistance shred. Poison applied by Puncture has increased duration.

nodes.name: Puncture Immobilize
nodes.description: Every 10 seconds, your next Puncture {Immobilizes} enemies on hit, causing them to be unable to move for 1 second.

nodes.name: Puncture Mana
nodes.description: Directly using Puncture and hitting at least one enemy restores mana. Puncture also has physical penetration based on your maximum mana.

nodes.name: Puncture Rapid Strikes
nodes.description: Every 4 seconds your first few direct uses of Puncture are rapid strikes, which have increased attack speed.

nodes.name: Decoy Root Node
nodes.description: Summon a decoy.

nodes.name: Decoy Explosion Damage And Area
nodes.description: Decoy's final explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and explodes in a larger area.

nodes.name: Decoy All Explosion Damage
nodes.description: All explosions from Decoy deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Decoy Detonate Mana Cost
nodes.description: Detonation costs less mana.

nodes.name: Decoy Freeze Rate
nodes.description: All explosions have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

nodes.name: Decoy Max Small Explosion
nodes.description: Decoy can cause additional small explosions.

nodes.name: Decoy Duration And Cooldown
nodes.description: Decoy lasts longer, but has a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Decoy Reflect Damage Taken
nodes.description: Decoy reflects a percentage of damage to attackers.

nodes.name: Decoy Dodge Rating
nodes.description: You have additional dodge chance while the decoy exists.

nodes.name: Decoy Crit Multi From Dodge
nodes.description: When the decoy expires, for the next 4 seconds you have additional critical strike multiplier equal to your dodge chance while the decoy was active.

nodes.name: Decoy Ignite Frequency
nodes.description: The Decoy has increased ignite frequency.

nodes.name: Decoy Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Decoy costs less mana.

nodes.name: Decoy Sonic Wave Haste
nodes.description: {Sonic Wave} grants {Haste} to you and your allies hit for a duration.

nodes.name: Decoy Sonic Wave Armor Shred
nodes.description: {Sonic Wave} inflicts additional stacks of armor shred, and armor shred it applies lasts longer.

nodes.name: Decoy Sonic Wave Fire Shred
nodes.description:
{Sonic Wave} inflicts fire resistance shred instead of armour shred.

If you have taken {Frostfire Powder} it instead inflicts cold resistance shred.

nodes.name: Decoy Reduced Duration
nodes.description: Decoy's final explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Decoy has a shorter duration.

nodes.name: Decoy Final Explosion Ignite
nodes.description: Decoy's final explosion ignites enemies.

nodes.name: Decoy Damage And Mana Cost
nodes.description: Decoy's final explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but costs more mana.

nodes.name: Decoy Combo Detonate
nodes.description:
Decoy becomes a combo ability. The first cast creates the decoy, and the second detonates it. The remote detonation costs mana.

Has no effect if Decoy has additional charges.

nodes.name: Decoy Small Explosion Chance
nodes.description: Decoy has a chance to cause a small explosion when hit, up to a maximum of 2 explosions.

nodes.name: Decoy Cold Explosion
nodes.description:
All explosions' base fire damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to fire damage. Explosions also gain a base freeze rate.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to chill chance and effects related to ignite now depend on chill instead.

nodes.name: Decoy Ignites Each Second
nodes.description: The Decoy is on fire and ignites nearby enemies each second, but costs more mana.

nodes.name: Decoy Ignite Converted To Poison
nodes.description:
Small explosions are replaced by Acid Flask detonations. The final explosion is replaced by three Acid Flasks ejected from the decoy.
{On Fire} now inflicts poison instead of ignite.

nodes.name: Decoy Max Charges
nodes.description: Decoy can store an additional charge.

nodes.name: Decoy Sonic Wave
nodes.description: The Decoy emits a {Sonic Wave} when it appears, inflicting {Frailty} and armor shred to nearby enemies.

nodes.name: Decoy Sonic Wave Fear
nodes.description: {Sonic Wave} Fears enemies for a duration.

nodes.name: Decoy Shadow Clone
nodes.description: Decoy leaves a {Shadow} in its place after detonating.

nodes.name: Decoy Throws More Decoys
nodes.description: Throw additional Decoys near the target location. Decoy location is slightly randomised.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Root Node
nodes.description: A series of fast dash attacks.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Physical Penetration
nodes.description: Dancing Strikes penetrates enemy physical resistance.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Shadow Daggers
nodes.description: Dancing Strikes inflicts enemies with {Shadow Dagger}.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Bleed Chance
nodes.description: Dancing Strikes has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Damage Over Time
nodes.description: You deal more global damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each time you have used Dancing Strikes recently.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Melee Damage Per Poison
nodes.description: Dancing Strikes deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per poison stacks on the target up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Less Phys More Poison
nodes.description: Dancing Strikes has a chance to poison enemies, but deals less physical damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Hit Damage Against Ailments
nodes.description: Dancing Strikes hits deal more damage to bleeding and poisoned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Dodge Rating
nodes.description: Dancing Strikes grants you additional dodge rating for a short duration on use.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Dodge Rating Per Dex
nodes.description: Dancing Strikes grants you additional dodge rating per point of Dexterity for a short duration on use.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Damage To Bosses
nodes.description: Dancing Strikes deals more damage to rare enemies and bosses (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Third Strike Arena
nodes.description:
Dancing Strikes' third attack creates a {Fighting Arena} for 4 seconds.

While fighting inside the arena, you and your allies deal more damage and take less damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers). The less damage taken is doubled for you.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Arena Bleed
nodes.description: You and allies fighting inside the arena have a high chance to cause enemies to bleed.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Dash Distance
nodes.description: Dancing Strikes deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) but you travel less far between each attack.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Less Damage Over Time
nodes.description: You take less damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) for a short duration after using Dancing Strikes.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Shadow And Sync Strike
nodes.description: {Lethal Mirage} and {Synchronized Strike} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each time you have used Dancing Strikes recently.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Third Strike Heals
nodes.description: Dancing Strikes' third attack heals you if it hits at least one enemy.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Haste Chance
nodes.description: Dancing Strikes has a chance to grant you {Haste} for 2 seconds on use.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Shuriken Chance
nodes.description: Dancing Strikes' second and fourth attack have a chance to throw {Shurikens} in target direction.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Area
nodes.description: Dancing Strikes deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Shred Armor Chance
nodes.description: Dancing Strikes has a chance to shred enemy armor.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Rhythm
nodes.description: When you use Dancing Strikes and hit at least one enemy, you gain a stack of {Rhythm} for a short duration and refresh all existing stacks, granting you global more damage per stack (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Rhythm Dodge Rating
nodes.description: You have increased dodge rating per stack of {Rhythm}.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Rhythm Global Bleed
nodes.description: You have a global chance to cause enemies to bleed per stack of {Rhythm}.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Rhythm Global Crit Multi
nodes.description: Your critical strikes deal more damage per stack of {Rhythm}.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Rhythm Damage And Mana
nodes.description: Each stack of {Rhythm} also grants 5% global more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Dancing Strikes cost more mana.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes First Strike Shred
nodes.description: Dancing Strikes' first attack shreds enemy armor.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Second Strike Shadow
nodes.description: Dancing Strikes' second attack creates a {Shadow}, but Dancing Strikes costs more mana.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Phys Shred
nodes.description: Dancing Strikes shreds enemy physical resistance.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Puncture Damage
nodes.description: Your next {Puncture} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) after using Dancing Strikes.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Shadow Cascade Chance
nodes.description: Dancing Strikes' first attack has a chance to also attack with {Shadow Cascade}.

nodes.name: Dancing Strikes Bleed To Poison
nodes.description: All bleed chance is converted to poison chance with Dancing Strikes. Physical penetration from this tree converted to poison penetration.

nodes.name: Ballista Root Node
nodes.description: Summons a ballista that fires fire arrows at nearby enemies.

nodes.name: Ballista Less Cost And Duration
nodes.description: Ballista costs significantly less mana, but has a shorter duration.

nodes.name: Ballista Extra Projectile Chance
nodes.description: Ballista has a chance to shoot extra projectiles.

nodes.name: Ballista Faster And Less Damage
nodes.description: Ballista has more attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers), but deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Ballista Armor Shred Chance
nodes.description: Ballista has a chance to shred enemy armor.

nodes.name: Ballista Double Shot Chance
nodes.description: Ballista has a chance to fire twice in quick succession.

nodes.name: Ballista Fire Damage And Ignite
nodes.description: Ballista bolts are lit on fire dealing additional fire damage and have a chance to ignite enemies.

nodes.name: Ballista Increased Attack Speed
nodes.description: Ballista has increased attack speed.

nodes.name: Ballista Arrows Explode On Expiration
nodes.description: Ballista's bolts now explode on hit dealing fire damage in an area, but has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Ballista Explosions Converted To Cold
nodes.description:
The explosion's base fire damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to fire damage. The explosion also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Ignite chance from inside this skill tree is converted to chill chance.

nodes.name: Ballista More Health And Duration
nodes.description: Ballista has more health and lasts longer.

nodes.name: Ballista Slow Chance
nodes.description: Ballista has a chance to slow enemies.

nodes.name: Ballista Ailment Chance Applies To Ballista
nodes.description: Your ailment modifiers also apply to your Ballista, but at a reduced ratio.

nodes.name: Ballista Gains Attack Speed On Hit
nodes.description: Ballista gains increased attack speed with each hit.

nodes.name: Ballista Being Nearby Buffs
nodes.description: Your Ballistae gain {Frenzy} while you are standing near them.

nodes.name: Ballista Modifiers Apply To Ballista
nodes.description: Your damage modifiers also apply to your Ballista, but at a reduced ratio.

nodes.name: Ballista Slower And More Damage
nodes.description: Ballista deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Ballista Wider Shield
nodes.description: Ballista shields are wider.

nodes.name: Ballista Added Crit Chance
nodes.description: Improves Ballista's base critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Ballista Crit Modifiers Applies To Ballista
nodes.description: Your critical strike chance and critical strike multipliers also apply to your Ballista, but at a reduced ratio.

nodes.name: Ballista Tripwire
nodes.description: When you construct a second ballista a tripwire is created between it and the existing ballista. Enemies that cross the tripwire cause both ballistae to explode.

nodes.name: Ballista More Damage After Potion
nodes.description: Ballista deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if constructed within 4 seconds of using a potion.

nodes.name: Ballista Damage And Attack Speed Less Duration
nodes.description: Ballista deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has more attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has a shorter duration.

nodes.name: Ballista Explodes On Death
nodes.description: Ballista now also explodes when it expires or is destroyed. This explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and hits enemies in a larger area based on your Dexterity.

nodes.name: Ballista Harpoon
nodes.description: Every 5 seconds Ballista shoots a {Harpoon Shot}, that sticks into an enemy and pulls them towards the Ballista.

nodes.name: Ballista Acid Flask Gives Poison Chance
nodes.description:
Hitting your Ballista with {Acid Flask} gives it a chance to poison enemies and more poison damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

If {Acid Flask} damage is converted to fire, this is instead ignite chance and more fire damage.

nodes.name: Ballista Potion Chance
nodes.description: Ballistae which have hit an enemy have a chance to drop a potion when destroyed, based on the time they existed.

nodes.name: Ballista Has Shield
nodes.description: Ballista now has shields in front of it.

nodes.name: Ballista Placement Speed
nodes.description: Ballista takes less time to place and has increased attack speed based on your Dexterity.

nodes.name: Ballista Pierce
nodes.description: Ballista bolts pierces enemies (continue through targets they hit).

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Root Node
nodes.description:
Requires dual wielding.

A circular attack that's also used by your  {Shadows}.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Damage Per Shadow
nodes.description: Shadow Cascade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per active {Shadow}.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Dodge While Cascading
nodes.description: You have more dodge rating while directly using Shadow Cascade (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Frailty Chance
nodes.description: Shadow Cascade has a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies hit, causing them to deal less damage.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Physical Damage Buff On 4 Hits
nodes.description:
If you hit at least 4 enemies with Shadow Cascade, you deal increased physical damage for a short duration.

This effect can be triggered by daggers from {Dagger Dance} as well.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Slow
nodes.description: Shadow Cascade slows enemies for a short duration.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Bleed Chance
nodes.description: Shadow Cascade has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Area
nodes.description: Shadow Cascade deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Attack Speed Affects Damage
nodes.description: Shadow Cascade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 1% of increased melee attack speed you have.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Damage Against Bleed And Poison
nodes.description: Shadow Cascade has more melee critical strike chance (multiplicative with other modifiers) against bleeding and poisoned enemies.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Base Crit Chance
nodes.description: Improves Shadow Cascade's base critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Crit Multi
nodes.description: Shadow Cascade's critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Mana Regain Per Shadow
nodes.description: You gain mana when you directly use Shadow Cascade per active {Shadow}.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Armor Shred Chance
nodes.description: Shadow Cascade has a chance to shred enemy armor.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Melee Damage Against Low Health
nodes.description: Shadow Cascade deals more melee damage to enemies on low health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Damage No Attack Speed
nodes.description: When you directly use Shadow Cascade it deals more damage, but it has less attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Duration
nodes.description: Daggers from {Dagger Dance} last longer causing them to travel further.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Daggers Bleed Chance
nodes.description: Daggers from {Dagger Dance} have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Dagger Damage No Melee
nodes.description: {Dagger Dance} throws more daggers which deal significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Shadow Cascade no longer includes a melee attack.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Shadow Daggers
nodes.description: Daggers from {Dagger Dance} inflict enemies with {Shadow Dagger}. This chance is much lower when {Dagger Dance} is used by a {Shadow}.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Bleed To Poison
nodes.description: Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison when using Shadow Cascade.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Shadow On Kill Chance
nodes.description: Shadow Cascade has a chance to create a {Shadow} on kill.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Mana Regain With Shadow
nodes.description: A portion of Shadow Cascade's mana cost is refunded if directly used when you have at least one {Shadow}.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Damage With Number Of Shadows
nodes.description: Shadow Cascade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have at least a certain number of {Shadows}.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Dagger Dance
nodes.description: Shadow Cascade now also throws piercing daggers at nearby targets, dealing throwing physical damage.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Channeling
nodes.description: Shadow Cascade is now channeled and throws daggers 3 times a second. It rapidly drains your mana.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Damage Per Swords Or Daggers
nodes.description: Shadow Cascade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per sword or dagger you are wielding.

nodes.name: Shadow Cascade Shadow Swap
nodes.description:
When you directly use Shadow Cascade while targeting a {Shadow} you swap places with the Shadow.

This effect consumes mana based on how many times you have swapped places with a Shadow in the past 5 seconds.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Root Node
nodes.description: A circular attack that's also used by your shadow clones. Requires dual wielding.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Added Melee Phys Per Sword Or Dagger
nodes.description: Lethal Mirage deals additional melee physical damage per equipped sword or dagger.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Physical Penetration
nodes.description: Lethal Mirage penetrates enemy physical resistance.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Bleed Chance And Effect
nodes.description: Lethal Mirage has a chance to cause enemies to bleed, and bleed inflicted by Lethal Mirage has additional Physical Penetration.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage More Hit Damage Per Bleed
nodes.description: Lethal Mirage hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed on the target up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage More Crit Chance Per Bleed
nodes.description: Lethal Mirage has more critical strike chance (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed on the target.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Only Strikes Allies
nodes.description: Lethal Mirage now targets allies rather than enemies.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Self Mirage Form
nodes.description: When Lethal Mirage ends you gain {Mirage Form} for 1 second per critical strike landed. This can stack up to 6 seconds.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Health And Mana On Kill
nodes.description: You gain health and mana per kill with Lethal Mirage.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Faster
nodes.description: Mirages are created faster, causing Lethal Mirage to have a shorter duration.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Cooldown Per Kill
nodes.description: Reduce Lethal Mirage's cooldown per enemy killed by Lethal Mirage up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage More Damage And Melee Leech
nodes.description: Lethal Mirage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and leeches a portion of the melee damage dealt as health.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Consumes Shadows For Mirages
nodes.description: Lethal Mirage consumes all active {Shadows} gaining additional Mirages per {Shadow} consumed, resulting in more hits.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage More Damage Per Shadow Consumed
nodes.description: Lethal Mirage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Shadow} consumed.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Smoke Cloud
nodes.description: The smoke from {Umbral Burst} persists as a cloud blinding enemies and inflicting {Frailty} each second.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Smoke Cloud Makes Allies Uncrittable
nodes.description: Allies within the smoke cloud avoid critical strikes.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Smoke Cloud Converted To Poison
nodes.description: The smoke cloud is converted to a poison cloud causing enemies to be poisoned each second, but no longer inflicts {Frailty}.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Longer Poison
nodes.description: Poisons caused by Lethal Mirage last longer.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Haste On Use
nodes.description: You gain {Haste} when you reappear.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Less Mirage Added Crit Chance
nodes.description: Improves Lethal Mirage's base critical strike chance, but it has fewer Mirages, resulting in fewer hits.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Can Strike Allies
nodes.description: Lethal Mirage can now also hit allies granting them the {Mirage Form} buff for 4 seconds, granting bleed chance and additional dodge rating.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Additional Mirages 1
nodes.description: Lethal Mirage gains an additional Mirage, resulting in more hits.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Chance To Leave Shadow
nodes.description: Mirages have a chance to leave behind a {Shadow} when they hit an enemy.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Smoke Burst On Reappear
nodes.description: When you reappear Lethal Mirage releases a burst of smoke blinding enemies and inflicts them with {Frailty}.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Additional Mirages 2
nodes.description: Lethal Mirage gains an additional Mirage, resulting in more hits.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Shadow Cascade Chance
nodes.description: Mirages have a chance to use {Shadow Cascade} in addition to their normal attack.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Cull And Cannot Bleed
nodes.description:
Lethal Mirage instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health), but can no longer inflict bleed.

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Shadow At Disappear Location
nodes.description:
Lethal Mirage creates a {Shadow} at the location you disappear from.

This {Shadow} is not consumed by the {Shadow Eater} node.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Lightning
nodes.description:
Lethal Mirage deals additional melee lightning damage and its base physical damage is converted to Lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Physical penetration from this tree is converted to lightning penetration.

All bleed and poison chances are converted to shock chance.

Swaps Lethal Mirage's {Physical} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

nodes.name: Lethal Mirage Dash Wait Dash
nodes.description:
On exiting Lethal Mirage's damage window, dash forward again another 6 meters. 

This extends the invulnerability period if invulnerability has not been disabled by other effects.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Root Node
nodes.description:
Requires a bow.

Fires an arrow that attaches itself in a target then explodes after 0.6 seconds. Added bow damage is converted to lightning damage.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Reduced Arm Time And Crit Chance
nodes.description: Detonating Arrow has increased critical strike chance and it has reduced arming time.
