nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Crit Multi And Crit Vulnerability
nodes.description: Detonating Arrow critical strikes deal more damage and it has a chance to apply {Critical Vulnerability} to enemies, making them easier to critically strike.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Explosion Area
nodes.description: The explosion deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Shock Chance And Less Hit Damage
nodes.description: Detonating Arrow has a chance to shock enemies, but the explosion hit deals less hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Consume Mana More Damage
nodes.description: Detonating Arrow consumes a portion of your current mana to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on the mana consumed, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Explosion Area And Damage
nodes.description: The explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Plus Charges
nodes.description: You can store an additional charge of Detonating Arrow.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Freeze Rate
nodes.description: Detonating Arrow has a higher chance based on your uncapped Cold Resistance.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Less Movespeed With Arrow
nodes.description: Detonating Arrow causes enemies to have less movement speed (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each arrow attached.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow More Arming Time
nodes.description: Detonating Arrow has a longer arming time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Damage Increased Arming Time
nodes.description: Detonating Arrow deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a longer arming time. The explosion deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second the arrow spent arming.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Less Elemental Resist
nodes.description: Detonating Arrow causes enemies to have less elemental resistance while they have at least 1 arrow attached.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Explosion Hit Damage Per Missing Health
nodes.description: The explosion hit deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 5% health the enemy is missing.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Damage Less Explosion Radius
nodes.description: The explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Damage Per Second Charged
nodes.description: Detonating Arrow deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second charged up.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Shock Chance
nodes.description: Detonating Arrow has a chance to shock enemies.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Homing
nodes.description: Detonating Arrow now slightly seeks out targets.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Attack Speed Shock Duration
nodes.description: Detonating Arrow has increased attack speed and shock applied by this skill last longer.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Chain Lightning Pen Shock Chance
nodes.description: {Lightning Tendrils} penetrate a portion of enemy lightning resistance and have a chance to shock enemies.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Cone And Reduced Arm Time
nodes.description: Detonating Arrow now explodes on impact in a cone behind the target rather than a circle, but no longer has an arming time.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Fire Conversion
nodes.description:
The explosion base lightning damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance and effects related to shock now depend on ignite instead.

Swaps Detonating Arrow's {Lightning} tag for a {Fire} tag.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow More Explosion Area Damage And Stun Chance
nodes.description: Detonating Arrow now has a cooldown, but when you directly use it, it deals more damage in a significantly larger area (both multiplicative with other modifiers), and has an increased chance to stun.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow First Arrow Explodes
nodes.description: If an enemy has an attached Detonating Arrow and gets hit again, it explodes the first arrow immediately.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Detonating Arrow's base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage. It also gains a base freeze rate.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to chill chance.

Swaps Detonating Arrow's {Lightning} tag for a {Cold} tag. 

This has no effect if Detonating Arrow is converted to fire with {Dragon Arrow}.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Charge Up To Pierce
nodes.description: Detonating Arrow can now be charged up for up to 2 seconds, causing it to pierce a number of enemies (continue through targets it hits) per 0.5 seconds charged up.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Poison Conversion Less Hit Damage
nodes.description:
The explosion now poisons enemies on hit, but its hits deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Detonating Arrow's base damage is convered to Physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to poison chance.

Swaps Detonating Arrow's {Lightning} tag for {Poison} and {Physical} tags.

This has no effect if Detonating Arrow is converted to fire or cold with {Dragon Arrow} or {Frostfang Arrow}.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Damage And Area With Existing Arrow
nodes.description:
When you hit an enemy with Detonating Arrow that already has an arrow attached to them, the explosion deals more damage in a larger area (multiplicative with other modifiers). 

{Suckerpunch Arrow} will not attach an additional Detonating Arrow.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Lightning Chain
nodes.description:
The explosion causes {Lightning Tendrils} to chain out to other nearby targets. This can't hit enemies hit by the explosion.

This has no effect if Detonating Arrow's damage is converted.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow No Mana Cost
nodes.description: Detonating arrow no longer costs mana and instead restores mana when you directly use it and hit at least one enemy. However it now only has a small chance of exploding.

nodes.name: Detonating Arrow Damage Over Time
nodes.description: Ailments inflicted by Detonating Arrow deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Slows Each Second
nodes.description: Applies slow to enemies within the smoke cloud each second.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Armor Shred
nodes.description: Applies armor shred to enemies within the smoke cloud each second.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Bow Poison
nodes.description: You have a chance to poison enemies with bow attacks while inside the smoke cloud.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Slow And Armor Shred Frequency
nodes.description: Smoke Bomb has a chance to shred enemy armor each second within the smoke cloud.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Increased Duration
nodes.description: The smoke cloud lasts longer.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Blinds And Crit Chance With Bow
nodes.description: Your bow attacks have improved base critcal strike chance and blind enemies while you are inside the smoke cloud.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Smoke Blades
nodes.description: You and allies are granted {Smoke Blades} each second for 4 seconds while inside the smoke cloud, granting you additional melee and throwing damage. This effect can stack.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Smoke Blades Leech
nodes.description: {Smoke Blades} now also causes melee and throwing attacks to leech a portion of the damage you deal as health.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Increased Starting Area
nodes.description: The smoke cloud covers a larger area.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Frailty By Initial Hit
nodes.description: The initial burst applies {Frailty} to enemies, causing them to deal less damage.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Allies Ailment Cleansing
nodes.description: The initial burst also cleanses negative ailments on allies.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Mana From Consumed Shadows
nodes.description: The initial burst consumes all {Shadows} inside the smoke to grant you and allies mana per {Shadow} consumed this way.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Early Fire Smoke
nodes.description: Leaving the smoke cloud early causes it to immediately catch fire and end.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Dusk Shroud
nodes.description: You are granted a stack of {Dusk Shroud} each second for 2 seconds while you are in the smoke cloud, granting you glancing blow chance and dodge rating. This effect can stack.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Dusk Shroud Frequency
nodes.description: The smoke cloud grants stacks of {Dusk Shroud} more frequently.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Dusk Shrould To Allies
nodes.description: The smoke cloud now also grants {Dusk Shroud} to allies for 2 seconds while inside the smoke cloud.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Cloud Growth
nodes.description: The smoke cloud has a larger area and grows faster.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Puncture And Shurikens Bleed
nodes.description: {Puncture} and {Shurikens} have a chance cause enemies to bleed if used inside the smoke cloud.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Targeted Bomb With Bow
nodes.description: While using a bow you now shoot an arrow that detonates the Smoke Bomb at the target location.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Poison Shred Conversion
nodes.description: Armor shred applied by Smoke Bomb is converted to poison resistance shred.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Shadow Dagger On Slow
nodes.description: Smoke Bomb has a chance to inflict a stack of {Shadow Dagger} whenever it applies slow.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Create Shadow Chance
nodes.description: The smoke cloud has a chance to create a {Shadow} each second at a random location inside the smoke cloud.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Crimson Shroud On Kill
nodes.description: You are granted a stack of {Crimson Shroud} on kill while inside the smoke cloud, granting you bleed chance and less damage over time taken for 4 seconds. This stacks up to 3 times.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Backflip On Use
nodes.description:
You backflip away from target direction when you use Smoke Bomb. Smoke Bomb now counts as movement skill.

During Smoke Bomb's movement you are immune to Damage.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Ailment Cleansing
nodes.description: The initial burst cleanses negative ailments on you.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Fire Smoke At End
nodes.description: The smoke cloud catches fire at the end of its duration, igniting enemies inside the cloud.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Shadow Cascade At End
nodes.description: You use {Shadow Cascade} when the smoke cloud ends.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Explodes Decoys
nodes.description: Your {Decoys} inside the smoke cloud automatically explode when the smoke cloud ends.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Silver Shroud
nodes.description:
The initial burst grants you a stack of {Silver Shroud}, causing you to dodge the next hit and gain ward per stack.

Smoke Bomb now has a minimum cooldown.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Heal From Consumed Shadows
nodes.description: The initial burst consumes all {Shadows} inside the smoke to grant you and allies health per {Shadow} consumed this way.

nodes.name: Smoke Bomb Traversal
nodes.description:
You leap to the target location when you use Smoke Bomb, instead of backflipping away.

Smoke Bomb now has a much shorter cooldown, but counts as a {Traversal} skill.

You are now limited to having a maximum of 1 Smoke Bomb active at once.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows More Area
nodes.description: Hail of Arrows deals damage in a larger area

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Dusk Shroud Chance
nodes.description: You have a chance to gain a stack of {Dusk Shroud} each second for 2 seconds while inside the area, granting you glancing blow chance and dodge rating. This effect can stack.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Dusk Shroud To Allies
nodes.description: Hail of Arrows now also grants a stack of {Dusk Shroud} to allies each second for 2 seconds while inside the area.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Barrage Crit Chance
nodes.description: Improves {Barrage of Arrows'} base critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Barrage Immobilize And Slow
nodes.description: {Barrage of Arrows} immobilizes enemies for a short duration. Rare enemies and bosses are slowed instead.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Frailty Chance
nodes.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies each second.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Armor Shred Chance
nodes.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to shred enemy armor each second.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Crit Vulnerability
nodes.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to inflict enemies with {Crit Vulnerability} each second.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Damage Against Ignited
nodes.description: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage to ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Damage Less Radius
nodes.description: Hail of Arrows deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Bow Leech
nodes.description: Hail of Arrows leeches a portion of the bow damage it deals as health.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Damage
nodes.description: Hail of Arrows deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Bow Damage Against Stunned
nodes.description: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage to stunned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers). This does not affect ailment damage.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Less Duration Reduced Mana Cost
nodes.description: Hail of Arrows costs less mana, but has a shorter duration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Reduced Mana Cost And Cooldown
nodes.description: Hail of Arrows costs less mana and has a shorter cooldown, but has a longer delay before the arrows fall.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Bleed Chance
nodes.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to cause enemies to bleed each second.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Bow Damage Per Bleed
nodes.description: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage per stack of bleed on the enemy, up to a maximum. This does not affect ailment damage.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Slow Chance
nodes.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to slow enemies each second.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Freeze Rate Chill Duration
nodes.description: Hail of Arrows has increased chance to freeze enemies each second and has a chance to inflict Frostbite each second.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Increased Duration
nodes.description: Hail of Arrows lasts longer.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Bow Damage Per Second
nodes.description: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) over its duration scaling up to a maximum. This does not affect damaging ailments.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows More Duration One Hail
nodes.description:
Hail of Arrows lasts significantly longer (multiplicative with other modifiers), but you can only have one Hail of Arrows active at a time. 

Using Hail of Arrows again causes the old instance to stop.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Poison Chance
nodes.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to poison enemies each second.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Barrage And Mana Cost
nodes.description: Hail of Arrows now also shoots a {Barrage of Arrows} on use dealing bow physical damage. This does not scale with damage over time.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Fire Damage Conversion
nodes.description:
Hail of Arrows' base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance and effects related to bleed now depend on ignite instead.

Swaps Hail of Arrows' {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.

This has no effect if Hail of Arrows is converted to cold with {Crystal Arrows} or to poison with {Acid Rain}.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Less Duration More Charges
nodes.description: You can store additional charges of Hail of Arrows, but it has a shorter duration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Advancing Rectangle
nodes.description: Hail of Arrows now fall in a forward advancing rectangle area rather than a circle.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Hail of Arrows' base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies each second.

All slow chance from this tree is converted to chill chance and effects related to slow now depend on chill instead. Bleed chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance.

Swaps Hail of Arrows' {Physical} tag for a {Cold} tag.

This has no effect if Hail of Arrows is converted to poison with {Acid Rain}.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Channeled
nodes.description:
Hail of Arrows is now channeled and can be retargeted while you are channelling. It costs less initial mana, but costs mana every second. It also deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Channelled Hail of Arrows' delay is halved, and increases to its delay are halved.

nodes.name: Hail Of Arrows Poison Conversion
nodes.description:
Hail of Arrows' base physical damage is converted to poison. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Swaps Hail of Arrows' {Physical} tag for a {Poison} tag.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison chance.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Ignite Chance and Duration
nodes.description: Cinder Strike has a chance to ignite enemies and ignites inflicted by the first attack have increased duration.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Blind Or Frailty
nodes.description: Cinder Strike has a chance to blind enemies and a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike First Strike Area And Damage
nodes.description: Cinder Strike's first attack deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Second And Third Increased Attack Speed
nodes.description: Cinder Strike's second and third attacks have increased attack speed.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Blind Damage And Crit
nodes.description: Cinder Strike deals more damage to blinded enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has additional critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Crit Multi Doubled For First
nodes.description: Cinder Strike has additional critical strike multiplier. This bonus is doubled for the first attack.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Cinder Strike costs less mana.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Explosive Flask Damage
nodes.description: Volatile Flasks you would throw are instead replaced with {Explosive Trap}. Explosive Traps thrown this way consume mana equal to a percentage of Explosive Trap's mana cost.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Explosion On Kill
nodes.description: Cinder Strike has a chance to cause an explosion on kill. This counts as a {Volatile Flask} explosion.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Base Fire Damage Per Ignited Enemy
nodes.description: Cinder Strike hits deals additional fire damage for each ignited enemy you have hit recently up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike More Crit Chance Per Ignite
nodes.description: Cinder Strike's first attack has more critical strike chance (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of ignite on the target up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Fire DoT Per Dexterity
nodes.description: Cinder Strike deals increased fire damage over time per point of Dexterity.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Ignite Conversion
nodes.description: Poison chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance for Cinder Strike.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Fire Damage Buff
nodes.description: If you use and hit at least one enemy with Cinder Strike you are granted {Oil Coating} granting you increased fire damage. This effect can stack and lasts 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Fire Buff Ignite Effect And Fire Pen
nodes.description:
If you have at least 3 stacks of {Oil Coating} you are granted additional fire penetration.

This effect is doubled for ignites inflicted by Cinder Strike.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Fire Buff Limit But Regain Health And Mana
nodes.description: {Oil Coating} is limited to 5 stacks. If you would gain another stack you instead regain health and mana.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Fire Buff Dodge And Fire Res
nodes.description: You have additional chance to dodge and additional fire resistance per stack of {Oil Coating}.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Fire Buff Elemental Damage
nodes.description: {Oil Coating} now grants you increased elemental damage rather than just fire damage.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Fire Buff Fire Throwing Damage
nodes.description: {Oil Coating} now also grants additional throwing fire damage.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Fire Shred Chance
nodes.description: Cinder Strike has a chance to shred enemy fire resistance.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike More Burning Daggers Less Mana Use
nodes.description: {Burning Daggers} from all sources deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and Burning Daggers from {Molten Arsenal} consume less mana.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Burning Daggers From Shadows
nodes.description: All your {Shadows} now also throw 5 {Burning Daggers} in a cone in front of them when you do. This consumes all active {Shadows}.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Damage
nodes.description: Cinder Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers and its hits deal additional fire damage.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Only First Strike
nodes.description: Cinder Strike now only has the first attack and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but costs significantly more mana.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Explosive Flask On First Strike
nodes.description: When you use Cinder Strike and hit with its first attack it has a chance to throw a {Volatile Flask} at a nearby target.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Burning Dagger
nodes.description: If you use and hit at least one enemy with Cinder Strike it consumes 8 mana granting you a {Burning Dagger} that circles you for a second before launching at the nearest enemy.

nodes.name: Cinder Strike Burning Dagger Cone
nodes.description: You now also throw 5 {Burning Daggers} in a cone in front of you on Cinder Strike's first attack.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Root Node
nodes.description:
Requires a bow.

Summons 7 {Black Arrows} which rain from the sky over 4 seconds, granting bonus damage to your next bow attack when retrieved.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Arrows Give Damage Over Time
nodes.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants increased damage over time to your next bow attack.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Arrow Pickup Gives Crimson Shroud
nodes.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} grants you a stack of {Crimson Shroud} for a short duration, granting you bleed chance and less damage over time taken. This stacks up to 3 times for a short duration.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Arrows Restore Health
nodes.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} restores health.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Arrows Give Dusk Shroud
nodes.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} grants you a stack of {Dusk Shroud} for 4 seconds, granting you glancing blow chance and dodge rating. This effect can stack.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Arrows Give Bow Phys Damage
nodes.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants additional physical damage to your next bow attack.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Arrows Give Crit Chance
nodes.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants increased critical strike chance to your next bow attack.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Arrows Grant Phys Shred Chance
nodes.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants a chance to shred enemy physical resistance to your next bow attack.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Frenzy On Pickup
nodes.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} grants you the Frenzy buff, granting you 20% increased attack and cast speed for a short duration.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Arrows Grant More Damage But Consume Mana
nodes.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to your next bow attack, but consume additional mana.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Cinder Strike Culling
nodes.description: Using a {Black Arrow} causes your next {Cinder Strike} to instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Arrows Restore Mana
nodes.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} restores mana.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Arrows Grant Poison Chance And Poison Pen
nodes.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants additional poison penetration and poison chance to your next bow attack.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver More Arrows
nodes.description: Additional {Black Arrows} are summoned, but the arrows are summoned at the same frequency causing {Dark Quiver} to have a longer duration.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Arrows Grant Elemental Damage
nodes.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants increased elemental damage to your next bow attack.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Elemental Bow Attack Ailments
nodes.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants a chance to freeze, shock or ignite enemies, depending on the element, to your next bow elemental attack.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Slows Enemies On Pickup
nodes.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} slows nearby enemies for a short duration.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Arrow Frequency
nodes.description: {Black Arrows} are summoned more frequently. This does not cause more arrows to be summoned and also causes {Dark Quiver} to have a shorter duration.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Instant Arrows
nodes.description: You instantly summon a number of {Black Arrows} on use. The rest are spread out over the normal duration.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Arrows Grant Ballista Attack Speed
nodes.description:
Picking up a {Black Arrow} grants active {Ballistae} increased attack speed while they are alive.

This effect stacks up to 4 times.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Ballistae Always Crit With 4 Arrows
nodes.description: {Ballistae} that have been buffed by at least 4 {Black Arrows} always critically strike.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Multishot Pierce
nodes.description: Using a {Black Arrow} causes your next {Multishot} to pierce additional enemies (continue through targets they hit).

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Flurry Base Crit
nodes.description: Using a {Black Arrow} improves your next {Flurry's} base critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Cinder Strike Reset On Pickup
nodes.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} resets the combo of {Cinder Strike}.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Consume Shadows For More Damage
nodes.description:
Using a {Black Arrow} consumes all active {Shadows} to grant your next bow attack more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Shadow} consumed.

Consuming at least 3 {Shadows} grants significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Puncture Bleed Chance And Phys Pen
nodes.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants {Puncture} additional physical penetration and bleed chance.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Detonating Arrow Area
nodes.description: Using a {Black Arrow} causes your next {Detonating Arrow} to deal damage in a significantly larger area.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Knockbacks Enemies On Pickup
nodes.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} knocks nearby enemies back 4 meters.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Passive Arrow Generation
nodes.description: Using a bow attack grants you a chance to summon a {Black Arrow} at a random nearby location. This effect has a 3 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Hail of Arrows Damage From Crit
nodes.description: Using a {Black Arrow} causes your next {Hail of Arrows} to deal increased damage over time equal to twice your critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Arrows Grant Permanent Ballista Phys Damage
nodes.description:
Picking up a {Black Arrow} grants active {Ballistae} additional bow physical damage while they are alive.

This effect stacks up to 4 times.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Shadow On Pickup
nodes.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} creates a {Shadow} at the arrow's location.

nodes.name: Dark Quiver Heartseeker Recurve Chance
nodes.description: Using a Black Arrow grants your next {Heartseeker} additional {Recurve} chance.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Root Node
nodes.description:
Requires a melee weapon.

Jump forward and strike in an area in front of you while shadows appear and simultaneously strike on either side of you.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Increased Area
nodes.description: Synchronized Strike deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Shadow Damage Within 4 Seconds
nodes.description:
{Shadows} created by Synchronized Strike deal increased damage. This effect also applies to shadows created from any source for 4 seconds after using Synchronized Strike.

This effect stacks.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Bleed And Physical Shred Chance
nodes.description: Synchronized Strike has a chance to cause enemies to bleed and a chance to shred enemy physical resistance.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Crimson Shroud On Use
nodes.description: Using Synchronized Strike grants you {Crimson Shroud} for a short duration, granting you bleed chance and less damage over time taken. This stacks up to 3 times for a short duration.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike More Damage
nodes.description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike More Damage To Low Health
nodes.description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage to enemies on low health.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Leech
nodes.description: Synchronized Strike leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Haste On Kill
nodes.description: You gain {Haste} for a short duration when you kill an enemy with Synchronized Strike.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Culling
nodes.description:
Synchronized Strike instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Crit Chance Buff On Kill
nodes.description: You are granted increased critical strike chance for 4 seconds on kill with Synchronized Strike. This effect can stack.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Damage Per Sword Poison Per Dagger
nodes.description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per equipped sword and has a chance to poison enemies per equipped dagger.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Base Crit Chance
nodes.description: Improves Synchronized Strike's base critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Crit Multi
nodes.description: Synchronized Strike deals more critical strike damage.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Crit Vulnerability
nodes.description: Synchronized Strike has a chance to inflict enemies with {Critical Vulnerability}.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Armor Shred Chance And Effect
nodes.description: Synchronized Strike has a chance to shred enemy armor. Armor shred applied by Synchronized Strike has increased effectiveness.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Shadow Dagger
nodes.description: Synchronized Strike inflicts enemies with a {Shadow Dagger}.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Consume Shadows For Ward And Increased Area
nodes.description: Synchronized Strike consumes existing {Shadows} to deal damage in a larger area and grant you ward per {Shadow} consumed.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Synchronized Strike costs less mana.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Attack Speed Buff
nodes.description: You are granted increased attack speed for 3 seconds if Synchronized Strike hits at least one enemy.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Shadows Restore Health
nodes.description: {Shadows} created within 4 seconds of using Synchronized Strike restore health on creation.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike No Shadows Big Damage
nodes.description:
Directly using Synchronized Strike grants {Dark Passage} for 4 seconds, creating a shadow every second over its duration.

Synchronized Strike deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but only creates a single shadow from the initial attack.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Always Crit On Hight Health Targets
nodes.description: Synchronized Strike always critically hits enemies on high health.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike More Shadows And Mana Cost
nodes.description: Synchronized Strike creates 2 additional {Shadows}, but costs significantly more mana. This can exceed your normal maximum number of {Shadows}.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike More Damage But Expire
nodes.description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but {Shadows} from Synchronized Strike expire after attacking. They also do not cause existing {Shadows} to expire and do not trigger {on shadow creation} or {on shadow expiration} effects.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Existing Shadows Shadow Cascade
nodes.description:
Synchronized Strike causes existing {Shadows} to use {Shadow Cascade} on use, rather than being consumed immediately. 

This effect consumes a portion of mana per active Shadow.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Shadows Jump Inward
nodes.description: The {Shadows} now jump inward towards the target rather than outward, making it easier for them to hit the same target. Synchronized Strikes has additional mana cost.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Early Attack More Damage
nodes.description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage, but the {Shadows} now attack from where you teleport from, rather than where you arrive.

nodes.name: Synchronized Strike Disappear Added Cooldown
nodes.description:
You now disappear instead of teleporting to the target and a {Shadow} is created in your place, but Synchronized Strike has a longer cooldown. You are invulnerable for 1 second after using Synchronized Strike.

Synchronized Strike's mana cost is significantly lower.

nodes.name: Surge Root Node
nodes.description: Quick fixed distance dash which hits all enemies in the path with a lightning melee attack.

nodes.name: Surge Shock And Stun Chance
nodes.description: Surge shocks enemies and has an increased chance to stun.

nodes.name: Surge Increased Damage Area
nodes.description: Surge deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Surge Spark Charge On Hit
nodes.description: Surge has a chance to apply a {Spark Charge} on enemies.

nodes.name: Surge Shock And Spark Charge Effect Per Sword
nodes.description:
Shock applied by Surge has increased duration per equipped sword.

{Spark Charges} applied by Surge deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per equipped sword.

nodes.name: Surge Added Melee Lightning Damage
nodes.description: Surge deals additional melee lightning damage.

nodes.name: Surge More Damage Per Movement Speed
nodes.description: Surge deals more damage per 1% of movement speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Surge Increased Duration
nodes.description: Surge has increased duration, causing you to move slower.

nodes.name: Surge More Lightning Damage Per Static
nodes.description: Surge deals more lightning damage per 4 {Static Charges} you have when you use Surge (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Surge Static Charges On Use
nodes.description: Gain {Static Charges} when you use Surge.

nodes.name: Surge Static Charges On Hit
nodes.description: You gain {Static Charges} on hit with Surge.

nodes.name: Surge Base Crit And Ward On Crit
nodes.description: Improves Surge's base critical strike chance and you gain ward on crit with Surge.

nodes.name: Surge Ward If Hits At Least One
nodes.description: You gain ward if Surge hits at least one enemy.

nodes.name: Surge Ward Per Hit
nodes.description: You gain ward on hit with Surge.

nodes.name: Surge Cold Damage Wave
nodes.description: Surge causes a {Tidal Wave} to continue past the arrival point, dealing spell cold damage and chills enemies.

nodes.name: Surge Freeze Rate Multi And More Cold Damage
nodes.description: Surge has a higher chance to freeze enemies and deals more cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Surge Lightning Blast On Arrival
nodes.description: You now cast {Lightning Blast} on arrival with Surge. This uses Lightning Blast's mana cost.

nodes.name: Surge Max Dormant Energy Stacks
nodes.description: While Surge is on cooldown, using a melee attack and hitting at least one enemy grants you a stack of {Dormant Energy} up to a maximum. Using Surge again consumes all stacks to deal more damage per stack (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Surge Ward Per Dormant Energy Consumed
nodes.description: Consuming stacks of {Dormant Energy} grants you ward per stack consumed.

nodes.name: Surge Fire Aura Per Dormant Energy Consumed
nodes.description: You have a chance to cast {Fire Aura} when you consume a stack of {Dormant Energy}.

nodes.name: Surge Flame Reave On Arrival
nodes.description: Surge causes a {Flame Reave} to continue past the arrival point, a melee attack dealing fire damage in a cone in front of you. This effect costs Flame Reave's mana cost as well.

nodes.name: Surge Reduced Distance and More Damage
nodes.description: Surge deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) but you travel a shorter distance.

nodes.name: Surge Immobilize On Hit
nodes.description: Surge {Immobilizes} enemies hit for a short duration.

nodes.name: Surge Damage Immunity
nodes.description: You are invulnerable while Surging.

nodes.name: Surge Casts Static On Arrival
nodes.description: You cast {Static} on arrival with Surge.

nodes.name: Surge Increased Travel Distance
nodes.description: You travel further with Surge.

nodes.name: Surge Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Surge's base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance and effects related to shock now depend on Frostbite instead.

Swaps Surge's {Lightning} tag for a {Cold} tag.

nodes.name: Surge Lightning Blast While Travelling
nodes.description: You now cast {Lightning Blasts} while traveling with Surge. Each cast consumes mana equal to Lightning Blast's mana cost.

nodes.name: Surge Zigzag
nodes.description: Surge now moves you in a zig zag motion rather than a straight line and deals more spell lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Surge Fire Conversion
nodes.description:
Surge's base lightning damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to lightning damage. 

Shock chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance and effects related to shock now depend on ignite instead.

Swaps Surge's {Lightning} tag for a {Fire} tag.

Has no effect if you have the {Glacial Assault} node.

nodes.name: Warcry Root Node
nodes.description: Unleash a mighty roar that stuns and knocks back nearby enemies.

nodes.name: Warcry Increased Area
nodes.description: Warcry affects a larger area.

nodes.name: Warcry Ally Increased Crit Chance
nodes.description: You and allies affected by Warcry gain increased crit chance for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Warcry Ally Increased Cold Damage
nodes.description: You and allies affected by Warcry deal increased cold damage for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Warcry Ally Cold Minion Increased Crit Chance
nodes.description: You and your cold minions affected by Warcry gain increased crit chance and additional chill chance for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Warcry Frostbite Chance
nodes.description: Warcry inflicts stacks of {Frostbite} to affected enemies.

nodes.name: Warcry Frozen Targets Take Increased Damage
nodes.description: Enemies frozen by Warcry take increased damage from hits.

nodes.name: Warcry Frailty Chance
nodes.description: Warcry applies one stack of {Frailty} to affected enemies for a short duration.

nodes.name: Warcry Wolf And Scorpion Ailment Chance
nodes.description: For 4 seconds after using Warcry, your {Wolves} have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and your {Scorpion} has a chance to poison enemies.

nodes.name: Warcry Heal On Use
nodes.description:
Warcry now also restores your health. 

The amount of healing is increased by healing effectiveness and is doubled if used while on low health.

nodes.name: Warcry Cleanses Ailments
nodes.description: Warcry now cleanses negative ailments on you.

nodes.name: Warcry Heal Affects Allies
nodes.description:
Warcry now also restores ally health for the same amount as from {Breath of Eterra}. 

The amount of healing is increased by healing effectiveness and is doubled if used while on low health.

nodes.name: Warcry Haste On Hit
nodes.description: If Warcry hits at least one enemy, you gain {Haste} for 1 second.

nodes.name: Warcry Increased Haste Duration And Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Warcry costs less mana and {Haste} gained from {Hastily Advance} lasts longer.

nodes.name: Warcry Gain Frenzy With Haste
nodes.description: You gain {Frenzy} for the same duration as you have Haste from {Hastily Advance}.

nodes.name: Warcry Increased Fear Duration
nodes.description: Fear inflicted by Warcry lasts longer and each stack of the {Berserk} buff from the Berserker node now also causes you to deal more damage to Feared enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Warcry Berserk Increased Melee Damage And Max Stacks
nodes.description: {Berserk} has increased duration and additional maximum stacks.

nodes.name: Warcry Berserk Increased Attack Speed
nodes.description: {Berserk} now also grants you increased attack speed per stack of Berserk up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Warcry Increased Knockback Distance
nodes.description: Warcry knocks enemies further back.

nodes.name: Warcry Deals Physical Spell Damage
nodes.description: Warcry now hits enemies and deals spell physical damage.

nodes.name: Warcry Added Bleed Chance
nodes.description: Warcry causes enemies to bleed.

nodes.name: Warcry Half Cooldown No CC
nodes.description: Warcry now has a cooldown of 5 seconds which cannot be reduced by stunning or freezing enemies, but Warcry no longer has a guaranteed stun, freeze, or fear.

nodes.name: Warcry Crits Can Recast
nodes.description:
While Warcry is on cooldown, your critical strikes have a chance to use Warcry for you. 

This effect can only happen once per direct Warcry use, and it will reset the cooldown.

nodes.name: Warcry Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Warcry now freezes enemies instead of stunning them, but it no longer knocks enemies back.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance and effects related to bleed now depend on Frostbite instead.

nodes.name: Warcry Maelstrom On Use
nodes.description:
You now cast {Maelstrom} when you use Warcry. 

Maelstrom cast this way costs less mana.

nodes.name: Warcry Damage Immunity On use
nodes.description: You are invulnerable for 1 second after using Warcry.

nodes.name: Warcry Berserk
nodes.description:
You gain the {Berserk} buff for 1.5 seconds when you use Warcry, granting you additional melee damage.

While you have Berserk, you gain additional stacks of Berserk on melee hit up to a maximum, and melee hits refresh all stacks.

nodes.name: Warcry Berserk Applies To Raptor And Bear
nodes.description: {Berserk} now also affects your Raptor and Bear.

nodes.name: Warcry Fear Instead Of Stun
nodes.description: Warcry now fears enemies for 2 seconds instead of stunning them.

nodes.name: Warcry Totem
nodes.description: You now place down a totem for 3 seconds that repeatedly uses Warcry instead of you, but Warcry costs more mana.

nodes.name: Warcry Pull Instead Of Knockback
nodes.description: Warcry now pulls enemies instead of knocking them back.

nodes.name: Warcry Taunts
nodes.description: Warcry now also taunts affected enemies for a short duration.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Root Node
nodes.description: Summons a Volatile Zombie which shambles towards an enemy and explodes.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Leap Attack
nodes.description: Zombies now leap towards their targets, up to a maximum distance.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Damage And Movespeed
nodes.description: Zombies deal more damage and have more movement speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Slow And Powerful
nodes.description: Zombies deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and the Zombies' health decays slower, but they also move slower.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Giant
nodes.description: You now summon a single large zombie with more health, that deals more damage in a larger area (all multiplicative with other modifiers), but Volatile Zombie costs more mana.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Marrow Shards On Death
nodes.description:
When a Zombie dies you have a chance to cast {Marrow Shards} from the Zombie towards a nearby enemy.

Marrow Shards does not cost health when cast this way.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Vomit
nodes.description: Zombies will now {Vomit} on enemies before exploding, dealing physical and poison damage over time. Zombies lose 33% of their maximum health per second while vomiting.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Mark For Death
nodes.description: The explosion applies {Mark for Death} to enemies hit, but Volatile Zombie costs more mana.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie More Zombies Per Cast
nodes.description: You summon additional Zombies per cast, but Volatile Zombie costs more mana and has additional cooldown duration.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Poison Chance
nodes.description: The explosion has a chance to poison enemies.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Explosion Area
nodes.description: The explosion deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Explosion Area And Skeleton Vanguard On Death
nodes.description: The explosion deals damage in a larger area and when a Zombie dies it creates a {Skeleton Vanguard}, but Volatile Zombie costs more mana.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Corpse Parasites On Death
nodes.description: When a Zombie dies it creates {Corpse Parasites} for 4 seconds, but Volatile Zombie costs more mana.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Big Explosion No Movement Or Leap
nodes.description: The explosion deals damage in a larger area, but Zombies no longer move.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Chance To Sacrifice On Death
nodes.description: When a Zombie dies you have a chance to cast {Sacrifice} on another nearby minion. This consumes mana equal to a percentage of Sacrifice's mana cost.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Less Mana Cost Faster Summoning Speed
nodes.description: You summon Zombies faster and Volatile Zombie costs less mana.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie You Heal From Zombie Max Health
nodes.description:
You are healed for a portion of the Zombies' maximum health when they explode. 

The amount healed is affected by your increased healing effectiveness.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Fire Conversion
nodes.description:
The explosion's base physical damage and {Vomit}'s base physical and poison damage are converted to fire. Consequently their damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical or poison damage.

Poison chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance and effects related to poison now depend on ignite instead.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Necrotic Conversion
nodes.description: The explosion's base physical and fire damage and {Vomit}'s base physical damage are converted to necrotic. Consequently their damage scales with increases to necrotic damage, but not increases to physical or fire damage.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Culling
nodes.description:
Zombies instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Fear
nodes.description: The explosion now fears enemies for a short duration.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Infernal Shade On Nearby Enemy On Death
nodes.description: When a Zombie dies you have a chance to cast {Infernal Shade} on an enemy near the zombie. This consumes mana equal to a percentage of Infernal Shade's mana cost.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Speed On Lower Health
nodes.description: Zombies have increased movement speed per point of missing health, but their health decays faster.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie More Hit Damage To Rares And Bosses
nodes.description: The explosion's hit deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) against bosses and rare enemies.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Direct Cast Dread Shade
nodes.description: You have a chance to cast {Dread Shade} on Zombies created by a direct cast of Volatile Zombie. This consumes mana equal to a percentage of Dread Shade's mana cost.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Vomit Armor Shred Chance
nodes.description: {Vomit} has a chance to shred enemy armor each second.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Vomit More Damage
nodes.description: {Vomit} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Vomit Poison Chance
nodes.description: {Vomit} has a chance to poison enemies each second based on your maximum mana.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie Autocast On Other Minion Death
nodes.description: When a minion dies you have a chance to cast Volatile Zombie at its location, expending its mana cost.

nodes.name: Volatile Zombie You Gain Ward From Zombie Max Health
nodes.description: {Necromantic Fervor} now grants ward rather than health. The amount of ward gained is not affected by increased healing effectiveness.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Root Node
nodes.description: Summons a Volatile Zombie which shambles towards an enemy and explodes.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Cast And Movement Speed
nodes.description: Storm Crows have increased cast speed, movement speed and more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Armor Shred
nodes.description: Storm Crows hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Damage Per Crow
nodes.description: Storm Crows deal more damage per active crow (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Armour Shred Chance And Effect Per Stat
nodes.description: Storm Crows hits have a chance to shred enemy armor per point of strength, and armor shred they apply has increased effectiveness per point of strength.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Melee Hits Grant More Damage
nodes.description: Your melee hits have a 20% chance to grant active Storm Crows more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Shock Chance And Lightning Resist
nodes.description: Storm Crows have a chance to shock enemies and have additional lightning resistance.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Activated Ability More Damage And Increased Stun Chance
nodes.description: {Crowstorm} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Area And Shock
nodes.description: {Crowstorm} deals damage in a larger area and has a chance to shock enemies it hits.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Storm Crows' base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance and effects related to shock now depend on Frostbite instead.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Freeze Rate Multiplier
nodes.description: Storm Crows have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow More Spell Damage Per Shock
nodes.description: Storm Crows deal more spell damage per stack of shock on the target (multiplicative with other modifiers), up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Lightning Damage Modifiers Apply To Crows
nodes.description: Your increases to lightning damage also apply to your Storm Crows, but at reduced effectiveness.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Lightning Attack Chance To Chain
nodes.description: Storm Crows' basic lightning spell has a chance to chain to up to 2 additional targets.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Damage And Crit Chance
nodes.description: Storm Crows deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Crit Multi
nodes.description: Storm Crows' critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Melee Hits Grant Crit Chance
nodes.description: Your melee hits have a 20% chance to improve active Storm Crows' base critical strike chance for 10 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Lightning Attack More Damage From Moving
nodes.description: Storm Crows' basic lightning spell deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second they spent moving since their previous attack, up to a maximum duration.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Single Crow More Powerful
nodes.description:
You can now only have 1 Storm Crow, it deals more damage, has more health (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and is larger.

It also gains the ability to cast {Storm Surge}, a movement ability that casts its basic lightning spell four times as it travels.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Lightning Attack More Damage But Consumes Mana
nodes.description: Storm Crows' basic lightning spell deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but now consumes your mana.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Aspect Of The Crow Chance
nodes.description: Storm Crow hits have a chance to grant you a stack of {Aspect of the Crow} for 8 seconds, granting you additional melee and spell lightning damage per stack.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Other Companions Gain Lesser Aspect
nodes.description: Your non-crow companions gain {Aspect of the Crow} when you do, but it has 50% reduced duration on them.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Heals Other Companions
nodes.description:
Storm Crows fly to your companions below half health to heal them. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

The amount of healing is increased by healing effectiveness.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Heal Grants Ward
nodes.description:
{Goodberries} now also grants the companion ward. 

The amount of ward gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Heal Cooldown Recovery Speed
nodes.description: Storm Crows are able to use {Goodberries} more frequently.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Heals You
nodes.description: Storm Crows can now also fly to and heal you with {Goodberries}.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Wisdom Of The Storm Every 10 Seconds
nodes.description:
Every 10 seconds Storm Crows cast {Wisdom of the Storm} on its nearest ally, granting it {Aspect of the Crow}. 

This effect has 50% reduced duration on minions.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Intelligence Per Crow
nodes.description: You are granted additional Intelligence per active Storm Crow.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Wisdom Only On Totems
nodes.description: {Wisdom of the Storm} no longer has a cooldown, but can now only target totems.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Dodge Rating
nodes.description: Storm Crows have additional dodge chance and increased dodge chance.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Cooldown And Damage
nodes.description: {Crowstorm} deals more damage per contributing Crow (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a shorter cooldown.

nodes.name: Summon Storm Crow Teleport
nodes.description:
When you directly cast {Crowstorm} you and your crows are teleported to the target location if it is accessible.

Crowstorm now counts as a {Traversal} skill.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Ignite Chance
nodes.description:
Void Cleave hits ignite enemies and half of its base damage is converted to fire, meaning that this half of the damage scales with increases to fire damage but not with increases to void damage.

Ignite inflicted by Void Cleave gains additional fire penetration based on your increased void damage.

Void Cleave gains the {fire} tag.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Fire Conversion
nodes.description:
All of Void Cleave's base void damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to void damage.

Additionally your next non-channeled fire attack or spell after Void Cleave deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Void resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to fire resistance shred and effects related to void resistance shred now depend on fire resistance shred instead.

Void Cleave loses the {void} tag.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Molten Infusion To Minions
nodes.description: When you use Void Cleave and hit at least one enemy, your minions gain a stack of {Molten Infusion} for 4 seconds, granting them additional melee fire damage and a chance to ignite enemies.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Molten Infusion Effect From Direct Hits
nodes.description: Minions only gain a stack of {Molten Infusion} when you directly hit them with Void Cleave, but {Molten Infusion} has significantly increased effect.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Travel Distance And Damage
nodes.description: You can travel farther with Void Cleave and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Void Cleave More Damage After Warpath
nodes.description: After channelling {Warpath} for at least 2 seconds your next Void Cleave within 1 second deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Void Cleave More Area And Damage
nodes.description: Void Cleave deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in an increased area.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Base Crit And Cannot Be Dodged
nodes.description: Improves Void Cleave's base critical strike chance and it cannot be dodged.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Melee Damage To High Health Enemies
nodes.description: Void Cleave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to enemies on high health.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Crit Chance And Crit Vulnerability
nodes.description: Void Cleave hits apply {Critical Vulnerability} and Void Cleave has increased critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Crit Multi And Mana On Crit
nodes.description: Void Cleave critical strikes deal more damage and you gain mana with Void Cleave critical strikes.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Next Erasing Strike Crit
nodes.description: If Void Cleave hits at least one enemy your next {Erasing Strike} is always a critical strike.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Melee Void Damage Tripled For Echoes
nodes.description:
Void Cleave deals additional melee void damage. 

This effect is tripled for echoed Void Cleaves.

nodes.name: Void Cleave More Melee Void Damage To Low Health Enemies
nodes.description: Void Cleave deals significantly more melee void damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to enemies on low health.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Slow Chance And Increased Stun Chance And Duration
nodes.description: Void Cleave hits slow enemies, have increased stun chance and increased stun duration.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Cooldown Recovery Speed
nodes.description: Void Cleave has a shorter cooldown.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Void Res Shred
nodes.description: Void Cleave hits shred enemy void resistance.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Cast Abyssal Echoes
nodes.description:
You cast {Abyssal Echoes} after using Void Cleave.

Abyssal Echoes cast this way uses its mana cost.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Time Rot On Hit
nodes.description: Void Cleave hits inflict enemies with {Time Rot}.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Ravaging Aura Duration Per Enemy Hit
nodes.description: When you use Void Cleave you gain {Ravaging Aura} for a short duration scaling with the amount of enemies hit up to 10.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Ravaging Aura More Damage And Area
nodes.description: {Ravaging Aura} deals additional spell void damage and has an increased area of effect.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Ravaging Aura Leech
nodes.description: {Ravaging Aura} leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Next Throwing Attack Inflicts Stacks Of Time Rot
nodes.description: If Void Cleave hits at least one enemy your next throwing attack inflicts enemies with {Time Rot}.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Damage Per Time Rot On Enemy
nodes.description: Void Cleave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of {Time Rot} on the target.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Armor Shred And Armor Shred Effect And Duration
nodes.description: Void Cleave hits shred enemy armor and {Armor Shred} applied by Void Cleave has increased effect and duration.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Next Throwing Attack Added Void Damage
nodes.description: If Void Cleave hits at least one enemy your next throwing attack deals additional void damage.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Added Charges Added Mana Cost
nodes.description: You can store an additional charge of Void Cleave, but Void Cleave costs more mana.

nodes.name: Void Cleave More Melee Damage Per Bleed Or Ignite
nodes.description: Void Cleave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Physical Damage Applies To Fire
nodes.description: Your increases to physical damage also apply to fire damage for Void Cleave.

nodes.name: Void Cleave Extended Range
nodes.description: You can travel much further with Void Cleave (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it has a longer cooldown and now counts as a {Traversal} skill.

nodes.name: Multistrike Stack Duration And Melee Physical Damage
nodes.description: Armament stacks last longer and grant you additional melee physical damage per stack.

nodes.name: Multistrike Armor And Block Effect Stack Buff
nodes.description: You have additional armor and block effectiveness per stack of Armament.

nodes.name: Multistrike Consume Stacks At 0 Mana To Restore Mana
nodes.description: When you drop below 0 mana, you consume all stacks of Armament to restore mana per stack.

nodes.name: Multistrike Additional Sword At 0 Stacks
nodes.description: When you have 0 stacks of Armament you have an additional sword when using Multistrike, as if you had 1 stack.

nodes.name: Multistrike Smites Instead Of Swords
nodes.description:
Each additional sword is replaced with {Smite}.

Smite cast this way costs its full mana cost per cast.

nodes.name: Multistrike Multistrike On Block With Cooldown
nodes.description:
You have a chance to retaliate with Multistrike swords on block. 

This effect has a 1 second cooldown and doesn't include the initial strike.

nodes.name: Multistrike Additional Swords For Echoes
nodes.description: Multistrike attacks repeated by your {Echoes} have additional swords.

nodes.name: Multistrike Initial Strike More Damage
nodes.description: The initial strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Multistrike More Damage Per Armor
nodes.description: Multistrike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 30 armor, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Multistrike Forge Strike Consumes Stacks To Summon Weapons
nodes.description: Directly using {Forge Strike} consumes all stacks of Armament to summon additional {Forged Weapons} per stack.

nodes.name: Multistrike Chance To Summon Weapon At Max Stacks
nodes.description: Multistrike has a chance to consume a stack of Armament while at maximum stacks to summon a {Forged Weapon}.

nodes.name: Multistrike Double Strike And Axes
nodes.description: You now strike twice with Multistrike, but the full attack takes significantly longer. Each additional sword is now replaced with an axe that strikes its target twice.

nodes.name: Multistrike Base Crit
nodes.description: Improves Multistrike's base critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Multistrike Consume Mana To Refresh All Stacks At Positive Mana
nodes.description: When you create more additional swords than there are nearby enemies, each remaining sword can consume mana to strike the nearest enemy, even if it was hit by the initial attack.

nodes.name: Multistrike Attack Speed
nodes.description: Multistrike has increased attack speed.

nodes.name: Multistrike More Damage At Max Stacks
nodes.description: Multistrike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you are at maximum stacks of Armament.

nodes.name: Multistrike Physical Penetration
nodes.description: Multistrike penetrates enemy physical resistance.

nodes.name: Multistrike Bleed Chance Per Stack
nodes.description: Multistrike hits have a chance to inflict bleed on enemies per stack of Armament.

nodes.name: Multistrike Melee Damage Per Stack Of Bleed
nodes.description: Multistrike deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Multistrike Stabs With Spears Instead Of Swords
nodes.description:
Each additional sword is replaced with a spear, which stabs in an elongated area rather than a slash. This has no effect if swords are already converted to axes.

Additionally, Multistrike's critical strikes deal more damage while wielding a spear.

nodes.name: Multistrike Stikes Within Larger Area
nodes.description: Multistrike deals damage in a larger area and its created swords can strike enemies further away.

nodes.name: Multistrike Strike Another Target On Kill
nodes.description:
If a sword kills an enemy it will create an additional sword to strike another enemy.

This effect cannot be triggered from additional swords created this way.

nodes.name: Multistrike Maximum Stacks
nodes.description: You can have an additional maximum stack of Armament.

nodes.name: Multistrike Maximum Stacks Less Attack Speed Per Stack
nodes.description: You can have an additional maximum stack of Armament, but Multistrike has less attack speed per stack (multipicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Multistrike Consume All Stacks At Max Stacks To Use Forge Strike
nodes.description: While at maximum stacks of Armament and positive mana, attacking with Multistrike will consume all stacks and 40 mana to use {Forge Strike}.

nodes.name: Multistrike Additional Sword At Max Stacks With 2h Weapon
nodes.description: Multistrike has an additional sword while you are at maximum stacks of Armament and wielding a two-handed weapon.

nodes.name: Multistrike Void Cleave Consumes Stacks For More Damage
nodes.description: {Void Cleave} consumes all stacks of Armament to gain more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased area per stack consumed.

nodes.name: Javelin Bleed And Slow Chance
nodes.description: Javelin hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and have a chance to slow.

nodes.name: Javelin More Hit Damage Per Distance
nodes.description: Javelin hits deal more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to enemies the farther away they are, up to a maximum of 15 meters.

nodes.name: Javelin Added Damage While Stationary For 1 second
nodes.description: Javelin gains physical and lightning penetration for each second you have been standing still up to a maximum duration.

nodes.name: Javelin Added Throwing Lightning Damage
nodes.description: Javelin deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its hits deal additional lightning damage.

nodes.name: Javelin Lightning Conversion
nodes.description:
Javelin's base physical damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Ignite and bleed chance from all sources is converted to {Electrify} for Javelin and effects related to bleed or ignite now depend on Electrify instead.

Physical resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to lightning resistance shred chance and effects related to Physical resistance shred now depend on lightning resistance shred instead.

Swaps Javelin's {Physical} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

nodes.name: Javelin Lightning Damage Over Time
nodes.description: Javelin has a chance to {Electrify} enemies on hit. Electrify applied by Javelin has additional Lightning Penetration.

nodes.name: Javelin Splits Instead of Piercing
nodes.description: When Javelin hits an enemy it now splits into additional piercing lightning spears which aim towards enemies close to the target, but Javelin itself can no longer pierce and it costs more mana.

nodes.name: Javelin More Hit Damage To High Health
nodes.description:
Javelin hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled against enemies on high health.

nodes.name: Javelin More Hit Damage Per Enemy Pierced
nodes.description: Javelin hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) up to a maximum, for each enemy pierced.

nodes.name: Javelin Critical Chance
nodes.description: Improves Javelin's base critical strike chance and its critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Javelin Armor Shred Chance
nodes.description: Javelin hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

nodes.name: Javelin Reduced Mana Cost And Less Damage
nodes.description: Javelin costs less mana.

nodes.name: Javelin Next Melee Costs Less Mana
nodes.description: Directly using Javelin causes your next melee attack to costs less mana.

nodes.name: Javelin Next Judgement Or Forge Strike More Damage
nodes.description: Directly using Javelin and hitting an enemy causes your next {Judgement} or {Forge Strike} to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Javelin Damage And Attack Speed
nodes.description: Javelin deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased attack speed.

nodes.name: Javelin Ignite Chance
nodes.description: Javelin hits have a chance to ignite enemies.

nodes.name: Javelin Rain
nodes.description: You now throw Javelin into the air causing 4 javelins to rain down at target location dealing damage in an area, but it costs more mana.

nodes.name: Javelin Rain Is Flag
nodes.description:
Now only 1 Javelin rains down at the target location, it deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and persists for 4 seconds, but has a cooldown.

It has a {Battle Standard} attached granting you and other allies in its radius increased damage and added endurance threshold based on your attunement.

nodes.name: Javelin Flag Healing Aura
nodes.description: The {Battle Standard} now heals allies around it each second. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

nodes.name: Javelin Flag Duration
nodes.description: The {Battle Standard} now lasts longer, but is still limited to one standard.

nodes.name: Javelin Flag Enemy Can Pick Up
nodes.description: If an enemy walks over the {Battle Standard} it captures it and carries the flag until it expires.

nodes.name: Javelin Flag Casts Smite
nodes.description: The {Battle Standard} now casts {Smite} at targets nearby every 1.5 seconds.

nodes.name: Javelin Flag Smite Frequency And Crit Chance
nodes.description: The {Battle Standard} casts {Smite} more frequently and Smite cast this way has improved base critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Javelin Flag Reactivate To Lunge
nodes.description:
Javelin is now a combo ability, the first part throws down the {Battle Standard} and the second part causes you to {Dash} to the flag.

Javelin's cooldown is now longer.

nodes.name: Javelin Rain Added Javelins And Mana Cost
nodes.description: Additional Javelins rain down, but Javelin costs more mana.

nodes.name: Javelin More Damage Over Time
nodes.description: Javelin deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Javelin Attack Speed For Damage
nodes.description: Javelin deals more damage, but has less attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Javelin Holy Trail And Cooldown
nodes.description: Javelin now leaves behind a {Holy Trail}, that deals fire and lightning damage to enemies each second, heals you and your allies each second and lasts for 6 seconds, but Javelin now has a cooldown. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness

nodes.name: Javelin More Fire And Lightning Damage
nodes.description: Javelin deals more fire and lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you have a chance to ignite and electrify enemies with melee attacks while Javelin is on cooldown.

nodes.name: Javelin Alternate Trail Scaling
nodes.description: {Holy Trail} gains additional spell damage based on your increased healing effectiveness.

nodes.name: Javelin Frailty And Phys Shred Chance
nodes.description: Javelin hits have a chance to apply {Frailty} per point of Strength and a chance to shred enemy physical resistance per point of Dexterity.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Attack And Cast Speed
nodes.description: You have increased attack and cast speed while in Swarmblade form.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Bleed Chance
nodes.description: Your Armblade Slash, Dive and {Locust} hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Consume Bleeds To Buff Locusts
nodes.description:
When you create a {Locust Swarm} with Swarm Strike you consume all stacks of bleed from enemies hit by it, causing the {Swarm} to deal increased damage in a larger area per stack of bleed consumed.

The increased area scales up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Poison Chance
nodes.description: Yours and your {Locusts'} hits have a chance to poison enemies.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form More Locusts From Hives
nodes.description: You can control additional {Locusts} and your Hives contain additional {Locusts}.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form More Hives And Charges
nodes.description: Hives release {Locusts} more frequently and if you have an active {Locust Swarm} it also releases Locusts every second.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form To Spriggan
nodes.description:
After using Summon Hive, Human Form is now replaced with {Cleanse Hives}, which releases all {Locusts} from up to 2 Hives, replaces them with {Healing Totems} and transforms you to {Spriggan Form}.

This requires you to have Spriggan Form unlocked.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Health And Rage On Locust Spawn
nodes.description: When a {Hive} releases a {Locust} you regain health and {Rage}.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Attack Own Hives To Release Locusts
nodes.description: Your Armblade Slash can now hit your own Hives which causes them to release {Locusts}.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
The base damage of Swarm Strike, {Locust Swarm}, and Dive is converted to cold, and {Locusts'} base melee damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. These attack all also gain a chance to freeze enemies.

Poison chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance while in Swarmblade Form.

Your {Locusts'} Poison chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Freeze Rate Per Attunement
nodes.description: You and your {Locusts} have a higher chance of freezing enemies per point of Attunement.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Hives Cast Thorns As Totems
nodes.description:
Your Hives now cast {Thorns} using your {Thorn Totem} skill tree, rather than releasing {Locusts}.

Your Hives are not totems, and are not affected by totem modifiers.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Dodge And Armor
nodes.description: You and your {Locusts} have a higher chance to dodge and additional armor while in Swarmblade Form.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Cast Maelstrom On Dash
nodes.description:
You cast {Maelstrom} a number of times when you Dive. 

This consumes a portion of Maelstrom's mana cost as {Rage}.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Rage Gained On Dodge
nodes.description: You gain {Rage} when you dodge.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Dodge Rating To Armor
nodes.description: All of your dodge rating is converted to armor while in Swarmblade Form.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Increased Spin Area
nodes.description: Your Swarm Strike, {Locust Swarm} and your {Locusts'} melee attacks all deal damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Leech From Locusts
nodes.description: Your {Locust Swarm} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health to you

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Locusts Increased Duration
nodes.description: {Locust Swarm} has more duration and Swarm Strike hits deal more damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form To Werebear
nodes.description:
After using Swarm Strike, Human Form is now replaced with {Angered Swarm}, which adds 4 seconds to the duration of your {Locust Swarm} and transforms you to {Werebear Form}.

This requires you to have Werebear Form unlocked.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Companions Use Ability On Spin
nodes.description: A random active companion uses its active ability after you directly use Swarm Strike.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Locusts Buff Per Locust
nodes.description: Your {Locust Swarm} deals more damage per {Locust} consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers) and while the Locust Swarm is active you have additional chance to poison on hit per {Locust} consumed.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Melee Physical Damage For You And Locusts
nodes.description: You and your {Locusts} deal additional melee physical damage while in Swarmblade Form and your {Locust Swarm} deals additional melee physical damage per active {Locust} consumed when you use Swarm Strike.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Crit Chance For You And Locusts
nodes.description: You and your {Locusts} have improved base critical strike chance while in Swarmblade Form.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Rage Gain On Crits
nodes.description: You regain {Rage} when you or your {Locusts} critically hit.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Slashes Use Serpent Strike
nodes.description:
Your {Serpent Strike} tree now applies to Armblade Slashes, and it does not require a spear.

This effect does not include the base additional poison chance or increased poison duration from Serpent Strike.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Gain Health Or Rage On Kill Or Hit
nodes.description: You regain health and {Rage} when you or your {Locusts} kill an enemy or when you hit a rare enemy or boss.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Consume Stacks To Cast Tornado
nodes.description:
You gain a stack of {Howling Cascade} when you use Armblade Slash and hit at least one enemy. Reaching 6 stacks consumes them to cast {Tornado}.

This consumes Tornado's mana cost.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Reduce Stacks To Proc Tornado
nodes.description: Reduce the maximum stacks of {Howling Cascade} required to cast {Tornado}, and tornadoes cast via Howling Cascade deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Slash Storm Bolt
nodes.description: When you use Armblade Slash and hit at least one enemy, you consume rage to gain a {Storm Stack}.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Swarm Minion Damage
nodes.description: {Locust Swarm} now scales with your minion damage rather than your damage.
