nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Hive Spawn Fewer Locusts And They Are Better
nodes.description: You can only control half as many {Locusts}, but they have significantly more health, deal significantly more damage in a larger area (all multiplicative with other modifiers) and are larger.

nodes.name: Swarmblade Form Dive And Swarmstrike Damage Plus Rage On Hit
nodes.description: Swarm Strike and Dive deal more damage and you regain {Rage} on hit with both skills.

nodes.name: Upheaval Root Node
nodes.description: Sunders the ground in a line in front of you, dealing damage to enemies along the path.

nodes.name: Upheaval Creates Totem
nodes.description:
You now create an {Upheaval Totem} that attacks with Upheaval from it rather than yourself. You are limited to 1 of these totems. Upheaval now has a cooldown and costs significantly more mana.

Upheaval Totems last 8 seconds.

nodes.name: Upheaval Earth Shattering On Hit
nodes.description: When you directly use Upheaval and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of {Earth Shattering} up to a maximum, causing your next {Fury Leap} or {Earthquake} to consume all stacks to gain additional physical penetration and increased area per stack consumed.

nodes.name: Upheaval 3 Lines
nodes.description:
Upheaval now splits up into 3 fault lines in front of you, but Upheaval costs additional mana. Enemies can only be hit by 1 Fault Line at a time.

Upheaval Totems now have 50% less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Upheaval 5 Lines
nodes.description: Upheaval now travels in 5 fault lines in a star around you.

nodes.name: Upheaval Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Upheaval's base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Upheaval has a chance to freeze enemies on hit.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance and slow chance from all sources is converted to chill chance.

nodes.name: Upheaval Shockwave On Enemy Hit
nodes.description: When Upheaval hits an enemy it has a chance to release a {Shockwave}, a melee physical subskill. The Shockwave cannot hit enemies already hit by Upheaval and vice versa.

nodes.name: Upheaval Reduced Mana And Armor Shred
nodes.description: Upheaval costs less mana and has a chance to shred enemy armor.

nodes.name: Upheaval Cannot Miss Added Crit
nodes.description: Improves Upheaval's base critical strike chance and it cannot be dodged.

nodes.name: Upheaval Crit Multi
nodes.description: Upheaval critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Upheaval Thorn Totem Consumption
nodes.description: Creating an Upheaval Totem consumes all active {Thorn Totems} to grant it more damage per totem consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers). You can now create an additional maximum Upheaval totem and you have an additional charge.

nodes.name: Upheaval Max Totems
nodes.description: You can now create an additional maximum Upheaval Totem and you have an additional charge.

nodes.name: Upheaval More Melee Damage To Frozen
nodes.description: Upheaval deals additional melee cold damage, and also deals more melee damage to frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Upheaval Freeze Rate
nodes.description: Upheaval has additional freeze rate and has additional chance to inflict Frostbite on hit.

nodes.name: Upheaval Shatter On Frozen Kill
nodes.description: You cast {Shatter} on enemies you kill with Upheaval, a spell subskill dealing cold damage in an area.

nodes.name: Upheaval Additional Lines
nodes.description: Upheaval now creates additional fault lines and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but costs more mana.

nodes.name: Upheaval Bleed And Slow Chance
nodes.description:
Upheaval hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and have a chance to slow them.

This effect is doubled while using a two handed weapon.

nodes.name: Upheaval Increased Area
nodes.description: Upheaval deals damage in a wider area.

nodes.name: Upheaval Earth Armor On Hit
nodes.description: When you use Upheaval and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of {Earth Armor} for 6 seconds up to a maximum amount of stacks, granting you additional armor and endurance threshold per stack of Attunement.

nodes.name: Upheaval Consumes Earth Armor To Cast Maelstrom
nodes.description: While you have {Earth Armor}, if you fall below 6 stacks of {Maelstrom} you consume all stacks of Earth Armor to cast Maelstrom once per stack consumed.

nodes.name: Upheaval Increased Range
nodes.description: Upheaval travels further.

nodes.name: Upheaval No Attack Speed Scaling More Damage
nodes.description:
Upheaval deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies, but no longer scales with modifiers to attack speed.

These effects are doubled when Upheaval is directly used.

nodes.name: Upheaval Phys And Cold Pen Doubled With 2H
nodes.description:
Upheaval penetrates enemy physical and cold resistance.

This effect is doubled while using a two handed weapon.

nodes.name: Upheaval Area Bleed Or Damage From Weapon
nodes.description: Upheaval has increased area while using a mace, additional bleed chance while using an axe and additional cold penetration while using a staff.

nodes.name: Upheaval More Damage And Stun Chance
nodes.description: Upheaval deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a higher chance to stun enemies.

nodes.name: Upheaval More Damage To Closer
nodes.description: Upheaval deals more melee damage to enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on how close they are to you, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Upheaval Frailty Chance and Phys Pen Less Range
nodes.description: Upheaval hits have a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies and it penetrates enemy physical resistance, but travels a shorter distance.

nodes.name: Upheaval Shockwave On Totem Hit
nodes.description: When Upheaval hits your totems it has a chance to release a {Shockwave} from the totem.

nodes.name: Upheaval Buff On Totem Hit
nodes.description: Upheaval hits grant your totems increased armor and more damage (each stack multiplicative with each other and other modifiers) for 4 seconds. This effect can stack up to 4 times.

nodes.name: Upheaval Shatters Totems
nodes.description: Upheaval and {Shockwave} hits from the {Sundering Strikes} node now {Shatter} totems, releasing shards of rock and debris dealing spell physical damage and heals you per point of Attunement.

nodes.name: Upheaval Totem Duration
nodes.description: Upheaval Totems last longer, and they deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Dusk Shroud Chance
nodes.description: You have a chance to gain {Dusk Shroud} when you use Umbral Blades and hit at least one enemy.

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Only 1 Blade
nodes.description: You now throw just one large Umbral Blade with each throw that deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased radius.

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Crit Chance
nodes.description: Umbral Blades has additional critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Crit Multi Per Blade
nodes.description: Umbral Blades has additional critical strike multiplier for each blade being thrown or recalled by the attack, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Shadow Dagger If Dagger Equipped
nodes.description: Umbral Blades hits inflict a stack of {Shadow Dagger} on hit, while using a dagger.

nodes.name: Umbral Blades More Damage Per Dusk Shroud
nodes.description: Umbral Blades deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of {Dusk Shroud} on you, up to 20.

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Shadows Leave Umbral Blade
nodes.description: Whenever one of your {Shadows} expire they now also leave behind an Umbral Blade. This effect can happen a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Attack Speed And Ward On Recall
nodes.description: Umbral Blades has increased attack speed and you gain ward on hit with recalled blades.

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Recalled Blades Go To Enemies Instead
nodes.description: Recalling the blades now sends each blade toward a different nearby enemy instead of to you, but recalled blades no longer pierce.

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Recalled Blades Pierce Chance
nodes.description: Recalled blades now have a chance to pierce enemies (pass through enemies it hits).

nodes.name: Umbral Blades No Recall Shift Recalls
nodes.description:
You can now only recall blades by using {Shift}, rather than the combo itself.

You regain mana for each blade recalled.

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Less Damage More Recall Damage
nodes.description: Recalled blades deal more damage, but blades thrown out deal less damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Recall Slow And Bleed Chance
nodes.description: Recalled blade hits have a chance to slow enemies and a chance to cause them to bleed.

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Recall More Hit Damage Per Slow And Bleed
nodes.description: Recalled blade hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of slow on the target and per bleed on the target, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Haste Chance When Recalling And Bleed Chance
nodes.description:
Umbral Blades hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed. 

When your blades are recalled you have a chance to gain {Haste} for 1 second.

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Bleed Converted To Poison
nodes.description:
Converts bleed chance from all sources to poison chance for Umbral Blades and effects related to bleed now depend on poison instead. 

If you have the {Explosive Blades}, the explosion hit poisons enemies, but deals 80% less damage and it no longer deals any fire damage.

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Extra Blade On Throw 2
nodes.description: You now throw additional blades with Umbral Blades on the second throw.

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Extra Blade Every 2 Seconds
nodes.description: Every 2 seconds you throw additional blades with Umbral Blades on the next throw.

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Added Throwing Physical Damage
nodes.description: Umbral Blades deals additional throwing physical damage.

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Throw 3 Added To Combo
nodes.description: You now throw a third time with Umbral Blades with 4 blades before recalling the blades.

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Throw 3 Has Extra Blades
nodes.description: You now throw additional blades with Umbral Blades on the third throw.

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Umbral Blades base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Swaps Umbral Blades' {Physical} tag for a {Cold} tag. Bleed chance from all sources is converted to Frostbite chance.

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Freeze Rate And Chill Chance
nodes.description: Umbral Blades hits have additional freeze rate and have a chance to chill enemies.

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Stops At Cursor Location
nodes.description: Umbral Blades now throw towards a fixed distance in front of you, and you have increased attack speed with Umbral Blades.

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Explosive Blades
nodes.description:
Blades in the ground now arm after 0.5 seconds, but can no longer be recalled and Umbral Blades has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers). If enemies walk over them the blades will cause a {Shard Explosion}, a subskill dealing physical damage in an area.

Blades expire and explode after 3 seconds if no enemies walk over them.

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Explosive Blades Area And More Damage Per Second
nodes.description: The {Shard Explosion} deals damage in a larger area and deals more damage per second the blade has remained on the ground (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Umbral Blades Blade Leaves Shadow Chance
nodes.description: Recalled blades have a chance to create a {Shadow} at their position.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Explosion More Damage Per Slow
nodes.description: The {Glyph} explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of slow on the target.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Explosion Mana Efficiency And More Damage
nodes.description: Glyph of Dominion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and costs less mana.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Can Place Two Glyphs
nodes.description: You can now place down up to two Glyphs of Dominion, but Glyph of Dominion costs more mana. When the first {Glyph} explodes the second one does too. The second explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) the further it is from the first one up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Expands Slower
nodes.description: Glyph of Dominion expands slower and lasts a longer (both multiplicative with other modifiers). This increases the time before it reaches its full size to detonate.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Expands Faster
nodes.description: Glyph of Dominion expands faster and lasts a shorter duration (both multiplicative with other modifiers). This decreases the time before it reaches its full size to detonate.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Expands Faster Per Missing Mana
nodes.description: Glyph of Dominion expands faster and lasts a shorter duration (both multiplicative with other modifiers) per amount of missing mana. This decreases the time before it reaches its full size to detonate.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Delay Before Explosion
nodes.description: After Glyph of Dominion reaches its full size it now has a short delay before it detonates.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Adds Cooldown Gains Damage Per Rune
nodes.description: Glyph of Dominion now has a cooldown, which is refreshed whenever you directly cast {Runic Invocation}. It also deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per rune from {Runic Invocation}, without consuming them.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Consumes Runes
nodes.description:
Glyph of Dominion now consumes the {Runes} from {Runic Invocation} on cast to gain additional effects per {Rune} you have. 

{Rah Rune}: Glyph deals more damage in a larger area per {Rune} of this type.
{Gon Rune}: Glyph detonates additional times during the delay per {Rune} of this type.
{Heo Rune}: Glyph inflicts stacks of Frostbite per second per {Rune} of this type.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Added Charges
nodes.description: Glyph of Dominion has additional charges and all charges are refreshed whenever you directly cast {Runic Invocation}.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Delay Casts Elemental Nova And Fire Aura
nodes.description: You cast {Elemental Nova} in the middle of the {Glyph} if you stand inside it when the delay from {Doom Scribe} starts and you gain stacks of {Fire Aura}.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Damage Over Time Accelerates
nodes.description: Glyph of Dominion's damage over time part deals more damage for each second it is active (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion More Damage Per Armor Shred
nodes.description: While standing on your {Glyph} you and your allies deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of Armor Shred on the enemy, up to a maximum of 14 stacks.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion More Damage Over Time
nodes.description: Glyph of Dominion deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Grants Disintegrate Damage And Ward
nodes.description: {Disintegrate} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and grants you ward per second if you start channelling it while standing on your {Glyph}.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Increased Area
nodes.description: Glyph of Dominion deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Casts On Self And Grants Ward
nodes.description: Glyph of Dominion is now cast at your current location and it grants you and your allies ward per second per your uncapped resistance while standing on your {Glyph}.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Grants Resistances
nodes.description: You and your allies gain additional resistances while standing on your {Glyph}.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Grants Static Charges
nodes.description: After casting Glyph of Dominion you gain {Static Charges} at an accelerating rate while standing still, until your {Glyph} detonates.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Grants Haste And Cleanses
nodes.description:
Whenever you or your allies enters your Glyph of Dominion it cleanses ailments and grants the {Haste} buff for a short duration.

Leaving and re-entering the same {Glyph} does not cause this effect to trigger again.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Grants Shock Chance
nodes.description: You and your allies gain additional Shock chance while standing on your {Glyph}.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Constantly Stuns
nodes.description: Normal and Magic enemies have a chance to be stunned every half second while on your {Glyph}.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Grants Lightning Blast Chains
nodes.description: Your {Lightning Blast} now chains while you are standing on your {Glyph}, but consumes mana when cast this way while you are at positive mana.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Grants Increased Area
nodes.description: You and your allies gain increased area to spells and attacks while standing on your {Glyph}.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Fire Conversion
nodes.description:
{Glyph of Dominion's} base lightning damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to ignite for Glyph of Dominion and effects related to shock now depend on ignite instead.

Swaps {Glyph of Dominion's} {Lightning} tag for a {Fire} tag.

Ignite chance is halved for minions and other allies.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Constantly Ignites
nodes.description: Glyph of Dominion ignites enemies on the {Glyph} every half second.

nodes.name: Glyph Of Dominion Ignite Frequency Per Ignite Chance
nodes.description: The ignite frequency from {Burning Symbol} is increased by your chance to ignite.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Auto Lightning Blast Pylons
Frost Wall Lightning Blast Pylons Frequency
Frost Wall More Hit Damage Per Enemy Pass Through
Frost Wall Ward And Mana On Pass Through
Frost Wall Explosion More Damage And Area
Frost Wall Explosion More Area And Damage From Direction
Frost Wall Flame Ward On Pass Through
Frost Wall Increased Area And Duration
Frost Wall More Damage To Chilled Enemies With Wall
Frost Wall More Hit Damage From Duration
Frost Wall Moves And Mana Gain
Frost Wall Spell Damage Per Freeze Multi
Frost Wall Freezes Normal And Magic Enemies
Frost Wall Ward On Pass Through
Frost Wall Ward On Pass Through From Enemy Health
Frost Wall Brands Enemies With Big Fire Damage
Frost Wall Fireball On Pass Through
Frost Wall Casts Runebolts Matching Wall Type
Frost Wall Frostbite Through Wall
nodes.description: Frost Wall has a chance to inflict a stack of Frostbite to enemies inside the wall every 0.25 seconds.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Lightning Blast Pylon
nodes.description:
One of Frost Wall's {Pillars} now casts {Lightning Blast} at nearby enemies when you first pass through the wall.

This effect consumes mana equal to {Lightning Blast's} mana cost.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Auto Lightning Blast Pylons
nodes.description:
Frost Wall's outer {Pillars} cast {Lightning Blast} at nearby enemies every other second.

This effect consumes mana equal to {Lightning Blast's} mana cost.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Lightning Blast Pylons Frequency
nodes.description: After Frost Wall has existed for a short duration, its outer {Pillars} cast {Lightning Blast} more often, up to a maximum, every time an enemy passes through the wall.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Empowers Runic Invocation
nodes.description:
After you pass through your Frost Wall your next {Runic Invocation} or {Glyph of Dominion} cast within 5 seconds is empowered. 

An empowered spell cast this way, costs less mana (multiplicative with other modifiers) and it also deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second the wall has existed, before you walk through it.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Cleanses
nodes.description: Frost Wall now cleanses negative ailments on you and your allies when they first pass through the wall.

nodes.name: Frost Wall More Damage And Freeze Rate Multi
nodes.description: Frost Wall deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a higher chance to freeze enemies.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Ward And Mana On Pass Through
nodes.description:
Frost Wall now grants you and your allies ward and mana when they first pass through the wall.

These effects are doubled if the wall is placed at least 2 meters away from you.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Haste And Frenzy
nodes.description:
Frost Wall now grants the {Haste} and {Frenzy} buffs for a short duration, up to a maximum, when you and your allies first pass through the wall.

The maximum duration is equal to Frost Wall's age plus 1 second.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Explodes
nodes.description: Frost Wall now creates three {Runic Detonations} shortly after you pass through it, dealing spell cold damage to nearby enemies.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Explosion More Damage And Area
nodes.description: The {Runic Detonations} from {Runic Conclusion} intensify, destroying the wall in the process and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Explosion More Area And Damage From Direction
nodes.description: The {Runic Detonations} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area if you are facing away from the wall when the detonations occur.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Flame Ward On Pass Through
nodes.description:
You now cast Flame Ward on you or your allies (excluding their minions) that pass through your Frost Wall, if it has existed for at least 0.2 seconds.

Frost Wall now has a cooldown, which it shares with Flame Ward. Using one will put the other on cooldown.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Empowered After 15 Seconds
nodes.description: If you haven't cast Frost Wall in the past 15 seconds, it has no mana cost and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Frost Wall Increased Area And Duration
nodes.description: Frost Wall is larger and lasts longer.

nodes.name: Frost Wall More Damage To Chilled Enemies With Wall
nodes.description: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to chilled enemies while you have an active Frost Wall.

nodes.name: Frost Wall More Damage From Duration
nodes.description:
Frost Wall deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second the wall has existed.

This does not affect ailments or subskills.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Moves And Mana Gain
nodes.description: When you cast Frost Wall while having an existing wall active with more than half its duration remaining, the existing wall is moved to the new target location instead of being replaced and you gain mana equal to half the Frost Wall’s mana cost.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Spell Damage Per Freeze Multi
nodes.description: Frost Wall deals additional spell damage equal to a portion of your freeze rate multiplier.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Increased Freeze Duration And Damage To Frozen
nodes.description:
Frost Wall's initial freeze has increased duration, and the wall deals more damage over time to frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This does not affect ailments or subskills.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Ward On Pass Through
nodes.description: You are granted ward whenever enemies pass through the wall for the first time.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Ward On Pass Through From Enemy Health
nodes.description: Whenever an enemy passes through the wall for the first time, and after it has existed for 0.2 seconds, you gain ward equal to a small portion of the enemy's maximum health, up to a maximum amount of ward per enemy.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Fire Conversion
nodes.description:
{Frost Wall's} base cold damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to cold damage.

For Frost Wall, chill chance from all sources is converted to {Ignite}, and Frostbite chance from all sources is converted to {Fire Resistance Shred}.

Swaps {Frost Wall's} {Cold} tag for a {Fire} tag.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Brands Enemies With Big Fire Damage
nodes.description:
Frost Wall now inflicts Brand of Trespass to enemies inside the wall. This Brand does not stack, but deals a large amount of fire damage over time.

Brand of Trespass deals more damage equal to your ignite chance.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Fireball On Pass Through
nodes.description:
Whenever an enemy passes through your Frost Wall, you have a chance to cast {Fireball} towards them.

This effect consumes mana equal to {Fireball's} mana cost.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Lightning Conversion
nodes.description:
{Frost Wall's} base cold damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage.

For Frost Wall, chill chance from all sources is converted to {Slow}, and Frostbite chance from all sources is converted to {Shock}.

Swaps Frost Wall's {Cold} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Casts Runebolts Matching Wall Type
nodes.description:
Frost Wall now casts {Runebolt} in the original target direction the Wall was cast. The element of the bolts match the element of the Wall, regardless of {Runebolt's} tree.

This effect consumes 2 mana per projectile and does not cast if you are at negative mana.

nodes.name: Frost Wall Runebolt Frequency
nodes.description: Frost Wall casts {Runebolt} more often.

nodes.name: Flame Rush Mana Efficiency And CDR With Fire Res
nodes.description: Flame Rush costs less mana and has a shorter cooldown. These effects are doubled if you have enough uncapped fire resistance.

nodes.name: Flame Rush Damage Per 40 Current Mana
nodes.description: Flame Rush deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 40 current mana.

nodes.name: Flame Rush No Channel But Casts Glyph Of Dominion
nodes.description:
Flame Rush now casts {Glyph of Dominion} at the target location instead of channeling and Flame Rush ends when reaching the Glyph.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of {Glyph of Dominion's} mana cost.

nodes.name: Flame Rush Creates Volcanic Orb
nodes.description:
Flame Rush now casts {Volcanic Orb} that is attached to you and only detonates when you end Flame Rush, alongside any other active {Volcanic Orbs}.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of {Volcanic Orb's} mana cost.

nodes.name: Flame Rush Less Damage Taken
nodes.description:
You take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) during Flame Rush.

This effect is doubled against damage over time effects.

nodes.name: Flame Rush All Buffs Stick Around After
nodes.description: All buff effects from the Flame Rush tree persist afterwards for a portion of the time equal to the duration you spent in Flame Rush.

nodes.name: Flame Rush Ward Per Second
nodes.description: You gain ward per second during Flame Rush and you gain a burst of ward when Flame Rush ends.

nodes.name: Flame Rush Lightning Conversion
nodes.description:
{Flame Rush's} base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

{Fire Resistance Shred} chance from all sources is converted to {Lightning Resistance Shred} for Flame Rush and effects related to Fire Shred now depend on Lightning Shred instead.

Swaps {Flame Rush's} {Fire} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

nodes.name: Flame Rush Casts Static Orb In Opposite Direction
nodes.description:
Flame Rush now also casts a {Static Orb} in the opposite direction.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of {Static Orb's} mana cost.

nodes.name: Flame Rush Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
{Flame Rush's} base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

{Lightning Resistance Shred} chance from all sources is converted to {Cold Resistance Shred} for Flame Rush and effects related to Lightning Shred now depend on Cold Shred instead.

Swaps {Flame Rush's} {Lightning} tag for a {Cold} tag.

nodes.name: Flame Rush Brand Of Subjugation
nodes.description: Flame Rush now inflicts {Brand of Subjugation} to enemies you pass through. The Brand does not stack but deals a large amount of cold damage over time and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per your chance to chill.

nodes.name: Flame Rush Frenzy After Travel
nodes.description: You are granted the {Frenzy} buff for a short duration when you end Flame Rush.

nodes.name: Flame Rush Auto Cast Runic Invocation
nodes.description:
You cast {Runic Invocation} when you exit Flame Rush, if you have it on your action bar.

This effect consumes mana equal to a percentage of {Runic Invocation's} mana cost.

nodes.name: Flame Rush Boosted After Fireball Cast
nodes.description: Casting {Fireball} and then using Flame Rush in the same direction within 2 seconds causes that Flame Rush to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area and grants you mana on cast.

nodes.name: Flame Rush Casts Runic Burst With Fireball During Rush
nodes.description: Whenever you hit an enemy with {Fireball} during Flame Rush it causes a {Runic Burst} around the target.

nodes.name: Flame Rush Fire Shred On Pass Through
nodes.description: Flame Rush now applies {Fire Resistance Shred} on enemies it passes through.

nodes.name: Flame Rush Consumes Ignites To Gain Ward
nodes.description:
Whenever you pass through an ignited enemy you gain ward and consume all your ignite stacks on that enemy. 

Consuming your ignite stacks this way grants you ward per your ignite stack on them, but they don't deal their remaining damage.

nodes.name: Flame Rush Consumes Ignites To Deal Their Damage Instantly
nodes.description:
Whenever you pass through an ignited enemy with Flame Rush, instead of gaining ward per stack of ignite on the enemy and consuming your ignite stacks without dealing damage, you lose 12 ward per stack of ignite and the ignite stacks instantly deal their remaining damage on the enemy.

If you do not have enough ward for this effect, a percentage of your remaining health is consumed instead, up to a maximum. Ignite stacks consumed this way deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per point of intelligence.

nodes.name: Flame Rush Increased Travel Speed And Distance
nodes.description: You travel faster and further with Flame Rush.

nodes.name: Flame Rush More Damage And Area
nodes.description: Flame Rush deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

nodes.name: Flame Rush More Area And Double Crit When Pass Through Frost Wall
nodes.description: Whenever you pass through a {Frost Wall} during Flame Rush it causes the explosion to deal damage in a much larger area and its chance to critically hit is doubled.

nodes.name: Flame Rush Creates Rune Embers During Rush
nodes.description: Every 0.4 seconds during Flame Rush you create a {Rune Ember}, up to a maximum. Every 0.25 seconds while not in Flame Rush you fire a {Rune Ember} at a nearby enemy if you have any.

nodes.name: Flame Rush Rune Embers Damage
nodes.description: {Rune Embers} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Flame Rush Creates Additional Rune Embers On Cast
nodes.description: Casting Flame Rush creates additional {Rune Embers}.

nodes.name: Flame Rush Rune Embers Pierce
nodes.description: {Rune Embers} now pierce enemies.

nodes.name: Flame Rush Increased Rune Embers Frequency And Embers On Kill
nodes.description: You now have a chance to create a {Rune Ember} on kill during Flame Rush and you create {Rune Embers} faster during Flame Rush.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation More Damage Per Rune Consumed
nodes.description: Runic Invocation deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Rune} consumed.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Leap Backwards On Cast
nodes.description:
When you directly cast Runic Invocation you leap backwards a short distance. In this state you take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). 

Directly cast Runic Invocations deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

The effect of {Enigma} no longer works when taking this node.

Runic Invocation gains the {Movement} tag.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Leap Forward
nodes.description:
When you directly cast Runic Invocation now leap forwards instead of backwards. 

The effect of {Enigma} no longer works when taking this node.

Runic Invocation gains the {Movement} tag.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Autocast From First 2 Runes
nodes.description:
During the leap you also cast the Invocation corresponding to your first two {Runes}, consuming its mana cost.

Your Invocation must have at least two runes for this effect to occur.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Autocast From First Rune
nodes.description:
During the leap you also cast the Invocation corresponding to your first {Rune}, consuming its mana cost.

Your Invocation must have at least one rune for this effect to occur.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Mana Efficiency And Ward Per Rune
nodes.description: Runic Invocation grants ward per {Rune} consumed and on direct casts you refund a portion of its mana cost.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Cast Speed And Mana Gained As Ward
nodes.description: Runic Invocation has increased cast speed and when directly casting an {Invocation} you gain ward equal to a portion of your current mana.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Next Non Channel Cast Is Empowered
nodes.description: When you directly cast Runic Invocation, the next non-channelled elemental spell you cast penetrates enemy elemental resistance and deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Auto Cast Chance From Other Skills Consuming Runes
nodes.description: When you consume {Runes} with a skill other than Runic Invocation you have a chance to also cast the corresponding {Invocation} for those runes.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Area
nodes.description: {Invocations} that deal damage in an area now deal damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Rah Rune Boost
nodes.description: {Invocations} that include at least one {Rah Rune} have a chance to ignite enemies and deal additional spell fire damage.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Grants Passive Buffs With Runes
nodes.description:
Runes now provide you with passive effects while you have them.

{Rah Rune}: Grants increased mana regeneration per {Rune} of this type.
{Gon Rune}: Grants ward per second per {Rune} of this type.
{Heo Rune}: Grants a higher chance to freeze enemies per {Rune} of this type.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Runic Energy Stacks Every Second
nodes.description: Every second you go without casting a Runic Invocation you gain a stack of {Runic Energy} up to a maximum. {Invocations} consume all {Runic Energy} to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Runic Energy}.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Proc Random Skill From Bar With 12 Runic Energy
nodes.description:
When you directly cast Runic Invocation with at least 12 {Runic Energy} you also proc a random equipped non-channeling skill of the same element as each of the {Runes} consumed.

This effect consumes these skills' mana costs and puts them on cooldown (excluding movement skills and skills that are currently on cooldown).

These skills are cast at 0.24 second intervals after the {Invocation}.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Chance To Repeat Per Runic Energy
nodes.description: Runic Invocation now has a chance to be repeated per stack of {Runic Energy}.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Gain Runic Energy When Rune Combination Changes
nodes.description: While you have 3 runes and your combination of runes changes without casting an invocation, you gain {Runic Energy}.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation More Max Runic Energy But Bonuses Halved And Runic Energy Per Mana Spent
nodes.description: Your maximum {Runic Energy} is tripled, but bonuses per {Runic Energy} are halved. When you cast a skill you gain {Runic Energy} per mana spent.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Runic Energy Stacks Faster Until Invocation Repeat
nodes.description: Each unique {Invocation} you directly cast causes {Runic Energy} to accumulate faster until you repeat an {Invocation}.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Heo Rune Boost
nodes.description: {Invocations} that include at least one {Heo Rune} have a chance to chill enemies and have a higher chance to freeze them.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Cooldown Costs No Mana More Damage
nodes.description: Directly casting Runic Invocation now refunds its mana cost and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it now has a cooldown when cast this way.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Gain Runes Depending On Skills On Bar In Sequence
nodes.description:
Whenever you gain a {Rune}, instead of it depending on the type of skill cast, it always results in your sequence of {Runes} mirroring the first three skills on your action bar from left to right.

This effect ignores skills that don't have an elemental tag.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Cooldown Recovery
nodes.description: Runic Invocation has a shorter cooldown.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Reduce Cooldown Without Casting Invocation With 3 Runes
nodes.description: While you have 3 {Runes} and your combination of {Runes} changes without casting an {Invocation}, Runic Invocation's remaining cooldown is reduced.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Blink Traversal
nodes.description:
Whenever you directly cast an {Invocation} you blink to the target location first, but Runic Invocation now has a cooldown. 

{Invocations} cast this way automatically targets a random nearby enemy.

Runic Invocation gains the {Traversal} tag.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Spell Damage And Cast Speed Buff Per Rune Consumed
nodes.description:
After casting Runic Invocation you gain additional spell damage and cast speed for a short duration. 

The buff duration scales with amount of {Runes} consumed.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Gon Rune Boost
nodes.description: {Invocations} that include at least one {Gon Rune} have a chance to shock enemies and have a higher chance to critically hit enemies.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation More Damage Per Type Of Rune Consumed
nodes.description: Runic Invocation deals more damage per type of {Rune} consumed.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Ward Per Int From Only Different Runes
nodes.description: When you cast an {Invocation} using a sequence of three different {Runes} you gain ward per point of intelligence.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Autocast Elemental Nova But Adds Mana Cost
nodes.description:
Whenever you cast Runic Invocation, you also cast up to one of each type of {Elemental Nova} that you can cast directly. Each unique {Rune} you have when casting Runic Invocation represents different {Elemental Nova}. 

These {Novas} are cast with a 0.3 second interval.

This effect consumes mana equal to {Elemental Nova's} mana cost.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Faster Runes from Channel
nodes.description:
You gain {Runes} faster while channelling.

You gain a burst of ward based on your maximum mana when your number of runes increases from channelling.

nodes.name: Runic Invocation Penetration Per Intelligence
nodes.description: Runic Invocation penetrates elemental resistances per point of Intelligence.

nodes.name: Runebolt Cast Speed And Haste Chance
nodes.description: Runebolt has increased cast speed and it has a chance to grant you the {Haste} buff for a short duration.

nodes.name: Runebolt More Cold Damage
nodes.description: Runebolt deals more cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Runebolt Convert Lightning To Cold
nodes.description:
The {Lightning Bolt's} base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to {Chill} for Runebolt and effects related to shock now depend on chill instead.

Swaps the {Lightning Bolt's} {Lightning} tag for a {Cold} tag.

nodes.name: Runebolt Convert Fire To Cold
nodes.description:
The {Fire Bolt's} base fire damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to {Chill} for Runebolt and effects related to ignite now depend on chill instead.

Swaps the {Fire Bolt's} {Fire} tag for a {Cold} tag.

nodes.name: Runebolt More Lightning Damage
nodes.description: Runebolt deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Runebolt Convert Cold To Lightning
nodes.description:
The {Cold Bolt's} base cold damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Chill chance from all sources is converted to {Shock} for Runebolt and effects related to chill now depend on shock instead.

Swaps the {Cold Bolt's} {Cold} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

nodes.name: Runebolt Convert Fire To Lightning
nodes.description:
The {Fire Bolt's} base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to {Shock} for Runebolt and effects related to ignite now depend on shock instead.

Swaps the {Fire Bolt's} {Fire} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

nodes.name: Runebolt More Fire Damage
nodes.description: Runebolt deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Runebolt Convert Lightning To Fire
nodes.description:
The {Lightning Bolt's} base lightning damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to ignite for Runebolt and effects related to shock now depend on ignite instead.

Swaps the {Lightning Bolt's} {Lightning} tag for a {Fire} tag.

nodes.name: Runebolt Convert Cold To Fire
nodes.description:
The {Cold Bolt's} base cold damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to cold damage.

{Frostbite} chance from all sources is converted to ignite for Runebolt and effects related to {Frostbite} now depend on ignite instead.

Swaps the {Cold Bolt's} {Cold} tag for a {Fire} tag.

nodes.name: Runebolt Random And Chance To Double Cast
nodes.description:
Runebolt now randomly selects the element with each cast rather than by combo order. 

Directly casting Rune Bolt now has a chance to double cast if the previous cast was a different type. The chance is based on the amount of {Glyph of Chaos} you have in your crafting inventory.

nodes.name: Runebolt Extra Projectiles
nodes.description: Runebolt has a chance to shoot additional projectiles in a volley in front of you.

nodes.name: Runebolt Extra Projectiles In Glyph
nodes.description: Runebolt's chance to shoot extra projectiles from the {Arcane Overcharge} node and the amount of projectiles are doubled while standing in a {Glyph of Dominion}.

nodes.name: Runebolt Cone And Auto Target
nodes.description: Runebolt now shoots in a cone and the projectiles seek out enemies.

nodes.name: Runebolt Health Ward Or Mana
nodes.description: Directly casting Runebolt and hitting at least one enemy grants you health if it was a {Fire Bolt}, ward if it was a {Lightning Bolt} and mana if it was a {Cold Bolt}.

nodes.name: Runebolt Tri Elemental
nodes.description:
If your last three direct casts were all Runebolt, then any further cast of it becomes tri-elemental (fire, lightning and cold). Tri-elemental Runebolt deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and applies all the effects of the {Attuned Recovery} node.

Once you directly cast another skill, Runebolt loses all of these effects.

nodes.name: Runebolt Empowered By Frost Wall
nodes.description: When Runebolt passes through a {Frost Wall} it is intensified dealing more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and gains increased projectile speed.

nodes.name: Runebolt Armor Shred Chance
nodes.description: Runebolt hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

nodes.name: Runebolt Physical Damage Per Highest Strength
nodes.description: Runebolt deals additional physical damage per point of strength of you or your nearby ally with the highest amount of strength.

nodes.name: Runebolt Creates Or Shoots From Runestone
nodes.description:
Directly casting Runebolt now creates a {Runestone} in front of you if you do not currently have one nearby instead of casting a Runebolt. If you have a nearby {Runestone}, directly using Runebolt now casts two bolts from the {Runestone} towards the target.  

After several seconds {Runestone} consumes mana to explode.

nodes.name: Runebolt Chance From Channelling Runestone
nodes.description: Every second while channeling a skill, your nearest {Runestone} has a chance to cast Runebolt towards your target.

nodes.name: Runebolt Explodes
nodes.description: Runebolt now explodes when it reaches its target location or when hitting enemies or obstacles, dealing damage of the corresponding element in an area.

nodes.name: Runebolt Explosion Area Per Resistance
nodes.description: The explosion from {Devastator} deals damage in a larger area per uncapped resistance of the corresponding element.

nodes.name: Runebolt Mana Gain
nodes.description: Directly casting Runebolt and hitting at least one enemy has a chance to grant you mana.

nodes.name: Runebolt Grants Rune Weave
nodes.description: Casting Runebolt and hitting at least one enemy grants you a stack of {Runeweave} up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Runebolt Rune Weave More Elemental Damage Per Armor Shred
nodes.description: Each stack of {Runeweave} also grants you more elemental damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of armor shred on the target up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Runebolt Rune Weave Runic Invocation Crit Chance
nodes.description: Each stack of {Runeweave} also grants your {Runic Invocation} additional critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Runebolt Ailment Chance From Rune Type
nodes.description:
Runebolt gains additional effects for each unique {Rune} you have. Multiple {Runes} of the same type does not stack the effect.

{Rah Rune}: Runebolt has a chance to ignite enemies.
{Gon Rune}: Runebolt has a chance to shock enemies.
{Heo Rune}: Runebolt has a chance to inflict {Frostbite} on enemies.

nodes.name: Runebolt Reversed Combo
nodes.description: Runebolt's combo is now cast in a reversed order.

nodes.name: Runebolt Randomizes Runes
nodes.description: Casting Runebolt now randomizes the runes of your {Runic Invocation}.

nodes.name: Runebolt Casts In Sequence Of Runic Invocation
nodes.description: Runebolt is now cast in a sequence with the same order of your most recent {Runic Invocation}

nodes.name: Runebolt Imbued Runestone
nodes.description:
If you have 3 {Runes} from {Runic Invocation} when you create a {Runestone}, the {Runes} are consumed to instead create an {Imbued Runestone} that fires three bolts. An {Imbued Runestone's} explosion has 100% more area of effect and damage.

This effect has a 20 second cooldown. When you cast {Runic Invocation} the remaining cooldown is reduced by 20% per {Rune} in the {Invocation}.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Freeze and Crit
nodes.description: Frost Claw has a higher chance to freeze enemies and a higher chance to critically strike.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Spell Damage per Melee Damage
nodes.description: Frost Claw deals additional spell damage based on your added melee damage.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Area
nodes.description: Frost Claw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its explosion deals damage in a larger area. These bonuses are doubled if you have at least 1200 ward.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Mana Cost
nodes.description: Directly casting Frost Claw costs less mana and you have a chance to regain mana when you cast it.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Fire Conversion
nodes.description:
Frost Claw's base cold damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to cold damage. 

Chill chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance.

Swaps Frost Claw's {Cold} tag for a {Fire} tag.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Lightning Conversion
nodes.description:
Frost Claw's base cold damage is converted to lightning, unless it has already been converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage. 

Frostbite chance from all sources is converted to shock chance.

Swaps Frost Claw's {Cold} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Slow and Chill
nodes.description: Frost Claw hits have a chance to {Slow} and {Chill}.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Cast Speed
nodes.description: You have increased cast speed with Frost Claw.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Frostbite
nodes.description: Frost Claw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and its hits have a chance to inflict {Frostbite}.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Ailment Duration
nodes.description: Frostbite, chill, slow, ignite, and shock inflicted by Frost Claw last longer.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Ele Nova Proc
nodes.description:
You have a chance to cast {Elemental Nova} when Frost Claw's projectiles reach the target.

This consumes mana equal to Elemental Nova's mana cost and cannot trigger if you are out of mana.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Freeze per Crit Chance
nodes.description: Frost Claw has a higher chance to freeze based on its critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Ice Barrage RoF on Hit
nodes.description: If you have an active {Ice Barrage} when you hit an enemy with Frost Claw, that Ice Barrage fires faster for the rest of its duration, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Ice Barrage Chance on Cast
nodes.description:
You have a chance to cast {Ice Barrage} in the target direction when you cast Frost Claw.

This consumes mana equal to Ice Barrage's mana cost and cannot trigger if you are out of mana.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Retaliation
nodes.description:
When you are hit by an enemy you have a chance to retaliate with Frost Claw.

When you cast Frost Claw by any method you gain Ward.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Ward Gain Per Freeze Rate
nodes.description: When you cast Frost Claw you gain ward based on its Freeze Rate Multiplier.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Cast on Melee Hit
nodes.description:
When you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to cast Frost Claw towards it, or at another nearby enemy if the hit killed the original target.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of Frost Claw's mana cost.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Frozen Sleeper
nodes.description: Gain a stack of Frozen Sleeper every second up to a maximum. When you cast Frost Claw it consumes all stacks to gain cold penetration per stack and release an {Ice Spiral} for each stack.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Ice Spiral Damage
nodes.description: When you cast {Ice Spirals} there is a chance that the number of projectiles will be doubled and they'll all deal double damage.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Ice Spiral Buffs
nodes.description: For each active {Ice Spiral}, Glacier gains increased area and additional cold penetration, and Snap Freeze gains increased area and freeze duration.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Second Cast
nodes.description:
Directly casting Frost Claw causes it to recast from the target location to a location 4 meters behind it. The second can hit the same enemies as the first cast.

Frost Claw costs additional mana.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Third Cast
nodes.description:
The second cast from {On Through The Snow} causes a third cast. The third cast can hit the same enemies as the first and second casts.

Frost Claw costs additional mana.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Aim Second Cast
nodes.description:
The second cast from {On Through The Snow} targets a random enemy that is 3 to 9 meters away from the original target location.

Frost Claw costs additional mana.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Returning Cast
nodes.description:
When the second cast from {On Through The Snow} is released, Frost Claw is also cast back towards you.

Frost Claw's mana cost is increased.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Five Projectiles
nodes.description:
Frost Claw has 2 additional projectiles allowing it to hit enemies in a wider area on the way to the target.

Frost Claw costs additional mana.

nodes.name: Frost Claw All Projectiles Hit
nodes.description:
Frost Claw no longer creates a burst of damage at the target, but its projectiles are now staggered and they can all hit the same target.

Frost Claw's mana cost is increased, it no longer has the {Area} tag and it has a lowered base freeze rate.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Slow Projectiles
nodes.description: Frost Claw has a lower mana cost and it deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to frozen enemies, but its projectiles are slower.

nodes.name: Frost Claw Fast Projectiles
nodes.description: Frost Claw's projectiles are faster and it costs less mana.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts Projectile Speed And Cast Speed
nodes.description: Chaos Bolts has increased cast speed, and its projectiles travel faster.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts Damned Chance
nodes.description: Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance to inflict enemies with damned.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts Necrotic To Physical Conversion
nodes.description:
Chaos Bolts' base necrotic damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Damned chance from all sources are converted to bleed chance for Chaos Bolts.

Swaps Chaos Bolts' {Necrotic} tag for a {Physical} tag.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts Reduced Mana Cost
nodes.description: Chaos Bolts costs less mana, but now consumes a portion of your current health and ward on cast.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts More DoT From Missing Health
nodes.description: Chaos Bolts deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) equal to a portion of your missing health.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts Ailment Chance Transfers To Minions
nodes.description:
Hitting your minions with Chaos Bolts grants them any damned, ignite, bleed or frostbite chance that Chaos Bolts gains from this tree.

This buff lasts 10 seconds, and does not stack.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts Extends Cthonic Fissures
nodes.description:
Directly casting Chaos Bolts extends the duration of your active {Cthonic Fissures} and {Infernal Shades}. 

This effect has a 3 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts More Hit Damage From Ailments
nodes.description: Chaos Bolts' hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to damned, ignited, bleeding and frostbitten.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts Ignite Chance
nodes.description: Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance to ignite enemies.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts Fire To Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Chaos Bolts' base fire damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to fire damage. It now has a chance to freeze enemies.

Ignite chance from all sources are converted to frostbite chance for Chaos Bolts.

Swaps Chaos Bolts' {Fire} tag for a {Cold} tag.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts Chill Chance And Double Damage Chance
nodes.description:
Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance to chill enemies. 

Additionally, Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance to deal double hit damage to chilled enemies.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts More Physical DoT And Freeze Rate Multi From Cold Res
nodes.description:
Chaos Bolts' hits have a higher chance to freeze enemies per 1% uncapped cold resistance.

Additionally, Chaos Bolts deals more physical damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 4% uncapped cold resistance.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts Explosion Area Chance
nodes.description: Chaos Bolts explosions have a chance to deal damage in a much large area.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts Fear And Increased Spread
nodes.description: Chaos Bolts' hits now have a chance to fear enemies, but the projectiles target a wider area.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts Added Projectiles And Mana Cost
nodes.description: Chaos Bolts releases additional projectiles, but it has a higher mana cost.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts Chance To Consume Mana
nodes.description: Chaos Bolts' projectiles have a chance to consume additional mana causing it to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts Mana Consumption Buffs Minions
nodes.description:
Whenever mana is consumed by the {Mana Anarchy} node, your minions gain additional spell damage based on your maximum mana and they also gain increased cast speed.

This buff lasts 13 seconds.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts One Large Projectile
nodes.description:
Chaos Bolts no longer shoots multiple projectiles, but now instead shoots one large projectile causing it to deal more damage (multiplicative with other multipliers) in a larger area. 

These effects scale with the amount of projectiles Chaos Bolts would have shot.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts Explodes Zombies
nodes.description: Chaos Bolts' hitting one of your {Volatile Zombies} causes it to instantly explode. Zombies exploding this way deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts Explodes Zombies Poison Chance
nodes.description: {Volatile Zombies} exploding from the {Volatile Kindling} node deal even more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area and poisons enemies.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts Destructive Intensity
nodes.description:
Whenever you cast Chaos Bolts you gain a stack of {Destructive Intensity} up to a maximum.

Each stack reduces the target area and improves Chaos Bolts base critical strike chance.

If you go 2 seconds without gaining a stack, all stacks are lost.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts More Damage To Cursed
nodes.description: Chaos Bolts deals more damage and its hits deal more damage to {Cursed} enemies (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts Chance To Harvest
nodes.description:
Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance per Dexterity to cause you to attack with {Harvest} from the location of enemies hit, hitting them and enemies around them.

This effect can occur a maximum of 3 times per second.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts Mana And Health Gain From Cursed
nodes.description: Chaos Bolts' hits against {Cursed} enemies regain health and mana.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts Recast Chance From Cursed
nodes.description:
Chaos Bolts' hits against {Cursed} enemies has a chance to cause you to recast Chaos Bolts from their location towards another nearby enemy, consuming a portion of its mana cost. 

The recast has a minimum range of 5 meters, and will not cast at enemies within that range.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts Chance To Rip Blood
nodes.description:
Chaos Bolts' hits have a chance per Intelligence to cast {Rip Blood} at target enemies.

This effect can occur a maximum of 2 times per second.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts Refreshes Curses
nodes.description: Chaos Bolts hits refreshes the duration of your {Curses} on them and grants you health per curse.

nodes.name: Chaos Bolts Casts Bone Curse On Cursed Hit
nodes.description:
Chaos Bolts' hits against {Cursed} enemies casts {Bone Curse} at their location.

This effect has a 6 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Ignite And Damned Chance Per Second
nodes.description: Ghostflame has a chance to inflict damned and ignite enemies each second.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Damage Conversion To Physical
nodes.description:
Ghostflames's base necrotic and fire damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic or fire damage.

Damned and ignite chance from all sources are converted to bleed chance per second.

Ghostflame now drains a portion of your health each second.

Swaps Ghostflames's {Necrotic} and {Fire} tags for a {Physical} tag.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Physical Damage Leeched As Health
nodes.description:
You leech a portion of the physical damage you deal as health while channeling Ghostflame.

A portion of your global bleed chance on hit now applies as bleed chance per second for Ghostflame.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Cast Marrow Shards
nodes.description:
Damaging an enemy with Ghostflame causes you to cast {Marrow Shards} towards them.

This effect can occur a maximum number of times each second.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Increased Marrow Shards Frequency
nodes.description:
Increases the frequency of {Marrow Shards} per second from the {Feast of Bones} node.

Improves the {Marrow Shards'} base critical strike chance cast this way.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Ignite And Damned Duration
nodes.description: Ghostflame has increased ignite and damned duration per point of Intelligence.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Ignite And Damned Chance As Chance Per Second
nodes.description:
A portion of your global ignite chance on hit now applies as ignite chance per second for Ghostflame.

A portion of your global damned chance on hit now applies as damned chance per second for Ghostflame.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Skull Screech
nodes.description:
After channelling Ghostflame for a short duration, the skull releases a terrible screech, cursing all nearby enemies with {Decrepify}.

Ghost Flame gains the {Curse} tag, but its direct damage still does not scale with increased curse damage.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Increased Screech Area And Reduced Delay
nodes.description: The screech from the {Decrepit Mortals} node has a shorter delay before being released and a larger area.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Screech Fears
nodes.description: The screech from the {Decrepit Mortals} node now also fears enemies and Ghostflame deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to feared enemies.

nodes.name: Ghostflame More Damage And Channel Cost
nodes.description: Ghostflame deals more damage, but has a higher channel cost (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Ghostflame Less Damage From Ignited Damned And Bleeding
nodes.description: You take less damage from ignited, damned or bleeding enemies while channeling Ghostflame, but it costs more mana to channel.

nodes.name: Ghostflame More Damage More Area
nodes.description: Ghostflame deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Health Leeched Against Cursed Enemies
nodes.description:
You leech a portion of the damage you deal as health against {Cursed} enemies while channeling Ghostflame.

Additionally, Ghostflame has a chance to inflict Frailty each second.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Gain Haste And Ward
nodes.description:
When you stop channeling Ghostflame after having channeled for at least 1 second, you gain the {Haste} buff for a short duration.

Additionally, when you stop channeling you gain ward per {Cursed} enemy.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Skull Persists
nodes.description:
After channeling for 1.1 seconds Ghostflame detaches itself, and persists for short duration without you needing to channel.

This effect ends early if you start channeling Ghostflame again.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Skull Duration Increased
nodes.description: The duration from the {Memorial of Flames} node is longer, but Ghostflame now has an upfront mana cost.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Skull Moves
nodes.description: The detached Ghostflame now slowly seeks out nearby enemies.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Consume Ward Gain Area
nodes.description: After channeling for 1 second, Ghostflame consumes a portion of your current ward, and it deals damage in a larger area per ward consumed.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Cast Beams
nodes.description:
For each 200 ward consumed by the {Silver Oblation} node you now cast a {Stygian Beam} at a nearby enemy dealing spell necrotic damage.

Enemies cannot be hit by more than 1 beam.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Addply Stack To Minions
nodes.description:
All your {Wraiths}, {Spectres}, and {Revenants} gain a stack of {Spirit Kindling} every 0.5 seconds while they are inside Ghostflame's area of effect.

Each stack of {Spirit Kindling} lasts 5 seconds, drains health per second, and grants increased movement speed, melee attack speed, and ignite chance equal to a portion of your ignite chance.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Full Circle
nodes.description: Ghostflame now deals damage in a full circle around you, but it has a higher channel cost.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Move Toward Cursor
nodes.description: You now move towards the target location while channeling Ghostflame with increased movement speed, but it has a higher channel cost.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Less Movespeed Less Channel Cost
nodes.description: Ghostflame has a lower channel cost, but you move slower while channeling Ghostflame.

nodes.name: Ghostflame More Movespeed
nodes.description: You move faster while channeling Ghostflame.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Direct Damage Increased
nodes.description: Ghostflame deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second you spend channeling Ghostflame.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Less Channel Cost And Mana As Ward
nodes.description: Ghostflame has a lower channel cost and you gain a portion of your current mana as ward each second while channeling Ghostflame.

nodes.name: Ghostflame More Dodge Rating
nodes.description: You gain additional dodge rating per intelligence while channeling Ghostflame, as well as more dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers) while channeling Ghostflame.

nodes.name: Ghostflame Dodge Rating Conversion To Armor
nodes.description: All of your dodge rating is converted to armor while channeling Ghostflame.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Slow Chance And DoT Leeched
nodes.description: Profane Veil's area has a chance to slow enemies each second. Additionally, you leech a portion of the global damage you deal as health while in Profane Veil.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Damage Converted To Fire And Ignite Chance Per Second
nodes.description:
Profane Veil's base necrotic damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Profane Form now has a chance to ignite enemies each second.

Swaps Profane Form's {Necrotic} tag for a {Fire} tag.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Convert Ailment Chance To Ignite Chance
nodes.description: While in Profane Veil you gain a percentage of your damned, bleed, poison, slow and ignite chance on hit as chance to ignite per second for Profane Form.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Alter Movespeed
nodes.description:
You move faster equal to a portion of your chance to ignite on hit up to a maximum.

Profane Veil gains the {Traversal} tag.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Can Cast Infernal Shade
nodes.description:
When you first damage an enemy with Profane Veil you have a chance to cast {Infernal Shade} on them.

This effect can occur a maximum amount of times per cast of Profane Veil.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Immobilise Cursed Enemies
nodes.description: Profane Veil Immobilizes {Cursed} enemies for a short duration, but Bosses and Rare enemies will instead be chilled, rather than Immobilized.

nodes.name: Profane Veil More Damage To Cursed Enemies
nodes.description: You deal more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to {Cursed} enemies while in Profane Veil.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Casting Curse Reduce Cooldown
nodes.description:
Directly casting a {Curse} skill reduces Profane Veil's remaining cooldown.

This effect can occur a maximum number of times.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Increase Area
nodes.description: Profane Veil affects a larger area.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Gains On Weapons
nodes.description:
Profane Veil gains additional effects depending on the weapon type you are wielding. 

{Staff}: Increased area.
{Wand}: More damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
{Scepter}: Increased duration.
{Dagger}: Increased movement speed.
{Axe}: Kill threshold.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Fear Enemies On Form Exit
nodes.description: You now fear nearby enemies for a short duration when you exit Profane Veil. Additionally, Profane Veil deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to feared or slowed enemies for the same duration.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Armor Works For DoT
nodes.description: Damage reduction from armor now also applies to damage over time taken while in Profane Veil.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Can Buff Wandering Spirit
nodes.description:
When a {Wandering Spirit} is revealed inside Profane Veil's area the {Spirit} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area for the rest of the {Spirit's} duration. 

Additionally, for each {Spirit} revealed inside Profane Veil's area you gain ward scaling with your necrotic resistance.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Gain Ward On Dodge
nodes.description: You gain ward per dexterity when you dodge while in Profane Veil.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Increased Duration And Movespeed
nodes.description: Profane Veil lasts longer and you move faster while in it.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Cannot Change Direction
nodes.description:
While in Profane Veil you move faster and it has increased cooldown recovery speed, but you can no longer change direction while concealed and it has a shorter duration without being able to extend its duration.

Profane Veil gains the {Traversal} tag.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Consumes Minions
nodes.description: Profane Veil's area now consumes your minions, and consuming minions this way grants you ward equal to a portion of their maximum health as well as extending its remaining duration by a small amount.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Summon Volatile Zombies
nodes.description:
You now summon {Volatile Zombies} when you exit Profane Veil equal to the number of minions consumed up to a maximum from the {Vampiric Pool} node.

{Zombies} summoned deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area per Intelligence.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Grant Ward And Summon Volatile Zombies Upon Killing
nodes.description:
The benefits from the {Vampiric Pool} and {Apocalypse} nodes now also trigger when you kill enemies with Profane Veil.

The limit from {Vampiric Pool} remains the same.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Damage Converted To Physical
nodes.description:
Profane Veil's base necrotic damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Profane Veil deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 10% global Bleed chance on hit.

Swaps Profane Veil's {Necrotic} tag for a {Physical} tag.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Cast Bone Curse
nodes.description: You now cast {Bone Curse} when you enter and exit Profane Veil.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Second AoE
nodes.description: You now create a secondary Profane Veil area that is detached from you and moves towards enemies, but Profane Veil now has a higher mana cost.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Second AoE At Target
nodes.description: The secondary area from {Forked Tongue} is now created at the target location, but Profane Veil costs additional mana.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Less Mana Cost And More Damages
nodes.description: Profane Veil costs less mana and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Profane Veil Applies Marked For Death
nodes.description: Profane Veil's area now applies {Mark for Death} to enemies, but entering Profane Veil applies {Mark for Death} to you.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Proliferate Poison And Damn
nodes.description: When you apply {Mark for Death} to an enemy or yourself by any method, all your stacks of damned and poison on them spread to a number of nearby enemies.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Cast Profane Orbs
nodes.description: While in Profane Veil, you consume 6 mana to cast a {Profane Orb} each second that seek out enemies.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Increase Profane Orbs Frequency And Damage
nodes.description: Increases the frequency of {Profane Orb} per 1% increased cast speed for {Curses} you have. Additionally, {Profane Orb} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Curse} on the target.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Less Mana Cost
nodes.description: Profane Veil costs less mana.

nodes.name: Profane Veil Apply Penance
nodes.description: Profane Veil's area inflicts {Penance} to enemies, which is a {Curse} that causes enemies to take fire damage when they hit a target. Additionally Penance deals more damage per 1% of Damage Reflected (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Profane Veil Cleanses Ailments
nodes.description: You now cleanse all negative ailments on you when you enter Profane Veil.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Less Mana Cost
nodes.description:
Chthonic Fissure costs less mana and it refunds some of its mana cost if there is a cursed player, rare enemy or boss within 20 meters when you cast it.

This effect also works if you are Cursed.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Spread Ignite Bleed Or Poison Stacks When Tormenting
nodes.description: {Tormenting} an ignited enemy spreads all of your ignite stacks from it to a number of other enemies around it.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Increased Spirit Frequency
nodes.description: The Fissure releases {Spirits} more frequently.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Second Fissure Opposite Direction
nodes.description: Chthonic Fissure now creates a secondary Fissure in the opposite direction that casts its own {Spirits}. Enemies can take damage from both Fissures if they stand on both, but Chthonic Fissure costs significantly more mana.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Cast Chaos Bolt Instead Of Spirit
nodes.description:
{Spirits} now have a chance to be replaced by a cast of {Chaos Bolts} that consumes a portion of its mana cost and scales with your {Chaos Bolts} tree.

{Chaos Bolts} cast this way have a chance to have no additional projectiles.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Dying Enemy Release Spirit
nodes.description: When {Tormented} enemies die they have a chance to release the {Spirit} to inflict and {Torment} another enemy within 8 meters.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Apply Necrotic Resistance Shred
nodes.description: The {Spirits'} hits shred enemy necrotic resistance.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Apply Fire Physical Or Poison Resistance Shred
nodes.description: The {Spirits'} hits shred enemy fire resistance.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Consumes Infernal Shade
nodes.description: When {Spirits} {Torment} an enemy afflicted by an {Infernal Shade} they consume the Shade, causing it to instantly deal its remaining damage and increases all existing Chthonic Fissures' frequency of releasing {Spirits} up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Apply Damned
nodes.description: The {Spirits'} hits inflict enemies with {Damned}.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure More Necrotic Damage Per Critical Strike Multiplier
nodes.description: Chthonic Fissure and ailments it inflicts deal more necrotic damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 1% Added Critical Strike Multiplier.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Torment Deals More Damage Per Uncapped Necrotic Resistance
nodes.description: {Torment} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your uncapped necrotic resistance.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure More Damage To Bosses And Rare Enemies
nodes.description:
Chthonic Fissure deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to rare enemies and bosses.

This effect is doubled if the enemy or you are cursed.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Spirits Target Player
nodes.description:
{Spirits} now target you instead of enemies, and whenever you are {Tormented} or {Torment's} duration on you is refreshed, you gain additional spell damage and Endurance Threshold.

This buff can stack and has the same duration as {Torment}, but persists if {Torment} is cleansed.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Increase Damage
nodes.description: The Fissure deals more direct damage for each second it is active (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you leech a portion of the damage it does.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Max Fissures
nodes.description:
You can now have additional Fissures active at a time, but {Spirits} are released less frequently.

If a Fissure is placed over an existing one, the new Fissure closes after 1 second.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Remove Spirit
nodes.description: Chthonic Fissure deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it no longer releases {Spirits}.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Cast Volatile Zombie
nodes.description:
Fissures now cast {Volatile Zombies} every 2 seconds, but consumes mana equal to a portion of {Volatile Zombies} mana cost.

{Volatile Zombie} cast this way has a chance to not create multiple {Zombies} if it would otherwise.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure More Damage
nodes.description:
Chthonic Fissure deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled if you are cursed.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Fire Damage On Hit
nodes.description: The Fissure's initial impact now hits enemies dealing spell fire damage, with added damage applying at 300% effectiveness for this hit.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Added Spell Damage And Stun Chance Per Ignite Bleed Or Poison Chance
nodes.description:
The Fissure's initial hit now deals additional spell damage with a higher chance to stun per 2% ignite chance.

This effects scales with bleed or poison if the Fissure is converted to physical or poison respectively.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Apply Acid Skin
nodes.description: The Fissure's initial hit now Curse enemies with {Acid Skin}, which causes them to take poison damage over time and a chance to be critically struck by any hit.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Bonus Critical Strike Chance On Acid Skin
nodes.description:
Your hits against enemies cursed by {Acid Skin} have additional base critical strike chance per 10% of your global increased poison damage.

This bonus critical strike chance is not affected by other critical strike chance modifiers.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Spread Ignite Bleed Or Poison Stack On Impact
nodes.description: The Fissure's initial impact now spreads all of your ignite stacks from the target to nearby enemies up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Move Along
nodes.description:
When directly casting Chthonic Fissure you now travel along the Fissure as it opens, but this adds a cooldown to Chthonic Fissure.

Chthonic Fissure gains the {Traversal} tag.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Ignite Chance On Hit As Ignite Chance Per Second
nodes.description:
The Fissure gains a percentage of your global chance to ignite on hit as ignite chance per second. 

Additionally, the Fissure has a base chance to ignite enemies each second.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Physical Conversion
nodes.description:
Chthonic Fissure's base fire damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources are converted to bleed chance per second for the Fissure.

Swaps Chthonic Fissures' {Fire} tag for a {Physical} tag.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Increased Torment Duration
