nodes.description: {Torment} lasts longer and any ignite, poison and bleed inflicted by Chthonic Fissure also last longer.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure More Damage To Ignited Poisoned Bleeding Enemies
nodes.description: {Torment} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to ignited, poisoned or bleeding enemies.

nodes.name: Chthonic Fissure Poison Conversion
nodes.description:
Chthonic Fissure's base fire damage over time is converted to poison. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to poison chance per second for the Fissure.

Swaps Chthonic Fissures' {Fire} tag for a {Poison} tag.

nodes.name: Falconry Falconers Mark
nodes.description: Whenever the Falcon hits an enemy with {Falcon Strikes} it {Marks} them. Your next hit against a {Marked} target deals more damage and consumes the {Mark}.

nodes.name: Falconry Falcon Applies Falconers Mark
nodes.description: Your Falcon's other hits now have a chance to inflict {Falconer's Mark}.

nodes.name: Falconry Consume Mark For Added Damage Buff
nodes.description:
When you consume a {Falconer's Mark} your Falcon gains additional melee damage equal to a portion of your added melee damage, throwing damage, bow damage, or spell damage depending on the type of ability used to consume the mark.

This effect lasts 10 seconds and can stack a limited number of times.

nodes.name: Falconry Falcon Throws Acid Flasks
nodes.description:
Your Falcon now throws {Acid Flasks} for you. {Acid Flasks} thrown by the Falcon scale with your stats and your {Acid Flask} tree, but can apply {Falcon's Mark} from {Marking Strikes}.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of your {Acid Flask's} mana cost and has a 6 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Falconry Falcon More Max Acid Flasks
nodes.description: Your Falcon has additional {Acid Flask} charges.

nodes.name: Falconry Falcon Acid Flask Charges From You
nodes.description: When you directly use {Acid Flask} your Falcon has a chance to gain additional {Acid Flask} charges.

nodes.name: Falconry Falcon More Damage Per Char Level And Dex
nodes.description: Your Falcon deals more global damage per character level and per point of Dexterity (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Falconry Falcon More Damage Doubled For Falcon Strikes
nodes.description:
Your Falcon deals more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). 

This effect is tripled for {Falcon Strikes}.

nodes.name: Falconry Falcon Prioritizes Targets Near You
nodes.description: Your Falcon now more heavily prioritizes enemies close to you during combat.

nodes.name: Falconry Falcon Prioritizes Targets Location Of Your Recent Attack
nodes.description: Your Falcon now heavily prioritizes enemies close to the target location of your most recent melee, throwing or bow attack.

nodes.name: Falconry Falcon More Damage To Moving Enemies
nodes.description:
Your Falcon deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is tripled against moving targets.

nodes.name: Falconry Falcon Chance To Drop Black Arrow
nodes.description: When your Falcon hits an enemy it has a chance to drop a {Black Arrow} at its location.

nodes.name: Falconry Ailment Sharing To Falcon
nodes.description: A portion of your chance to inflict bleed, poison, shred armor, shred resistances, and slow on hit now also apply to your Falcon's hits.

nodes.name: Falconry Falcon Feather Knives
nodes.description:
Your Falcon now uses {Feather Knives} at nearby enemies. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

Your Falcon also throws a single Feather Knife whenever you consume {Falconer's Mark}.

nodes.name: Falconry Feather Knives CDR From Your Throwing Attack Speed
nodes.description: A portion of your global throwing attack speed now applies to the Falcon's {Feather Knives} ability as increased cooldown recovery speed.

nodes.name: Falconry Increased Damage Sharing To Falcon
nodes.description: A portion of the highest of your global increased melee damage, increased throwing damage, or increased bow damage now apply to all your Falcon's damage.

nodes.name: Falconry Crit Chance Sharing To Falcon
nodes.description: Your critical strike chance modifiers now also apply to your {Falcon}, but at a reduced ratio.

nodes.name: Falconry Crit Multi Sharing To Falcon After Skill Use
nodes.description:
When you use a melee, throwing, or bow attack and critically strike at least one enemy, your Falcon gains a portion of your global melee, throwing, or bow critical strike multiplier respectively for 10 seconds.

This effect can occur at most twice every two second.

nodes.name: Falconry Your Abilities Reduce Cooldown
nodes.description: When you directly use a melee, throwing, or bow attack and hit at least one enemy, you reduce a portion of {Falcon Strike's} remaining cooldown.

nodes.name: Falconry Falcon Screech
nodes.description: After the first hit of {Falcon Strike} your Falcon lets out a {Screech} which slows and applies {Frailty} to enemies around it.

nodes.name: Falconry Screech Fears
nodes.description:
Your Falcon's {Screech} now also fears enemies it hits.

Additionally, your Falcon moves to you when a hit leaves you at low health, and this effect will interrupt any skill it is currently using.

This effect can occur at most every 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Falconry More Falcon Strike Hits
nodes.description: {Falcon Strikes} hits addtional times and your {Falcon} has increased melee attack speed.

nodes.name: Falconry Falcon Strikes Culling
nodes.description:
{Falcon Strikes} instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

nodes.name: Falconry Razor Wing Line Attack
nodes.description: {Falcon Strikes} now cause your Falcon to swoop down in a line in front of you attacking all enemies in that line rather than hitting enemies individually.

nodes.name: Falconry Increased Area Sharing To Falcon
nodes.description:
A portion of your global increased area for area skills now applies to the width of {Falcon Strikes}.

Additionally, {Falcon Strikes} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have directly used an area skill in the past 8 seconds.

nodes.name: Falconry Falcon Strikes Additional Hits On Kill Or Hit
nodes.description:
If {Falcon Strikes} kills an enemy it will hit an additional time.

Additionally, when {Falcon Strikes} hits a boss or rare enemy it has a chance to hit an additional time.

nodes.name: Falconry Health And Mana Recovery On Boss Or Rare Kill
nodes.description: When your Falcon kills an enemy or hits a boss or rare enemy it restores health and mana to you based on your total attributes. This effect can occur from hits a limited number of times per 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Falconry Consume Mark For Falcons Wake Speed Buff
nodes.description:
When you consume {Falconer's Mark} you gain the {Falcon's Wake} buff for a short duration. 

This buff grants you increased movement speed, attack and cast speed.

nodes.name: Falconry Consuming Mark Recovers Falcon Strike Cooldown
nodes.description: Consuming a {Falconer's Mark} instantly recovers {Falcon Strike's} cooldown, but it now also costs additional mana.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault More Damage And CDR
nodes.description: Aerial Assault deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a shorter cooldown.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Featherstorm
nodes.description: After the initial {Wing Burst} your Falcon continues releasing {Featherstorm} at the target location for 5 seconds.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Featherstorm Slow Chance And Dodge Rating
nodes.description:
{Featherstorm} now has a chance to slow enemies inside its area each second. 

Additionally, you and your allies have additional dodge rating while inside the area.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Shadow Falcon Featherstorm
nodes.description: If there is a boss or rare enemy nearby, Aerial Assault now also creates a {Shadow Falcon} to use {Featherstorm} against it.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault No Longer Moves You But More Damage
nodes.description:
Aerial Assault no longer moves you. Additionally, it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and it no longer has a minimum range.

Aerial Assault loses its {Traversal} tag.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Featherstorm Duration And More Direct Damage Per Second
nodes.description: {Featherstorm} lasts longer and deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second it has been active.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Featherstorm Black Arrow Chance
nodes.description: {Featherstorm} now has a chance each second to drop a {Black Arrow}.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Featherstorm Poison Conversion
nodes.description:
{Featherstorms'} base physical damage over time is converted to poison. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to physical damage.

A portion of your global poison chance on hit now applies as poison chance per second for {Featherstorm}.

Swaps {Featherstorms'} {Physical} tag for a {Poison} tag.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Cooldown Reduction On Falcon Hits
nodes.description: A portion of Aerial Assault's cooldown is recovered when your Falcon hits an enemy. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Drops Caltrops
nodes.description: Using Aerial Assault now also drops {Caltrops} at your location.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Caltrops Duration And Damage
nodes.description: {Caltrops} from all sources have a chance to slow on hit and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Additional Caltrops On The Halfway
nodes.description: You now drop additional {Caltrops} halfway through Aerial Assault's movement if you traveled at least 6 meters.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Caltrops Bleed Chance And Falcon Bleed Chance Buff
nodes.description:
{Caltrops'} hits from all sources have a chance to cause enemies to bleed. 

Additionally, when an enemy walks over your {Caltrops} your Falcon's hits gain additional bleed chance scaling with your Dexterity for 4 seconds. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Recover Missing Mana On Use
nodes.description: Directly using Aerial Assault recovers a portion of your missing mana.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Recovers Falconry And Dive Bomb Cooldowns
nodes.description: Directly using Aerial Assault recovers a portion of the remaining cooldown of {Falconry} and {Dive Bomb} per 10 maximum mana you have.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Recover Missing Health On Use
nodes.description: Directly using Aerial Assault recovers a portion of your missing health.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Recovered Health Converted To Ward
nodes.description: Convert the health gain from the {Healing Gust} node to ward at half the effect.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Aerial Prowess Buff On Crit
nodes.description:
For the next 8 seconds after using Aerial Assault, critical strikes dealt by you or your {Falcon} grant you a stack of {Aerial Prowess} up to a maximum.

When you next use Aerial Assault, it consumes all stacks to restore health per stack and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault More Dodge While Traveling And Aerial Prowess Stacks
nodes.description:
You have more global dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers) while traveling with Aerial Assault.

Additionally, each hit you dodge while traveling grants you a stack of {Aerial Prowess}.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Non Crits And On Kill Grant Aerial Prowess
nodes.description: Aerial Assault now has a chance to grant you {Aerial Prowess} stacks on non-critical strikes and when you kill an enemy.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Consuming Aerial Prowess Grants Haste And Frenzy
nodes.description: Consuming stacks of {Aerial Assault} now grants you {Haste} and Frenzy for a short duration per stack consumed.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Rogue Skills Consume Aerial Prowess To Gain More Damage
nodes.description: Directly using {Ballista,} {Explosive Trap}, or {Dive Bomb} now also consumes your stacks of {Aerial Prowess}, applying the damage bonus to the ability that consumed them.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Frailty On Feather Burst
nodes.description: The {Wing Burst's} hits apply frailty.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Ballistas Target Your Location After Landing
nodes.description: After landing, all your active {Ballistas} prioritize targets around you, deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per Intelligence, and gain increased attack speed.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Feather Burst Area
nodes.description: The {Wing Burst} deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault More Direct Damage To High Health Enemies
nodes.description: The {Wing Burst} deals more direct damage to enemies on high health.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Ambush Damage Apply To Bosses And Rares
nodes.description: The damage bonus from {Ambush} always applies against bosses and rare enemies, regardless of their health.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Creates Shadow On Feather Burst Kill
nodes.description: When the {Wing Burst} kills an enemy and you have 3 or fewer active {Shadows}, it creates a {Shadow} at that enemy's location.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Your Damage Applies to Feather Burst
nodes.description: A portion of your added, increased, and more throwing damage modifiers now apply to the {Wing Burst}.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Umbral Blades On Feather Burst
nodes.description: The {Wing Burst} now also includes a few {Umbral Blades} that your Falcon throws for you.

nodes.name: Aerial Assault Armor Shred On Umbral Blades From Feathers
nodes.description: The {Umbral Blades'} hits from the {Twilight Strike} node now shred enemy armor.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Cooldown Recovery Speed
nodes.description: Dive Bomb has a shorter cooldown.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Cooldown Reduction On Attack
nodes.description: You reduce a portion of Dive Bomb's remaining cooldown when you use a throwing or bow attack and hit at least one enemy.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Featherfall
nodes.description:
Before your Falcon dives it now uses {Featherfall} that causes razor-sharp feathers to strike a number of enemies in an area around the target location.

{Shadow Falcons} won't use {Featherfall}.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Featherfall Armor Shred
nodes.description: {Featherfall's} hits shred enemy armor.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Area And Slow
nodes.description: Dive Bomb's hits slows enemies and it deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Crit Vulnerability
nodes.description: Dive Bomb's hits apply {Critical Vulnerability} on enemies.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Talon Blades
nodes.description:
Dive Bomb and {Featherfall} hits grant you a stack of {Talon Blades} for 18 seconds.

You have increased critical strike chance and critical multiplier per stack.

All stacks of {Talon Blades} are lost if you directly use Dive Bomb again.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Increased Movespeed With 5 Talon Blades
nodes.description: You move faster while you have at least 5 stacks of {Talon Blades}.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Explodes Explosive Traps With And Buffs Them
nodes.description:
If Dive Bomb hits your {Explosive Traps} they instantly explode dealing more damage in a larger area (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

Additionally, when you detonate an {Explosive Trap} this way you gain a stack of {Talon Blades}.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Physical Shred
nodes.description: Dive Bomb's hits shred enemy physical resistance.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Grants Crimson Shroud
nodes.description: Dive Bomb's hits grant you a stack of {Crimson Shroud} per enemy hit, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb More Damage Per Bleed And Instant Bleeds
nodes.description:
Dive Bomb's hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed on the target up to a maximum.

Additionally, it causes all bleed stacks inflicted by you or your Falcon to be consumed to deal their remaining damage instantly.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Reduced Delay And More Damage
nodes.description: Dive Bomb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and it has a shorter delay before the Falcon dives.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb More Damage Stun Duration And Cooldown Duration
nodes.description: Dive Bomb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and stuns caused by it last longer, but it has a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Shadow Falcon
nodes.description:
Dive Bomb now creates a {Shadow Falcon} to strike the location of your own {Shadows} and it will prioritize your {Shadows} nearest the target location, but {Shadow Falcons} deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) than the real Falcon.

The number of {Shadow Falcons} cannot exceed the number of {Shadows} you currently have.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Dusk Shrouds Per Hit
nodes.description: You have a chance to gain a stack of {Dusk Shroud} for each {Shadow Falcon} that hit at least one enemy.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Shadow Falcon For Primary Attack
nodes.description:
A {Shadow Falcon} takes your Falcon's place, that uses Dive Bomb. Your Falcon is able to attack and use other abilities during this.
If you do not have an active Falcon, Dive Bomb will scale with your stats instead.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Shadow Falcon Double Hit Inside Smoke Bomb
nodes.description: Your {Shadow Falcons} that land inside the area of your {Smoke Bomb} have a chance to take off again after a short delay before diving again at a nearby enemy to deal damage around them.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Shadow Falcon Damage Per Umbral Blade
nodes.description: Your {Shadow Falcons} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modfiers) per {Umbral Blade} you have on the ground, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Spear Leap
nodes.description:
If you are wielding a spear you also leap to the target location when you use Dive Bomb. This deals damage in the area around the target.

Dive Bomb gains the {Traversal} tag.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Bleed
nodes.description: Dive Bomb's hits cause enemies to bleed.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Damage From Dual Wielding
nodes.description: If you are dual wielding, a portion of the damage specific stats from both of your weapons apply to your Falcon's Dive Bomb.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb More Ailment Damage Per Stun Chance
nodes.description: Dive Bomb deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 10% of your increased stun chance.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Regain Mana And Cooldown On Boss Or Rare Hit
nodes.description: If Dive Bomb hits at least one boss or rare enemy you regain mana and recover a portion of your remaining traversal skills' cooldown.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Detonates Decoys For More Damage And Area
nodes.description:
If Dive Bomb hits one of your {Decoy}, it detonates it, causing its explosion to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

The effects from the {Rapid Pursuit} node are also gained when Dive Bomb hits one of your {Decoys}.

Dive Bomb cannot explode more than one {Decoy} per use.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Less Mana Cost More Damage
nodes.description: Dive Bomb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and costs less mana.

nodes.name: Dive Bomb Increased Smoke Bomb Duration
nodes.description:
If your Falcon lands inside the area of your {Smoke Bomb} the smoke area lasts longer.

This effect can occur once per Smoke Bomb.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Damage And Fire Shred
nodes.description: Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its hits shred enemy fire resistance.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Attach To Enemy
nodes.description:
Whenever you hit an enemy with any melee attack, you attach an Explosive Trap to that enemy.

This effect has a 1.5 second cooldown and attached traps explode after 1 second ignoring arming time or when the enemy it's attached to dies. Enemies cannot have more than 1 trap attached.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Attach Between You And Enemy
nodes.description:
Attached traps deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

If the enemy that the Explosive Trap is attached to hits you, it now attaches to you instead (but will still only damage enemies). Hitting an enemy then attaches it back to them without changing the delay before exploding.

Additionally, when it explodes, the trap deals 30% more damage for each time it has been passed.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Detonating Arrow Trap
nodes.description:
When an Explosive Trap detonates, all other Explosive Traps now also detonate in quick succession and fire {Detonating Arrows} at the original target trap's location. The Detonating Arrows can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of your {Detonating Arrow's} mana cost.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Detonating Arrow More Damage Per Dex
nodes.description: {Detonating Arrows} fired this way deal additional bow damage per 3 Dexterity.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Lightning Conversion
nodes.description:
Explosive Trap's base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Fire resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to lightning resistance shred.

Swaps Explosive Trap's {Fire} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Spark Charges
nodes.description: Explosive Trap's hits have a chance to shock enemies and inflict them with a {Spark Charge}.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Converted Traps In Area
nodes.description:
When directly using Explosive Trap, an unconverted Explosive Trap and a trap corresponding to each conversion node you have taken are thrown at the same time. Traps thrown this way are thrown in a small area.

Additionally, Explosive Trap deals less damage in a smaller area (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and cost additional mana.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Explosive Trap's base fire damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Fire resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to cold resistance shred.

Swaps Explosive Trap's {Fire} tag for a {Cold} tag.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Chill And Freeze Rate Per Int
nodes.description:
Explosive Trap's hits have a chance to chill enemies.

Additionally, Explosive Trap has additional freeze rate per Intelligence.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Freeze Trap
nodes.description:
When you directly throw Explosive Trap, its hits always freeze enemies, but it now has a cooldown.

Whenever you freeze an enemy with any skill, a portion of Explosive Trap's remaining cooldown is recovered.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Explosion Area And Trigger Area
nodes.description: Explosive Trap is now triggered from farther away and deals damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Triggers Against Fast Enemies
nodes.description:
Particularly fast enemies (with a movement speed above 6 meters per second) trigger Explosive Traps instantly, even if they haven't armed.

Additionally, Explosive Trap's hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to moving enemies.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Damage And Area Per Second Before Detonation
nodes.description: Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area for each second it has existed before detonating up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Arming Time And More Damage
nodes.description: Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if the arming time is not ignored, but it takes longer for it to arm before it can detonate.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Smoke Trap
nodes.description: When an Explosive Trap detonates, if it hit at least one enemy, it has a chance to grant you a stack of {Dusk Shroud}. This chance increases for each second it spends arming.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Throwing Damage Per Dusk Shroud
nodes.description: Explosive Trap deals additional throwing damage per stack of {Dusk Shroud} you have.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Mana Efficiency And Throwing Speed
nodes.description: Explosive Trap costs less mana and it has increased throwing attack speed.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Grants Falcon Damage Buff
nodes.description:
Whenever one of your Explosive Traps detonate, your {Falcon} gains physical and elemental penetration for a short duration.

This effect can trigger up to a maximum of 15 times within 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Reduces Falcon Skills Cooldown
nodes.description: Whenever one of your Explosive Traps detonate, your {Falcon's} skills recover a portion of their remaining cooldowns.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap More Traps
nodes.description: You can now have more active Explosive Traps.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Additional Traps Per Throw
nodes.description: When you directly use Explosive Trap you throw additional traps, but Explosive Trap costs more mana.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Reduced Mana Cost But Less Damage And Area
nodes.description: Explosive Trap costs less mana, but deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a smaller area.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Blast Rain
nodes.description:
You now shoot arrows attached with Explosive Traps up into the air that then drop down around the target location.

Explosive Trap now scales with your bow damage instead of throwing damage and your bow attack speed instead of throwing attack speed.

This requires wielding a bow.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Blast Rain Instant Detonation When Hitting Ground
nodes.description:
Explosive Traps now instantly detonate when the arrows hit the ground via the {Blast Rain} node, ignoring the arming time.

Additionally, Explosive Trap has a higher chance to stun enemies.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Drops Traps
nodes.description: Whenever an Explosive Trap detonates, it has a chance to drop a fresh Explosive Trap at its location as long as there is an enemy within 6 meters, but Explosive Trap costs more mana.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Chance To Drop Fresh Traps
nodes.description:
Explosive Trap has an additional chance to drop a fresh Explosive Trap via the {Trap Sprinkler} node, but Explosive Trap costs more mana.

Traps dropped this way cannot drop more additional traps.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Drops Ballistas
nodes.description:
Whenever an Explosive Trap detonates, it now has a chance to create a {Ballista} for you.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of {Ballista's} mana cost.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Throws Traps
nodes.description:
Explosive Traps dropped by the {Trap Sprinkler} node are now flung at a nearby enemy within 12 meters instead of being dropped.

Explosive Traps dropped by the {Trap Sprinkler} node can now drop Explosive Traps when there's an enemy within 12 meters even if there is not an enemy within 6 meters.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Throws Acid Flasks
nodes.description:
When an Explosive Trap drops a trap by the {Trap Sprinkler} node, it also flings an {Acid Flask} for you towards the target location.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of Acid Flask's mana cost.

nodes.name: Explosive Trap Mine Field
nodes.description:
Whenever you directly throw Explosive Trap, you now throw traps, up to your maximum number of traps, in a wide area around the target location.

Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per maximum traps, but it now has a cooldown and costs more mana per maximum trap.

nodes.name: Net Bleed On Hit
nodes.description: Net's hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

nodes.name: Net Area
nodes.description: Net snares enemies in a larger area.

nodes.name: Net Cannot Be Dodged
nodes.description: Net's hits cannot be dodged.

nodes.name: Net Slows
nodes.description: Net's hits slows enemies.

nodes.name: Net Cannot Dodge Or Avoid Crits
nodes.description: Netted enemies and enemies slowed by the {Tanglewire} node cannot dodge and cannot avoid critical strikes.

nodes.name: Net Huntress Advantage Buff
nodes.description: Directly using Net grants you the {Huntress Advantage} buff for a short duration, granting you more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) against slowed or immobilized enemies.

nodes.name: Net Huntress Advantage Attack Speed
nodes.description: While you have {Huntress Advantage} you now also have global increased throwing attack speed.

nodes.name: Net Physical Damage Over Time
nodes.description: Net causes enemies to take physical damage over time and causes them to bleed each second.

nodes.name: Net Lightning Conversion
nodes.description:
Net's base physical damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance on hit from all sources is converted to lightning resistance shred for Net.

Additionally, Net deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per global shock chance.

Swaps Net's {Physical} tag for a {Lightning} tag.

nodes.name: Net Damage Per 100 Dodge Rating
nodes.description: Net deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) scaling with your dodge chance.

nodes.name: Net Damage And Bleed Duration
nodes.description: Net deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and bleeds that it inflicts last longer.

nodes.name: Net Poison Conversion
nodes.description:
Net's base physical damage is converted to poison. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance on hit from all sources is converted to poison chance for Net.

Net gains the {Poison} tag.

nodes.name: Net No Flip Back
nodes.description: You no longer flip back when using Net.

nodes.name: Net Trap
nodes.description:
Net now throws a trap that releases a net at a nearby enemy when it triggers.

You can have a maximum of 6 Net Traps active at once and they last up to 30 seconds.

nodes.name: Net Spear Trap
nodes.description:
Net Traps now also use {Puncture} for you when they are triggered. This will use the melee or bow version of Puncture depending on your equipped weapon.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of {Puncture's} mana cost.

nodes.name: Net Additional Traps
nodes.description: You now throw additional Net traps with each throw, but Net costs additional mana.

nodes.name: Net Caltrops
nodes.description: When using Net you drop {Caltrops} at your starting location after jumping.

nodes.name: Net Caltrops Area
nodes.description: {Caltrops} from all sources deal damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Net Caltrops Crit Per Slow Chance
nodes.description: Improves {Caltrops'} base critical strike chance from all sources per 10% global slow chance.

nodes.name: Net Caltrops At Target Location
nodes.description:
If Net hits an enemy you now also throw {Caltrops} at your target location where the Net hits.

This effect can occur once per 2 seconds.

nodes.name: Net Jump Distance
nodes.description: You jump further when using Net.

nodes.name: Net Jump Forward
nodes.description: You now jump forwards when using Net instead of backwards and it is thrown behind you.

nodes.name: Net Smoke Bomb After Jump
nodes.description: When directly using Net you now throw a {Smoke Bomb} after jumping.

nodes.name: Net Duration
nodes.description: Net snares enemies for a longer duration.

nodes.name: Net Stun And Chill And Mana Gain
nodes.description:
Net's hits chill bosses and rare enemies while other enemies are stunned for a short duration. Additionally, you gain mana for each moving enemy hit.

This effect adds a 10 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Net Cooldown Recovery
nodes.description: Net has a shorter cooldown.

nodes.name: Net Traversal Conversion
nodes.description:
You now jump further when using Net and it has a reduced cooldown.

Net gains the {Traversal} tag.

nodes.name: Net Netted Enemies Deal Less Phys Damage
nodes.description: Netted enemies deal less physical damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Net Falcon Deals More Damage To Netted Enemies
nodes.description: Your {Falcon} deals more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to netted enemies.

nodes.name: Net Frailty On Hit
nodes.description: Net's hits apply frailty to enemies.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Additional Storm Bolt Chance
nodes.description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to cast {Storm Bolt} at an additional enemy.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Damage And Storm Bolt Frequency
nodes.description: Gathering Storm deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you expend {Storm Stacks} more frequently, but {Storm Bolts} target enemies within a smaller area.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Maelstrom Chance Per Stack
nodes.displayName: In the Eye of the Storm
nodes.description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to cast {Maelstrom}.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Chance To Gain Instead Of Losing Stack
nodes.description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to gain a stack instead of losing one.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Haste Chance
nodes.description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to gain {Haste}.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Storm Stack On Companion Ability And More Storm Bolt Damage
nodes.description:
Whenever you use a companion ability you expend {Storm Stacks} over the next 0.3 seconds.

Storm Bolts triggered this way deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Chance To Cast Storm Bolt Again Against Boss Or Rare
nodes.description: Whenever you hit a boss or rare enemy with a {Storm Bolt} you have a chance to cast it again at the same enemy after 0.25 seconds.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Melee Bolt With Staff
nodes.description: While wielding a staff the melee attack of Gathering Storm is replaced by a direct ranged cast of {Storm Bolt}, but Gathering Storm costs additional mana.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Larger Targeting Area
nodes.description: {Storm Bolts} target enemies from farther away.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Storm Stacks From Minions
nodes.description: If you have from 1 to 15 {Storm Stacks}, your minions' lightning skill hits have a chance to grant you a {Storm Stack}.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Lightning Pen
nodes.description: Gathering Storm penetrates enemy lightning resistance.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Consume Mana For More Damage
nodes.description: {Storm Bolts} now consume a portion of your current mana to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 10 current mana, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Additional Targets While Dual Wielding
nodes.description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} while dual wielding you now cast {Storm Bolts} at two enemies instead of one.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Attack Speed
nodes.description: Gathering Storm has increased attack speed.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Mana Gain Per Active Storm Stack
nodes.description: Whenever you directly use Gathering Storm you gain mana per active {Storm Stack} up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Global Stun Chance And Freezy Multi
nodes.description: You have increased global stun chance and additional freeze rate multiplier per active {Storm Stack} up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Chance To Consume Mana For Added Storm Stacks
nodes.description: Gathering Storm's hits have a chance to consume mana to grant you additional {Storm Stacks}.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Melee Area And Chance For Added Storm Stacks
nodes.description: Gathering Storm's melee attack deals damage in a larger area and you have a chance to gain an additional {Storm Stack} if you hit at least 3 enemies with the same melee attack.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Storm Crows Attack Additional Targets
nodes.description:
Whenever you use Gathering Storm and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of {Wings of Lightning}.

Each time one of your {Storm Crows} attack, they consume a stack of Wings of Lightning, causing their basic attack to chain 2 additional times.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Shock Chance And More Damage To Shocked Enemy
nodes.description:
{Storm Bolts'} hits have chance to shock enemies.

Gathering Storm deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to shocked enemies.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Spell Damage Per Melee Damage
nodes.description:
Gathering Storm deals additional spell damage per 3 melee damage on your equipped axe or mace.

The added spell damage granted by this effect is significantly reduced when applied to a Storm Totem through its {Unmatched Storms}.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Physical Conversion
nodes.description:
Gathering Storm's and {Storm Bolt's} base lightning damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance on hit from all sources is converted to armor shred chance for Gathering Storm.

Swaps Gathering Storm's {Lightning} tag for a {Physical} tag.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Melee Damage Per Strength
nodes.description: Gathering Storm deals additional melee damage per Strength while wielding a 2 handed weapon.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Gathering Storm's and {Storm Bolt's} base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance on hit from all sources is converted to frostbite chance for Gathering Storm.

Swaps Gathering Storm's {Lightning} tag for a {Cold} tag.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Chill Chance And Freeze Rate
nodes.description: Gathering Storm's hits have a chance to chill enemies and a higher chance to freeze enemies.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Freeze Rate Per Attunement And Cold Per For Frostbite
nodes.description: Gathering Storm has a higher chance to freeze enemies per 2 Attunement and it also has additional cold penetration for frostbite per 2 Attunement.

nodes.name: Gathering Storm Crit Chance Per Maelstrom
nodes.description: Gathering Storm has improved base critical strike chance per stack of {Maelstrom} on you from any source.

nodes.name: Healing Hands Deals Damage
nodes.description: Healing Hands now hits enemies within its area of effect, dealing spell fire damage. Added spell damage applies to it at 200% effectiveness.

nodes.name: Healings Hands Damage per Healing Effect
nodes.description: Healing hands deals additional spell damage based on your Increased Healing Effectiveness and on Increased Healing Effectiveness from this tree.

nodes.name: Healing Hands vs Void
nodes.description:
Healing Hands {Immobilizes} void enemies for 1 second on hit and deals more damage to them (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Healing Hands grants allies 10% less void damage taken (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds when cast on them. This buff does not stack.

nodes.name: Healing Hands vs Undead
nodes.description:
Healing Hands fears Undead Enemies for 2 to 3 seconds on hit and deals more damage to them (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Healing Hands grants allies 10% less necrotic damage taken (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds when cast on them. This buff does not stack.

nodes.name: Healings Hands Damage per Buff Skill Level
nodes.description: Healing hands deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on the combined levels of your specialised Buff skills.

nodes.name: Healings Hands Electrify
nodes.description: Healing hands has a chance to {Electrify} on hit.

nodes.name: Healing Hands Spread Electrify
nodes.description: Healing Hands deals more lightning damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) and when you hit an electrified enemy with Healing Hands it spreads all stacks of electrify from that enemy to a number of other enemies within 5 metres.

nodes.name: Healing Hands Melee
nodes.description:
Healing Hands is converted into a melee attack that hits in a wide arc in front of you. It now scales with melee damage instead of spell damage and effects on this tree that granted spell damage now grant melee damage instead.

Healing Hands still heals you, as well as allies within its area of affect.

nodes.name: Healing Hands Healing Effectiveness
nodes.description: Healing Hands has increased healing effectiveness. This bonus is doubled if there is a dead player within 30 meters.

nodes.name: Healing Hands Area And Mana Cost
nodes.description: Healing Hands has an increased area of effect and a lower mana cost.

nodes.name: Healing Hands Mana Cost
nodes.description: Healing Hands has a lower mana cost.

nodes.name: Healing Hands Divine Bolts
nodes.description:
You cast {Divine Bolt} at nearby enemies when you directly cast healing hands and heal yourself or an ally.

Divine Bolt is affected by specific passives from the Paladin tree and if you take this node then Divine Bolt from all sources scales with nodes on this tree.

nodes.name: Healing Hands Ward
nodes.description:
Healing Hands also grants ward to allies based on your Attunement.

If the ally has an effect that causes them to gain ward per second based on their missing health, then it will not heal them, but will provide a percentage of its healing as ward.

nodes.name: Healing Hands Cast On Self
nodes.description:
If Healing Hands would not affect any allied players at the chosen target location, it is cast centered on you instead.

Healing Hands has increased healing effectiveness.

nodes.name: Healings Hands Ward per Healing Effect
nodes.description: Healing Hands also grants ward to allies based on your Increased Healing Effectiveness and on Increased Healing Effectiveness from this tree.

nodes.name: Healing Hands Channelled
nodes.description: Healing Hands becomes a channeled ability, casting 4 times per second regardless of cast speed, and draining your mana.

nodes.name: Healings Hands Ward per Second
nodes.description:
Healing Hands also grants ward per second for three seconds after being cast on an ally.

The ward per second is equal to a proportion of the ward granted up front by the other nodes on this tree and by items that cause you to grant ward with Healing Hands.

This effect cannot stack multiple times, casting again on the same ally just refreshes the duration.

nodes.name: Healings Hands Upfront Heal
nodes.description: Healing Hands restores additional health up front.

nodes.name: Healings Hands Heal over Time
nodes.description: Healing Hands restores additional health over time. This lasts for three seconds just like Healing Hands' inherent healing over time effect.

nodes.name: Healings Hands Melee Proc
nodes.description:
When you directly use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy, you have a chance to cast Healing Hands around the target. This consumes mana based on Healing Hands's mana cost.

Healing Hands restores less up front health when cast indirectly.

nodes.name: Healings Hands Smite Proc
nodes.description: When you directly cast Smite, you have a chance to cast Healing Hands around the target location. This consumes 70% of its mana cost.

nodes.name: Healing Hands Traversal
nodes.description:
When you directly use Healing Hands you dash to the target location first. However, Healing Hands now has a cooldown and counts a {Traversal} skill.

This does not affect indirect casts of Healing Hands.

nodes.name: Healing Hands Cooldown Recovery
nodes.description: A portion of Healing Hands' remaining cooldown is recovered if you use it to heal an ally other than yourself. This effect can occur once per direct cast of Healing Hands.

nodes.name: Healings Hands Health Globe
nodes.description: When you cast Healing Hands, there is a chance it spawns a {Health Globe} at a random point inside the area of effect. When an ally walks over the globe, it is consumed, healing them for 70 health.

nodes.name: Healing Hands Immune While Moving
nodes.description: You are immune to damage while moving with Healing Hands.

nodes.name: Healing Hands Slow More Damage
nodes.description: Healing Hands takes longer to cast, but deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased healing effectiveness and a larger area of effect.

nodes.name: Healing Hands Heal To Full
nodes.description:
If you heal an allied player other than yourself that was below half prior to healing, Healing Hands restores them to full health and grants them ward equal to 80% of their max health.

This has no effect on you, nor on minions, nor players that have an effect that causes them to gain ward per second based on their missing health.

nodes.name: Healings Hands Sky Beam
nodes.description:
While channelling Healing Hands you also call down a beam from the sky that deals fire damage over time to enemies around the target area and heals allies within its area of effect.

Healing Hands costs additional mana per second while channelling.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Leech And Recurve Chance
nodes.description: You leech a portion of Heartseeker's damage and it has an additional chance to {Recurve}.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Crit Chance And Crit Multi
nodes.description: Heartseeker has additional critical strike chance and its critical strikes deal more damage.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Bow Damage After Recurve
nodes.description: Heartseeker deals more bow damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) after each recurve, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Debuffs And No Retarget
nodes.description: Heartseeker's hits have a chance to apply frailty and shred enemy armor, but it no longer seeks new targets when the first target dies.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Puncture On Recurve
nodes.description: When Heartseeker's target dies, you shoot {Puncture} at a nearby enemy for each {Recurve} it would have triggered after the target died.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Dusk Shroud On Recurve
nodes.description: Heartseeker has a chance on {Recurve} to grant you a {Dusk Shroud}, up to a maximum every 2 seconds.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Chance For Shadow Heartseeker
nodes.description: When you directly use Heartseeker and hit at least one enemy, it has a chance to consume one of your {Shadows} to use Heartseeker at the same target.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Dark Arrow After Recurve
nodes.description:
After a Heartseeker arrow {Recurves} at least 3 times, it has a chance to leave a {Black Arrow} between you and the target enemy if the enemy is at least 6 meters away.

This effect can occur a limited number of times every 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Heartseeker More Damage
nodes.description: Heartseeker's hits cannot be dodged and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Heartseeker Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Heartseeker's base physical damage is converted to cold and it now has a base freeze rate. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance on hit from all sources is converted to frostbite chance for Heartseeker.

Swaps Heartseeker's {Physical} tag for a {Cold} tag.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Freeze Rate and Frostbite
nodes.description: Heartseeker's hits have a higher chance to freeze and have a chance to chill enemies.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Cold Pen Per Cold Res
nodes.description: Heartseeker penetrate additional cold resistance scaling with your cold overcapped resistance.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Fire Conversion
nodes.description:
Heartseeker's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage. 

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance.

Swaps Heartseeker's {Physical} tag for a {Fire} tag.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Burning Dagger
nodes.description: Heartseeker has a chance to grant you a {Burning Dagger} on {Recurve} consuming mana.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Consecutive Recurve Buff
nodes.description: Consecutive {Recurves} each grant a stack of {Dragonfang} for 10 seconds. Higher stacks can only be achieved by a higher amount of consecutive {Recurves}, up to a maximum of 20.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Frenzy On Use
nodes.description:
Directly using Heartseeker and hitting at least one enemy grants you frenzy for a short duration. 

This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Health And Mana Gain On Use
nodes.description: When directly used, Heartseeker arrows have a chance to grant mana and health on hit.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Increased Attack Speed And Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Heartseeker has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Poison Chance And Poison Duration
nodes.description: Heartseeker's hits have a chance to poison enemies and poison it inflicts last longer.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Bleed Chance And Bleed Pen
nodes.description: Heartseeker's hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and bleed it inflicts penetrate enemy physical resistance.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Ailment Damage After Recurve
nodes.description: Heartseeker deals more ailment damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) after each recurve, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Crimson Shroud On Recurve
nodes.description: Heartseeker has a chance to grant you {Crimson Shroud} on {Recurve}.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Recurve Chance
nodes.description: Heartseeker has an additional chance to {Recurve}.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Big Hit Cooldown
nodes.description: Heartseeker has an additional chance to {Recurve}, and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it now has a cooldown.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Added Charges
nodes.description: Heartseeker has additional charges.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Dark Arrows Restore Charges
nodes.description: Your Heartseeker restores a charge whenever you pick up a {Black Arrow}.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Minimum Recurve Chance
nodes.description: Heartseeker now has a minimum chance to {Recurve}.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Recurve Chance Per Dex
nodes.description: Heartseeker has an additional chance to {Recurve} scaling with Dexterity.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Adds Duration To Hail Of Arrows
nodes.description: Whenever Heartseeker {Recurves}, it extends the duration of your most recent {Hail of Arrows} by a small amount, up to 10 times per use of {Hail of Arrows}.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Slow Chance
nodes.description: Heartseeker now twists around in a semi-cirle to {Recurve} and its hits have a chance to slow enemies.

nodes.name: Heartseeker Armor Shred Converted To Poison
nodes.description: Armor shred chance from all sources is converted to poison chance.

nodes.name: Flay Chill Chance And Damage
nodes.description: Flay deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and has a chance to chill on hit.

nodes.name: Flay Every Other Melee Eruption On Elite
nodes.description: Every second melee attack with Flay which hits a boss or rare enemy has a chance to trigger a {Blood Eruption}.

nodes.name: Flay More Hit Damage Doubled Against Low
nodes.description: Flay deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), doubled against low life enemies.

nodes.name: Flay Marked For Death And Cull
nodes.description: Enemies hit by Flay are inflicted with Marked for Death for a duration, and Flay hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

nodes.name: Flay Dagger Increased Attack Speed
nodes.description: While using a dagger, Flay has increased attack speed.

nodes.name: Flay Spirit Step Max Distance
nodes.description:
When you directly use Flay and hit at least one enemy, you have a chance to gain Haste for 2 seconds. This chance is tripled if Flay is a traversal skill.

Flay's Spirit Step can move you from a further distance.

nodes.name: Flay Melee Hit Aura Of Decay Area
nodes.description: When you directly use Flay and hit at least one enemy with the melee attack, your active {Aura of Decay} is granted more ailment frequency (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased radius for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Flay Transfer Aura of Decay On Elite Hit
nodes.description:
Hitting a boss or rare enemy with Flay's melee attack transfers your active Aura of Decay to them for up to 6 seconds.

While the aura is attached to an enemy, you can move away from it to avoid the self-inflicted ailments.

nodes.name: Flay Area And Damage Double By Bleeding
nodes.description: Flay has increased area of effect and additional spell damage. These effects are doubled if there is a bleeding enemy within 15 meters.

nodes.name: Flay Axe Dagger Melee Added As Spell
nodes.description: A percentage of the melee damage on your equipped axes or daggers is also applied as spell damage for the Blood Eruption.

nodes.name: Flay More Spell Damage Per 100 Max Mana
nodes.description:
Flay and all skills triggered by its skill tree deal more spell damage per 100 maximum mana. 
Flay has additional mana cost.

nodes.name: Flay Chaos Bolt Chance Per Max Mana
nodes.description:
Directly using Flay and hitting at least one enemy with the melee attack has a chance per 1 maximum mana to release a {Chaos Bolt} towards an enemy.
This effect consumes 2 mana per Chaos Bolt released.

nodes.name: Flay Crit Chance And Leech
nodes.description: Flay has additional critical strike chance, and leeches a percentage of damage dealt as health.

nodes.name: Flay Marrow Shards On Crit
nodes.description:
Flay has additional critical strike multiplier.
Critically hitting at least one enemy with Flay's melee attack has a chance to release Marrow Shards towards another nearby enemy within 6 meters.

nodes.name: Flay Exposed Flesh
nodes.description: Flay inflicts {Exposed Flesh} on hit, a Curse which reduces cold resistance and armor, and increases the target's chance to be frozen.

nodes.name: Flay Blood Eruption More Damage Per Curse
nodes.description: Blood Eruption has increased area of effect and deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each of your curses that were on the enemy.

nodes.name: Flay Eruption Casts Wandering Spirit
nodes.description: Blood Eruption consumes mana to release a Wandering Spirit. This effect can trigger a limited number of times per 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Flay Blood Eruption Spreads Bleeds
nodes.description: Blood Eruption spreads all bleeds on that enemy to a limited amount of other enemies within its range.

nodes.name: Flay Bleed And Bleed Duration
nodes.description: Flay has a chance to inflict bleed on hit, and bleeds inflicted by Flay have increased duration.

nodes.name: Flay More Hit To Chilled Or Frozen
nodes.description:
Flay deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to chilled or frozen enemies.

Flay has additional freeze rate per active skeleton or bone golem.

nodes.name: Flay Spectral Strike On Normal Enemy Hit
nodes.description: If you directly use Flay and hit at least one enemy, but do not hit a boss or rare enemy, a spectral copy of Flay strikes a random nearby boss or rare enemy.

nodes.name: Flay Spectral Strike On Any Enemy Hit
nodes.description:
Directly using Flay and hitting at least one enemy has a chance to trigger a spectral copy of Flay against a nearby enemy if one would not be triggered otherwise.

Spectral copies of Flay have increased area of effect.

nodes.name: Flay Consume Health And Ward For Melee And Spell Damage
nodes.description: Directly using Flay consumes a percentage of your current health and ward. Flay gains additional melee damage per 30 health consumed and additional spell damage per 30 ward consumed by this effect, up to a limited amount of each.

nodes.name: Flay Hits Reduce CD Reaper Form And Reap
nodes.description:
Flay deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Directly using Flay and hitting at least one enemy reduces the remaining cooldown of Reaper Form by a percentage. This can occur a limited number of times per use of Reaper Form or Reap.

nodes.name: Flay Bleed Chance And Dot Damage
nodes.description:
Flay has a chance to inflict bleed on hit, and Flay deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Flay has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Flay Traversal Mode
nodes.description: Flay is now a traversal skill with a cooldown. The Spirit Step can move you from a much further distance and no longer requires a target.

nodes.name: Flay No Spirit Step
nodes.description: The Spirit Step is removed, and Flay has increased attack speed.

nodes.name: Flay Only Blood Eruption
nodes.description:
Flay's melee attack is removed. Flay becomes a spell that directly creates the Blood Eruption, and is now affected by cast speed instead of attack speed.

Any modifiers to Flay's attack speed in its skill tree instead apply to cast speed.

nodes.name: Flay Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Flay's base damage is converted to cold and it now has a chance to freeze. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance.

This node has no effect if {Soul Ripper} is allocated.

nodes.name: Flay Necrotic Conversion
nodes.description:
Flay's base damage is converted to necrotic. Consequently this damage scales with increases to necrotic damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to damned chance.

nodes.name: Flay Poison Conversion
nodes.description:
Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison chance.

This node has no effect if {Soul Ripper} or {Frostblight} are allocated.

nodes.name: Flay Blood Revelry Stack
nodes.description:
When you create a {Blood Eruption}, you gain a stack of {Blood Revelry}, up to 5. Direct uses of Harvest or Rip Blood can consume a stack of Blood Revelry to deal more damage and gain increased area of effect.

Blood Eruptions have a significantly reduced delay before erupting.

nodes.name: Flay More Melee Damage Less Attack Speed
nodes.description:
Flay deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a lower mana cost.

Flay has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Shadow Rend More Damage
nodes.description: Shadow Rend deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Shadow Rend More Damage Less attack speed
nodes.description: Shadow Rend deals more damage, but has less attack speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Resummon Shadow Chance
nodes.description: Shadows consumed by {Shadow Massacre} have a chance to manifest a new shadow afterwards, based on their distance from you. Maximum effect is reached for shadows that are at least 6 meters away.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Health Per Dex Per Shadow
nodes.description: Each shadow consumed by {Shadow Massacre} or {Hidden Strength} restores health based on your dexterity.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Direct Dusk Shroud
nodes.description: You have a chance to gain a stack of {Dusk Shroud} when you directly use Shadow Rend and hit at least one enemy with the shadow's attack.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Shadow Random Dash
nodes.description: The manifested shadow chooses a random enemy to dash toward, ignoring your targeted direction. It can target enemies that are further away.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Damage and Ward per Dusk Shroud
nodes.description: For every {Dusk Shroud} on you up to 20, the shadow's attack deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and grants ward if it hits at least one enemy.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Bleed Double For Shadow
nodes.description: Shadow Rend has additional chance to inflict bleed on hit, doubled for the shadow's attack.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Added Crit Chance
nodes.description: Shadow Rend has additional critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Shock and Crit Multi per Shock
nodes.description: Shadow Rend has additional chance to shock enemies on hit, and it has additional critical strike multiplier per shock on the enemy.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Crit Multi and Blind
nodes.description: Shadow Rend has additional critical strike multiplier, and additional chance to blind enemies on hit.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Shadow Shadow Daggers
nodes.description: The shadow's attack has a chance to inflict Shadow Daggers on hit.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Shadow Blades over Traversal
nodes.description: Traversal skills consume all stacks of {Ghost Blades} over the course of their duration.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Frailty and Slow
nodes.description: Shadow Rend has a chance to inflict frailty and slow on hit.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Penetration per Unique Ailment
nodes.description: Shadow Rend has additional physical penetration per unique negative ailment on the enemy, up to 5.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Frenzy
nodes.description: Directly using Shadow Rend grants Frenzy for a duration, and Shadow Rend deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you have frenzy.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Buffed In Smoke Bomb
nodes.description: While you are inside your {Smoke Bomb}, Shadow Rend has increased attack speed and a lower mana cost.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Attack Speed and Mana Cost
nodes.description: Shadow Rend has increased attack speed and a lower mana cost.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Armor Shred and Melee Area
nodes.description:
Shadow Rend has increased melee area for the shadow's attack.

The shadow's attack has a chance to shred armor on hit, doubled with a bow.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Multishot Cascade
nodes.description:
Directly using Shadow Rend consumes existing shadows to make them imitate Multishot or Shadow Cascade, depending on your equipped weapon type. Each Shadow Cascade or Multishot imitated consumes mana.

This node has no effect if {Hidden Strength} is allocated.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Shadow Forward Dash
nodes.description: Shadow Rend no longer moves you. The manifested shadow dashes forward 5 meters in the targeted direction before attacking, and will choose a target within range upon arriving.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Mana Damage Melee Area consumption
nodes.description:
Directly using Shadow Rend consumes all shadows. It restores mana if you consume at least 1 shadow.

For each shadow consumed after the first, it gains more damage and more melee area (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Traversal
nodes.description:
Shadow Rend is now a traversal skill. You dash up to 7 meters forward after manifesting the shadow.

Shadow Rend deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a cooldown.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Lightning Conversion
nodes.description: Shadow Rend's base physical damage is converted to lightning damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Shadow Blades
nodes.description: Directly using Shadow Rend and hitting at least one enemy with the shadow's attack grants stacks of {Ghost Blades}, up to 9. Stacks of Ghost Blades are consumed 3 times per second while moving to throw a Ghost Blade at a nearby enemy.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Poison and Hit Per Poison
nodes.description:
Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison chance for Shadow Rend.

Shadow Rend deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per poison on the enemy, up to 30.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend More Bow to Damaged and Bow Forward
nodes.description: Shadow Rend deals more bow damage to damaged enemies. When used with a bow, Shadow Rend moves you forwards instead of backwards.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Added Charges
nodes.description: Shadow Rend has an additional charge.

nodes.name: Shadow Rend Shuriken Umbral throw chance
nodes.description:
You have a chance to throw {Shurikens} or {Umbral Blades} at a nearby enemy when you jump and when you land, consuming 70% of the skill's mana cost each time.

The skill chosen is your most recently directly used skill among them, or else random.

nodes.name: Bladestorm consume Umbral Blade More Damage
Bladestorm Increased Shuriken rate above Half Mana
Bladestorm Duration and Mana Cost
nodes.description: Bladestorms have an increased duration and lower mana cost.

nodes.name: Bladestorm Spread to Max
nodes.description: Directly casting Bladestorm throws up to your maximum number of Bladestorms in a spread in front of you, but Bladestorm has additional mana cost.

nodes.name: Bladestorm Speed Per Dex
nodes.description: Bladestorms have increased movement speed based on your dexterity.

nodes.name: Bladestorm Move Speed from Shift
nodes.description: Bladestorms gain more movement speed (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 1 second if you {Shift} through any part of the Bladestorm.

nodes.name: Bladestorm consume Umbral Blade More Damage
nodes.description: Each {Umbral Blade} thrown into a Bladestorm is destroyed upon landing to grant the Bladestorm more damage and radius (both multiplicative with other modifiers) for 4 seconds, up to 40 stacks.

nodes.name: Bladestorm Blade Frenzy stacks
nodes.description: Each Bladestorm created grants stacks of {Blade Frenzy}. Your next direct cast of Shurikens or Umbral Blades consumes all stacks to gain additional throwing damage and projectiles thrown per stack.

nodes.name: Bladestorm Increased Shuriken rate above Half Mana
nodes.description: Bladestorms cast {Shurikens} with increased frequency.

nodes.name: Bladestorm Armor Shred
nodes.description: Bladestorms have a chance to shred armor on hit.

nodes.name: Bladestorm Acid Flask Area
nodes.description: {Acid Flasks} which explode inside a Bladestorm deal more damage and have more radius (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Bladestorm 2h Area DW Hit Rate
nodes.description:
Bladestorm has increased area with a two handed melee weapon or bow equipped.

Bladestorm has increased hit rate while dual wielding.

nodes.name: Bladestorm Weapon Bonuses
nodes.description: Bladestorm has additional critical strike chance per equipped dagger, chance to inflict bleed on hit per equipped one handed sword, and additional critical strike multiplier with a two handed sword.

nodes.name: Bladestorm Area and Attack Speed
nodes.description: Bladestorm has increased area and increased attack speed.

nodes.name: Bladestorm Added Crit
nodes.description: Bladestorm has additional critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Bladestorm More Damage
nodes.description: Bladestorm deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Bladestorm More Hit and Reduced Mana Cost
nodes.description: Bladestorm deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a lower mana cost.

nodes.name: Bladestorm Shadow Dagger Double Smoke
nodes.description: Bladestorm has a chance on hit to inflict {Shadow Daggers}. This chance is doubled if the enemy is inside a {Smoke Bomb}.

nodes.name: Bladestorm Detonate Caltrops
nodes.description: {Blade Detonations} create {Caltrops} in the area. This effect can occur a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

nodes.name: Bladestorm Detonate Haste Duration
nodes.description: You and allies hit by {Blade Detonation} gain Haste for a duration.

nodes.name: Bladestorm Detonate Mana per Eruption
nodes.description: You gain mana each time you are hit by one of your own {Blade Detonations}.

nodes.name: Bladestorm Bleed Chance
nodes.description: Bladestorm has a chance to inflict bleed on hit.

nodes.name: Bladestorm Slow Chance
nodes.description: Bladestorm has a chance to slow enemies on hit.

nodes.name: Bladestorm Seeks Enemies
nodes.description: Bladestorm slowly seeks out enemies.

nodes.name: Bladestorm Shotguns
nodes.description:
Bladestorms have more movement speed (multiplicative with other modifiers), and multiple Bladestorms can now hit the same target simultaneously.

Bladestorm has increased mana cost and duration. Your maximum number of Bladestorms is reduced.

nodes.name: Bladestorm Shurikens Per Second
nodes.description: Bladestorms repeatedly cast {Shurikens} at enemies within 10 meters of them, consuming 4 mana or Shurikens's mana cost, whichever is higher. This effect is only active while you are above half mana.

nodes.name: Bladestorm Cascade triggers Hit
nodes.description: Bladestorms hit by {Shadow Cascade} will instantly hit enemies in their area.

nodes.name: Bladestorm Blade Detonation
nodes.description: When your Bladestorms collide, they are destroyed and each cause a {Blade Detonation}.

nodes.name: Bladestorm Poison Conversion
nodes.description:
Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison chance for Bladestorm.

This node has no effect if {Frostblade} is allocated.

nodes.name: Bladestorm Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Bladestorm's base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance and poison chance from all sources is converted to frostbite chance.

nodes.name: Dreamslash Shadow Resummon Chance
nodes.description: Shadows performing Dreamslash have a chance to be resummoned after completing the attack.

nodes.name: Dreamslash Blind and More Damage to Blinded
nodes.description: Dreamslash has a chance to blind enemies, and deals more damage to blinded enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Dreamslash Shadow Dagger Doubled for Shadow
nodes.description: Dreamslash has a chance to inflict {Shadow Daggers} on hit. This is doubled for shadows performing Dreamslash.

nodes.name: Dreamslash Added Crit Chance
nodes.description: Dreamslash has additional critical strike chance.

nodes.name: Dreamslash increased Attack Speed and reduced Mana Cost
nodes.description: Dreamslash has increased attack speed, and its mana cost is lower.

nodes.name: Dreamslash More Damage
nodes.description: Dreamslash deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Dreamslash Armor Shred
nodes.description: Dreamslash hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

nodes.name: Dreamslash Crit Multi Per Shadow Using Slash
nodes.description: Dreamslash has additional critical strike multiplier per shadow performing Dreamslash.

nodes.name: Dreamslash Increased Area Doubled with 2h
nodes.description: Dreamslash has increased area of effect. This is doubled when using a two handed weapon.

nodes.name: Dreamslash Increased Area for Shadows
nodes.description: Shadows performing Dreamslash have increased area of effect.

nodes.name: Dreamslash Bleed Chance and Shadow Chance Per Bleed
nodes.description:
Dreamslash has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

When you directly use Dreamslash and hit an enemy, you have a chance per bleed on that enemy to create a shadow nearby the enemy. This effect has a cooldown.

nodes.name: Dreamslash Frosbite and Chill Chance
nodes.description: Dreamslash has a chance to inflict frostbite and chill on hit.

nodes.name: Dreamslash Shadow Uses Throwing Skill
nodes.description: Shadows performing Dreamslash also use a random specialized throwing skill, consuming mana equal to a percentage of that skill's mana cost. This effect can occur a limited number of times per second, and will not choose skills that have a cooldown.

nodes.name: Dreamslash More Damage Per Recent Shadow Created
nodes.description:
Dreamslash deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per shadow created in the past 3 seconds, up to a maximum.

Dreamslash now has a minimum mana cost.

nodes.name: Dreamslash Mana to Guarantee Resummon
nodes.description: A limited number of shadows performing Dreamslash can consume mana to guarantee being resummoned.

nodes.name: Dreamslash Ignite Chance Double for Shadow
nodes.description: Dreamslash has a chance to ignite enemies. This is doubled for shadows performing Dreamslash.

nodes.name: Dreamslash Bleed Slow Ward per Shroud
nodes.description: Dreamslash has a chance to cause enemies to bleed per {Crimson Shroud}, a chance to slow enemies per {Dusk Shroud}, and grants ward on hit per {Silver Shroud}.

nodes.name: Dreamslash Haste and Attack Speed while Hasted
nodes.description: Dreamslash has a chance on hit to grant {Haste} for a short duration. Dreamslash has increased attack speed while you have Haste.

nodes.name: Dreamslash Refraction
nodes.description: When you directly use Dreamslash and consume a Dream stack, Dreamslash has a chance to refract towards an enemy within 8 meters. This can hit the same enemies again.

nodes.name: Dreamslash Dream Stack on Kill or Elite Hit
nodes.description: You have a chance to gain a {Dream} stack when you kill an enemy or hit a boss or rare enemy with Dreamslash, and Dreamslash has additional critical strike chance when consuming a Dream stack.

nodes.name: Dreamslash Dream Stack increased rate per Dexterity
nodes.description: The rate at which you gain {Dream} stacks is increased by your dexterity.

nodes.name: Dreamslash No Movement
nodes.description: Dreamslash no longer moves you. It instead unleashes a wave of damage in the targeted direction, hitting all enemies in its path. It is still a melee attack.

nodes.name: Dreamslash Cold Conversion
nodes.description:
Dreamslash's base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold, but not to physical damage. 

Bleed chance and ignite chance from all sources are converted to frostbite chance.

nodes.name: Dreamslash Consume Shadows for Dream Stacks
nodes.description:
Shadows no longer perform Dreamslash.

If you directly use Dreamslash while you are below your maximum {Dream} stacks, you will consume a shadow near an enemy to gain a Dream stack and perform Dreamslash starting from the shadow's location.

nodes.name: Dreamslash Dream Aura
nodes.description:
When you use Dreamslash you gain {Dream Aura} for 4 seconds, which has a radius equal to Dreamslash's range. While Dream Aura is active, enemies within its range have an additional chance to receive critical strikes.

While you do not have Dream Aura active, Dreamslash has increased range.

nodes.name: Dreamslash Gains Dream Stacks
nodes.description:
You gain a stack of {Dream} every 2 seconds, up to a maximum.

Directly using Dreamslash can consume a Dream stack to grant the attack more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and cause it to choose a random nearby target.

nodes.name: Dreamslash Fire Conversion
nodes.description:
Dreamslash's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire, but not to physical damage. 

Bleed chance and frostbite chance from all sources are converted to ignite chance. Chill chance from all sources is converted to fire resistance shred chance.

nodes.name: Dreamslash Chain Refraction
nodes.description: Refracted Dreamslashes can also refract, but the chance is halved after each refraction.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Cold Res Shred Chance
nodes.description: Your tide elemental has a chance to shred cold resistance on hit.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Gains Wellspring Aura
nodes.description: Your tide elemental gains {Wellspring}, an aura that grants additional cold spell damage and increased cast speed to allies within 18 meters.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Physical Conversion
nodes.description:
Your tide elemental becomes a {Wind Elemental}. The base cold damage of your tide elemental's spells are converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not with increases to cold damage.

Frostbite chance and cold resistance shred from all sources are converted to frailty chance and physical resistance shred, respectively.

Your tide elemental gains additional dodge rating.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Lightning Conversion
nodes.description:
Your tide elemental becomes a {Thunder Elemental}. The base cold damage of your tide elemental's spells are converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not with increases to cold damage.

Frostbite chance and cold resistance shred from all sources are converted to shock chance and lightning resistance shred, respectively.

Your tide elemental gains additional critical strike multiplier.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Consumes Elemental Fury
nodes.description:
When your tide elemental directly casts {Elemental Bolt} while at maximum stacks of {Elemental Fury}, it consumes all stacks to gain an additional projectile per stack.

Elemental Bolt cast this way fires its projectiles in a tight volley, and can hit the same target multiple times.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental No Cooldown On Summon
nodes.description:
Summon Tide Elemental no longer has a cooldown, but it costs additional mana.

The {Geyser} that occurs when casting Summon Tide Elemental deals more damage and has more area of effect (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Is Totem
nodes.description:
Your tide elemental is now a totem. It cannot move, but is affected by totem modifiers.

Your tide elemental deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Elemental More Damage
nodes.description: Your tide elemental deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Crit Chance And Crit Multi
nodes.description: Your tide elemental has additional critical strike chance and critical strike multiplier.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Crit Chance From Mana
nodes.description: Your tide elemental has additional critical strike chance based on your maximum mana.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Cast Speed And Movement Speed
nodes.description: Your tide elemental has increased cast speed and movement speed.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Bolt Additional Projectiles
nodes.description: Your tide elemental's {Elemental Bolt} fires additional projectiles in a cone.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Bolt Nova And Additional Projectiles
nodes.description:
{Elemental Bolt}'s projectiles are fired in a nova, targeting enemies within 12 meters.

Elemental Bolt fires additional projectiles, but your tide elemental has less cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Gains Elemental Fury Stacks
nodes.description:
When your tide elemental directly casts {Elemental Bolt} it gains {Elemental Fury} for 4 seconds, stacking up to a maximum.

Each stack of Elemental Fury grants increased cast speed for Elemental Bolt.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental More Damage Per Second Summoned
nodes.description: Your tide elemental deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) the longer it has remained alive, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Geyser Repeat Chance From Totems
nodes.description: {Geyser} has a chance to repeat from each totem within 12 meters. Each cast can hit the same enemy.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Geyser Increased Area
nodes.description: Your tide elemental's {Geyser} has increased area of effect.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Geyser Cooldown Recovery Speed
nodes.description: {Geyser} has increased cooldown recovery speed.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Geyser Casts Elemental Bolt
nodes.description: While you are above half mana, {Geyser} consumes your mana to also cast {Elemental Bolt} a number of times from its location, targeting enemies within 12 meters.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Redirects Tornado
