nodes.description: When one of your {Tornadoes} hits your tide elemental, the tide elemental redirects it towards an enemy within 12 meters and grants the tornado more damage and speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers) for a duration.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Chance To Recast Tornado
nodes.description: Whenever you create a {Tornado} at least 4 meters away from your tide elemental, you have a chance to create a Tornado at your tide elemental's location as well.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Health Regen From Mana Regen
nodes.description:
Your tide elemental gains a percentage of your increased mana regeneration as increased health regeneration.

It also gains additional health regeneration.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Cooldown Reset On Death
nodes.description:
If your tide elemental dies, its cooldown is reset.

Your tide elemental has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Wellspring Effect Per Attunement
nodes.description: {Wellspring}'s buffs have increased effect on players based on your attunement.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Wellspring Doubled On Totems
nodes.description: {Wellspring}'s buffs are significantly more effective on totems (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it no longer affects players.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Wellspring Chain Chance For Storm Crows
nodes.description: {Wellspring} grants Storm Crows a chance to chain to two additional enemies with their basic lightning spell.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental More Damage Per Storm Crow
nodes.description: Your tide elemental deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per active {Storm Crow}.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Moves Totems
nodes.description:
When you summon your tide elemental, your totems are moved to surround it.

Totems that were moved gain additional duration, up to a maximum.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Frostbite Chance
nodes.description:
Your tide elemental has a chance to inflict frostbite on hit.

This effect is doubled with at least 80 attunement.

nodes.name: Summon Elemental Gains Maelstrom When You Do
nodes.description: Your tide elemental has a chance to cast {Maelstrom} whenever you do. Maelstroms cast by your tide elemental in this way use your tide elemental's stats, but your Maelstrom tree.

nodes.name: Radiant Lance Electrify And Slow Chance
nodes.description: Radiant Lance has a chance to {Electrify} and {Slow} on hit.

nodes.name: Radiant Lance Strikes From Above
nodes.description:
Radiant Lance no longer fires a beam forwards. It now unleashes a blast from the sky, hitting enemies within the targeted area.

Radiant Lance deals more damage.

nodes.name: Radiant Lance More Ailment Damage And Electrify Chance
nodes.description: Radiant Lance deals more ailment damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). Additionally, it gains chance to {Electrify} based on your uncapped lightning resistance.

nodes.name: Radiant Lance Mana Efficiency
nodes.description: Radiant Lance has increased mana efficiency.

nodes.name: Radiant Lance Casts Healing Hands On Ally
nodes.description: When you directly cast Radiant Lance and hit at least one other ally, you cast {Healing Hands} on them, consuming mana equal to a percentage of its mana cost.

nodes.name: Radiant Lance Casts Judgement On Elite
nodes.description: When you directly cast Radiant Lance and hit at least one boss or rare enemy, you cast {Judgement} on them, consuming mana equal to a percentage of its mana cost.

nodes.name: Radiant Lance Strikes Above And Forwards
nodes.description:
Radiant Lance now shoots a beam forwards and a blast from the sky. An enemy can be hit by both simultaneously.

Radiant Lance has less cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has additional mana cost.

Radiant Lance no longer scales with attunement, and instead gains spell void damage per vitality.

nodes.name: Radiant Lance Places Reliquary
nodes.description:
You no longer directly cast Radiant Lance. Instead, you place a {Reliquary} that casts it for you for 6 seconds. Reliquaries have 55% less cast speed, resulting in a base cast rate of once every 2 seconds. Radiant Lance has increased mana cost.

You can have a maximum of 1 Reliquary by default, and gain additional max Reliquaries based on your attunement.

Reliquaries casting Radiant Lance count as you indirectly casting it. This means it still scales with your stats, not the minion's stats. For example, to increase how frequently they cast Radiant Lance, you must increase your cast speed.

It now deals more damage based on your maximum mana.

nodes.name: Sorc Chill
nodes.description: You have a chance to chill enemies when you are hit, and your skills have a chance to chill enemies on hit. This effect is doubled for cold skills.

nodes.name: Sorc Increased Spell Damage On Expensive Ability Use
nodes.description: You deal increased spell damage and have additional ward retention.

nodes.name: Sorc Lightning Crit Chance
nodes.description: You have an increased chance to critically strike with spells. This effect is doubled for lightning skills.

nodes.name: Sorc Ward On Elemental Spell Hit
nodes.description:
You have a chance to be granted ward whenever you hit an enemy with a fire, cold, or lightning skill.

This effect has a 10 second cooldown, but the cooldown is not shared between different elements, so you can gain ward from a fire hit and a lightning hit within the same 10 second duration.

nodes.name: Sorc Intelligence and Chance for Ele Spell Damage
nodes.description: You have additional Intelligence and you gain additional ward decay threshold scaling with your Intelligence.

nodes.name: Sorc Lightning Nova On Distant Crit
nodes.description: When you critically strike an enemy from at least 4 meters away, you have a chance to cast {Spark Nova,} a spell that deals lightning damage to nearby enemies.

nodes.name: Sorc Elemental Damage And Stun Chance
Sorc Adaptive Spell Damage And Cast Speed
Sorc Damage To Shocked And Spark Charges
nodes.description: You deal more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to shocked enemies.

nodes.name: Sorc Mana And Mana Before Health
nodes.description: You have additional mana and a portion of the damage you take is dealt to your mana before health.

nodes.name: Sorc Ward On Potion Use
nodes.description: Whenever you use a potion, you gain ward based on your intelligence.

nodes.name: Sorc Base Spell Damage
nodes.description:
You have additional spell damage and you have a chance to refund a portion of the mana cost paid when directly using a skill.

These values are doubled if you have 300 maximum mana and tripled if you have 1000 maximum mana.

nodes.name: SB Ward On Hit
nodes.description: You gain ward when you use an elemental melee attack and hit at least one enemy.

nodes.name: SB Melee And Spell Damage
nodes.description: You have additional melee damage and spell damage.

nodes.name: SB Melee Ailments
nodes.description: Your fire melee attacks have a chance to ignite on hit. Your cold melee attacks have a chance to chill on hit. Your lightning melee attacks have a chance to shock on hit.

nodes.name: SB Fire Aura While Moving Or Using Melee
nodes.description:
While moving or using a melee attack, you have a chance each second to cast {Fire Aura}. 

This chance is doubled if you have less than 3 stacks of {Fire Aura}.

nodes.name: SB Frost Claw
nodes.description:
When you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to cast {Frost Claw}.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of {Frost Claw's} mana cost.

nodes.name: SB Arcane Shield
nodes.description: You have increased armor and additional health.

nodes.name: SB Melee Cold and Freeze
nodes.description: Your melee attacks deal additional cold damage and you have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

nodes.name: SB Fire Aura Area And Damage
nodes.description: Your {Fire Auras} from all sources deal damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: SB Cold Fire Aura
nodes.description: You deal increased cold damage and have a higher freeze rate multiplier.

nodes.name: SB Arcane Shield Armor
nodes.description: Each stack of {Arcane Shielding} also grants increased armor.

nodes.name: SB Melee Lightning And Spark Charge
nodes.description: Your melee attacks deal additional lightning damage and your lightning melee attacks have a chance to apply a {Spark Charge} on hit.

nodes.name: SB Attack Speed and Ward On Hit
nodes.description: You have increased melee attack speed, and you gain ward when you use an elemental melee attack and hit at least one enemy.

nodes.name: SB Lightning Fire Aura
nodes.description: You deal increased lightning damage.

nodes.name: SB Dex And Int
nodes.description: You have additional dexterity and intelligence.

nodes.name: SB Dual Wielding
nodes.description: You can dual wield melee weapons by equipping a sword in your off hand. While dual wielding, you have increased attack and cast speed, but take more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: SB Mana on Hit
nodes.description: You have additional health and you have a chance to regain mana when you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy.

nodes.name: SB Speed And Dodge Rating
nodes.description: You have increased movement speed, attack speed, and dodge rating.

nodes.name: SB Melee Lightning and Parry Chance
nodes.description: Your melee attacks deal additional lightning damage and you have a chance to parry attacks.

nodes.name: SB Melee Ignite
nodes.description: Your melee hits have a chance to ignite on hit and the ignites they inflict have increased effect.

nodes.name: SB Melee Cold and Cast Speed
SB Fire Aura on Hit
nodes.description: You have additional fire resistance and you have a chance to cast {Fire Aura} when you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy, up to a limited number of times per second.

nodes.name: SB Int And Endurance
nodes.description: You have additional intelligence and endurance.

nodes.name: SB Armor And Ward Per Second
nodes.description: You have additional armor and gain ward per second.

nodes.name: SB Health and DoT
nodes.description: You have additional health and your ward decays more slowly.

nodes.name: SB High Cost Melee And Fire Aura Consumption
nodes.description: Your melee attacks deal more elemental damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if they cost 10 or more mana.

nodes.name: SB Blade Weaving
nodes.description:
When you use a melee attack that costs less than 10 mana you gain a stack of {Blade Weaving}, up to a maximum.

When you use a melee attack that costs 10 or more mana the stacks are consumed and the attack deals 15% more elemental damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack consumed.

nodes.name: SB Ward Regen Per Intelligence
nodes.description: You gain ward per second scaling with your intelligence.

nodes.name: SB Blade Conduit
nodes.description:
You have additional mana.

When you indirectly cast a spell you gain a stack of {Blade Conduit} for 4 seconds, up to 6 stacks. Each stack grants increased mana regeneration.

nodes.name: Runemaster Health And Less Damage Taken
nodes.description: You have additional health and you take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) from ignited, shocked or chilled enemies.

nodes.name: Runemaster Mana Cast Speed And Ward Burst
Runemaster Intelligence And Ward On Cast
Runemaster Spell Damage And Crit Chance
nodes.description: After using a traversal skill, your next non-channeled spell has additional spell damage and a higher chance to critically strike.

nodes.name: Runemaster Catalyst Crit Res
nodes.description: While using a Catalyst you have additional Intelligence and take reduced bonus damage from critical strikes.

nodes.name: Runemaster Ward On Traversal
nodes.description: The spell damage and crit chance from the {Never Late} node now also apply to {Traversal} skills, and you gain ward when you use a {Traversal} skill.

nodes.name: Runemaster Caster Weapon Bonuses
nodes.description: You have additional critical strike multiplier while using a wand, additional ward retention while using a sceptre, and increased cast speed while using a staff.

nodes.name: Runemaster Damage To Bosses Decree
nodes.description: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to Bosses and Rare enemies.

nodes.name: Runemaster Ward Burst Decree
nodes.description: You gain ward every 2 seconds.

nodes.name: Runemaster Brand Of Deception
nodes.description: Your damage over time has additional elemental penetration

nodes.name: Runemaster Crit Damage And Ward
nodes.description:
You gain ward when you critically strike enemies.

This can trigger a maximum of 5 times per second.

nodes.name: Runemaster Armor While Channeling
nodes.description: You have additional armor while channeling per active {Rune} from {Runic Invocation}.

nodes.name: Runemaster DoT vs Branded
nodes.description: You deal more damage over time to {Branded} enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Runemaster Runeword Avalanche
nodes.description:
When you directly use a Cold Skill you have a chance to gain {Runeword: Avalanche}, a buff that grants additional Spell Cold Damage and grants additional Endurance Threshold per stack of Ignite on the attacker.

This buff lasts 6 seconds and does not stack.

nodes.name: Runemaster Runeword Duration
nodes.description: You have additional Intelligence, and {Runeword Buffs} last longer.

nodes.name: Runemaster Speed After Traversal
nodes.description: After using a {Traversal} skill you gain increased cast speed and movement speed for a short duration. This buff cannot stack.

nodes.name: Runemaster Increased Area
nodes.description: Your area skills have increased area, and when you directly use an area skill and hit an enemy you gain ward per active {Rune} from {Runic Invocation}.

nodes.name: Runemaster Endurance And Mana
nodes.description: You have additional endurance and maximum mana.

nodes.name: Runemaster Runeword Inferno
nodes.description:
When you directly use a Fire Skill you have a chance to gain {Runeword: Inferno}, a buff that grants additional Spell Fire Damage and grants you more Armor per stack of Shock on the Attacker.

This buff lasts 6 seconds and does not stack.

nodes.name: Runemaster Runeword Hurricane
nodes.description:
When you directly use a Lightning Skill you have a chance to gain {Runeword: Hurricane}, a buff that grants additional Spell Lightning Damage and Freeze Rate Multiplier.

This buff lasts 6 seconds and does not stack.

nodes.name: SB Slow Cast
nodes.description: You have additional spell damage, but your spells take longer to cast.

nodes.name: Primalist Health On Hit Every 3 Seconds
nodes.description: You have increased health and every 3 seconds your next hit restores your health.

nodes.name: Primalist Dual Wielding
nodes.description: You can dual wield melee weapons by equipping an axe or sword in your off hand. While dual wielding, you have increased attack and cast speed, but take more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Primalist Potion Effect On Minions
nodes.description: Your minions deal increased damage, and using a potion also heals your minions for a percentage of the amount it heals you.

nodes.name: Primalist Shared Melee Damage And Leech
Primalist Minion Damage On Hit Every 3 Seconds
nodes.description: The healing from {Hunter's Restoration} also applies to your minions, and when you trigger Hunter's Restoration, your minions gain increased damage for 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Primalist Physical Cold Lightning
nodes.description: You deal increased physical, cold, and lightning damage. These bonuses are doubled while you have an active minion.

nodes.name: Primalist Low Health
nodes.description:
While at low health (below 35%) you take less damage and deal more melee damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

Additionally, when damage leaves you at low health you gain these benefits for 5 seconds if you aren't already at low health.

nodes.name: Primalist Adaptive Spell Damage
nodes.description: You and your totems deal additional spell damage. This bonus is tripled while using an axe.

nodes.name: Primalist Weapon Melee Damage
nodes.description: You deal additional melee damage with most two handed weapons. The amount and damage type depend on the type of weapon used.

nodes.name: BM Strength And Health
nodes.description: You have additional strength and take less damage from nearby enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: BM Slow Melee
nodes.description: Every 5 seconds, your next melee attack deals increased damage and grants {Aspect of the Shark} for 3 seconds, a buff that grants 10% more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increases melee attack speed by 10%.

nodes.name: BM One Companion
nodes.description:
You are limited to a single companion.

Your companion is larger and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: BM Resistance on Melee Hit
nodes.description: You are granted {Aspect of the Boar} for a duration when you use a traversal skill or Evade, a buff that grants 30% increased bleed duration and reduces damage taken by 15%. This effect has a 2 second cooldown. You also have additional endurance.

nodes.name: BM Heal on Companion Ability
nodes.description: You and your companions have additional health, and you and your companions are healed whenever you use a companion ability.

nodes.name: BM Phys Bleed
nodes.description: {Aspect of the Boar} also grants a chance for attacks and spells to cause enemies to bleed and physical penetration with bleed.

nodes.name: BM Shark Shred
nodes.description: {Aspect of the Shark} also grants attacks and spells a chance to reduce enemy armor.

nodes.name: BM Boar Damage Taken
nodes.description:
{Aspect of the Boar} grants additional damage reduction, and now also grants increased health regeneration.

Additionally, your hits have a chance to grant you {Aspect of the Boar}.

nodes.name: BM Companion Damage And Shared Ele Res
nodes.description: Your companions deal increased damage, and you and your minions have additional elemental resistance.

nodes.name: BM Dex And Move Speed
nodes.description: You have additional dexterity and increased movement speed.

nodes.name: BM Shark on Kill
nodes.description: You gain health and have a chance to be granted {Aspect Of The Shark} for 3 seconds whenever you kill an enemy or hit a boss or rare enemy.

nodes.name: BM Vitality
nodes.description: You have additional vitality and a higher endurance threshold.

nodes.name: BM Haste on Hit
nodes.description: You and your minions have increased dodge rating, and you and your minions have a chance to gain {Haste} for 1 second on hit.

nodes.name: BM Aspect Duration And Health
nodes.description: All {Aspects} have increased duration, and you have additional health.

nodes.name: BM Lynx
nodes.description:
You and your companions have an increased chance to critically strike. 

When you use a companion ability, you and your companions are granted {Aspect of the Lynx} for a duration, a buff that grants +5% critical strike chance and 100% increased stun chance.

nodes.name: BM Shared Physical Res
nodes.description: You have a higher endurance threshold and you and your minions have additional physical resistance.

nodes.name: BM Viper On Hit
nodes.description:
You and your companions have increased melee attack speed.

When you hit an enemy, you have a chance for you and your companions to be granted {Aspect of the Viper} for 3 seconds, a buff that grants 100% chance to poison on hit and 20% more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: BM Shark Duration And Effect
nodes.description: {Aspect of the Shark} is more effective and lasts longer.

nodes.name: BM One Companion Health
nodes.description:
You are limited to only one companion.

Your companion is granted more health and deals more damage (both effects are multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: BM Lynx Crit Multi
nodes.description: You and your companions' critical strikes deal more damage, and {Aspect of the Lynx} now also grants critical strike damage.

nodes.name: BM Viper Duration
nodes.description: {Aspect of the Viper} lasts longer and grants you Poison Penetration.

nodes.name: BM Shark Stacks
nodes.description: {Aspect of the Shark} can now stack up to 5 times, but it is significantly less effective (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: BM Companion Aspect Effect
nodes.description: Your companions receive increased effect from your {Aspects}, and a percentage of all damage taken is redirected to your highest health minion.

nodes.name: BM Health And Reduced Bonus Damage From Crits
nodes.description: You have additional health, and your minions have increased health. Additionally, you and your companions take reduced bonus damage from critical strikes.

nodes.name: Shaman Armour With A Totem
nodes.description: You and your totems have additional armor while you have an active totem and you have increased mana regen while you have an active totem.

nodes.name: Shaman Shared Damage And Tenacity
nodes.description: You and your minions gain increased damage.

nodes.name: Shaman Attunement And Protection
nodes.description: You have additional attunement. You and your minions penetrate enemy physical and elemental resistances.

nodes.name: Shaman Attack And Cast Speed With A Totem
nodes.description: You have increased attack and cast speed while you have an active totem.

nodes.name: Shaman Shock Chance and Chill Chance
nodes.description: You and your minions have additional health, a chance to shock and a chance to chill on hit.

nodes.name: Shaman Stun Chance and Avoidance and Attunement
Shaman Storm Bringer
nodes.description: You and your minions have increased lightning damage and additional lightning resistance.

nodes.name: Shaman Wind Bringer
nodes.description: You and your minions have increased cold damage, increased physical damage and additional dodge rating.

nodes.name: Shaman Totem Speed
nodes.description: Your totems have increased attack and cast speed and you have a chance to gain {Haste} for 3 seconds when you directly summon a totem.

nodes.name: Shaman Hail Bringer
nodes.description: You and your minions have a chance to chill on hit, a higher chance to freeze enemies and additional cold resistance.

nodes.name: Shaman Stun Chance
nodes.description:
You and your minions gain increased stun chance.

Additionally, you have additional Endurance.

nodes.name: Shaman Shared Flat Spell Lightning Damage
nodes.description: You and your minions gain additional spell lightning damage.

nodes.name: Shaman Slow Melee Cold
nodes.description: You have additional strength

nodes.name: Shaman Shared Flat Cold Damage
nodes.description: You and your minions deal additional cold damage with spells and attacks, and your hits have a chance to inflict Frostbite.

nodes.name: Shaman Shared Base Spell Damage
nodes.description: You and your minions have additional spell damage.

nodes.name: Shaman Protection Per Totem
nodes.description:
You have additional physical and elemental resistance for each active totem.

Additionally, your totems have resistances against all damage types.

nodes.name: Shaman Freeze Chance
nodes.description: You and your minions have a higher chance to freeze enemies, and you have increased mana regeneration.

nodes.name: Shaman Slow Melee Lightning
nodes.description: Your melee attacks deal additional lightning damage. Every 2 seconds, this effect is tripled for your next melee attack.

nodes.name: Shaman Chance to Cast Lightning on Cast
nodes.description:
You have increased spell damage.
Your direct spell casts have a chance to cast {Storm Bolt}.
While channeling, you have a chance to cast {Storm Bolt} every second.

nodes.name: Shaman Melee Damage Per Totem
nodes.description: While you have an active totem you have more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Shaman Chance to Cast Lightning on Hit
nodes.description: Your melee attacks have a chance to cast {Storm Bolt} on hit. This effect can occur a limited number of times per second.

nodes.name: Shaman Maelstrom When Hit
nodes.description:
You have additional health and mana, and have a chance to cast {Maelstrom} when hit. 

This effect has a 3 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Shaman Area And Less Damage Taken From Shocked
nodes.description:
Your area skills have increased area, and you take less damage from shocked enemies.

Your totems also gain the area increases for area skills.

nodes.name: Shaman Spell Damage Per Totem
nodes.description: While you have an active totem you have more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Shaman Totem Stun Immunity
nodes.description: You have additional health and armor, and these effects are tripled for your totems.

nodes.name: Druid Shared Physical And Poison Damage
Druid Healing Effect And Eterra's Blessing
nodes.description: Increases healing effectiveness for you and your minions.

nodes.name: Druid Cold Damage And Healing Effect
nodes.description: Increases cold damage and healing effectiveness for you and your minions.

nodes.name: Druid Damage While Transformed And Rage Decay
nodes.description: You deal increased damage while transformed and your rage decays slower.

nodes.name: Druid Melee Bleed And Spell Poison Chance
nodes.description: Your melee attacks have a chance to inflict Bleed on hit and your spells have a chance to inflict Poison on hit.

nodes.name: Druid Minion Health And Healing Effect
Druid Thorn Shield And Armor
nodes.description: You have a chance to cast {Thorn Shield} on yourself when you are hit and you have increased armor and reflect damage back to attackers.

nodes.name: Druid Shared Attack And Cast Speed
nodes.description: Increases the attack and cast speed of you and your minions.

nodes.name: Druid Shared Cold Damage And Freeze Rate
Druid No Rage Decay Out Of Combat
nodes.description: Your rage only decays if you have used an ability recently (past 4 seconds).

nodes.name: Druid Crit Chance And Crit Leech
Druid Attunement And Crit Avoidance Per Attunement
Druid Stacking Less Hit Damage Taken
nodes.description: Your melee hits have a 20% chance to grant you a stack of {Impervious} causing you to take less damage from hits (multiplicative with other modifiers), but you lose a stack when you are hit and you lose all stacks after 10 seconds of not gaining any stacks.

nodes.name: Druid Shared Added Physical Damage
nodes.description: You and your minions deal additional physical damage with spells and melee attacks.

nodes.name: Druid Minion Damage And Healing Effectiveness
Druid Health Regen And Mana Regen
Druid Shapeshifter Duration
nodes.description: You gain the {Shapeshifter} buff for a limited duration when you transform, granting you increased armor and damage.

nodes.name: Druid Shapeshifter Crit Chance And Crit Multi
nodes.description: You have increased critical strike chance and multiplier while you have the {Shapeshifter} buff.

nodes.name: Druid Damage With Exactly One Companion
nodes.description: You are limitted to one companion, but that companion has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers). If you control a companion you deal increased damage and have additional armour.

nodes.name: Druid Shapeshifter Heal On Transform
nodes.description: You and your minions are healed when you transform. This scales with increases to healing effectiveness.

nodes.name: Druid Shared Poison Chance And Vine On Kill
nodes.description: Your and your minions' hits have a chance to poison.

nodes.name: Druid Crit Chance And Rage Gain On Crit
Druid Health and Endurance Threshold
nodes.description: You have additional health and gain a percentage of your maximum health as endurance threshold.

nodes.name: Druid Shared Added Spell Damage
nodes.description: You and your companions have additional spell damage.

nodes.name: Druid Shared Cold Penetration
nodes.description: You and your minions have additional cold penetration.

nodes.name: Druid Damage Over Time While Transformed
nodes.description: You deal increased damage over time while transformed and take less damage over time in human form (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Rogue Attack Speed
nodes.description: Your melee, throwing, and bow attacks have increased attack speed and deal additional physical damage.

nodes.name: Rogue Less Damage While Moving
nodes.description: You take less damage while moving (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased dodge rating.

nodes.name: Rogue Dual Wielding
nodes.description: You can dual wield melee weapons by equipping a sword or dagger in your off hand. While dual wielding, you have increased attack and cast speed, but take more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Rogue Haste
nodes.description: You have a chance to gain {Haste} for one second on hit and deal increased damage based on your increased movement speed.

nodes.name: Rogue Glancing Blow
nodes.description: You have additional dodge rating and a chance to receieve a {Glancing Blow} when hit.

nodes.name: Rogue Third Attack
nodes.description: Every third melee, throwing, or bow attack deals increased damage.

nodes.name: Rogue Bow And Dagger Poison
nodes.description: You have a chance to poison on hit while you have a dagger or bow equipped.

nodes.name: Rogue Recovery On 0 Cost Skill
nodes.description: When you directly use a skill that costs zero mana and hit an enemy you regain health and mana.

nodes.name: Rogue Crit Chance
nodes.description: You have increased critical strike chance per sword, bow, or dagger you have equipped.

nodes.name: Rogue Bleed on Third Attack
nodes.description: Every third non-channelling melee, throwing, or bow attack also inflicts bleed.

nodes.name: Rogue Damage For Mana
nodes.description: When you directly use a melee or bow attack that costs mana, it consumes additional mana to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: Rogue Health on Glancing Blow
nodes.description: You have additional health and whenever you receive a glancing blow you recover health.

nodes.name: BD Flow
nodes.description: You have increased dodge rating, and you gain health when hitting an enemy.

nodes.name: BD Melee Damage And Move Speed
BD Dexterity And Glancing Blow
nodes.description: You have additional dexterity and you have a chance to receive a {Glancing Blow} when hit.

nodes.name: BD Shadow Damage and Health Restore
nodes.description: When you create a shadow you regain health, and skills used by shadows deal increased damage.

nodes.name: BD Melee Physical Damage and Dodge Rating
nodes.description: You deal additional physical damage with melee and throwing attacks, and you have additional dodge rating, doubled if you have been hit recently.

nodes.name: BD Flow Melee and Throwing Attack speed
nodes.description: Skills that generate or consume {Flow} deal increased damage and have additional critical strike multiplier.

nodes.name: BD Melee and Throw Bleed with Phys Dmg
nodes.description: You deal increased physical damage and have a chance to inflict bleed on hit with melee and throwing attacks.

nodes.name: BD Crit Avoid And Health
nodes.description: You have additional health and critical strike avoidance.

nodes.name: BD Longer Flow with Crit and Bleed
nodes.description: {Flow} is consumed when you use a 5th unique skill rather than a 4th, but the skill that consumes Flow has more critical strike chance and deals more damage over time (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: BD Attack Speed and Dusk Shroud Chance
nodes.description: You have increased melee and throwing attack speed. When you use a melee or throwing attack and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to gain a stack of {Dusk Shroud}. Each stack of Dusk Shroud adds 50 dodge rating and 5% chance to receive a {Glancing Blow} when hit.

nodes.name: BD Parry And Crit
nodes.description: You have additional parry chance and increased critical strike chance.

nodes.name: BD Resist And Endurance
nodes.description: You have additional resistances and endurance.

nodes.name: BD Dodge to Glancing Blow Conversion
nodes.description: Your dodge chance is added as twice as much chance to receive a glancing blow, but you cannot dodge.

nodes.name: BD Damage and Attack Speed Dual Wielding
BD Leech
nodes.description: You leech a portion of melee damage as health, and a portion of your damage over time as health.

nodes.name: BD Dodge Rating and Damage at Full Health
nodes.description: You have additional dodge rating. You have deal increased damage, tripled while at full health.

nodes.name: BD Weapon Combo Specific Bonuses
nodes.description: You gain a bonus while dual wielding depending on your weapon combination.

nodes.name: BD Poison And Bleed
nodes.description: You have additional vitality and deal increased damage over time.

nodes.name: BD Perfection
nodes.description: When you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of Perfection. When you receive a hit you lose all stacks. Each stack of perfection increases your damage.

nodes.name: BD Crit Chance and Vulternability
nodes.description: You have increased critical strike chance and you have a chance to inflict {Critical Vulnerability} on hit.

nodes.name: BD Health On Kill Per Shroud
nodes.description: You have additional health. When you kill an enemy or hit a rare or boss enemy, you regain health for each stack of any {Shroud} on you.

nodes.name: BD Perfection Armor and Dodge
nodes.description: You deal increased damage at full health, and each stack of {Perfection} also grants additional armor and dodge rating.

nodes.name: BD Low Life Crit Chance and Damage Taken
nodes.description:
While at low health you take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you have additional critical strike multiplier.

Additionally, when damage leaves you at low health you gain these benefits for 5 seconds if you aren't already at low health.

nodes.name: BD Armor Shred
nodes.description: Your hits have a chance to shred armor and inflict bleed.

nodes.name: BD Crit Multi and Less Other Damage
nodes.description: You have a higher critical strike multiplier, but you deal less damage with non-critical hits and damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

nodes.name: BD Added Shadows and Damage
nodes.description: Skills used by shadows deal increased damage, and you have a chance to gain a stack of {Dusk Shroud} when you use a melee or throwing attack and hit at least one enemy.

nodes.name: BD Dex Stack
nodes.description: You have additional dexterity.

nodes.name: Marksman Bow Damage and Crit Chance
Marksman Dexterity and Boss Dodge Rating Reduction
nodes.description: You have additional Dexterity and when you hit a boss or rare enemy you reduce its dodge rating for 8 seconds.

nodes.name: Marksman Bow Attack Speed and Health Gain
nodes.description: You have increased bow attack speed and when you use a bow attack and hit at least one enemy you regain health.

nodes.name: Marksman Concentration
nodes.description: By default you have {Concentration} which grants you more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). If you are hit by an enemy within 4m you lose concentration for 4 seconds. Subsequent hits do not reset the cooldown.

nodes.name: Marksman Bow and Throwing Damage
nodes.description: You have increased bow and throwing attack damage and you have a chance to shred armour on hit.

nodes.name: Marksman Elemental Arrows
nodes.description: If you have a bow equipped you gain 1 {Elemental Arrow} per second, up to a maximum of 3. Using a bow attack expends an Elemental Arrow to deal additional bow fire, lightning, and cold damage.

nodes.name: Marksman Critical Vulnerability
nodes.description: You have a chance to inflict Critical Vulnerability on hit.

nodes.name: Marksman DoT Less Taken and More Done
nodes.description: You take less damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers). While wielding a bow you deal increased damage over time.

nodes.name: Marksman Increased Elemental Arrow Damage
nodes.description: If you have a bow equipped you deal increased elemental damage and gain {Elemental Arrows} more frequently.

nodes.name: Marksman Crit Multi and Avoidance
nodes.description: You have a chance to avoid critical strikes and your critical strikes with bow attacks deal more damage.

nodes.name: Marksman Vitality And Potion Healing
nodes.description: You have additional Vitality, and a percentage of healing from your potions is also applied as healing over 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Marksman Health and Bow Health Leech
Marksman Bow Attack Speed On Bow Use
nodes.description: When you use a bow attack you gain {Arrow Storm} which increases your bow attack speed for 3 seconds. You can only gain Arrow Storm once every 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Marksman Dex Glancing Blow Movement Speed
Marksman Sharpshooter
nodes.description: Chance to gain a stack of Sharpshooter when you hit an enemy based on your how far you are from that enemy, up to a maximum at 10m. Each stack of Sharpshooter increases bow damage and lasts 8 seconds.

nodes.name: Marksman Silver Shroud On Proc
nodes.description: When you proc {Arrowstorm} you gain stacks of {Silver Shroud}. Silver Shroud is a buff that gives you 100% chance to dodge the next hit. Dodging a hit with Silver Shroud consumes all stacks, granting you 100 ward per stack.

nodes.name: Marksman Bow Damage and Nearby Damage Taken
Marksman Poison Chance and Penetration
nodes.description: You have additional poison penetration and bow attacks have additional chance to poison on hit.

nodes.name: Marksman Stacking Bow Crit
nodes.description: Adds {Barrage of Pain} to your Marksman Passive, Bow Mastery. You gain a stack and refresh all existing stacks of Bow Mastery by using a bow attack and hitting at least one enemy.

nodes.name: Marksman Bow Damage Per Mana
nodes.description: You have increased mana and mana regen and your bow attacks deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) equal to a portion of their mana cost.

nodes.name: Marksman Sharpshooter Double Damage And Armor Shred
nodes.description: Each stack of Sharpshooter also grants a chance to deal double damage and adds a chance to shred armor on hit.

nodes.name: Marksman Bow Attack Speed And Slow Chance
nodes.description: You have increased bow attack speed and have a chance to slow enemies on hit with bow attacks.

nodes.name: Marksman Mana Cost and Regen
nodes.description: When you directly use a skill that costs zero mana and hit an enemy you regain mana, but bow attacks cost more mana.

nodes.name: Marksman Stacking Crit Multi and Health on Crit
nodes.description: Each stack of Bow Mastery with {Barrage of Pain} also grants additional critical strike multiplier and health gained on crit.

nodes.name: BD Mana Regen
nodes.description: You have a chance to parry hits, and increased mana regeneration.

nodes.name: Falconer Minion Damage And Falcon Crit Chance
Falconer Haste Chance And Damage While Hasted
nodes.description:
You have a chance to gain haste for 2 seconds when you or your {Falcon} hits an enemy.

Additionally, you deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you have haste.

nodes.name: Falconer Crimson Shroud Chance
nodes.description: You have a chance to gain a stack of {Crimson Shroud} when your {Falcon} or {Ballistas} hit an enemy.

nodes.name: Falconer Dodge And Endurance Threshold
nodes.description: You have additional dodge rating and you gain a portion of your maximum health as endurance threshold if you have not been hit recently.

nodes.name: Falconer Bow Damage And Chance To Buff Falcon On Bow Attack
nodes.description: You deal increased damage while wielding a bow and your bow hits have a chance to grant your {Falcon} additional melee damage for 4 seconds. This has no stack limit.

nodes.name: Falconer Spear Buffs
nodes.description: You deal increased damage and have an additional chance to inflict bleed while wielding a spear.

nodes.name: Falconer Added Throwing Damage To Falcon
Falconer Area And Mana Gain On Detonations
nodes.description: Your area skills and your minions' area skills deal damage in a larger area.

nodes.name: Falconer Health And Silver Shroud
nodes.description: When you use a certain ability on your bar, you gain 3 stacks of Silver Shroud. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Falconer Block And Glancing Blow
nodes.description: You have additional block and a chance to receive a glancing blow. Additionally, you regain health whenever you block or recieve a glancing blow.

nodes.name: Falconer Shared Damage And Falcon Leech
Falconer Falcon Instant Abilities And CDR
nodes.description:
{Falcon Strikes} and {Dive Bomb} are now instant cast.

Additionally, {Falcon Strikes} and {Dive Bomb} have a longer cooldown.

nodes.name: Falconer Dodge And Chance To Throw Caltrops On Dodge
nodes.description:
You have additional dodge rating and you now have a chance to drop {Caltrops} around you when you dodge and there is an enemy within 4 meters of you.

This effect has a 2 second cooldown.

nodes.name: Falconer DoT And Ailment Sharing To Falcon
Falconer Share Crit Chance And Crit Multi
Falconer Throwing Damage And Caltrops Apply Frailty
Falconer Armor Per 2 Dex And Increased Armor On Falcon Hits
nodes.description: You have additional armor per point of Dexterity.

nodes.name: Falconer Haste Effect And Haste On Potion Use Plus More Potions
nodes.description: Haste on you has increased effect and you gain haste for a short duration whenever you use a potion.

nodes.name: Falconer Glancing Blow And Double Chance If No Recent Hit
Falconer Less Damage Taken While Moving And Movespeed And Dodge
nodes.description:
You take less damage while moving. Additionally, you have increased movement speed and dodge rating.

These effects are doubled if your {Falcon} has hit an enemy recently.

nodes.name: Falconer Health On Minion Crit Plus Crit Avoidance And Minion Crit Multi
nodes.description:
You regain health when you or your minions crits an enemy.

You have additional critical strike avoidance.

The tier of the sealed affix can roll up to the tier of the corresponding affix on the item. The number of items in the pile is equal to the number of affixes on the item.
